Rewrite as "Lapisan agar nutrisi (gel nutrisi) yang menempel di sekitar akar dan pangkal harus dicuci bersih dulu".

Item 10: 'sg reading of 1.2+' became 'Berat jenis (SG) airnya juga 1,2+'. This is fine, but 'kH 7000+' has no unit. Check whether the source's unit (ppm) is missing, and use the standard 'KH'.

Item 11: 'kH 7000+' is left as-is, fine, but 'sg 1,2+' is okay; the real issue is 'Ikan ini luar biasa langka di dunia ikan hias' being repeated, which is fine. Main error: 'menghirup udara dari permukaan' is acceptable, but 'dipelihara tanpa spesies lain' is fine.

Item 11: 'air dengan kimia seperti Danau Magadi' is awkward. Use 'air dengan kimia seperti air Danau Magadi' or 'air berkarakter kimia seperti Danau Magadi'.

Item 11: "oxygen solubility ... is significantly reduced" became "yang jauh lebih rendah", which is ambiguous. The clause "kelarutan oksigen ... yang sangat asin, yang jauh lebih rendah" reads awkwardly. Rewrite it as "kelarutan oksigen di air Danau Magadi yang sangat asin berkurang drastis".
Item 11: "sg reading of 1.2+" became "Berat jenis (sg) airnya juga 1,2+". This is acceptable. "kH 7000+" is kept without a unit, as in the source, so there is nothing to fix there.

Item 3/Item 1: "cukup sejuk" fine. Item 2: type locality quote left in English is fine.

Item 5: "kayu apung/bogwood" is clumsy. Use "driftwood" or "kayu apung" only. "bogwood" is a different term from "driftwood" in the source.
Item 11: "jari-jari lunak sirip anal" adds "lunak" (soft), which the source does not say ("anal fin rays"). Use "jari-jari sirip anal".
Item 1: "jari-jari lunak sirip anal" has the same added "lunak". Use "jari-jari sirip anal".
Item 10: "pernah teramati menghasilkan telur fertil" is stiff. Say "bertelur dengan telur yang subur" or similar. "Tidak ada pengasuhan oleh induk yang teramati" could be smoother.

Item 8: "cichlid yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa" changes the scope. The English says similarly-sized, non-aggressive characins, cichlids and catfishes. The Indonesian makes "tidak agresif ... ukuran serupa" apply only to cichlids. Rephrase so it covers characin too, e.g. "characin dan cichlid berukuran serupa yang tidak agresif".

Item 10: "pernah teramati bertelur dengan telur yang subur tanpa kehadiran jantan" is awkward and clumsy. Use "pernah teramati bertelur dengan telur yang subur meski tanpa jantan", or better, "menghasilkan telur fertil".
Item 7: "Di akuarium sebaiknya diberi pakan hidup dan beku" is too prescriptive and drops the passive sense of "should be offered". Use "Di akuarium berikan pakan hidup dan beku...".
Item 1: "catfish" is used as an English term in the opening sentence. Add "ikan lele" or "ikan baung" for context, or keep it as a trade term. Use "jari-jari lunak sirip anal" consistently.
Item 5: "Tumpukan kayu (driftwood) yang saling membelit" is unnatural for tangles of driftwood. Use "susunan kayu apung/bogwood yang saling silang".
Item 11: "hanya terdapat di lembah hulu rio Madeira" is awkward. "Upper rio Madeira basin" should be "lembah rio Madeira bagian hulu".
#10: "gerombolan" usually has a negative connotation (gangs). Use "kawanan" or "kelompok" for a group of fish.
#1, #3, #6, #10: "ikan lele" for catfish is acceptable, but Auchenoglanis is a bagrid-type (giraffe) catfish, not a true lele (Clarias). Consider "ikan catfish" or "patin/lele Afrika" for clarity.
#12: "sheatfish" left untranslated; add a local gloss such as "lele Eropa" or keep it in brackets after the Indonesian term.
#2: "Least Concern / Risiko Rendah" mixes English and Indonesian; use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" for consistency.
#7: "air yang lebih sadah" is ambiguous (sadah = hard); "air yang lebih keras/sadah (hard water)" would read more naturally.
#9: "raksasa yang kalem" is okay, but "raksasa yang lembut/jinak" is more natural for "gentle giant".

Item 1/4: 'Max size: ♂ 120 mm SL, ♀ 90 mm SL' – the imperial figures were rightly dropped, but for the tank volume the ~243 litres is kept and the US gal is dropped, which is fine. No fix is needed there.
Item 10: 'sejumlah butir' and 'peternak' are acceptable, but 'peternak' for breeders is better as 'pembiak' or 'breeder'.
Item 8: 'terlalu heboh dan aktif' – 'heboh' is colloquial and wrong in register for 'boisterous'. Use 'terlalu agresif/aktif' or 'terlalu galak'.
Item 7: 'chironomid larvae' became 'cacing darah' and 'Tubifex' became 'cacing sutra'. Both are accepted local terms, but 'Tubifex' is a genus name and could stay as 'Tubifex (cacing sutra)'.
Item 3: 'Perairannya biasanya relatif dangkal, sekitar 4–6 meter' – 'between 4-6 metres' should be 'antara 4–6 meter', and 'sekitar' adds an approximation that is not in the source.
Item 9: 'lebih berwarna' is a literal rendering of 'more colourful'. Prefer 'warnanya lebih cerah/menarik'.
Item 10: 'mulai menampilkan perilaku pamer' – 'courtship display' reads clumsily. Prefer 'menunjukkan tarian/tampilan pacaran'.
Item 10: 'cairan sperma (milt)' – 'milt' is the sperm-containing fluid. Use 'sperma (milt)' to avoid redundancy.
Item 8: 'the majority of Mbuna are excessively boisterous' became 'terlalu ribut dan agresif'. 'Agresif' is added and is not in the source. Use 'terlalu heboh/aktif'.
Item 10: 'jantan ... mengeluarkan sejumlah telur' is wrong. The female lays the eggs, so the subject is fine, but 'mengeluarkan' is clumsy. Use 'bertelur/melepaskan'.
Item 10: 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable but imprecise. Use 'cairan sperma (milt)'.
Item 10: 'induk betina' for 'Maternal mouthbrooder' is awkward. Use 'mouthbrooder maternal (induk betina mengerami telur di mulut)'.
Item 10: 'burayak' for fry is non-standard for cichlids. Use 'anakan' or 'burayak' consistently. Items 4 and 10 mix 'anakan' and 'burayak'.
Item 5: 'tanaman air yang tahan air sadah' repeats 'air'. Use 'tanaman yang tahan air sadah'.
Item 5: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is fine, but 'biologically immature' would be more faithful as 'belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 1: the opening 'New yellow regal peacock' is left in English, with no Indonesian phrasing around it. Write 'Ikan new yellow regal peacock, Aulonocara baenschi, adalah ...'.
Item 10: 'tarian kawinnya' for 'courtship display' is not in the source. Use 'menampilkan perilaku pamer untuk memikat betina'.

Item 7: 'Tubifex' became 'cacing sutra', and 'chironomid larvae' became 'cacing darah'. The terms are acceptable, but 'ujung pipet yang tajam' reads oddly. Use 'ujung pipet atau pisau kecil yang tajam'.

Item 1: "garis-garis cokelat cokelat-tua" is garbled and repeats the word. Use "garis-garis cokelat cokelat" only if it is deliberate; otherwise write "garis-garis cokelat tua (cokelat cokelat)" as "garis-garis cokelat tua" or "cokelat cokelat-kehitaman". The simplest fix is "garis-garis cokelat cokelat" → "garis-garis cokelat tua".

Item 11: "chocolate-brown striping" became just "cokelat tua". Use "cokelat cokelat" (chocolate) wording such as "cokelat kehitaman (warna cokelat)" to keep the colour nuance, or at least match item 1.
Item 7: "juga bisa cocok" is awkward. Use "juga bisa memberikan hasil yang baik".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is not the usual hobby term. Use "pembudidaya" or "breeder".
Item 10: "burayak" is quite formal. Hobbyists more often write "anakan" or "benih", so consider one of those.
Item 10: "urutan hierarki" is redundant; use "hierarki kelompok" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 7: "juga bisa cocok" is slightly awkward; "juga bisa berhasil baik" would be more natural.
#8: "terlalu ribut dan agresif" adds "agresif", which the English doesn't have ("excessively boisterous"). Use "terlalu aktif/ribut".
#7: "juga bisa cocok" is awkward for "can also work well". Use "juga bisa berhasil baik" or "juga sangat baik digunakan".
In item 3, "bisa cenderung berkelahi" is slightly redundant; use "cenderung berkelahi" or "bisa berkelahi".

In item 4, "ikan buntal yang lincah ini didatangkan" is fine, but "will be kept mainly by experts" is rendered as "kebanyakan akan dipelihara oleh ahli". "Umumnya dipelihara oleh ahli" would sound more natural.
Omitted fact: "First time in limited quantities" is not translated; add something like "Pertama kalinya tersedia dalam jumlah terbatas".
Minor: "keluarga killifish" is fine, but "Dunia Baru" could be clarified as "Benua Amerika (Dunia Baru)".
Item 3: "dirty broth" was rendered "air yang kotor dan keruh"; "keruh" is an added detail. Use "air yang kotor" or "air kotor".

Item 6: "dive deep into the bottom" was rendered "menyelam masuk jauh ke dalam substrat dasar"; "jantan dan betina" for "both partners" is fine, but "substrat dasar" is redundant. Use "substrat" or "dasar".
Item 6: "Fully developed, the larvae wait" was rendered "Embrio ... menunggu". The source says larvae, so keep "larva" or note that this is the developed fry inside the egg.
Item 4: "Biasanya bahaya pemberian pakan berlebihan ... tidak bisa terlalu sering diingatkan" is awkward. Use "Biasanya kita tidak bisa cukup sering mengingatkan bahaya memberi pakan berlebihan".
Item 1: "Panjangnya paling banyak hanya 4,5 cm" is slightly stiff. Use "Panjangnya maksimal hanya 4,5 cm".
Item 1: "Blackfin pearlfish" was left with no Indonesian gloss. This is acceptable as a trade name, but consider adding "ikan mutiara" or similar.

Item 2: "exclusively traded as offspring" was rendered "sepenuhnya ikan hasil penangkaran". "Offspring" means captive-bred, so this is fine, but "hanya diperdagangkan sebagai hasil budidaya" is more natural.
Item 3: "Di air yang kotor, killifish pasti jatuh sakit" – "inevitably" is fine, but the EN "broth" (dirty brew) is dropped; acceptable. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 1: "Panjangnya paling banyak hanya 4,5 cm" is acceptable, but "bertengkar" is a bit weak; consider "berkelahi/bersaing dengan sesamanya".
Item 2: "hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "exclusively" is softened to "hanya"; consider "sepenuhnya/secara eksklusif hasil penangkaran".

Item 4: "pakan boleh diberikan sesering dan sebanyak yang diinginkan" is OK; "kita selalu diingatkan" adds "selalu" (always) not in the English ("Normally one cannot warn enough"). Use "Biasanya bahaya pemberian pakan berlebihan tidak bisa terlalu sering diingatkan".

Item 6: "jantan dan betina menyelam masuk jauh ke dalam dasar" – specify "ke dalam substrat/dasar gambut"; "dasar" alone is ambiguous. Also "Larva yang sudah berkembang sempurna" – the English refers to embryos in eggs; "larva" before hatching is misleading, use "embrio".
Item 6: "telur menetas dan siklusnya dimulai lagi" – "the game begins again" is rendered okay; "dibiakkan dengan berhasil" is awkward, use "berhasil dibiakkan".
Item 3: "Umur sampai satu tahun bisa terlihat di akuarium" is stiff; use "Di akuarium, ikan ini bisa hidup sampai satu tahun".
#19: "hancurkan pelet atau pakan serpihan" translates "pill" as pelet. "tablet" is closer to the source.
#22: "berisik (boisterous)" is a slightly off rendering of boisterous. "sangat lincah/ribut" or "kasar" would fit fish behaviour better, and the English in brackets is unnecessary.

#28: "mempelajari setiap spesies atau genus secara tuntas" is slightly looser than the English "exhaustive study of these on an individual basis". Consider "mengkaji masing-masing takson secara menyeluruh".
Item 10: "10-gallon (about 40-litre)" is fine, but the English says the 40 L tank suits 8–10 fish and the ID is correct. No change needed here. The real problems are in the items below.
Item 22: "udang galah/lobster air tawar" for "crayfish" is wrong. Udang galah is Macrobrachium. Use "lobster air tawar (crayfish)" only.

Item 22: "udang hias kerdil" for "dwarf shrimp" is awkward. Use "udang hias kerdil (dwarf shrimp)" or "udang kerdil". "lele kaca (ghost glass catfish)" is also imprecise, so use the common name for the ghost catfish.

Item 11: "Buah alder" (alder cone) is fine, but "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically-immature" is OK. The sentence "Spesies ini tampaknya paling cocok dengan pencahayaan" is slightly unnatural, so use "paling baik di bawah pencahayaan yang cukup redup".
Item 26: "sepasang induk atau satu jantan dengan beberapa betina" is OK. "Begitu sudah dalam kondisi siap" is clumsy, so use "Begitu induk siap memijah".
Item 29: "Hyphessobrycon stigmatia" is a spelling change from the English. Keep the Latin name exactly as in the source.

Item 28: "Faktor pembatas lainnya ... satu-satunya cara memecahkan masalah tersebut adalah dengan mempelajari masing-masing secara menyeluruh" is vague. Make it clear that each species or genus must be studied exhaustively one by one.
Item 25: "lebih streamline" leaves English in place. Use "lebih ramping dan berbentuk aerodinamis". "jantan cenderung sedikit lebih berwarna" is awkward, so use "warnanya sedikit lebih mencolok".

Item 19: "hancurkan pelet atau pakan serpihan" for "crush a pill or flake" turns "pill" into pellet. This is acceptable. But "artemia, burayak artemia" for "brine shrimp, artemia nauplii" is redundant, so use "udang brine (brine shrimp), nauplii artemia".
Item 18: "burayak artemia" is wrong for "Artemia nauplii". Burayak means fry. Use "nauplii artemia" and apply the same fix in items 19 and 11 where relevant.

Item 11: 'hardly shy' means 'barely shy/not shy at all' but also 'prefer not to swim too much' — source is itself odd; 'tidak terlalu pemalu' is acceptable, but 'lebih suka tidak banyak berenang' fine. (minor)
Item 5: 'Volumenya disebutkan sekitar 54 liter' — 'disebutkan' (is stated) adds a claim of citation; EN says 'Volume is about 54 litres'. Use 'Volumenya sekitar 54 liter'.
Item 7: 'Cryptocoryne spp.' sentence: 'You can add... Microsorum, Taxiphyllum or Cryptocoryne spp.' is fine, but 'alder cone' left untranslated; use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)' for clarity.

Item 10: 'minimal 8–10 ekor, karena dengan jumlah itu ikan akan lebih berani' — fine; however 'sparring' translated as 'saling adu' is acceptable. Item 9: 'burayak artemia' is wrong for Artemia nauplii; burayak means fry. Use 'nauplius artemia'.
Item 9: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' — 'kutu air' is a common name for Daphnia only; keep as 'daphnia, moina' to avoid ambiguity.

Item 14: 'Faktor lain yang membatasi adalah bahwa...' is awkward; rephrase, e.g. 'Kendala lain adalah dalam banyak kasus masalah ini hanya bisa diselesaikan dengan meneliti tiap kelompok secara menyeluruh satu per satu.'
Item 15: reference list left untranslated — correct, no fix.
Item 11: "hampir tidak pemalu" is a literal translation of "hardly shy" and is ambiguous. Use "tidak terlalu pemalu" or "cukup berani", and keep the sense of preferring not to swim much.

Item 14: "Faktor penghambat lainnya, dalam banyak kasus satu-satunya cara..." garbles the sentence. It should say that studying each group exhaustively, one by one, is often the only way to solve such problems. Rephrase it.
Item 5: the volume of 60 × 30 cm is stated as "sekitar 54 liter". The English gives no height, so this figure needs checking. The 60 × 30 cm conversion itself is fine.
Item 7: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically-immature aquaria" adds detail and changes the wording. Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" or "belum cycling".
Item 12: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise. Use "saat sedang penuh telur" or "bunting telur".
Item 10: "Minimal beli 8–10 ekor" is a bit loose in register. Use "Sebaiknya beli minimal 8–10 ekor".
Item 1: 'keong macan (Babylonian snail)' adds a local name not in the source. 'Tiger snail' appears only in a reference title. Check that this name is the one hobbyists use, or use 'keong Babylonia'.

Item 7: 'Nitrat sebaiknya tetap di bawah 20 ppm' is fine. But 'Pada 34 °C... Keong bahkan tidak bisa masuk sepenuhnya ke dalam cangkang' is OK, so no change is needed there. The real problem: 'Salinitas di bawah 1,015 (19 ppt) mematikan' keeps the source's inconsistent figures, so check it.
Item 10: 'Pada umumnya mereka adalah keong whelk predator yang memakan hewan yang berada di pasir' switches from singular 'keong ini' to plural 'mereka'. Reword it for consistency.
Item 10: 'Hidup berkelompok: tidak' for 'Social: no' is a loose rendering. 'Sosial' or 'Bersosialisasi' is closer.
Item 12: 'Rearing tank... Akuarium pembesaran harus memiliki parameter air yang sama' lacks context ('sama' as what?). Say 'sama seperti di akuarium utama/induk'.
Item 12: 'larva 150 larvae/l' is fine, but 'Setelah menetap di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (on the bottom), which is not in the source's 'After settlement'.
Item 12: 'Kawin' as the heading for 'Mating' is acceptable. 'Pada tahap keong muda yang sudah merayap, keong dapat diberi' is awkward and repeats 'keong'. Reword it.

Item 12: 'cacing sutra' for 'tubifex worms' is fine. 'artemia dewasa beku' and 'artemia beku yang baru menetas' read as 'newly hatched frozen artemia', which is illogical. The English says 'early hatched', so keep it faithful and clear.

Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 68 liter" is left in, but the English volume is given for a tank whose imperial dimensions were dropped. This is fine only if the conversion is right. The 30 × 12 in figure was correctly left out.
Item 3: "stagnant" is rendered "tergenang". This fits a slow-moving stream poorly. Use "tidak mengalir" or "keruh/diam" and keep the quotation marks.
Item 8: "may be preyed upon" is rendered "mungkin dimangsa". The passive form is awkward. Say "mungkin dimangsa olehnya" or "bisa dimangsa ikan ini".
Item 11: "B. dubruensis" (the English source's own spelling in the text) differs from "B. dibruensis" earlier in the same paragraph. Use one consistent spelling.
Item 8: "Ikan ini tidak suka hidup berkelompok" for "not a gregarious fish" is fine. However, "gurami hias" for "gouramis" is slightly off. Use "gurami".
Item 7: "Ikan ini harus selalu diberi pakan hidup atau beku" loses "regular meals ... in order to develop ideal colour and conditioning". It is mostly kept, so this is only minor.
Item 10: "burayak" is used for fry, but "anakan ikan" is used in the same passage. Use one term consistently. "Burayak" is also less common among hobbyists than "burayak/anakan" in some regions.
Item 4: the volume is stated as "sekitar 68 liter", but the source says about 68 litres. That matches, so no fix is needed here. The imperial figure was correctly dropped.
Item 11: "Pelukan memijah" for "spawning embrace" is acceptable but could be clearer. Consider "pelukan saat pemijahan".
Item 8: "Penempatan gua yang cerdik" is slightly awkward. Use "penempatan gua yang cermat".
Item 3: "Lokasi neotipe berupa sungai kecil" turns "stream" into "sungai kecil". That is fine, but "tergenang" for "stagnant" is a quote and is acceptable.
Item 10: "burayak" is correct for fry. Item 11: the line "ukuran dewasanya yang sedikit lebih besar" is fine.
Item 11: "beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang" is ambiguous. Use "beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada yang memanjang pada jantan".
Item 11: "Dalam makalah revisi 2002, semua spesies ... ternyata memiliki" changes "were found to" slightly. Use "ditemukan memiliki".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is fine. Leaving "glassworm" untranslated is acceptable, but "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine too.
Item 1: "dari sebuah sungai kecil berarus lambat di hutan" is fine.
Item 9: "Jantan juga mengembangkan sirip" is slightly unnatural. Use "sirip jantan menjadi sedikit lebih panjang saat dewasa".
Item 7: "glassworm, larva Chaoborus" adds a Latin genus that the English doesn't give. Delete it, or keep only "cacing kaca (glassworm)".
Item 5: "peternak" for "breeders" sounds like livestock farming. "Penangkar", "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more natural for aquarium hobbyists.
Item 2: "anak-anak Sungai Gangga" is slightly awkward. "Anak sungai Gangga" (tributaries) would read more naturally.
Item 1: 'one of only two badids popular in the hobby before 2002' is fine, but 'Badis badis ... ikan kecil dari famili Badidae' is ok; main issue is elsewhere.
Item 4: 'Volume approximately 72 litres (19 US gal)' – the volume was kept at 72 liter, which is fine. No fix needed here.
Item 2: 'ia hanya berdasarkan catatan lapangan dan gambar' is a grammatically incomplete sentence (no verb). Use 'ia hanya mendasarkannya pada catatan lapangan dan gambar'.

Item 2: 'utara-timur laut' is an awkward rendering of 'north-north east'. Use 'utara-timur laut' only if 'timur laut-utara' is not intended. Better 'sekitar 65 km di utara-timur laut Kalkuta' (north-northeast = 'utara-timur laut' is correct, but 'kilometers' should stay consistent with unit abbreviations).
Item 7: 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is a fine local term, but 'predator mikro' for 'micropredators' is odd; use 'mikropredator'.
Item 7: 'glassworm' left untranslated without a gloss. Use 'cacing kaca (glassworm)' or 'larva Chaoborus'.
Item 10: 'burayak' for fry is understood in Indonesian but 'anakan' is the usual term hobbyists use. Replace 'burayak' with 'anakan'.
Item 10: 'perilaku merayu' is stiff for 'courtship behaviour'. Use 'perilaku pacaran' or 'perilaku kawin'.

Item 11: 'Spesies tipe' and 'monofili' are acceptable, but 'Taman Nasional' etc. fine; 'ocellus' left in English is fine but 'bercak cleithrum' ('cleithral spot') may be unclear. Add a gloss such as 'bercak pada tulang kleitrum'.
Item 11: 'Badid punya beberapa ciri yang sama dengan anabantoid' – 'badid' is not a common term in Indonesia. Use 'ikan famili Badidae' on first mention.

Item 11: "Badis species now number fifteen" is rendered correctly, but "B. badis, B. chittagongis, B. dibruensis, B. tuivaiei dan B. ferrarisi hanya berbeda dalam perbedaan hitungan morfologi" is redundant ("berbeda dalam perbedaan"). Use "hanya berbeda dalam beberapa hitungan morfologi (meristik)".

Item 11: the English ends with "the exact placement of these two", where "these two" are B. kyar and B. juergenschmidti. The translation names them explicitly, which is fine. But "B. kyar ternyata merupakan kelompok saudara" turns "was found to represent" into "ternyata" and drops the hedging. Use "ditemukan sebagai kelompok saudara".
Item 11: "Dario ... beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung dan sirip dada yang memanjang" is slightly ambiguous. The English says the first few dorsal rays and the pectoral fins are extended.
Item 7: "cacing sutra (Tubifex)" is acceptable. "glassworm" is left untranslated; use "cacing kaca" or "larva nyamuk kaca" with the English term in brackets.
Item 10: "cenderung diam di dasar" adds "di dasar" (on the bottom). The English only says "quite sedentary".
Item 8: "sifatnya pemalu" and "retiring nature" are fine. "heboh" for "boisterous" is colloquial; use "lebih aktif/agresif".
Item 1/3: "dikoleksi" is used for "collected", which is acceptable. "burayak" in item 10 is good.
Item 2: "sungai-sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine. "identifikasinya masih sementara" for "tentative identifications" could be "identifikasi belum pasti".

Item 11: "tanpa pola putih pada B. kyar" is wrong. The English says males have no white patterning (vs. B. juergenschmidti having white edges). Rephrase to "(bukan tanpa pola putih)" or "(tanpa tepi putih)" and drop the reference to B. kyar, which the source does not make here.
Item 11: "kedua spesies ini" in the last sentence is ambiguous. It should clearly mean B. kyar and B. juergenschmidti.
Item 11: "beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang" is awkward. Say "beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung dan sirip dada yang memanjang pada jantan".
Item 11: "Dario saat ini hanya beranggotakan tiga spesies" is fine. However, "hitungan morfologis" would read better as "perbedaan hitungan morfologi (meristik)".
Item 5: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus" adds the idea of smoothness. The source says "water-worn", which means rounded by water. Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang bulat/terkikis air".
Item 5: "batok kelapa belahan" is awkward. Use "belahan batok kelapa".
Item 7: "kutu air (Daphnia)" is acceptable, but "kecocokan" for 'compatibility' should match the section title, e.g. "kompatibilitas" or "teman setank".
Item 8: "Ikan ini tidak suka bergerombol" is fine. But "lebih agresif" for "boisterous" shifts the meaning. Use "lebih lincah/heboh".
Item 10: "Ikan muda cukup diam" is unnatural for "quite sedentary". Use "cenderung diam di dasar".

Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra'. The English says to omit both bloodworm and Tubifex, so the phrase is fine. But 'Artemia, Daphnia or bloodworm' is recommended in paragraph 1, then bloodworm is said to be harmful in paragraph 2. This contradiction is in the source, but the translation should still be checked. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable.
Item 4: '(24 × 12 in)' was dropped, which is correct. The volume 'about 54 litres' is kept and matches 60×30 cm. No fix needed.
Item 11: 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang' is ambiguous. Use 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada yang memanjang pada jantan'.

Item 10: 'Sejak saat itu ... mungkin mulai menganggap anakan sebagai makanan, sehingga ikan dewasa sebaiknya dipindahkan'. The English says the adults 'are best transferred'. Keep this, but 'yet' in 'belum benar-benar diperlukan' is fine.

Item 3: 'Banyak sekali ikan lain ... mulai dari spesies Acanthocobitis, Schistura, dan Danio hingga Pillaia...'. The 'spesies' prefix applies only to the first three genera, which reads unevenly. Add 'spesies' to the whole list or remove it.
Item 5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn rocks and pebbles'. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat/halus'.

Item 1: 'Indonesian Borneo' became only 'Indonesia' (minor omission of Borneo); consider 'Kalimantan Barat, Borneo, Indonesia'.

Item 10: 'tata akuarium tersebut seperti yang dijelaskan di atas' is fine, but 'jangan mengganti air terlalu banyak' is fine; main issue: 'Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditangkap di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ... betina' OK. Problem: 'ada laporan bahwa anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia terlalu banyak' is fine; however 'Akuarium harus memakai penutup serapat mung…
Item 5: 'ikan ini juga jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'pelompat yang handal/ulung'.
Item 5: 'peternak' for breeders is acceptable but 'pembudidaya' is more standard.
Item 8: 'cyprinid' and 'loach' left in English; use 'ikan sejenis Cyprinidae kecil dan ikan pengicau/botia/pangkas (loach)'.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipenya' is awkward; use 'Lokasi tipe (type locality)' or 'lokasi penemuan spesimen tipe'. Also 'morphometrics' translated as 'ukuran serta proporsi tubuh' is ok.
Item 4: Volume 41 litres kept; should be rounded to approx. 40 liters per conversion rule (minor).
Item 7: 'Betta spp.' left as is, fine; 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok, but 'sangat rentan' overstates 'particularly prone' slightly (minor).
Item 11: 'suprabranchial' and 'epibranchial' left untranslated; use 'suprabrankial' and 'epibrankial'. 'Anakan' for juveniles/young is fine.

Item 17: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditangkap di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke dalam mulut betina" – the original says the same, but "sampai telur betina habis" is fine; however "plastik wrap" for clingfilm is awkward; use "plastik pembungkus makanan".
Item 17: "pelukan' latihan" for "dummy embraces" is unclear; use "pelukan palsu/percobaan".

Item 15: "kemungkinan akan mengintimidasinya dan kalah bersaing dengannya" reverses the meaning; the original says larger fish outcompete the betta, so use "mengungguli dalam persaingan (pakan)" (the betta loses out).
Item 9: "kayu beech atau ek aman dipakai" fine, but "pelompat yang sangat andal" is odd for "excellent jumper"; use "pelompat ulung".
Item 9: "mengambil napas dari lapisan udara" fine; "Akuarium harus tertutup rapat" ok. "peternak" for breeders is acceptable but "penangkar" is more standard.
Item 17: "Jantan mengerami telur di mulut" fine; "burayak" for fry is OK but "anakan" is used inconsistently in the same paragraph.
Item 7: "sekitar 55 liter" – the English says about 54 litres; the number was changed to 55 although the unit was already metric.
Item 3: "Utara" was turned into "Sumatra Utara", adding a name not in the English (the English only says "Utara").

Item 7: The English gives '24 × 12 in' as well as '60 × 30 cm', and the translation correctly drops the inches. 'kira-kira 54 liter' is fine, but the translator was told to round 5 L or more to the nearest 5 L, so 55 liter is expected. This is minor.
Item 3: 'wilayah Utara yang letaknya lebih ke utara' is awkward and unclear. It should say 'Sumatra Utara' (North Sumatra), which is the region the next paragraph names.
Item 9: 'sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara lembap' is stiff. Prefer 'sesekali perlu mengambil napas dari lapisan udara lembap'. 'jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook.
Item 8: 'Ukuran spesies ini bisa mencapai sekitar 6 cm' is slightly off. It would be more natural as 'panjangnya bisa mencapai sekitar 6 cm'.
Item 2: 'lingkar kerabat' is an odd rendering of 'form circle'. Use 'kelompok Betta picta' or 'kompleks'.
Item 13: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but the English 'Betta spp.' is left untranslated in places. This is minor.
Item 15: 'jadi teman yang cocok' is a loose paraphrase of 'compatible'. 'dapat dipelihara bersama' is closer.
"sungai-sungai kecil" for "brooks": acceptable, but "anak sungai" is the more natural hobby term.

"Pernah masuk ... diterima": the English "were received" (shop talk) is rendered as "Pernah masuk", which is fine. "spesimen ... hasil penangkaran Jerman" could read more smoothly as "hasil budidaya di Jerman".
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is not quite right, because driftwood used in aquaria does not float. Use "kayu driftwood" or "akar/kayu rendaman" instead.
Item 1: "ikan labirin berukuran besar yang mengerami telur di mulut oleh si jantan" is clumsy. Something like "ikan labirin besar yang jantannya mengerami telur di mulut" reads better.
#9: "menghuni perairan yang lambat" is awkward for "sluggish waters"; use "perairan berarus tenang/lambat".
#19: "mungkin akan dimasukkan ke dalam sarang" is a little stiff; "dapat disertakan" or "sering dijadikan bagian sarang" would read better.

Item 8: '45 × 30 cm (about 41 litres)' is carried over unchanged. Roughly 41 L implies a specific tank height, which is not stated here, so check it. Round it to the nearest 5 L, for example 'sekitar 40 liter'.
Item 9: 'Aquatic plant species ... Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, atau Cryptocoryne spp.' is fine, but 'unit reverse osmosis (RO)' is awkward. Use 'mesin/filter RO'.
Item 9: 'Karena di alam hidup di perairan yang alirannya lambat' has no clear subject. Rephrase, for example 'Karena ikan ini secara alami hidup di perairan yang tenang'.
Item 10: GH and KH are written '°d', which is not a form Indonesian hobbyists commonly use. Write 'dGH' and 'dKH' for consistency with item 11.
Item 10: 'Kondisi air lunak, asam, dan blackwater adalah yang ideal' is slightly clumsy. Use 'air lunak, asam, ala blackwater'.
Item 16: 'mengintimidasi dan mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan' adds 'for food'. The English says only 'outcompete'. Use a neutral 'mengalahkannya dalam persaingan'.
Item 19: 'Percumbuan' is an unusual term. Use 'pacaran' or 'proses pemijahan awal'.
Item 22: 'sisik predorsal' and 'jari-jari sirip anal' are acceptable. 'Sirip tunggal' for 'unpaired fins' is ambiguous. Use 'sirip-sirip tak berpasangan (median)'.
Item 22: 'kelompok dugaan' for 'putative groups' is unnatural. Use 'kelompok yang diduga/diusulkan'.
Item 23: The reference list is left in English, which is allowed, so no change is needed. Item 1: 'panjang total' follows the number without 'sekitar ... cm' being a problem, so no change is needed.
Item 1: "Pulau Borneo (Kalimantan)" adds something the source doesn't say and is misleading. Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo, not Kalimantan. Use "Pulau Borneo" only.
Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" narrows "outcompete" to food. Use a general phrase such as "bersaing dengannya" or "mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 10: "mengerami" (to incubate or brood) is used for mouthbrooding. "mengeram di dalam mulut" is more precise and consistent with the term used earlier.
Item 4: the English gives '72 litres' (80×30 cm base). The translation keeps 'sekitar 72 liter', which is fine. Do not change it.
Item 1: 'Kalimantan (Borneo)' for Sarawak is geographically wrong. Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo, not Indonesian Kalimantan. Use 'Pulau Borneo (Kalimantan)' or 'Borneo', as in item 2.
Item 10: 'telur/burayak' in 'menelan atau melepaskan telur/burayak sebelum waktunya' adds 'telur'. The English says only 'brood'. Use 'burayak' or 'seluruh anakan'.
Item 10: 'Pengeram mulut, yang mengerami adalah jantan' is clumsy. Use 'Pengeram mulut oleh jantan (paternal mouthbrooder)'.
Item 10: 'dan tata seperti yang disarankan di atas' is vague. It should say to set up the tank as described above.
Item 10: 'telur dikeluarkan sedikit demi sedikit dan dipungut ke mulut betina' is slightly off. Better: 'telur dikeluarkan dalam jumlah kecil, diambil dengan mulut betina'.
Item 5: 'jago melompat' is too colloquial. Use 'pelompat yang andal' or 'sering melompat'.
Item 5: 'Menambahkan daun kering' loses 'leaf litter'. Use 'serasah daun kering'.
Item 1: 'hobiis' is non-standard. Use 'penghobi' or 'hobiis ikan hias'.
Item 11: 'dari parit' / 'mutlak' are fine. However, 'iridesen' is a stiff term. Consider 'berkilau pelangi (iridescent)'.
"Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)": the IUCN term is usually "Risiko Rendah/Berisiko Rendah"; keep one form for consistency, e.g. "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)".
"saat pamer": "display" is better rendered "saat memamerkan diri/menggertak" (display behaviour) so it is not read as showing off to people.
"dua garis vertikal": the English says "bars"; "garis/pita vertikal" is acceptable, but "di atas tubuhnya yang gelap" would be more natural as "pada latar tubuhnya yang gelap".
"tipe aduan": "fighter types" is better as "cupang aduan (fighter)" to make clear they are fighting bettas.
"line-breeding": consider "pembiakan galur murni (line-breeding)" for readability.
Item 8: '45 × 30 cm ... about 41 litres' was copied unchanged. Volume 'sekitar 41 liter' is not rounded to the nearest 5 L (should be about 40 liter), and the depth is unstated. Round it.
Item 1/10: 'above 78°F (about 26°C)' is rendered as 'di atas sekitar 26 °C'. The word order is awkward and the figure is approximate. Use 'di atas 26 °C'.
Item 16: 'maximum standard length of approximately 2.4 inches (6 cm)' is fine, but item 1 says 2.3 inches. The source is inconsistent, so keep 6 cm in both.
Item 21: the references are left untranslated, which is allowed. No fix needed, but the text is unchanged English.
Item 19: 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable. Better to say 'cairan sperma/mani' (milt).
Item 3: 'Ini Betta imbellis tangkapan alam' is abrupt. Also 'darah persilangan' is odd. Use 'campuran hasil persilangan'.
Item 14: 'pasangan cupang yang bukan jantan' is a loose rendering of 'non-male betta mates'. Use 'cupang betina atau non-jantan sebagai teman'.
Item 13: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but add the Latin name or 'Daphnia' because hobbyists also say 'kutu air' for other crustaceans.
Item 19: 'Ganti air sebaiknya sedikit-sedikit tapi rutin' is colloquial ('tapi'). Use 'tetapi'.
Item 2: the second paragraph drops "Borneo" ("Kalimantan Barat, Borneo, Indonesia" became "Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia"). Restore it for completeness; this is minor.
Item 10: "pelukan kosong" for 'dummy' embraces would read better as "pelukan palsu" or "pelukan tanpa pemijahan".

"Kelantan, negara bagian paling utara di Malaysia": the English says "northernmost province" and Kelantan is not the northernmost state of Malaysia. The source wording is kept, so this is only a minor point. Consider "negara bagian" or "provinsi" for consistency.
"akuaris" is not the usual hobby term. Use "akuaris" only if it is common locally, or use "penghobi akuarium".
"Males and females can be distinguished best by..." is translated as "paling mudah dibedakan". This is acceptable, but "paling baik" would be closer to the source.

Item 2: "the northernmost province Kelantan of Malaysia" is translated as "negara bagian paling utara Malaysia". Kelantan is not the northernmost state in Malaysia, and the English says "northernmost" of the Peninsula's range. Keep the meaning faithful and avoid a flat claim that Kelantan is the northernmost state.

Item 15: "Fertilised eggs are caught on the anal fin of the male then picked up in the mouth of the female" is fine. But "Ikan pengeram mulut yang telurnya dierami oleh jantan" is a clumsy, redundant rendering of "Paternal mouthbrooder". Use "Pengeram mulut oleh jantan (paternal mouthbrooder)".

Item 15: "anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia terlalu banyak" lacks "ada laporan ... mengalami" grammar. Rephrase as "anakan Betta dilaporkan mengalami masalah kesehatan".
Item 7: "pelompat handal" should be "pelompat andal" (standard spelling).
Item 7: "ikan ini sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara lembap" is stiff. Use "sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 7: "Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot" and "Betta spp." leave the English abbreviation in place. Write "beberapa jenis Cryptocoryne" or "Betta lainnya".
Item 9: "Untuk pemijahan diperlukan air yang lunak dan asam" is correct. Item 11: "mengalahkannya saat berebut pakan" for "outcompete" is acceptable.
Item 6: the English "about 54 litres" is kept. The 60 × 30 cm base needs a height, so check the 54 L figure. It is the source figure, so leave it unchanged.

Item 17: "Pembagian anggota genus ... kini umumnya diterima" is fine. "Kompleks" is acceptable. "burayak" for fry is fine. "anakan" for "juveniles" is fine. "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, though some hobbyists prefer "daphnia".
Item 6: '60 × 30 cm ... sekitar 54 liter' is acceptable, but check the tank height assumption; the volume is not stated in the English as a derived figure, so this is fine. Not an error.
Item 9: 'air lunak dan asam itu wajib' is stronger than 'necessary'; better 'diperlukan'. The sentence also sounds clumsy.
Item 7: 'kayu beech atau oak' leaves the English tree names; use 'kayu beech (bukan) / kayu ek' or give a bracketed English term. Hobbyists in Indonesia rarely know 'beech'.
Item 7: 'Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot' and 'Betta spp.' are fine, but 'pelompat yang ulung' is a loose rendering of 'excellent jumper'; 'pelompat handal' is more natural.
Item 11: 'cyprinid kecil dan loach' leaves English; use 'ikan sirip-tunggal/ikan cyprinid kecil (suku Cyprinidae)' and 'ikan botia/loach'.
Item 15: 'plastik wrap' should be 'plastik pembungkus makanan (cling wrap)'.
Item 15: 'pelukan kosong' for 'dummy embraces' is OK. 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable but 'cairan sperma/air mani ikan' is more precise.
Item 2: 'Dibanding spesies lain dalam kelompoknya, ikan ini bisa dikenali' is awkward. Rephrase it as 'dapat dibedakan dari spesies lain dalam kelompoknya'.
Item 17: 'sirip dada' is correct, but 'garis postorbital kedua' and 'suprabranchial/epibranchial' are left untranslated. Add short Indonesian glosses for readability.
Item 1/15: 'ikan labirin pengeram mulut, dengan jantan yang mengerami telur' is clumsy. Use 'ikan labirin pengeram mulut yang dierami oleh jantan'.
#7: "1 pasang per sekitar 19 liter" is the wrong tank size. A 5-gallon tank should be named by the size local keepers use, which is 20 liter. Write "1 pasang per 20 liter".
#16: "larva yang jatuh" in the hatching sentence is slightly loose, since the English says the male collects any that fall. It is a minor wording point only.
#12: "mengunggulinya" for "outcompete" is unnatural; use "mengalahkannya dalam persaingan (pakan/ruang)".
#15: "Ritual pemijahan" for "Courtship" is slightly off; "Pacaran" or "Perilaku pendekatan/pacaran" is more precise.
#6/#15: "peternak" for "breeders" is acceptable but "pembiak/breeder" is more usual in the hobby.

Item 4: 'Machrobrachium sp.' kept as is, but the Latin name should not be changed. Fine, but 'The water is relatively fast-flowing' conflicts with 'still pools' in the source, so no fix is needed there.
Item 15: 'Idealnya siapkan akuarium terpisah ... dan tata seperti yang disarankan di atas' is ambiguous. It should say the tank is set up as described above, and the clause order is confusing.
Item 15: 'Mouthbrooder; telur dierami di mulut oleh si jantan' adds 'oleh si jantan', which is fine. But 'Proses pendekatan' for 'Courtship' is better rendered as 'pacaran' or 'ritual pemijahan'.

Item 15: 'Beri sedikit-sedikit berbagai jenis pakan' drops 'small amounts of different foods several times per day' only slightly. The phrase should be clearer: 'beri pakan dalam porsi kecil dengan berbagai jenis'.
Item 15: 'plastik wrap' for clingfilm is non-standard. Use 'plastik pembungkus makanan'.
Item 12: 'more vigorous fishes' is translated as 'lebih agresif', which changes the meaning. Use 'lebih lincah/aktif'.
Item 12: 'outcompete' is rendered as 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan', which adds 'pakan'. Make it general: 'mengungguli'.
Item 9: 'cacing sutra' for blackworms is a different worm (Tubifex). Use 'cacing hitam (blackworm)'.
Item 10: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but add 'Daphnia' to avoid confusion with other water fleas.
Item 6: 'Betta spp. ... jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook. Use 'pelompat yang andal'.
Item 1: "Betta" capitalized in "satu-satunya Betta" – use lowercase "betta" (common name), as in the source.
Item 1: the "two bars on its cheek plates" is rendered as "dua garis di tutup insangnya"; "garis vertikal"/"balok" would be more precise, minor.
Item 4: "Ikan ini dipelihara... tetapi tahan pada rentang yang lebih lebar" is slightly awkward; "toleran terhadap rentang yang lebih luas" is more natural.
Item 4: "dalam pemeliharaan ini tidak dipelihara di air payau" is repetitive; use "tidak dipelihara di air payau di sini" or "tidak dipelihara dalam kondisi payau".
Item 5: "teman akuarium" is awkward for tankmates; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan penghuni lain yang bukan betta jantan".
Item 6: "burayak" is fine, but "Awali dengan infusoria" is a bit stilted; "Beri makan awal berupa infusoria" is more natural.
Item 8: "Kayu apung" for "driftwood" is misleading, because it means wood that floats. Use "kayu rambat" or "driftwood" instead.
Item 4: "Provinsi Bangkok" is imprecise, because Bangkok is a metropolitan administrative area. "Bangkok, serta Provinsi Samut Sakhon..." would be better.

Item 11: 'kesadahan karbonat yang nyaris nol' for 'negligible carbonate hardness' is okay, but the sentence 'Spesies ini membutuhkan air asam' is fine; the real issue is item 20: 'Betta pembuat sarang busa' should be 'Betta bubble-nester (pembuat sarang busa)'; acceptable.
Item 20: 'Masa inkubasi 8–14 hari' versus item 19 '10–14 hari' is a source inconsistency; consider leaving as is, but make sure each matches its own source.
Item 9: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature aquaria' is a slight reinterpretation; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum matang siklusnya)'.
Item 9: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator dengan aliran yang lembut' is fine, but 'set to turn over gently' is better rendered as 'diatur agar perputaran airnya pelan'.
Item 9: 'dan ikan ini adalah pelompat yang andal' – 'andal' (reliable) is a wrong connotation for 'excellent jumper'; use 'pelompat ulung' / 'sangat pandai melompat'.
Item 16: 'lebih aktif dan lincah' for 'more vigorous' is slightly added; use 'lebih tangguh/agresif'.
Item 16: 'ikan cyprinid dan loach' – use Indonesian-hobby phrasing such as 'ikan cyprinid (sebangsa wader) dan loach'; minor.
Item 3: 'Di alam, ikan ini sangat rentan' is ambiguous with the IUCN term; clarify as 'sangat rentan terhadap ancaman di alam'.
Item 22: 'garis vertikal berwarna kuning kemerahan' for 'reddish-yellow' is fine; 'jarak antarmata' for interorbital distance is fine. The wording 'menghirup udara langsung dari atmosfer' is okay.
Item 1: 'Rentan (Vulnerable; ...)' fine. Item 10/11 fine.

Item 4: '80 × 30 cm ... about 72 litres' is carried over unchanged; the English figure comes from the 31 × 12 in conversion and is inconsistent. Check the volume and use a sensible rounded figure, for example about 70 litres (check against the original tank height).
Item 2: the 'Sungau Sepatah' spelling is kept inside the quoted type-locality text. This is acceptable, but 'Lokasi tipenya' could read more naturally as 'Lokalitas tipe'.
Item 3: 'sisa-sisa hutan rawa gambut dan hutan rawa gambut yang masih utuh' is clumsy. Better: 'hutan rawa gambut yang sebagian sudah terdegradasi dan yang masih utuh'.
Item 3: 'dikoleksi' is a stiff literal rendering of 'collected'. Prefer 'dikumpulkan' or 'ditangkap'.
Item 7: 'Betta spp. tampaknya sangat rentan' is fine, but 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ambiguous, since Indonesian hobbyists usually say 'kutu air (Daphnia)'. Add the Latin name or the English term.
Item 10: 'ikan betok (climbing perch)' is questionable. 'Betok' is the usual name for Anabas testudineus, but the line should make clear that the English name is given in brackets.
Item 8: 'cocok dijadikan teman' is a loose rendering of 'compatible'. Prefer 'dapat dipelihara bersama'.
Item 5: 'sirkulasinya pelan sudah memadai' leaves the sponge-filter phrase unclear. 'Set to turn over gently' should read 'diatur agar aliran airnya pelan'.
Item 1: "3+ inches (about 7.6 cm)" became "7,6 cm lebih"; the "3+" means "more than 3 inches", so "lebih dari 7,6 cm" or "7,6 cm+" reads better. This is minor.
Item 5: the English says "about 72 litres (19 US gal)"; the translation is fine. No fix needed here.
Item 12: "vigorous fishes" became "lebih agresif" (more aggressive). "Vigorous" means energetic or boisterous. Use "lebih aktif/lincah" so the meaning isn't changed.
Item 12: "kalah bersaing dengannya" is ambiguous and could mean the fish loses out to the intimidator. Rephrase as "kalah bersaing (dalam mendapatkan pakan)" or "dikalahkan dalam persaingan".

Item 16: "Burayak" is used for fry, but it fits poorly here. The fry are free-swimming juveniles that are already 5 mm, so "anakan" is more natural. Use one term consistently, since the text switches between "burayak" and "anakan".
Item 16: "Idealnya siapkan akuarium terpisah ... dengan penataan seperti yang dijelaskan di atas" is fine. Fix "ukuran 5 mm lebih": write "5 mm atau lebih".
Item 16: "Ganti air sedikit (5–10% volume akuarium) setiap hari juga perlu mulai dilakukan" is clumsy. Rephrase as "Lakukan juga pergantian air kecil harian (5–10% volume akuarium)".
Item 17: "sirip dubur" for the anal fin is acceptable, but hobbyists usually write "sirip anal". Consider using "sirip anal".
Item 6: "Betta spp. ... mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff. "Mengakses" is calqued from "access"; use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap di atas permukaan".
Item 2: "mengerami telur di mulut oleh pejantan" is awkward and passive. Use "ikan labirin berukuran besar yang pejantannya mengerami telur di mulut".
Item 4: "about 54 litres" for 60 × 30 cm is kept as in the English, but the volume depends on water depth. This is only a minor concern.

Item 10: "Idealnya siapkan akuarium terpisah ... dan tata seperti yang dijelaskan di atas" is awkward. The English means to set the tank up as suggested above. Rephrase it as "tata akuarium seperti yang dijelaskan di atas".
Item 10: "penutup serapat mungkin" loses the sense of "the tightest-fitting cover you can find". Use "penutup yang paling rapat yang bisa Anda temukan".
Item 10: "Beberapa kali pelukan semu tanpa telur" adds "tanpa telur", which the English does not say. Remove it.
Item 11: "sepasang organ di atas insang" drops the term "suprabranchial". Use "organ suprabrankial berpasangan".
Item 11: "bar dagu" is a half-translation. Use "garis/pita di dagu".
Item 11: "garis bawah" for "lower lateral stripe" is imprecise. Use "garis lateral bawah".
Item 8: "dan loach ... cocok dijadikan tank mate" mixes English terms. Use "ikan loach" and "teman satu akuarium", or put "tank mate" in brackets.
Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" narrows "outcompete" to food only. Use a more general wording such as "mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 5: "Filter spons bertenaga aerator" is acceptable but could be clearer. Use "filter spons dengan aerator/pompa udara".

Item 10: 'Akuarium harus memakai penutup serapat mungkin' is fine, but 'Burayak ... langsung menerima pakan hidup' omits nothing; however 'Betta muda mengalami masalah kesehatan' drops the hedge 'there exist reports ... developing' so it reads as established fact. Write 'ada laporan bahwa Betta muda dapat mengalami masalah kesehatan'.
Item 10: 'Setelah masa pendekatan yang panjang' for 'protracted courtship' is acceptable, but 'pelukan kosong' for 'dummy embraces' is unclear. Use 'pelukan semu/tanpa telur'.
Item 5: 'kayu apung (driftwood)' is a mistranslation. Driftwood is 'kayu driftwood' or 'kayu rambat/akar kayu'. 'Kayu apung' means floating wood. Use 'kayu driftwood' or 'kayu apung/akar kayu'.
Item 5: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is better as 'pembudidaya' or 'breeder'.
Item 5: 'Betta spp.' and 'Cryptocoryne spp.' leave the English abbreviation as is. Use 'Betta' and 'Cryptocoryne'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Pakan serpihan' should be 'pakan flake/serpih'.
Item 8: 'cocok dijadikan teman' is awkward. Use 'cocok dijadikan tank mate/penghuni bersama'.
Item 2: the English is garbled, but 'Sejauh ini belum pernah tercatat di tempat lain' is fine.
Item 11: the terms 'caudal peduncle', 'opercle', 'suprabranchial' and 'epibranchial' are left as English or Latin. 'Garis dagu' for 'chin bar' is unclear. Use 'balok dagu' or 'bar dagu'.
Item 19: "Maximum size: 3+ inches (over 7.5 cm)" -> 3 inci is about 7.6 cm; fine, but item 6 and 1 are fine. No issue here.
Item 15: "Telur yang dipungut betina dimuntahkan ke mulut jantan" is fine, but "ikan yang lebih lemah bahkan bisa mati dibunuh" is awkward; use "bahkan bisa dibunuh".

Segment 4: the English says "gravity spot" (a typo for "gravid spot"). The translation silently corrects it to "Gravid spot" and adds "(bercak kehamilan)". That is arguably fine, but check that the term is consistent with the source.
Segment 3: "ikan lele/catfish" is a questionable rendering of "catfish". Lele is a specific food fish (Clarias). Use "ikan catfish" or "ikan dasar sejenis corydoras" instead.
Segment 5: "terlalu gampang stres" is colloquial. Use "terlalu mudah gelisah" or "mudah stres" to match the register of a handbook.
Segment 4: "hampir mirip jantan" is redundant. Use "hampir menyerupai jantan" or "mirip jantan".
Segment 3: "Teman satu akuariumnya" is slightly awkward. "Ikan penghuni bersama" or "tank mate" would be more natural.
Segment 5: "Memijahkan" suits "breeding" in context, but "sangat kanibal terhadap burayaknya" should be "memangsa burayak" for naturalness.

Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but 80 × 30 cm alone doesn't fix a volume. The source tank depth is unstated and the English gives "31 × 12 in". Keep the volume as in the source (72 L) and make sure it is clearly tied to the tank size.
Item 8: "much larger or more boisterous species" was translated as "lebih agresif". "Boisterous" means rowdy or lively, not aggressive. Use "lebih lincah/hiperaktif" instead.
Item 8: "teman setangki lainnya dibiarkan" is awkward. Use "tidak mengganggu penghuni lain".
Item 5: "common beech or oak" is left as "kayu beech atau oak biasa". Use Indonesian names ("kayu beech/ek"). Also, "setup" should be "penataan/set-up".

Item 5: "karena Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, maupun Cryptocoryne spp." is clumsy, and "dengan" became "karena". Rephrase as "termasuk Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, atau Cryptocoryne yang semuanya mampu bertahan".
Item 1: "ikan cyprinid" and "kerabatnya" are fine. "Lokasi tipe" would be more standard as "lokasi tipe (type locality)".
Item 8: "pers. comm." is left in English. Use "komunikasi pribadi".

Item 9: the English lists only 'pH' and 'Hardness' (with 'Hardness: 1–10 dGH'). The translation is fine there, so no change is needed. The real problem is in item 8: 'Temperature: 72–78°F (about 22–26°C)' was translated as 'sekitar 22–26 °C'. 72–78°F is about 22–26°C, so this is correct and needs no change.

Item 16: 'Pada awalnya bisa dipasang filter internal bertenaga listrik' is awkward for 'internal power filter'. Use 'filter internal (power filter)'. Also, 'arusnya mengalir di sepanjang akuarium' loses 'directed down the full length of the tank'. Say 'diarahkan menyusuri seluruh panjang akuarium'.
Item 16: 'dasar dibiarkan kosong atau ditutup semacam jaring' is acceptable, but 'bertelur secara terus-menerus' for 'continuous spawner' would read more naturally as 'memijah sepanjang waktu'.

Item 16: 'Indukan ... sebaiknya dipindahkan setelah beberapa hari' is fine, but 'filter listrik ... mesin' for 'power filter ... mechanism' is awkward. Use 'filter power head' or 'bagian mesin filter'.
Item 2: 'hidup berkawanan' is non-standard. Use 'hidup berkelompok' or 'ikan kawanan'.
Item 7: 'Pilihan dekorasi' is fine, but 'kayu beech atau oak' leaves the species names in English with no explanation. Add 'kayu beech (bük) atau ek', or use 'kayu ek'.
Item 12: 'rasbora eyespot' is fine, but 'Rasbora eyespot' is not an established Indonesian trade name. Consider adding the more common 'rasbora mata hijau' or 'rasbora dorsiocellata'.
Item 3: 'ikan siprinid' is a rarely used term in the hobby. Use 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' or 'cyprinid'.

Item 3: "must be spacyious" became "harus luas dan sebaiknya punya banyak tempat sembunyi". The English says the tank should have many hiding places and must be spacious. The Indonesian is close but shifts the emphasis. Consider "Akuarium harus berisi banyak tempat sembunyi dan harus luas".

Item 3: "polusi listrik" for "electro-smog" is acceptable but a bit loose. Consider "elektrosmog" or "gangguan medan listrik". "dari akuarium tetangga" is also an interpretation of "from the neighbour". Use "dari ikan/akuarium di sebelah".
Item 1: "di hobi akuarium" is awkward. Use "dalam hobi akuarium" or "di dunia akuarium hias".
Item 1: "ikan gajah/elephantfish" is fine. "mormyrid" is left untranslated and not explained as a group, but this is minor.
Item 2: "organ pernapasan tambahan" is fine. "eg" was rendered as "jadi", which is acceptable. "Tidak rewel" is slightly colloquial, so consider "tidak menuntut".
Item 5: "cukup suka berkelahi" is OK. "Cukup agresif" is more common among hobbyists.
#19: "peternak" for "breeder" is slightly off. "penangkar" or "pembudidaya" is more natural for fish hobbyists.

#2 and #6: "ceruk sungai yang airnya hampir tidak mengalir" and "danau tapal kuda" are long, unfamiliar renderings of "backwaters" and "oxbows". Consider "perairan genangan/rawa tepi sungai" and "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)", with the English term in brackets.
#1: "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is not the usual Indonesian category name. "Risiko Rendah" or "Kurang Perhatian" is more standard.
#22: "Lineage 8 (sub-klad 1)" mixes English and Indonesian. Use one style, for example "Garis Keturunan 8" or "Lineage 8 (subklad 1)".
#4: the added "(aslinya: ...)" repeats the Spanish type-locality text, which is not in the English. Drop it, or keep only the original locality name.
Item 8: '(about 243 litres)' — 120×45×45 cm is 243 L, so the figure is right and the units are unchanged. No change needed here; leave it. (Ignore this note.)

Item 4: Type locality left in Spanish ('afluente occidental del río Lagartococha...') — this is a formal type-locality quote, but the Indonesian reader gets no translation. Add an Indonesian rendering, e.g. 'anak sungai bagian barat Río Lagartococha, dekat kota Garza-Cocha, sistem Napo bagian hulu'.

Item 5: Type locality quote left in English ('Tributary of Río Lagartococha near town of Garza-Cocha...') — this is untranslated English. Translate it, e.g. 'Anak sungai Río Lagartococha dekat kota Garza-Cocha, sistem Río Napo bagian hulu, Provinsi Napo, Ekuador'.

Item 2: 'lele berlapis baja' for armoured catfish and 'lembah Amazon' for basin are slightly awkward. 'Daerah aliran sungai (DAS) Amazon' and 'lele lapis baja' would read more naturally. 'perairan mati' for backwater is unclear and the English term in brackets doesn't fully resolve it.
Item 1: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' — the standard Indonesian IUCN term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Kurang Perhatian'. Minor.

Item 23: 'Dias et al. (2024) memvalidasi kembali genus tersebut' is stiff. 'mengaktifkan kembali sebagai genus yang sah' reads better. Also 'long-finned brochis' is left untranslated; consider adding a gloss.

Item 9: "Clear out crevices or branches" is translated as "Singkirkan celah-celah sempit atau ranting". You can't remove crevices, but the sense is kept. Better: "Singkirkan ranting atau hindari celah sempit". This is minor.
Item 16: "Assassin snails can harass them" is rendered "mengusik dan menyerang Brotia pagodula". The "menyerang" and the added name are extra. Use "dapat mengganggu".

Item 16: "Reportedly... tolerate" in item 7 is fine, but in item 16 "Spire decollated" is rendered "terkikis". The standard term is "terpotong/tereduksi" (decollate means the apex is truncated). Minor.
Item 14: "agar dipastikan ada jantan dan betina" is clumsy. Use "agar kedua jenis kelamin pasti ada".
Item 14: "area leher" and "rongga viseral bagian kepala-kaki" are rough. "Kantong pengeraman di sisi punggung daerah leher" would be more natural.
Items 3 and 4 contradict each other (Thoungyin River vs Moei). The English source says the same, so keep both. Item 3: "anak Sungai Salween" should be "anak sungai Salween" (lowercase "anak sungai").
Item 10: "pakan ini tetap di dasar sampai ditemukan keong" is awkward. Use "karena pakan ini tetap berada di dasar sampai ditemukan keong".
Item 11: "herbs ... should always be fed" is rendered "sebaiknya selalu diberikan". This is acceptable but could use "tanaman herba liar" for clarity. Minor.
Item 16: "umurnya hampir tidak bisa mencapai 1–2 tahun paling lama" is garbled and changes meaning. Rewrite as "umurnya paling lama hanya sekitar 1–2 tahun".
Item 16: "Tentakel kepala" and "antena keong" are inconsistent. Use "tentakel" for the snail.
Item 16: "Marisa cornuarietis akan memakan semua tanaman" is fine, but "Keong assassin bisa mengganggu mereka" is vague. Make it clear that assassin snails prey on or harass Brotia.

Item 14: "Betina menyimpan anakan ... di bagian punggung area leher, yang mengisi hampir seluruh rongga viseral" is ambiguous. It is unclear whether "yang" refers to the pouch. Rephrase so it is clear the pouch fills the cavity.

Item 14: "4–5 ekor" and "Pembiakannya sangat lambat" are fine. However, "cangkang embrionya berkerut secara tidak simetris" is awkward. Use "cangkang embrio berkerut tidak simetris dan tak beraturan".
Item 10: "pakannya mungkin perlu ditambah" is slightly ambiguous. Say "perlu diberi pakan tambahan".
Item 10: "Tambahkan sayuran hijau seperti wortel" is ok. But "pupuk dan pakan tidak mengandung tembaga" is fine.
Item 8: "agar pH di bawah 7 tidak dibiarkan" shifts the meaning from "not tolerated by the animals". Use "pH di bawah 7 tidak dapat ditoleransi keong dalam jangka panjang".
Item 11: "menyiramnya dengan air mendidih" is ok. But "tanaman herba seperti dandelion" is fine.

Item 7 vs Item 8: the sources conflict on pH, hardness and temperature (7.0–7.5 vs 7.5–8.5; 22–28 vs 18–26). The translation is faithful and the conflict is in the source, so no fix is needed on the translation side.
Item 4: '~137 litres' became 'sekitar 135 liter'. The tank volume is stated in litres in the source, so it should be kept as 'sekitar 137 liter'.

Item 1: 'tidak seperti kerabatnya yang lain dalam genus ini' is not in the English, which says 'unusually for the genus'. Item 3 says 'satu-satunya anggota genus ini'. Make these two consistent and faithful.

Item 10: '(2-5°H)' was rendered '2–5 dGH'. This is acceptable, but 'cacing tanah' and 'udang' in item 7 are fine. Check that 'burayak' is not added where the source says 'eggs' or 'fry' without a reason.
Item 5: 'bouts of skittishness' became 'tidak gampang panik atau kaget'. This is OK, but 'Penampilannya paling maksimal' is awkward. Use 'tampil paling bagus'.
Item 5: the English ends with 'long-term health' of 'their'. This is a minor point. 'Kondisi ini bisa ditiru' is fine.
Item 11: 'memvalidasi ulang' is stiff. Use 'mengaktifkan kembali (revalidasi) genus'.
Item 1: 'ships poorly' became 'kurang tahan banting saat pengiriman'. 'Tahan banting' is colloquial. 'Kurang tahan saat pengiriman' is better.

Item 3: "satu-satunya anggota genus ini yang bermigrasi" is accurate, but item 1 says "tidak seperti kerabatnya yang lain dalam genus ini" (unusually for the genus) – fine; however item 5: "tidak gampang panik atau kaget" is OK. Item 5: "Cahaya yang lebih redup dari tanaman apung ini" is awkward; use "Cahaya yang lebih redup akibat tanaman apung ini".

Item 7: "cacing tanah atau udang yang dipotong-potong" is fine, but "Bisa rewel soal makan" adds "soal makan" which is minor.

Item 7: "Di akuarium pun ikan ini sama tidak rewelnya" is awkward; "Di akuarium pun ikan ini tidak pilih-pilih makanan" reads more naturally.

Item 11: "Post spawning the adults return... to feed" fine, but "clear and black water tributaries" ok; main issue: "Namun spesies inilah yang paling umum di alam" fine. Real issue: "Banyak di antaranya sangat mirip" changes "A number of these are very similar" slightly (Banyak vs sejumlah) – use "Sejumlah".

Item 8: "agresi antarsesama pasti ada" omits "a certain level of"; use "agresi antarsesama dalam tingkat tertentu tidak terhindarkan".
Item 8: "ikan cyprinid, dan ikan catfish" – use "cyprinid dan lele/catfish" more naturally; "cichlid" could be "cichlid (ikan sebangsa chanda)" optional.
Item 5: "hidup di kolom air sungai" for "pelagic, riverine" loses "riverine" nuance; "jago melompat" is too colloquial for a handbook – use "pelompat ulung".

Item 7: "pakan berprotein (daging)" - 'meaty foods' fine, but "Udang dan cacing tanah hidup sangat disukai" drops 'particularly relished' passive nuance; acceptable.
Item 1: "karasin" is a rare term; "characin" or "ikan karasin (characin)" would be more recognisable to hobbyists. This is minor.

Item 10: "Belum ada catatan pemijahan" adds "pemijahan", which the English doesn't say. It is probably the breeding section, so it is acceptable. "Belum tercatat di kalangan penghobi" would be closer to the source.
Item 10: the bracketed gloss "(induk betina mengerami telur di mulut)" is not in the source. It is accurate but unnecessary, so it could be dropped or shortened to "pengeram mulut oleh induk betina".
Item 8: "cukup bisa ditoleransi" is slightly stiff. "cukup ditoleransi" or "umumnya bisa hidup rukun" would read more naturally.
Item 8: "cukup bisa saling menerima" is a little stiff; "cukup ditoleransi" or "umumnya bisa hidup rukun" would be more natural.
Item 5: "perenang pelagis yang suka menjelajah" is acceptable, but "roamer" could be phrased more simply, e.g. "perenang pelagis yang aktif berkeliaran".
Item 1: "Lokasi tipe" is slightly literal; "Lokalitas tipe" is the more common term in ichthyology, but meaning is intact.

Item 5: 'a couple of inches of sand' became 'setebal sekitar 5 cm'. This is acceptable, but 'kayu bogwood' could use the local term 'kayu akar/driftwood'.
Item 8: 'cichlid kerdil' is fine, but 'Loricariidae' for 'smaller Loricariids' could be 'lele Loricariidae kecil' for naturalness. Minor.
Item 11: 'cuma hanyut' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'hanya hanyut'.
Item 11: 'Nama lokalnya di daerah asal' is slightly redundant; 'Nama lokalnya' is enough.
Item 1: 'dibandingkan anggota genusnya yang lain' is a bit awkward. Use 'paling umum dijumpai di antara anggota genusnya di toko ikan hias'.
Item 10: 'half a dozen' became 'minimal enam ekor'. This is OK. 'mereka mau menerima' is stiff; use 'burayak dapat diberi'.
Item 5: "pot tanah liat" adds "clay", which the English ("plant pots") does not say. Use "pot tanaman" or "pot".
Item 7: "larva Chironomus (cacing darah)" narrows "chironomid larvae" to one genus. Use "larva chironomid/Chironomidae (cacing darah)".

Items 1 and 8: "kemungkinan sebaiknya dipelihara" is clumsy for "should probably be kept". Use "sebaiknya dipelihara sendirian" or "mungkin lebih baik dipelihara sendirian".
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" / "Ikan umpan" for 'feeder' fish is OK, but "Mysis" and "artemia" casing is inconsistent; keep Latin/genus names consistent (Artemia, Mysis).

Item 7: "live or frozen chironomid larvae" was translated as "cacing darah" (bloodworm). This is acceptable, but "baik hidup maupun beku" now applies to all foods, including artemia and mysis, which is fine; no change needed except to say "larva Chironomus/cacing darah" if you want precision.
Item 11: "Bedanya dengan kerabat satu genusnya" reads awkwardly as a standalone sentence fragment; rephrase, e.g. "Spesies ini berbeda dari anggota genus lainnya karena ...".
Item 11: "sirip punggung berjari-jari keras dan sirip punggung berjari-jari lunaknya terpisah" is clumsy; use "sirip punggung berduri dan sirip punggung berjari-jari lunak terpisah".
Item 11: "jari-jari branchiostegal" left untranslated; use "jari-jari membran brankiostegal" or add a gloss.
Item 11: "Bagaimanapun ... Apa pun itu" for 'though' and 'At any rate' are stiff; use "Namun" and "Bagaimanapun" more naturally.

Item 10: "Kemungkinan besar belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan di penangkaran" is fine, but "Unlikely to have been bred" is a weaker statement; "Sepertinya belum pernah dibiakkan" would be more faithful.
Item 8: "Ikan ini kemungkinan besar tidak akur dengan sesama jenisnya" slightly overstates 'unlikely to be sociable'; "kecil kemungkinan bersikap sosial" is closer.
Item 5: "ikan mas koki" in item 7 correctly maps to goldfish, but 'plant pots' as "pot tanaman" is ambiguous; use "pot tanah liat" or "pot bunga" for aquarium décor.
Item 4: "akuarium komunitas" is fine, but 'quarters' for a group is correctly handled; no issue.

Item 5: 'It can apparently adapt to both full marine and freshwater' – 'we suspect' became passive 'diduga'; fine, but 'Usahakan mencari tahu salinitas... samakan kira-kira dengan itu' is awkward; rephrase as 'sesuaikan salinitas awal dengan air di toko'.

Item 7: 'live or frozen chironomid larvae' translated as 'cacing darah' – chironomid larvae are bloodworm, OK, but 'Spesies ini ... pakan pengganti' for 'prepared alternatives' is slightly off; use 'pakan olahan/pengganti pakan alami'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' – fine; 'feeder' fish advice OK.

Item 10: 'Not thought to have occurred in aquaria' (breeding context) rendered 'belum pernah terjadi di akuarium' loses the subject; specify 'Diperkirakan belum pernah berhasil dibiakkan di akuarium' (or keep neutral), as 'terjadi' is vague.
Item 11: 'jari-jari keras' / 'jari-jari lunak' for spinous/rayed dorsal fin is awkward; use 'jari-jari sirip keras (duri)' and 'jari-jari lunak', and 'sirip dada' vs 'sirip pectoral' consistent.
Item 11: 'ciri terakhir ini juga dimiliki' and 'berbagi leluhur bersama terdekat' awkward; use 'tidak memiliki nenek moyang bersama terdekat'.

Item 11: 'menempelkan posisi tubuh sejajar dengan permukaan padat' is awkward. Use 'menyejajarkan tubuh dengan permukaan padat'.
Item 11: 'siklus hidup di laut sampai muara' is ambiguous. Use 'siklus hidup laut hingga muara (estuari)'.
Item 1: 'gudgeon berkepala pipih' leaves 'gudgeon' unexplained. Consider 'ikan gudgeon (sleeper) berkepala pipih'.

Item 8: 'Teman satu akuarium' is fine. 'spesies kerabat' is slightly unclear for 'related species'. Use 'spesies yang berkerabat dekat'.
"Sebagian ahli juga memasukkan": the English says "authors"; "para penulis/beberapa peneliti" is closer, but this is minor.

Section 12: "mencabik sirip" is acceptable, but "mengorek substrat" for "dig" and "mendapat manfaat ... dengan memungut bakteri" are clumsy; use "menggali" and "mengambil".
Section 14: "menelentangkannya" is non-standard; use "membaringkannya telentang".
Section 2: "karapas" is correct, but "di antara semuanya" is vague; use "di antara semua spesies Cambarellus".
Section 13: "sepasang pleopod tambahan" (a pair) changes "an extra set of pleopods"; use "seperangkat pleopod tambahan" or similar.
Section 10: "Lighting: ... so they are indifferent to it" is rendered as "tidak terpengaruh oleh lampu"; acceptable but "tidak peduli terhadap cahaya" is closer.
Section 3: "genus Cambarellinae" is kept unchanged. This follows the source, but the ending is a subfamily name, so a translator note could help.

Section 3: "sama sekali tidak bisa diandalkan" for "totally compromised" is okay. "Spesies yang perlu perhatian konservasi untuk dimasukkan ke dalam Endangered Species Act" is clumsy, so rephrase it as "dinilai perlu mendapat perhatian konservasi untuk dimasukkan dalam daftar Endangered Species Act".
Section 8: "Akuarium harus sudah melewati siklus nitrogen" is fine. The sentence "Harus ada banyak area gelap" is stiff; use "Sediakan banyak area gelap".
Section 11: "Pakan butiran (granul) udang" and "Pakan hidup yang tinggal di dasar" are awkward; "pakan hidup penghuni dasar" is more natural.

Section 11: "Biarkan pakan selama 24 jam sebelum diangkat" and "sisa pakan ... harus dibuang" follow the source, but "burayak" for fry is less common among hobbyists; use "benih ikan" or "anakan ikan".
Section 12: "Katak kerdil (dwarf frog)" and "udang hias kerdil" are non-standard; "dwarf shrimp" is usually "udang kerdil" or "udang hias".
Section 12: "mereka tidak sosial" is a literal rendering; use "tidak bersifat sosial" or "tidak suka bergerombol".

Section 15: "kepribadian yang lincah" is fine. "dewasa kelamin" in section 14 is fine. Section 12 uses "menjaga jarak dari sesamanya", which is fine. Section 12: "Mereka tidak terlalu membuat berantakan" is awkward; use "tidak terlalu berantakan".
"Lobster ini" in sentence 2 adds a noun not in the English ("them"); acceptable but could be "Hewan ini" or "Udang karang kerdil ini" for consistency. Minor.
"dwarf orange crayfish" and "orange Mexican dwarf crayfish" are left in English; consider adding a local name such as "lobster air tawar kerdil oranye" (English in brackets is fine).
Item 2: "cukup mungkin merupakan hibrida" is awkward; use "kemungkinan besar hibrida".
Item 4: "vegetasi emersed maupun submersed" leaves English terms; use "tanaman yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air maupun terendam".
Item 6: "soil" left untranslated; use "tanah" or "soil substrat" (e.g. soil akuascape).
Item 6: "kaki atau capit yang hilang tumbuh kembali" changes "lost appendages replaced" slightly; acceptable but "anggota tubuh" is closer.
Item 10: "udang bisa tertangkap" is ambiguous; use "udang bisa ditangkap dan dimakan lobster".
Item 5: "sangat pandai kabur" is a bit literal; use "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 9: "bisa-bisa mereka saling memangsa" is slightly colloquial; "mereka bahkan bisa saling memangsa" is better.
Item 12: "daya tarik feromon itu makin lama makin berkurang" is a bit loose; "efek penarik" would be closer.
Section 3: 'Alabama, Arkansas, ... ' fine, but section 4 'rawa payau' for 'marshes' is wrong (payau = brackish); use 'rawa/lahan basah'.
Section 4: 'sungai kecil yang arusnya pelan, dan sungai yang lambat' – clumsy/redundant; 'sluggish streams and slow rivers' should be smoother (e.g., 'anak sungai dan sungai berarus lambat').
Section 9: 'tubifex worms' translated 'cacing sutra' – acceptable, but 'Hikari Shrimp Cuisine' fine; 'Keong segar yang dihancurkan' ok. 'Blackworms' as 'cacing hitam' fine.
Section 2/6: 'lobster' used for crayfish; 'lobster air tawar' is fine but 'lobster kecil' in section 2 should be consistent.
Section 5: 'secara teknis memungkinkan' fine; but 'kabur' for 'escape artists' is ok. 'banyak hal bisa salah dengan cepat' is literal; rephrase naturally.
Section 8: 'cone' left untranslated (should be 'kerucut/cone catappa' or 'pinecone'); 'hang-on' and 'inlet' left in English – use 'filter gantung' and 'lubang hisap'.
Section 8: 'Tanaman hidup atau plastik' – 'artificial' is fine; 'kayu' for driftwood should be 'kayu apung/driftwood'.
Section 10: 'guppy endler' should be 'endler (Endler's livebearer)'; 'mencapit' for 'snap at' ok. 'Mereka berani dan jauh lebih sosial dibanding spesies lain' OK.
Section 10: 'Berbeda dengan lobster kerdil Meksiko yang tidak tahan melihat jantan lain' ok.
Section 12: 'menutupi ukurannya' in section 2 is a calque; use 'mengimbangi ukuran kecilnya dengan karakter...'.

Item 9: "Tubifex worms" rendered as "cacing sutra" in both mentions. That is acceptable for tubifex, but "Blackworms" is left as "Blackworm" (untranslated). Use "cacing hitam (blackworm)" for consistency.

Item 9: "Brine shrimp" is translated as "Artemia". This is fine, so no change is needed. In the same list, "Detritus worms" becomes "Cacing detritus", which is a literal rendering. Consider "cacing tanah kecil/cacing detritus (detritus worms)".

Item 6: "cycle the tank" is translated as "jalankan siklus nitrogen". This is acceptable, but "cycling akuarium" is the term hobbyists use. "Safe with any live plants" is translated as "aman untuk semua tanaman air", which loses "live". Use "tanaman hidup".

Item 6: "Keep putting in and replacing food" is translated as "Tetap berikan pakan dan ganti pakan yang tersisa". This adds "yang tersisa" (leftover), which shifts the meaning. Use "ganti pakan" without the addition, or "Tetap berikan dan ganti pakan secara rutin".

Item 10: "Endler's livebearers" is translated as "endler", which is vague. Use "guppy endler". "Dwarf swordtails" is translated as "platy pedang kerdil", which is incorrect, because dwarf swordtail is not a platy. Use "swordtail kerdil".
Item 10: "they mostly occupy existing burrows and hollow them out" is translated as "memperdalamnya" (deepen them). This is a small shift in meaning. "Mencapit udang" for "snap at" is acceptable.
Item 5: "everything can go wrong very fast" is translated as "segala sesuatu bisa memburuk". This is a slightly awkward rendering. Use "banyak hal bisa salah dengan cepat".
Item 1: "Optimal tank size: ~40 litres" is translated as "±40 liter". "Sekitar 40 liter" would be more natural.
Item 12: "2 broods" is translated as "2 kali anakan". This is awkward. Use "2 kali bertelur/melahirkan anakan (brood)". "Obligate burrowers" is translated as "penggali sejati". This is acceptable.

Section 9: "Signal crayfish are territorial" was rendered as "Lobster air tawar ini bersifat teritorial", which drops the source's mention of signal crayfish. That is an English source error, but the translation should still be checked. Cambarus bartonii is not a signal crayfish.

Section 9: "Cambarus bartonii ... lose ground when encountering crayfish of different species" is fine, but "hostile" became "bersikap agresif". That is acceptable. "burrows ... 1–3 ft (0.3–1 m)" is correct.

Section 12: "ranging from weak beiges to deep chestnuts to tan" became "dari krem pucat, cokelat kastanye tua, hingga cokelat muda". The order and the colour sense are a little off. Use "dari krem pucat hingga cokelat kastanye tua dan cokelat muda (tan)".

Section 12: "Kingdom ... Subphylum: Crustacea" is fine. "Interesting fact: ... 30–40% of crayfish brain volume" is fine. "Tubuhnya bisa berpigmen" is a literal rendering of "The body can be pigmented"; it is vague but acceptable.
Section 7: "Cambarus bartonii sangat tidak menuntut" is awkward. Use "sangat tidak rewel" or "tidak menuntut perawatan khusus".
Section 6: "suhu letal atas awal (ultimate upper incipient lethal temperature)" is a clumsy rendering of the technical term. Check it against the standard term "suhu letal atas awal ultimat".
Section 6: "dapat bertahan (LC50) pada pH 2,43" is imprecise. Say that LC50 (50% mortality) was reached at pH 2,43 over 96 jam.
Section 4: "agar kimia air lebih stabil" is unnatural. Use "agar kualitas/parameter air lebih stabil".

Section 9: "Signal crayfish bersifat teritorial" – the source says "Signal crayfish" but this is a copy error; since the species is Cambarus bartonii, use the species name or "lobster air tawar ini" (don't leave this English name as if a different species).

Section 9: "cukup agresif" for "moderately aggressive" is acceptable, but "hostile" translated as "bersikap agresif" is fine; however "Hidup berkelompok: Tidak" for "Social: No" is okay. Main issue is the Signal crayfish line.
Section 12: "dari krem pucat, cokelat kastanye tua, hingga cokelat muda" – the English order is beige → chestnut → tan, ok; but "Subfilum: Crustacea" etc. fine. "Pemantauan kimiawi" acceptable.
Section 8: "Biarkan pakan selama 24 jam sebelum diangkat" – ambiguous; better "Biarkan pakan di akuarium hingga 24 jam sebelum diangkat".
Section 8: "Biarkan cangkang lama" – use "kulit/eksoskeleton lama" for consistency; "sisa molting" ok.
Section 6: the temperature phrasing "Studi laboratorium menetapkan suhu letal awal batas atas" is awkward; clarify as "suhu letal atas awal (ultimate upper incipient lethal temperature)".
Section 7: "Cambarus bartonii sangat tidak rewel" is awkward; use "sangat tidak menuntut" or "tidak rewel".
Section 1: "Warna: Cokelat" fine; "Umur" for life span fine.
Section 12: 'Water temperature 80–84°F (26.7–28.9°C)' became '27–29 °C'. Fine as rounding, but check that the rounding is consistent with the 26–30 °C range given elsewhere.

Section 12: 'Hatching' says larvae hatch 'pada malam hari' for 'overnight'. Fine, but 'Waktu mencapai dewasa' for 'Maturity' is acceptable. 'Photoperiod L:D' was expanded with 'terang:gelap', which is fine.
Section 3: 'Australia Barat dan Timur Laut' is ambiguous, since 'West and North East Australia' reads as 'Australia Barat dan Australia Timur Laut'. Write 'Australia bagian barat dan timur laut'.
Section 10: 'Social: no' translated as 'Hidup berkelompok: tidak' is slightly off. Use 'Sosial: tidak' or 'Bersifat sosial/berkelompok: tidak'.

Section 9: 'Uneaten food was removed the following morning' is rendered correctly, but the English is a past-tense report in a care guide. The Indonesian 'diangkat' reads as a report rather than advice. Consider an imperative: 'Angkat sisa pakan keesokan paginya'.
Section 13: 'Superfamily: Majidae' is kept as in the source, although Majidae is a family. This is a source error, so consider flagging it rather than copying it.
Section 13: 'Rostrum: ... with an emarginated anterior edge' rendered as 'bertakik' is acceptable. 'Antena: pangkal yang panjang dan tipis' is slightly awkward.
Section 2: 'Because they are not very mobile, they may simply miss the food' is fine. 'Kebiasaan menghias diri juga bisa melibatkan pengambilan' is slightly stiff.
"Cacing darah beku": "bloodworm" is fine, but "pakan utama" for "basic food" is acceptable; no real issue beyond this, consider "pakan dasar".
"situasi penerbangan yang kurang memadai": "unsatisfying flight situation" is closer to "kurang memuaskan"; minor nuance.
"RD Kongo": more common form is "Republik Demokratik Kongo" or "DR Kongo"; spell out for readability.
Item 5: "menyebarkan (meredam) cahaya lebih jauh" is awkward; use "menyebarkan/melembutkan cahaya" (diffuse).

Item 11: "memiliki ukuran otak relatif yang setara dengan manusia" is clumsy and redundant after "memiliki otak yang relatif besar, yaitu"; rephrase, e.g. "dengan ukuran otak relatif setara otak manusia".

Item 5: "Substrat pasir sangat penting" is acceptable, but "mengorek substrat" repeats the word; use "mengorek dasar".
