Item 11: "Elephant Fish" is translated as "ikan gajah (elephant nose)". "Elephant nose" is not in the source and changes the common name. Use "ikan gajah (elephant fish)" or just "elephant fish". The same applies in item 1.
Item 11: "mengetahui jenis kelamin sesamanya" is acceptable. "spesies ikan yang berbeda" is repetitive. Use "membedakan berbagai spesies ikan".
Item 4: "(~648 liter)" is the source's own figure for 180×60×60 cm, which is correct, so keep it. Item 4 and the rest of the batch are fine otherwise.
Item 1: "membentuk seperti paruh" is redundant. Use "membentuk seperti paruh" → "berbentuk seperti paruh".
Item 1/5: "mudah kaget" for "skittish" is fine. "Butuh tutup yang rapat" is casual for a handbook. Use "Membutuhkan tutup yang pas dan rapat".

Item 7: "mengambil segenggam substrat" renders "mouthfuls" as a handful; use "sesuap/segigit substrat" or "mengambil substrat dengan mulutnya".

Item 5: 'Lighting ... Anda berencana' is fine, but 'batu yang halus terkikis air' is awkward. Use 'batu sungai yang terkikis air' or 'batu bulat hasil kikisan air'.

Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' adds detail not in the source. 'biologically immature set-ups' means a tank not yet biologically mature, so write 'akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 5: 'daun kering' for 'leaf litter' is OK. 'tata letak bergaya sungai berarus' is clumsy, so use 'aquascape bergaya aliran sungai'.

Item 1/8/9: 'Moose-faced loach' is left as English with no local name or bracket. This is acceptable as a trade name, but 'loach' could be used consistently. Item 9 mixes 'cobitid' and 'famili Cobitidae' without italics or consistency.
Item 8: 'Kehadiran ikan-ikan ini juga bisa membantu mengurangi sifat pemalunya' is fine. 'riset yang matang wajib dilakukan' is stiff, so use 'wajib diteliti dulu dengan cermat'.

Item 12: the references are left untranslated, which is fine.

Item 13: "Below 21 °C ... At 21 °C ... and above" is fine, but "ganti wadah pakan setiap 6 bulan" changes the meaning. The English means replace the food (container contents) every 6 months. Say "ganti pakan (kemasan baru) setiap 6 bulan".
Item 9: "Salinitas: tetap tumbuh baik hingga 6‰" is ambiguous. Rephrase as "tumbuh baik pada salinitas hingga 6‰".

Item 11: "kerikil halus dan membulat" mistranslates "smooth, rounded gravel large enough not to be swallowed". "Halus" suggests fine grain, which contradicts "large enough". Use "kerikil yang permukaannya licin/mulus dan membulat".
Item 11: "suka mengaduk kotoran di dasar" adds "di dasar". Minor.
Item 5: "koki komet asli berasal dari ikan Crucian carp" is awkward. Use "ikan mas karasu/Crucian carp". Also "tidak ada di alam" is better as "tidak ditemukan di alam liar".
Items 3, 5, 7, 14, 21: "koki" and "mas koki" are used inconsistently for goldfish. Use "mas koki" or "koki" consistently.
Item 12: "kutu air (moina)" is imprecise, because moina is not a kutu air in the usual sense. Use "moina" or "kutu air (Moina)". "Burayak" is OK.
Item 18: "tambah porsi pakan" is fine. "Jumlah telur rata-rata" for fecundity is OK.
Item 8: "Akuarium yang panjang lebih baik daripada akuarium tinggi" is fine. "Koki biasa (common)" is OK.
Item 15: "faktor kuncinya adalah sifat lingkungan air yang beriklim sedang (temperate)" is awkward. Use "suhu air yang sejuk/sedang".
"stres sementara" is slightly literal; "stres sesaat" or "stres jangka pendek" would read more naturally.
"spesimen hasil penangkaran di Jerman" is fine, but "German-bred" could be "hasil penangkaran Jerman" (minor). "pemelihara yang sudah ahli" could be "penghobi tingkat lanjut/ahli" (minor).
"punya warna merah yang luar biasa banyak" is awkward; better: "menampilkan warna merah yang sangat pekat/intens" ("degree of red coloration").
"penangkaran ikan hias" for "breeding sports" is imprecise; "sports" means mutations/varian hasil mutasi, so use e.g. "munculnya varian mutasi (sport) pada ikan hias".
"udang kerdil" is not the usual hobby term; "dwarf shrimp" is commonly "udang hias/udang kerdil (dwarf shrimp)". Consider adding the English term in brackets.
Caridina logemanni should be italic as a Latin name if the format allows; the content is unchanged.

Item 7: "20-40 eggs per litter" mistranslated as "per induk" and the clause order changed; also "induk betina dan jantannya" is fine but "per induk" should be e.g. "per kelahiran/penetasan (per induk betina)". Better: "Satu kali bertelur biasanya 20–40 butir".

Item 1: "Pada 2015" but the reference (item 9) says 2014; the source inconsistency is kept, but "nama ilmiah ... akhirnya memberikan" is fine. Check, though, that "Tiger" in quotes uses straight quotes and "udang tiger" is consistent; hobbyists usually write "Tiger shrimp" or "udang tiger".

Item 5: "aufwuchs" is a German term hobbyists in Indonesia rarely use; the added explanation "yaitu lapisan organisme yang menempel di permukaan" is an addition. Use "pemakan alga/biofilm (grazer)" instead. Also "growth eaters" means the same.
Item 5: "daun beech" and "daun ek/oak" are left in English or awkward; use "daun bukit/beech" or "daun ek" with English in brackets only once, e.g. "daun ek, daun beech, ketapang".
Item 4: "lebih menguntungkan" is stiff; use "lebih baik". "berkembang biak dengan banyak" is awkward; use "berkembang biak dengan baik/banyak".
Item 8: "Posisinya sudah digantikan oleh" is slightly awkward, and the added "seperti harimau" is an addition; the original only says "tiger stripes".

"pemakan lapisan biofilm dan alga (grazer)": the English says "growth eaters" (Aufwuchs). "biofilm dan alga" is a reasonable interpretation, but it narrows the meaning a little; consider "pemakan aufwuchs/lapisan organisme yang menempel (grazer)".
"Tiger shrimps ... mau saja makan": "mau saja" is a bit casual. Use "dengan senang hati makan" or "mau makan".

"Sekali bertelur, 20–40 butir itu normal": "per litter" is better as "sekali menetas/per induk 20–40 telur"; the sentence is awkward. Also "induk jantan dan betinanya" for "mom and dad" is stiff; use "induknya" or "induk betina dan jantan".
"garis-garis hitam khas ala harimau": "khas" and "ala" are redundant. Use "garis hitam khas seperti harimau".
"Udang tiger": the commonly used term is "udang tiger" or "Tiger shrimp". Keep it consistent, and italics are not needed.
"beech, oak": untranslated English leaf names are left in place. Add the Indonesian equivalents (daun beech/"bangkuang"? no) or "daun beech, ek/oak" so that readers can understand them.
"hobi akuarium": "hobi" alone with "di hobi ini" is awkward. Use "dunia akuarium hobi" or "dalam hobi ini" and "di kalangan penghobi".

Item 11: "Meskipun nafsu makan ikan karnivora agresif sudah dicoba dipuaskan" changes the meaning and is awkward. English means "even if you try to keep aggressive carnivores well fed"; rewrite as "Meskipun ikan karnivora agresif sudah diberi makan sampai kenyang".
Item 1: the tank minimum "38 liter" is the English's own litre figure, so it is not a conversion error. A 10-gallon tank is 40 L by the rounding rule, so "38 liter" could be rounded to 40.
Item 3: "merumput alga" and "hobi akuarium" are slightly stiff. Use "memakan alga" or "menggerogoti alga", and "dunia akuarium hobi".

Item 6: "kimia air" is non-standard. Use "parameter air" or "kualitas air".
Item 10: "Para pemakan sisa" for "scavengers" is fine, but "sayuran rebus (blanching)" is imprecise. Use "sayuran yang diblansir".
Item 11: "Dengan toleransi suhunya" is awkward. Rewrite as "Karena toleran terhadap rentang suhu yang luas".
Item 12: "Endler's livebearer (guppy endler)" should be "guppy Endler". "ikan mas/maskoki" is fine.
Item 15: "menangkarkan" is a bit formal, and "Mungkin akan terlihat perubahan tingkah laku pada udang" is awkward. Make it "Anda mungkin melihat perubahan perilaku udang".
Item 11: "solid white or lighter color line" translated as "garis putih pekat" – 'pekat' is odd for white; use "garis putih solid/tegas".

Item 10: "Para pemakan sisa" for scavengers is fine, but "Udang ini lebih memilih tidak makan alga" is okay; "kulit kosong" for exoskeleton should be "kulit/eksoskeleton bekas molting"; "bukan berwarna pekat" for solid-colored is awkward – use "bukan yang berwarna solid".
Item 12: "Endler" alone drops "livebearers" and "ikan mas koki" for goldfish is wrong (goldfish = ikan mas/maskoki); "corydoras catfish" ok.
Item 12: "bisa kalah bersaing dengan mereka" reverses meaning: English says Amano may outcompete cherry shrimp; should be "bisa mengalahkan mereka dalam berebut makanan".
Item 1: Hardness unit "dKH" retained fine, but "Sifat: Damai" ok; item 2: "semburat cokelat muda" for tan fine. Item 5: "selang aerator" fine.
Item 3: "merumput alga dan detritus sisa hewan air lainnya" ok; item 14: "deretan garis putus-putus" ok; item 16: "air payau berkadar garam tinggi atau air laut" ok.
Item 11: "komunitas" 'community player' fine; "hanya memanjang sebagian dari panjang tubuh udang" slightly clumsy.
Item 12: "Seimbangkan pemberian pakan dengan pakan bubuk" is awkward; better "Lengkapi pemberian pakan dengan pakan bubuk".
Item 12: "berenang berputar-putar dengan heboh" is slightly colloquial; use "dengan liar/bersemangat".
Item 12: "Anakan udang tidak banyak berpindah tempat seperti udang dewasa" is ambiguous; use "tidak seaktif udang dewasa dalam berpindah tempat".

Item 2: "hanya hidup di air tawar murni di Kalimantan" changes the range. The English says Borneo, the whole island. Use "Borneo".

Item 3: the type locality 'Sarawak state, Borneo, East Malaysia' is left in English. Quoting the original is acceptable, but consider adding a gloss in Indonesian, for example "Negara Bagian Sarawak, Borneo, Malaysia Timur".

Item 13: 'Tetraodontidae umumnya disebut 'buntal'' — the English says 'Tetraodontids' (family members); fine, but 'Ikan buntal adalah ikan air tawar sekunder, dan sebagian besar anggotanya hidup khusus di lingkungan laut' is OK. The real issue: 'sirip dada ... diodontiform' fine.
Item 6: '54 liter' — the original says 'about 54 litres' and it is kept; no change needed except to make sure the rounding follows the 5-litre rule (use about 55 litres).
Item 3: 'Negara Bagian Sarawak' — use 'negeri Sarawak' or just 'Sarawak'; 'Negara Bagian' is awkward for Malaysia.

Item 8: "A male can be kept along with several females, but are territorial" is OK. "Hap" in item 10 is unexplained; consider "Haplochromis (Hap)".
Item 4: "bare minimum" is rendered "batas paling minimal". Use "minimum mutlak".
Item 1: "Bedanya dengan C. spilorhynchus ada pada..." is fine. "menjelajah" is acceptable. Consider "berkeliaran" or "mengembara" for "roams".
Item 10: "ke dalam erannya di mulut" and "memuntahkan erannya" – "eran" is not a word; use "telur-telur yang dierami di mulutnya" / "memuntahkan telurnya/burayaknya". Garbled and hard to read.
Item 10: 'menambahkan "telur" tersebut' adds quotation marks absent in the source and is unclear; say it tries to pick up the egg-spots as if they were eggs.
Item 10: "untuk membagi agresi jantan" – wrong verb; should be "menyebarkan/mengurangi (meredam) agresi jantan" (dissipate).

Item 10: "Sebagian peternak mengambil telur/embrio ... secara manual" – source says strip the fry (young) from mouth at 2 weeks; use "mengeluarkan anakan/embrio" and avoid ambiguous "telur/embrio". "peternak" → "pembiak".

Item 10: "haplochromine" replaces source 'Hap' fashion; acceptable but "Hap" not explained; "burayak" for fry is fine but 'predation' phrase "menghindari burayak dimangsa" is awkward (should be 'agar telur/anakan tidak dimakan').
Item 8: "Frontosa" good, but "lebarnya bukaan mulut" awkward; use "lebarnya mulut saat menguap" (yawn).
Item 7: "kerang hijau, kerang dara" for mussel/cockle: specific species substitution is questionable; "lancefish (sand lance)" odd—use "ikan lance/sand lance".

Item 8: 'Frontosa' is fine, but 'The best tankmates are those inhabiting the bottom part' is OK; however 'ikan apa pun yang terlalu besar untuk masuk ke mulutnya' reverses the logic: should be 'ikan yang terlalu besar untuk masuk ke mulutnya' (not 'apa pun'), otherwise reads as aggression toward anything.
Item 10: 'kerang hijau, kerang dara' for mussel and cockle is acceptable, but 'lancefish' left untranslated; use 'ikan lancefish (sand lance)' or 'ikan lance/teri' explanation.
Item 10: 'untuk menyebarkan agresi' is imprecise; should be 'untuk mengurangi/membagi agresi jantan' (dissipate).

Item 10: 'Sebagian peternak mengeluarkan burayak secara manual' - 'strip' is stripping the brood from mouth; better 'mengambil telur/burayak dari mulut induk secara manual'. At 2 weeks they are eggs/embryos, not fry.
Item 10: 'Tampaknya tidak ada tempat pemijahan yang dibuat' is okay, but 'Hap fashion' translated as 'cara khas Hap' leaves 'Hap' unexplained; use 'haplochromine'.
Item 8: 'Frontosa' and 'Mbuna' may be fine, but 'jantan bisa dipelihara... tetapi jantan bersifat teritorial' loses subject clarity; ok.
Item 4: 'ukuran minimum mutlak' is acceptable for 'bare minimum' but 'minimal' sounds more natural; also 'liter' is fine.
Item 7: 'Ikan ini adalah predator pengejar' is awkward; use 'predator pemburu yang mengejar mangsanya'.

Item 2: "Salah satu spesies channa terkecil dan paling berwarna ini baru dideskripsikan belum lama" is awkward, with a stray "ini" and a redundant "baru ... belum lama". Suggest "Salah satu spesies channa terkecil dan paling berwarna baru saja dideskripsikan."
Item 6: "Ikan hanya keluar" is minor and fine, but "Liang-liang ini berisi air permanen" could read more naturally as "Liang ini selalu berair".

Item 3: "Ukurannya tetap kecil dan mudah dipelihara" adds a fact ("mudah dipelihara" / easy to keep) not in the English, which only says "manageable size". Same in item 15: "ukurannya tetap kecil dan mudah dipelihara". Use "ukurannya tetap tidak terlalu besar".
Item 3: "karena C. andrao merupakan pengeram mulut oleh pejantan" is clumsy; use "pengeram mulut pejantan (paternal mouthbrooder)".

Item 2: "paling berwarna" is awkward; use "paling berwarna-warni". "baru saja dideskripsikan" is acceptable. "dalam kasus tertentu" for "exceptionally" is slightly off; use "secara luar biasa/sangat jarang".

Item 6: "rata-rata suhu udara minimum 38–45 °C" copies an error in the source, but it is a faithful translation. In "lubang-lubang ... berair sepanjang tahun", the source says "permanent water"; this is fine. "Lubang-lubang ini" refers back to "burrows" correctly.
Item 10: "ikan pakan hidup (feeder)" is fine. "ikan mas koki" for "small goldfish" is imprecise; use "ikan mas kecil" or "goldfish kecil".
Item 14: "pengasuhan anak" for "brood care" is stiff; use "perawatan anakan oleh induk". "telur tidak subur" is acceptable.
Item 15: "sisik epidermis (pelat kepala)" and "menghirup udara langsung" are acceptable. In "spesies Channa ... Nama-nama spesies kerabat", "congeners" is fine.
Item 16: "snapper" glossed as "pencaplok/penyambar" is a doubtful rendering. The source gloss is just "snapper". Keep it simple.
Item 17: The reference list is left untranslated, which is allowed.

Item 6: 'average minimum air temperatures 38–45°C during summer' is kept as is; the source figure is implausible for a minimum. Translation is faithful, so treat it as a source issue and flag it to the editor.
Item 1: '(4 in SL)' was dropped. This is acceptable as a metric-only conversion, so no fix is needed.
Item 3: 'Ukurannya tetap mudah ditangani' is awkward. Use 'ukurannya tetap kecil/mudah dipelihara'.
Item 7: 'dan akuarium yang lebih besar diperlukan untuk satu kelompok' is awkward. Use 'sedangkan untuk kelompok diperlukan akuarium yang lebih besar'.
Item 6: 'pers. comm.' was left in English. Use 'komunikasi pribadi'.
Item 6: 'Lubang ini selalu berisi air' is more definite than 'permanent water'. Use 'berair sepanjang tahun'.
Item 15: 'C. hoaluensi' is a typo carried over from the source. Use 'C. hoaluensis'.
Item 15: 'serta dari perilaku reproduksinya' is grammatically broken. Use 'serta berdasarkan perilaku reproduksinya'.
Item 15: 'mengingatkan pada sisik epidermis (pelat kepala)' and 'ruas tulang belakang' are fine. 'Lebih jauh dari' is a literal rendering of 'further from'. Use 'selain itu dibedakan dari'.
Item 16: 'snapper' was left untranslated in the etymology. Add a gloss, for example 'pencaplok/penyambar'.
Item 7: 'Suhu: 0–30 °C' is kept from the source, which is fine, but check the range. Not a translation error.
Item 2: 'minimal 2 m' is fine, but 'Butuh' is informal for a handbook. Use 'Memerlukan' or 'Membutuhkan'.
Item 8: 'ikan umpan/pakan' is awkward for 'feeder fish'. Use 'ikan pakan (feeder fish)'.
Item 8: 'ikan mas koki' is redundant. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish'; 'koki' alone is fine.
Item 6: 'pandai kabur' is slightly informal. Use 'terkenal sering meloloskan diri'.
Item 1: 'Ukurannya bisa mencapai 85 cm' is correct. 'channa berukuran besar' for 'large snakehead' is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Spesies ini ... terkadang tertukar' is fine. 'sirip dubur' is correct. 'sisik di bagian atas dan samping kepala' is OK.
Item 11: The references are left untranslated, as allowed.
Item 10: 'dorsal and lateral scales on head small' is rendered as 'sisik di bagian atas dan samping kepala'. This is acceptable.

Item 9: 'Belum tercatat berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium' adds 'berhasil'. 'Unrecorded in aquaria' means not recorded as bred in aquaria. The meaning is intact, but 'dibudidayakan' for 'bred' is acceptable.
Item 1: "850 mm" should be converted to metric cm per the rules, i.e. "85 cm". Same in item 5, "850 mm SL" -> "85 cm SL" (standard length).
Item 7: "Suhu: 0–30 °C" is faithful to the English, but the source range (0°C) is implausible. Check against the original data. The Indonesian copies the number, so this is not a translation error.
Item 1: "jadi karena ukuran ..." is awkward and the connector "jadi" changes the logic. Use "namun karena ukuran dan perilaku alaminya, ikan ini sebagian besar tidak cocok ...".
Item 8: "pakan hidup seperti ikan livebearer atau ikan mas koki" – "feeder fish" is better rendered "ikan umpan/pakan". "Ikan mas koki" is fine.

Item 10: "Channa spp. ... suprabranchial" and "memiliki sisik ... bercak" are fine. "mengimpor atau memiliki spesies ini ilegal" is awkward; use "Saat ini mengimpor atau memiliki spesies ini dilarang ... kecuali memegang izin resmi".
Item 4: "mengambil napas dari udara" is awkward; use "bernapas dengan udara atmosfer".
Item 3: English says 'about 243 litres'; rounding to 'sekitar 240 liter' is fine, no issue.

Also in item 1 the sentence is ambiguous: the dropped 'C. melasoma' character claim is fine, but 'Bintik hitam ... dan ... sirip ekor' lacks a verb frame making it read as if the fin itself distinguishes.

Item 6: 'whole prawns/shrimp' became only 'udang utuh' and 'live river shrimp' as 'udang sungai hidup' — acceptable; but 'feeder fish' rendered as 'ikan ... "pakan"' is unclear; use 'ikan umpan (feeder fish)'.
Item 6: 'ikan mas koki' is redundant/nonstandard; use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish' consistently (e.g. 'ikan koki').
Item 7: 'Ruang ini bukan organ labirin' — fine; but 'epidermis (pelat kepala)' for 'cephalic plates' is okay. 'Ikan ... menghirup udara' fine.
Item 8: reference list untranslated is allowed, no issue.

Item 4: 'membuat ikan tidak terlalu sering bersembunyi' is acceptable.
Item 7: 'Ng. et al.' vs 'Ng et al.' minor punctuation change; fine.

Item 4: "pandai kabur" – "notorious for their ability to escape" is better as "terkenal sering meloloskan diri".

Item 6: "ikan mas koki kecil" – the English says "small goldfish", so "ikan mas koki" is acceptable, but "cacing darah" for chironomid larvae is fine. "livebearer" is left untranslated; use "ikan vivipar (livebearer)".
Item 6: "jantung sapi atau ayam" is ambiguous, because it can read as "cow heart or chicken". Rephrase as "jantung sapi atau daging ayam".

Item 8: "dorsal-fin rays"/"anal-fin rays"/"caudal-fin rays" etc. fine, but "C. gachua species assemblage ... putative" was reworded to "kelompok spesies C. gachua (diduga)", which shifts 'putative' onto the group rather than the assemblage; minor.
Item 8: "Spesies dari India timur laut" — "northeastern India" is India timur laut, fine, but "Semua Channa spp. ... bukan labirin" is OK; "hypoxic" rendered as "kekurangan oksigen" is acceptable.

Item 2: "Sen-Bin-Ti River, Putao plains..." type locality left in English is fine; "Putao township" as "distrik" is acceptable (township = kota praja/kecamatan).
Item 1: "Channa burmanica adalah ikan gabus (channa)" — snakehead general term ok; "sirip perut" for pelvic fins is fine.

Item 8: 'dengan dugaan kelompok spesies C. gachua menurut Britz (2008) yang mencakup...' is awkward and distorts 'putative ... assemblage'; rephrase, e.g. 'kelompok spesies C. gachua (diduga) menurut Britz (2008), yang terdiri atas...'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'memberi ikan pakan hidup seperti ikan livebearer' loses the 'feeder fish' meaning; use 'ikan umpan (feeder)' instead of 'ikan pakan hidup'.

Item 7: 'pakan mati' for 'dead alternatives' is ok, but 'ikan dewasa mau makan ... udang sungai hidup' is fine; 'Predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' should be 'predator obligat/karnivora murni'. Minor.
Item 5: 'terkenal pandai kabur' is a little colloquial; use 'terkenal sering melarikan diri/melompat keluar'.
Item 2: 'Kecamatan Putao' – 'township' in Myanmar is usually 'distrik/kota praja'; 'Kecamatan' is an Indonesian administrative term. Minor.
Item 8: 'sirip dubur' for anal fin is okay but hobbyists typically say 'sirip anal'; 'predorsal' left untranslated ('sisik predorsal' -> 'sisik di depan sirip punggung'). Minor.
Item 1/8: 'Channa burmanica adalah channa (snakehead)' - 'ikan gabus/channa' commonly; fine, but 'tampaknya endemik' is OK.
"jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "terkenal sering meloloskan diri".
"Ikan juvenil dan remaja" for subadults: "remaja" is OK but "subadult" might be clearer; consider "ikan juvenil dan subdewasa".
"hitam muda" for "light black" is awkward; use "abu-abu" or "hitam pucat".
"ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder' fish: use "ikan pakan (feeder)"; "umpan" suggests fishing bait.
"divalidasi ulang" is a bit stiff; consider "dinyatakan sah kembali sebagai spesies tersendiri".

Item 5: "approximately 243 litres (64 US gal)" -> "sekitar 243 liter" is fine, but "Volume yang disebutkan" is vague; say "Volume yang dinyatakan/disarankan".
Item 12: "northeastern India" rendered "India timur laut" is fine, but "sampai ke gurat sisi" for "lateral lines" is singular/plural shift; use "garis rusuk/gurat sisi" consistently.

Item 8: "ikan umpan hidup (feeder)" -> use "ikan pakan (feeder fish)"; 'umpan' means fishing bait.

Item 12: "Kepulauan Sunda Besar" fine; but "sabuk gelap" for 'dark belts' is literal -> "pita/sabuk gelap" acceptable; "sirip dubur" in item 10 -> "sirip anal" is the term hobbyists use.

Item 2: "pandai kabur" is colloquial; use "terkenal sering meloloskan diri".

Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but "Pemijah bebas yang kedua induknya ikut menjaga" in item 9 is awkward; rephrase as "Pemijah bebas biparental (kedua induk ikut menjaga)".

Item 6: "Tanaman permukaan" should be "tanaman terapung" for Ceratopteris, the hobby term.

Item 8: "daging ikan yang dipotong memanjang" for "cut into strips" is fine. "Ikan predator sejati" is acceptable for "expressed predatory fish".

Item 4: "genangan tepi sungai yang tenang" for "backwaters" is redundant with "berair tenang". Simplify it.
Item 11: "sirip dubur" for "anal fin" is acceptable. "Epitel pernapasan" and "ruang suprabranchial" are fine.

Item 6: "final size of maximally 30 cm ... belong to the species which can be maintained in the aquarium" is rendered fine, but item 1 says 'Needs a very large tank' while this suggests small; no translation error.
Item 8: "As expressed predatory fish" translated as "ikan predator sejati"; fine. "daging ikan yang dipotong memanjang" okay.

Item 9: "Sebagai teman setangki, hanya ikan yang lebih besar dari ikan gabus yang dipelihara yang cocok" is clumsy with repeated "yang"; rephrase, e.g. "hanya ikan yang lebih besar daripada ikan gabus yang dipelihara yang cocok dijadikan teman setangki". Item 7: "feeder fish" rendered as "pakan hidup (feeder)" – inaccurate; should be "ikan pakan (feeder fish)". Also "Livebearer" and "goldfish" fine. "Mamalia atau unggas seperti jantung sapi atau ayam" ok.

Item 11: "sirip dubur" is OK; "bukan labirin" should be "bukan labirin sejati/organ labirin"; "sisik epidermis" fine.

Item 4: "predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is acceptable but "predator obligat" is more precise.
Item 4: "ikan mas koki" is redundant. Use "ikan mas koki" or "koki" consistently, e.g. "ikan koki kecil".
Item 5: "memeluk/melingkar" uses a slash and is awkward. Choose one verb, e.g. "saling melingkarkan tubuh".

Item 4: "gut loading" in brackets is fine, but "sedangkan ikan dewasa mau menerima" is wordy. Simplify it to "ikan dewasa dapat diberi".

Item 1/2: 'menetap sebagai populasi liar' adds the 'liar' nuance; acceptable, but 'channa' as the gloss for snakehead is fine. Item 2: 'Hangjiang River' dropped the 'River' inconsistency, and 'Sungai Yangtze, Minjiang, Hangjiang, dan Pearl' lost the English 'rivers' structure; check list.
Item 3: 'banyak ditumbuhi tanaman air yang lebat' is redundant; use 'padat ditumbuhi tanaman air'.
Item 7: references left untranslated as instructed; no problem.

Item 1: "Snakehead terbesar dan paling megah semuanya termasuk kerabat Channa marulius" – the source says the largest snakeheads belong to the C. marulius group/relationship; "semuanya" is ambiguous. Use "termasuk kelompok Channa marulius".

Item 1: "Padanan spesies tersebut di Asia Tenggara" is fine, but "Kemungkinan besar ikan ini bisa tumbuh sebesar C. marulius" is stronger than the source's "likely to have the potential to". Soften to "kemungkinan berpotensi tumbuh".
Item 2/14: "hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)" is an unneeded gloss; "pelagis" alone is fine.

Item 11: "ikan mas koki kecil" – the source says small goldfish, so "ikan mas" or "goldfish" is correct. Mas koki is a specific fancy variety. Use "goldfish kecil". Also "ikan umpan hidup" for "feeder fish" is fine.
Item 11: "jantung sapi atau ayam" reads as heart of cow or chicken. The source gives beef heart and chicken (meat). Use "jantung sapi atau daging ayam".
Item 14: "gurat sisi ke-17-20" is a confusing double hyphen. Use "ke-17 sampai ke-20".
Item 14: "Kalimantan" for Indonesian Borneo loses the "Borneo" term in places. Consider "Kalimantan (Borneo)" at first mention, and in item 6 "Kalimantan, Borneo" is dropped.

Item 1: the source says the species sifts "mouthfuls of substrate". "Menyaring substrat yang diambilnya sesuap demi sesuap" is acceptable, but "cichlid pengeram mulut" and "bentofag" are fine.

Item 8: "Dibanding beberapa kerabatnya, ikan dari genus ini tidak terlalu agresif" is fine. "Non-gregarious" is rendered as "tidak hidup berkelompok", which is also fine.

Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically immature aquarium' is acceptable, but 'pasir yang halus dan lembut' adds redundancy; minor.

Item 3: 'river basins' translated as 'daerah aliran sungai' (watershed term). Better 'cekungan sungai' or simply 'sungai'. Minor.

Item 1: "hampir sepenuhnya herbivora" for "vegetarian" is acceptable, but "air sadah dan basa" drops the nuance; fine.

Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is the outdated IUCN term; use "Berisiko Rendah" or "Resiko Rendah" (LC). Minor.

Item 10: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is a bit awkward; "filter busa (sponge filter) yang digerakkan udara" is more natural.

Item 4: the first sentence, "ukuran minimalnya akuarium dengan alas...", is awkward. Use "ukuran minimalnya adalah akuarium...".

Section 1: "sungai-sungai kecil di hutan hujan" fine; "salah diberi label" is awkward, use "salah dilabeli".

Item 1: 'dari sungai-sungai kecil di hutan hujan' is acceptable; 'cichlid' left untranslated is a standard hobby term (fine).

"jenis kelamin ... paling mudah dibedakan" is fine, but "penuh telur" could be "bertelur penuh" or "sarat telur". This is optional polish only.

"Musim ini bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris": the source says "UK winter"; this is kept literally and is irrelevant or confusing for Indonesian readers. Rephrase, e.g. as the temperate-zone winter (Northern Hemisphere), or explain it.

Item 9: "Dias et al. (2024)" fine, but "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; consider "bernapas udara fakultatif".
Item 8: "saat sedang bertelur" for 'gravid' – better "saat sedang membawa telur / bunting telur" (gravid is not spawning).
Item 6: "mencari makan di dasar" adds 'di dasar' not in the English 'foraging' (minor).
Item 3: "kolam-kolam" for natural pools in a dry stream suggests ponds; "genangan" or "kolam alami" would be more natural.
Item 5: "batu sungai yang membulat dan halus terkikis air" is slightly clumsy for "water-worn rocks"; "batu sungai yang terkikis air" is simpler.

Item 1/8: 'reduced body depth' translated as 'tubuh yang lebih pipih' – 'pipih' means flattened (laterally/dorsoventrally), not reduced height; use 'tinggi tubuh yang lebih rendah / tubuh lebih ramping'. Added '(tidak setinggi kerabatnya)' also not in source.
Item 8: 'Duri sirip yang pendek dan tubuh yang pipih' – same mistranslation of 'reduced body depth'; changes the morphological meaning.
Item 2: '(sungai kecil, 200 meter ... )' parenthetical gloss omits coordinates 24°47'08"S, 65°28'10"W in the translation; the gloss drops this fact.
Item 2: 'cabang dari hulu lembah Río Paraná' – 'upper Río Paraná basin' should be 'daerah aliran Río Paraná bagian hulu'; 'lembah' is wrong and 'affluent' = anak sungai.
Item 5: 'batu yang halus terkikis air' – 'water-worn rocks' should be 'batu yang terkikis/halus oleh air' (e.g., 'batu sungai yang membulat'); awkward.
Item 3: 'satu spesies Jenynsia sp.' – redundant; 'spesies Jenynsia yang belum teridentifikasi'.
Item 9: reference list left untranslated – acceptable, no issue.
Item 8: 'Taksonominya' lacks clear referent (Corydoras/Callichthyidae); 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex fine.
Item 4: tank volume '~68 liter' is a calculated figure; fine, but 60 × 38 × 30 gives 68.4 L — OK. No issue.

Item 10: 'Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris' — UK reference is kept from source; for Indonesian readers, rephrase neutrally (e.g. 'bertepatan dengan musim dingin di belahan bumi utara'), since 'the UK winter' is irrelevant locally.
Item 10: 'selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak daripada betina' is awkward; rephrase as 'sebaiknya jumlah jantan lebih banyak daripada betina'.
Item 10: 'meskipun bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan' is awkward; use 'meskipun kadang sampai 4 butir sekaligus'.
Item 10: 'Di mana pun telur akan ditetaskan' / 'penuh telur' phrasing is slightly stiff; consider 'berisi telur' and 'Di mana pun telur ditetaskan'.

Item 1: 'corydoras (lele lapis baja/armoured catfish)' — Brochis is not a Corydoras and 'armoured catfish' refers to the family; use 'lele berlapis baja (armoured catfish)' without calling it corydoras, to avoid confusion with the 'Corydoras pinheiroi' name just given.
Item 5: 'sungutnya bisa terkikis hingga hilang' is a bit of an over-translation; 'sungutnya bisa habis/rusak' is more faithful to 'lose their barbels'.
Item 10: "Selain itu... Inggris": "musim dingin di Inggris" keeps UK reference; fine, but "Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama" is OK. Main issue: "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" fine.
Item 4: "~68 liter" is the exact conversion of the given figure, but the source is already metric; fine. "Alas akuarium" is unusual; use "Ukuran dasar akuarium".
Item 7: "Mau menerima" is awkward for a fish; use "Ikan ini menerima" or "Memakan".
Item 5: "sungutnya bisa rusak/hilang" - the slash is awkward; use "sungutnya bisa terkikis/hilang" (lose = hilang/habis).
Item 10: "burayak" used for hatchlings but "anakan" used for 'brood' and 'fry' inconsistently: "besarkan anakan di akuarium yang sama" vs "burayak"; use one term.
Item 10: "fungussing" mistranslated mildly: "mencegah jamur" ok; "filter kotak bertenaga aerator" is unclear; use "filter spons atau filter kotak (box filter) bertenaga udara".
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering of "armoured catfish"; use "lele lapis baja (armoured catfish)" or the term hobbyists use, "corydoras".
Item 4: "Many-spotted Cory" is left in English as a suggested common name. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add a local rendering such as "Cory berbintik banyak".
Item 1/3: "bertubuh tinggi" for "deep-bodied" is slightly awkward. "Berbadan tinggi/tebal" or "bertubuh pipih tinggi" may read more naturally.
Item 1/3: "anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai kecil" is repetitive for "small tributaries, creeks"; consider "anak sungai kecil, kali/sungai kecil" or "anak sungai dan sungai kecil".
Item 10: "alder cone" is left in English; consider adding a local gloss such as "kerucut alder (alder cone)".
Item 18: 'Reports vary on whether the parents eat their own eggs' is fine, but 'bermata dua hitam' is awkward; use 'dengan dua mata hitam'.

Item 18: 'sebagian peternak' for 'breeders' is fine, but 'Mereka mungkin menambahkan ... udang kerdil untuk membersihkan jamur' is OK; 'water sprite' and 'alder cone' left in English without a local term (e.g. 'kerucut alder', 'kiambang/water sprite'); add a short gloss.
Item 15: 'seolah "berkedip" dengan cepat menunduk' is garbled. Rephrase to 'ikan ini "berkedip" dengan cara cepat menunduk'.
Item 15: 'ikan ini tidak akan mengganggu siput' is acceptable, but 'bukan pemakan cepat' is stiff; use 'makannya lambat'.

Item 2: 'Ikan lele' for schooling catfish is acceptable, but 'melayang di tengah kolom air' is fine; 'corydoras' is not italicized or capitalized consistently with Latin name Corydoras elsewhere (item 2/15/20). Keep genus capitalized and italic if Latin.

Item 4: 'Corydoras pygmy' mixes Indonesian word order with English 'pygmy'; the common name is better as 'cory pygmy' or 'corydoras kerdil', and it is used inconsistently with item 20 'corydoras pygmy' versus item 20 header 'pygmy cory' elsewhere.
Item 9: the pH range '6,4–7,5' is kept, but 'sedikit lebih sejuk' relative to what is not clarified; this matches the source. 'cukup lunak' for 'moderately soft' is fine, so no change needed there.
Item 14: 'kalah bersaing dengannya' is ambiguous; say 'atau mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan'.

Item 12: 'pakan mikro beku' scopes 'beku' over Cyclops/daphnia, but 'Frozen' may apply only to cyclops/daphnia and microfoods; fine. However 'Pemakan hewan renik' for micro-carnivores is vague; use 'karnivora mikro'.

Item 13: 'ukurannya pas untuk sekali telan' is fine, but 'bisa mencari makan di dasar' loses 'off the ground'; 'di permukaan daun' ok. Consider 'cacing sutra (tubifex) freeze-dried' as 'tubifex kering-beku'.

Item 9: "cukup lunak" for "moderately soft" is fine, but "sedikit lebih sejuk" with 22–26 °C is carried over from the source; no error there. The real issue is item 7: "minimal 8–12 ekor" turns "at least 8–12" into a vague range. Write "setidaknya 8–12 ekor" or "8–12 ekor atau lebih".

Item 12: "Cyclops beku, kutu air (daphnia) beku, dan pakan mikro beku" applies "beku" to every item. The English says "Frozen cyclops, daphnia, and microfoods", so it is acceptable, but "kutu air" for daphnia is a non-standard hobby term. Use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

Item 13: "cacing sutra kering beku (freeze-dried)" is wrong. Tubifex is not the same as Tubifex sutra worms, and "kering beku" is awkward. Use "tubifex freeze-dried" or "cacing tubifex yang dikeringbekukan".
Item 15: "neon tetra" is correct, but "udang hias kecil yang sudah dewasa" for "adult-sized dwarf shrimp" is a bit off. Write "udang kerdil dewasa".

Item 15: "mengedipkan mata" for "wink" is a literal rendering that is not clear to readers. It also drops "quickly looking down" as the way they do it. Rephrase, for example "seolah 'berkedip' dengan cepat menunduk".
Item 17: "Spesies penyebar telur" is fine, but "burayak" is correct. No fix needed here, so ignore it.

Item 18: "peternak" for "breeders" is fine, but "pita hitam di belakang kepala" and "pola belang-belang penuh" for "fully mottled pattern" are acceptable. The problem is "Dalam beberapa hari" for "Within a couple of days", which is fine too. The one real fault is "Cory pygmy" and "corydoras pygmy" being used inconsistently with "pygmy corys". Pick one term.
Item 4: "Corydoras pygmy" should keep the species form, so use "Corydoras pygmaeus" or "corydoras pygmy" consistently. "Originally discovered" is also rendered correctly.

Item 4: '90 × 30 cm (sekitar 81 liter)' — the original gives a base size with a volume figure; the volume is kept but the tank height is unspecified, so the 81 litres is an unsupported figure that may mislead; consider a clear rounded value or leave out the volume.

Item 9: 'betina yang sudah matang kelamin' — the English says 'sexually mature individuals' (not only females); this narrows the meaning. Use 'individu yang sudah matang kelamin' (probably the females, but not stated).

Item 10: 'Spawning mop' is left in English with a gloss, which is fine, but 'burayak' used for the 'fry' in the last paragraph is fine; 'kone alder' is a non-standard coinage. Use 'alder cone' alone or 'buah alder'.
Item 1: 'garis perbatasan' and 'tertukar' are slightly awkward; 'sungai yang menjadi sebagian besar garis perbatasan' is clumsy. Use 'sungai yang sebagian besar alirannya menjadi perbatasan'.
Item 11: 'diduga bahkan sedikit beracun' drops 'or venomous' (beracun/berbisa). Add 'atau berbisa'.
Item 3: 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is acceptable, but 'danau tapal kuda' is a poor term for oxbow lakes in Indonesian; use 'danau oxbow/bekas meander'.

Item 4: '90 × 30 cm (sekitar 81 liter)' – the volume is left as the source's figure, but a tank with a 90 × 30 cm base would normally be named by a standard size; check the volume against the tank table (e.g., 90×30×30 ≈ 81 L is the source's own estimate, so confirm it isn't mis-stated).
Item 2: type locality quote left in English ('tributary of Amazon River, 7 days by river boat from Manaus...'); translate it into Indonesian, keeping the coordinates unchanged.
Item 1/2: 'luas sebaran lengkapnya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'belum sepenuhnya jelas'.
Item 1: 'Bentuk albinonya kadang-kadang tersedia' is stiff; use 'Varian albino kadang tersedia di pasaran'.

Item 10: 'burayak' is correct for fry, but 'Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan' changes the subject. The English says the species is not the easiest to raise; keep the species as the subject.
Item 10: 'spawning mop' and 'alder cone' are left in English without a gloss; add a short Indonesian explanation (e.g., 'kone alder') at first mention.
Item 6: "~68 liter (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" is arithmetically right (68.4 L), so this is fine. No issue there.

Item 11: The English says "Females are ... broader-bodied than females" (an error in the source). The translation silently corrects it to "dibanding jantan". This is sensible, but it is a deviation from the source.

Item 12: "This occurs at the same time of year as the UK winter" was changed to "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara". This is wrong for the Amazon, where the wet season is not the northern winter. Use something neutral such as "bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris", or keep the source's meaning.

Item 12: "if summer breeding attempts are failing" became "upaya pemijahan di luar periode itu". The "summer" detail is lost. Restore it as "upaya pemijahan di musim panas", and replace "menunggu periode tersebut" with "menunggu musim dingin".

Item 12: "Use air-powered sponge or box-type filtration as fry won't be sucked into these" is slightly ambiguous. "filter kotak bertenaga aerator" is fine, but "karena burayak tidak akan tersedot" attaches to the wrong clause. Minor.
Item 7: "some floating cover" became "sedikit tanaman atau penutup yang mengapung". The added "tanaman" is acceptable, but "sedikit" is a little awkward. Minor.
Item 10: "ikan famili cyprinid" is awkward. Use "cyprinid" or "ikan karper kecil" instead.
Item 6: "~68 liter (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" is a computed volume and not a US-gallon tank, so it's fine; but "Panjang standar: 60 mm SL" keeps mm and should read 6 cm SL for consistency.

Item 12: "musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference; the source's "UK winter" is shop-specific, so rephrase neutrally (e.g. 'musim kemarau/musim dingin belahan bumi utara') or make clear it is the Northern Hemisphere winter.

Item 12: "Jantan lalu melepaskan sperma yang diduga melewati mulut dan insang betina, lalu diarahkan" - 'lalu' is repeated; use 'yang diduga melewati mulut dan insang betina sebelum diarahkan ke sirip perutnya'.

Item 12: "Pindahkan induk dan besarkan anakan di akuarium yang sama" - the English says 'remove the adults and raise the brood'; it should be 'Angkat/pisahkan induk', and the ambiguous 'Pindahkan' is acceptable but 'anakan' vs 'burayak' is inconsistent.
Item 9: "Mau menerima" is awkward; use 'Menerima' or 'Mau makan'.
Item 2/14: "hilir lembah Amazon" is awkward; use 'Amazon bagian hilir' or 'DAS Amazon bagian hilir'.
Item 13: "gelas atau wadah besar" - 'large cup' was rendered with an added alternative; use 'gelas besar' only.
Item 1: "teman dari spesies yang sama" is acceptable but 'sesama spesies' is more natural; 'secara total' is stiff.
"Ukurannya hampir tidak pernah mencapai 5 cm" is slightly off: "Hardly reaches 5 cm" means it barely reaches 5 cm. Use e.g. "Hampir tidak lebih dari 5 cm" or "Panjangnya nyaris hanya 5 cm".
"Dideskripsikan" and "dikoleksi" are stiff. Prefer "dideskripsikan/diperikan" and "ditangkap/dikumpulkan" for "was collected".
"Habitat alaminya adalah Rio Tique" is loose for "natural distribution". Use "Sebaran alaminya".

Item 4: "Volume: ~68 litres (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" – 60×38×30 cm is about 68 L, so this is fine; but "Panjang standar: 70 mm SL" is redundant (the abbreviation is left in English) – write "Panjang standar: 70 mm" or "SL (panjang standar)".

Item 10: "Musim ini jatuh pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris (belahan bumi utara)" – the added "(belahan bumi utara)" and the unexplained "pada bulan-bulan musim panas di sana" are insertions. The Indonesian reader would be confused by the UK reference; the source's meaning should be kept without adding new facts.
Item 10: "fry won't be sucked into these" – "burayak" is acceptable, but "filter box dengan aerator" is vague; use "filter spons atau filter kotak berpenggerak udara" (air-powered).
Item 10: "(meski bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan)" is awkward; use "(meski kadang sampai 4 butir)".
Item 7: "Mau makan sebagian besar pakan kering yang tenggelam" is stiff; use "Menerima sebagian besar pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 9: the English source says "females ... than females" (an error); the translation silently corrected this to "jantan", which is the sensible reading and is fine, so no change is needed here.
Item 4: "Volume: ~68 litres (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" is preserved, fine; but "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is OK. No issue there.

Item 10: "Inggris" and "musim dingin di Inggris" – source says UK winter; keep but this is acceptable; however "musim dingin" in the Indonesian reader context could be clarified (Indonesia has no winter).
Item 10: "Perilaku pemijahan ditandai dengan meningkatnya aktivitas dan kegelisahan" – "excitement" is better as "keaktifan/kegairahan", not "kegelisahan" (restlessness).
Item 10: "sementara jantan menjepit sungut betina" – 'grasps' is fine, but "posisi-T" should be "posisi T" (minor).
Item 7: "Mau menerima" is awkward; use "Menerima" or "Mau makan".
Item 5: "lele berlapis baja" (item 1) is a literal rendering of 'armoured catfish'; hobbyists say "lele lapis baja" or simply "corydoras" – minor.
Item 10: "anakan" vs "burayak" is used inconsistently for fry ("besarkan anakan ... besarkan burayak"); use one term.
Item 10: "Jantan kemudian melepaskan sperma" fine; however "filter kotak bertenaga aerator" is clumsy – use "filter spons atau filter box dengan aerator".
Item 9: English source has an error ("females ... than females"); translation corrected it to males, which is reasonable.
Items 2 and 6: "anak-anak sungai kecil, sungai kecil" is repetitive for "small tributaries, creeks". Use "anak sungai kecil, alur/parit air" or similar to separate the two.
Item 16: "gerombolan besar" for "large schools" sounds odd for fish. Use "kawanan besar" instead.
Item 4: "Mau menerima semua pakan buatan" is awkward for a fish; use "Menerima dengan baik semua pakan buatan..." or "Mudah menerima...".
Item 3: "kayu apung" is used for both driftwood and bogwood; fine in meaning, but "kayu bogwood/akar" could differentiate. Minor.
Item 1: "Rio Sararé, anak sungai di sisi kanan Rio Guaporé" is acceptable, but "Negara Bagian" is fine; "zirah" for armour plates is unusual, so prefer "lempeng tulang (scute)".
Item 8: reference left untranslated; "(Germany)" is fine, so no change is needed unless the style guide requires it.

Item 12: "This occurs at the same time of year as the UK winter" is rendered "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara". The meaning is shifted: the wet season in South America matches the northern-hemisphere winter, but Indonesian readers need it explained clearly. Better: "bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris/belahan bumi utara", or drop the UK reference.
Item 14: "Meski memakan benda kecil seperti telur atau burayak" lacks the "bite-sized" nuance. Use "benda berukuran kecil yang muat di mulut".
Item 14: "yang sebagian membuat cory" for "It's partly this ... that puts" is awkward. Rephrase as "sebagian alasan mengapa cory termasuk ikan paling populer".
Item 14: "Kory" vs source "cory": "kata Yunani kory" changes the spelling of the English source word. Use the Greek transliteration "korys" or keep "cory" consistently.
Items 1, 2, 7, 12: "burayak" is fine, but "anakan" is used for fry in item 12 ("besarkan anakan di akuarium yang sama"). Use one consistent term.
Item 12: "Neocardina heteropoda" is left as in the source. The correct spelling is Neocaridina heteropoda; a Latin name should stay unchanged, but flag it for checking.
Item 7: "kayu beech" and "daun oak" are left as English trade names, but Indonesian hobbyists may not know them. Add a gloss such as "kayu beech (bukan kayu lokal)", or use a local equivalent.
Item 12: "Sebagai pernapas udara fakultatif" is fine. But "Lele berlapis pelindung" for "armoured catfish" is a literal calque. Hobbyists use "lele berzirah" or "armoured catfish".
Item 6: "~68 liter" is a computed volume (60×38×30 = 68.4 L) and fine, but check that "cukup lega" matches "comfortably house"; no change needed otherwise.

Item 12: "Musim ini jatuh pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference. This is OK, but "di Inggris" is unlikely to be meaningful to Indonesian readers; consider "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara".
Item 12: "Neocardina heteropoda" is left as written in the source. Keep the Latin name unchanged.
Item 14: "Memang mereka akan menghabiskan sisa pakan ... Walaupun mereka akan memakan benda seukuran gigitan" is stiff. Rephrase as "Meski memakan benda kecil seperti telur atau burayak".
Item 14: "agresi ... hampir tidak pernah terdengar" is awkward. Use "hampir tidak pernah terjadi".
Item 14: "sisa pakan yang lolos dari ikan-ikan di atasnya" is okay, but "sungut mereka bisa terkena infeksi parah" adds "parah" for "nasty". This is acceptable.

Item 14: "Cory termasuk ... lele 'berlapis baja'" and the genus-name sentence leave "cory" as the Greek word, which is confusing. Use the Greek "kory" (helm) or write it as "korys" to separate it from the common name.
Item 7: "sungutnya bisa rusak/habis" uses a slash. Use "bisa rusak atau terkikis habis".
Item 13: "lapisan baja yang kuat" mistranslates "strong armor". Use "lapis pelindung/baju zirah yang kuat", not "baja" (steel).
Item 5: "Anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai kecil" is repetitive for "tributaries, creeks". Use "anak sungai dan kali kecil".
Item 15: "Permusuhan antarsesama spesies" is ambiguous for "intraspecific hostility"; use "agresi antar individu sesama spesies".
Item 13: "24–27 °C" changes the source range "24–26.5°C". Keep 26,5 °C, or note that it was rounded.
Item 9: "Mau menerima" sounds stilted. "Menerima" or "Mudah menerima" reads more naturally.
"Least Concern/LC" rendered as "Berisiko Rendah": the usual Indonesian IUCN term is "Risiko Rendah" or "Berisiko Rendah (LC)"; minor wording.
"Lineage 1" and "Garis keturunan" are mixed; use one term consistently, e.g. "Garis keturunan 1 (Lineage 1)".
"pembiak ikan" and "memijahkan" are acceptable, but "Sudah ada beberapa pembiak" is slightly stiff; "Ikan ini sudah dibiakkan oleh beberapa peternak" reads more naturally.
"tempat dua aliran bertemu dan menyatu ke sebuah anak sungai kecil" adds the nuance "menyatu"; the English says only that the two streams join a small tributary. Simplify it.
"di hobi akuarium" is slightly awkward; "di kalangan penghobi akuarium" is more natural.
"Least Concern" diterjemahkan "Risiko Rendah"; istilah IUCN baku di Indonesia adalah "Berisiko Rendah"/"Resiko Rendah (LC)" — samakan dengan istilah resmi.
"lele berlapis baja" untuk armored catfish kurang lazim bagi hobiis; gunakan "ikan Corydoras" atau "kucing berlapis baja (armored catfish)".
"peternak" / "mengawinkan" untuk breeder kurang natural di hobi akuarium; gunakan "pembiak" dan "memijahkan/membiakkan".
"Mau menerima pakan yang campur" kaku; lebih natural "Mudah menerima pakan campuran yang bervariasi".
"Nobua oba" dan "tempat dua aliran sungai bertemu dengan sebuah anak sungai" janggal; maknanya (dua aliran bertemu membentuk anak sungai kecil) kurang jelas.
"Garis punggung"/"pita punggung" untuk dorsal band/stripe; sebaiknya konsisten dan lebih jelas, mis. "pita di punggung".
"spesies tipe C. geoffroy La Cépède" — ejaan nama asli Latin diterjemahkan dengan benar, tetapi "Dias et al 2024" sebaiknya "dkk." atau dibiarkan konsisten.
"Lembah Rio Mamoré": "lembah" means valley. For a river basin, "daerah aliran sungai (DAS)" or "cekungan" is more accurate. This appears in items 1 and 2.
"lele berlapis baja": a literal rendering of "armoured catfish". Hobbyists would more naturally write "lele berzirah" or "lele lapis baja (armoured catfish)".
Item 6, "Mau menerima sebagian besar pakan kering...": the subject is missing and the wording is colloquial. Use something like "Ikan ini mau menerima..." or "Menerima...".

Item 14: "This occurs at the same time of year as the UK winter" was rendered as "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara"; the same goes for "musim panas belahan bumi utara". This changes the stated fact (UK) into a broader region, and the wet season in South America does not match northern-hemisphere winter in general. Keep it close to the source or state it neutrally and accurately.
Item 14: "Neocardina heteropoda" is left as in the source; the Latin name should stay unchanged, but the correct spelling is Neocaridina. Keep the name as given, no change needed from the translator.
Item 15: "Selain ukurannya jauh lebih besar, yaitu 7 cm" slightly changes "attaining a much larger size of 7 cm". Say "mencapai ukuran jauh lebih besar, yaitu 7 cm".
Item 12: "ikan keluarga cyprinid" and "cichlid kerdil" are acceptable but mixed. Consider "cyprinid" alone, or the local term "sirip kecil/ikan karper".
Item 11: "suka bergerombol dan berenang ke sana kemari" is fine, but "here and there" is vague; minor.
Item 9: "Saat ini diberi pakan" is fine; no change needed.
Item 1 and 2: "lele lapis baja" is OK, but hobbyists commonly say "corydoras" or "lele berlapis baja"; use "berlapis baja" consistently as in item 15.
Item 5: tank 45 × 30 × 30 cm (~41 litres) — 'Volume ~41 liter' is fine, but check consistency with the listing's tank-size convention; the text's 'Alas akuarium 45 × 30cm' is OK.

Item 14: 'Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris' — a UK-centric reference left in a text for Indonesian readers (no winter there); should be neutralised, e.g. 'saat musim dingin di belahan bumi utara', or explain that the rainy season in South America coincides with the northern-hemisphere winter.

Item 14: 'beberapa spesies tertentu bisa butuh beberapa tahun' — the source says 'several years for certain species'; fine, but 'Neocardina heteropoda' is rendered as 'Udang cherry' without the Latin spelling issue; keep as is.
Item 14: 'alder cone' left untranslated without explanation; add 'kerucut alder' or a short gloss.

"Temperamennya sangat lincah": "vivid temper" means a very lively/spirited, aggressive temperament; "lincah" (agile) changes the meaning and understates the warning. Use e.g. "sangat agresif/berangasan" or "temperamennya sangat keras".

"relationship" in "Central American Cichlasoma relationship" means group/affinity; "kelompok Cichlasoma Amerika Tengah" is acceptable, but "pemijah terbuka" and "pemijah gua" are fine. Consider "kerabat" if clearer (optional).

"Temperamennya sangat aktif dan galak": "vivid temper" means lively/spirited; "galak" (aggressive) is an added fact and "sangat aktif" is only approximate. Use e.g. "Temperamennya sangat lincah/hidup" without adding aggression.
"Cichlid berukuran agak kecil": the source says "smaller"; "agak kecil" is acceptable, but consider "relatif kecil" for consistency with sentence 2.
"kerabat Cichlasoma Amerika Tengah lainnya": "relationship" refers to a group/species complex. Use "kelompok Cichlasoma Amerika Tengah" for more precise wording.

Item 6: "Bleaching: high temperatures induce bleaching" leaves "bleaching" in English; it is explained once, so this is minor.
Item 10: the common names of the clownfish are left in English, e.g. "Maroon clownfish"; add the local names such as "ikan badut" where they exist.

Item 6: "Even with ample spacing ... it can move back" and "overpopulating" in the common problems list are fine, but "Some aquarists use this deliberately to induce splitting" is vague in the source; keep as is.
Item 5: 'Kahajan' became 'Kahayan' – fine, but 'Greater Sunda Islands of Borneo' rendered as 'Kalimantan'; acceptable. Real issue: 'Provinsi Kalimantan Selatan' drops 'Borneo' context; minor.
Item 3: 'Offspring are offered... farmed' – 'Anakan hasil penangkaran' adds 'hasil penangkaran' (captive-bred), not in the source; just say 'Anakan sesekali ditawarkan'.
Item 3: 'Adult wild specimens have recently been received' – 'pernah didatangkan' with 'Belakangan ini' is awkward; use 'baru-baru ini ... didatangkan'.
Item 12: 'ikan ini bisa cenderung bertengkar' is awkward/redundant; use 'bisa suka bertengkar'. 'perilaku ini' (hierarchy/group behaviour) is unclear.
Item 13: 'Sedikit lebih cocok ... dibanding kerabat segenusnya, E. bicolor' fine, but 'ikan lele/catfish' is a mixed term; use 'lele' consistently.

Item 16: 'Some SF forum members' was translated as 'Sebagian penghobi' – acceptable; however 'kiriman E. frenatum' for 'batches' ok. 'sport' translated 'mutasi genetik' is slightly stronger than 'genetic sport'.
Item 8: 'Namun, ikan ini akan tumbuh paling baik' – 'thrive' ok, but 'dirumput oleh ikan' is awkward; use 'dimakan/dirumput ikan'.
Item 6: 'streams and rivers' → 'sungai dan anak sungai' ok; 'aktivitas pembangunan oleh manusia' is redundant; use 'pembangunan oleh manusia'.
Item 1: 'konon pernah tumbuh' fine; 'Hal ini karena' slightly abrupt but ok.
Item 2: "Fishes sold as ... are often confused with it, but it has white-edged..." Translation "Padahal flying fox punya..." is OK, but "Difficulty: Moderate" fine. No issue; ignore.
Item 6: "pembangunan manusia" is a mistranslation of "human development"; use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan" (it does not mean human development in the HDI sense).
Item 8: "Namun, ikan ini akan tumbuh paling baik" - "However it will thrive" fine, but "cukup tidak tahan" is awkward for "quite intolerant"; use "sangat sensitif terhadap penumpukan limbah organik".
Item 12: "hal ini jauh tidak terlalu jadi masalah" is ungrammatical; use "masalah ini jauh berkurang".
Item 12: "bisa suka bertengkar" is awkward; use "bisa suka berkelahi" / "cenderung bertengkar".
Item 1: "Hal ini karena ikan terus tumbuh" fine, but "Flying fox bisa dengan mudah hidup" drops "such a"; minor.

Item 11: "Daphnia" translated as "kutu air" - acceptable, but "zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar" for blanched is fine; "Pada dasarnya ikan ini perumput aufwuchs" misses a verb, use "Pada dasarnya ikan ini adalah perumput aufwuchs".
Item 16: "jenis kelamin gramatikal" should be "gender gramatikal"; "tersilangkan" unnatural, use "terjadi hibridisasi/persilangan".
Item 16: "Tertukar dengan ikan mirip ... bukan hal yang jarang, dan sebagian besar disebabkan" is a hard-to-read subjectless sentence; rewrite it.
Item 5: "peternakan komersial" for "commercial farms" should be "tempat budidaya/penangkaran komersial"; also "Kahajan" was changed to "Kahayan" (acceptable).
#14: "more vigorous or larger species" is rendered "lebih agresif". Vigorous means energetic or fast at feeding, not aggressive. Use "lebih lincah/gesit" instead.
#17: "ikan catfish" is redundant. Use "ikan lele Amerika Selatan" or just "catfish Amerika Selatan".
Item 7: "sekitar 81 liter" is the exact conversion; a 90 × 30 × 30 cm tank is about 81 L but the table doesn't list it, so it is correct as whole litres. Keep it.

Item 12: English says "Primarily vegetarian" but ID "terutama herbivora" is fine. However "brush or beard" are translated as "alga sikat (brush) atau janggut (beard)", acceptable. The real problem: "Ikan ini mau makan pakan hidup dan beku ... dan pakan ini juga sebaiknya sesekali diberikan" is ok.
Item 11: Temperature 26–30 °C conflicts with item 10's 24–27 °C, but both match the English, so no change is needed.
Item 19: The reference list is untranslated, which is allowed.

Item 1: "super sensitive" became "sangat sensitif", which is fine. "Twig catfish" and "loricariid" were left in English; add the local term "ikan sapu-sapu ranting" or explain "loricariid" (keluarga Loricariidae).
Item 2: "si needle sucker" is awkward, and "needle sucker" is left untranslated. Use "ikan needle sucker" or similar.
Item 17: "Sebagian besar literatur yang ada menyebut keduanya F. acus dan F. gracilis" is fine. "catfish" is left in English; use "ikan lele/catfish Amerika Selatan".
Item 16: "kematian di hari-hari awal" is fine. "daun oak" could be "daun ek", which is minor.
Item 1: "mutlak hidup" for "obligate dweller" is awkward; use "hanya hidup di" or "penghuni sejati/eksklusif".
Items 1 and 3: "batuan induk" for "bedrock" is a geology term; "dasar batu padat" or "batuan dasar" is more natural.
Item 3: "daerah aliran Sungai Mendawai" is fine, but the common "sungai kecil" for "streams" in "sungai kecil berarus deras" is OK; "Hypergastromyzon, Gastromyzon" is OK; no issue there.
Item 4: "klad" for "clade" is jargon; "klade" is the standard spelling.
Item 4: "menjadi zat tanduk" for "horny" is awkward; use "bertanduk (mengeras seperti tanduk)".
Item 6: "pita yang lebih terang di bagian atasnya ke arah punggung" is slightly wordy and adds "di sisi tubuh"; simplify to "pita yang lebih terang di dekat punggung".
Item 2: "Ikan tangkapan alam" is acceptable, but "ikan liar/tangkapan alam" could be phrased more naturally; "Siamese algae eater" is fine, though "sucker/ikan sapu-sapu" confusion should be avoided.
Item 4: "suka bermain di dalamnya" is awkward; use "suka bermain di arus tersebut".
Item 6: "Volume: ~81 litres" for a 90 × 30 cm base needs tank height; the translation keeps the source figure, so no fix is required here. Ignore this note.
Item 15: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "Tubifex" in item 11 is also rendered as "cacing sutra". Keep this consistent.
Item 5: "batu kerikil bulat" for pebbles is awkward. Use "kerikil besar" or "batu kali".
Item 5: "Dasarnya didominasi batu besar dan batu kecil" for "rocks and stones" is acceptable but loose. Keep the terms consistent with the earlier substrate wording.
Item 5: "anak sungai" for "stream" and "beberapa anak sungai dan sungai" in item 4 suggest tributaries. Use "sungai kecil" or "aliran sungai".
Item 5: "Kamyit Chaung" is rendered as "Di Kamyit Chaung" while the source says "In the Kamyit Chaung river". Minor, but "sungai Kamyit Chaung" is closer.
Item 1: "Burma" is used in item 1 and "Myanmar" elsewhere, which matches the source. No fix needed. Ignore this note.

Item 7: "Memelihara Garra flavatra sangat mudah." conflicts with the longer care text, which says the fish needs stable, mature, well-oxygenated water. The English says "very easy", so this is faithful, but check whether the source is inconsistent.

Item 9: "Parameter air lainnya tidak berpengaruh baginya" says the other parameters have no effect, which matches the source. However, it conflicts with item 10 (pH 6.5–7.5, 2–12 dGH). Check whether this is intended.
Item 5/17: "Garra sensu stricto" and "klad" are fine. "sebaran" in "memiliki sebaran yang lebih luas" is fine.

#10: "Growth" (the algal film, i.e. Aufwuchs) is translated as "Lapisan biofilm". This adds the term "biofilm", which the English does not use here. Something like "Lapisan tumbuhan/alga (aufwuchs)" would be more faithful.
#12: "batu-batu berlumut alga" is awkward, because "berlumut" means mossy. Use "batu-batu yang ditumbuhi alga", as in #10.
#16: "Saat dicoba langsung" is vague for "In a self-experiment". Use "Dalam percobaan pada diri sendiri".
#16: "pemakan alga yang hebat" is a bit colloquial. "pemakan alga yang andal/baik" is more suitable for a handbook.
"menampung otot-otot yang diperlukan" is slightly wordy; could be "menampung otot terbang yang diperlukan".
Item 6: 'batu dan koral sungai' mistranslates 'water-worn rocks and pebbles'. 'Koral' means coral. Use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali dan kerikil'.
Item 6: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add an Indonesian gloss such as 'lapisan alga dan biofilm (aufwuchs)'.

Item 9: 'ikan lele penyuka arus' for 'rheophilic catfishes' is imprecise, because Glyptothorax, Akysis and Hara are not true lele. Use 'ikan catfish penyuka arus' or 'ikan berkumis penghuni arus deras'.
Item 8: 'gangguan pencernaan' for 'internal problems' narrows the meaning. Use 'gangguan kesehatan internal' or 'masalah organ dalam'.

Item 3: "perkelahiannya selalu tidak berbahaya" is stilted; better "perkelahian di antara mereka selalu tidak membahayakan". "tidak peduli dengan spesies lain" is slightly off for "not interested in other species"; use "tidak mengganggu spesies lain".

Item 6: "Artinya, tidak kurang dari 33 spesies yang dulu dalam impor dimasukkan ke 3 spesies saja" is clumsy; the original says "assigned to 3 species in earlier imports". Rephrase as "yang pada impor terdahulu digolongkan ke dalam 3 spesies".

Item 6: "This was accompanied by a true species explosion" became "jumlah spesiesnya langsung melonjak", which drops the "accompanied by" idea and the "true explosion" emphasis. Use "disertai ledakan jumlah spesies yang sesungguhnya".
Item 6: "perlu pengalaman yang sangat banyak" is unnatural; use "membutuhkan pengalaman luas". Also "not so easy as one can imagine" is OK, but "Hanya saja" shifts the tone.

Item 5: "tidak menjaga telur maupun anaknya" adds "anaknya" (fry); the original says "brood care" in general. This is fine in meaning, but "celah-celah antarbatu" for "gap system between the pebbles" should be "rongga antarkerikil", because the text refers to pebbles/gravel, not stones.
Item 2: "segala jenis pakan mau dimakan" is a redundant, clumsy addition after "sangat mudah diberi pakan"; merge into "sangat mudah diberi pakan jenis apa pun".
Item 4: "Jantan bisa dibedakan dari betina ... dari sisik" repeats "dari"; use "ditandai oleh sisik kelenjar besar". "sirip perut" is OK.
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air" is clumsy for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 6: "Kayu rendaman (driftwood) yang sudah lama" is a loose rendering of "aged driftwood". "Kayu apung/driftwood yang sudah lama dikeringkan/matang" is clearer.
Item 11: "dinaikkan secara bertahap sampai 28 °C selama 8 minggu" adds "secara bertahap", which the English does not say. It is minor and could be dropped.

Item 12: "ada alur sublakrimal" in the G. ridens group list — the English says "subacrymal groove" (typo for sublacrymal); fine, but the main diagnosis said "sublacrymal groove present and visible when viewed laterally"; ok. Real issue: "sirip perut tidak menutupi pangkal sirip dubur" fine.

Item 11: "tubuh keduanya digambarkan saling mengunci di atas, terlepas dari dasar" — wrong: should be "saling mengunci jauh dari dasar / di atas dasar (tidak menempel pada substrat)"; "di atas" is ambiguous and "terlepas dari dasar" is awkward.

Item 11: "untuk mengondisikan mereka siap memijah" and "Teramati setidaknya 100 telur" okay, but "dengan beberapa individu tampak lebih menjaga wilayahnya ... yang sering kali berupa titik makan terbaik" (item 9) is ambiguous: "yang" seems to refer to individuals rather than the territory (a prime feeding spot); rephrase.

Item 11: "Kali ini burayak ... muncul begitu saja seiring waktu" — "Pemijahan teramati terus-menerus" fine. "Suhu kemudian dinaikkan sampai 28 °C selama 8 minggu" — original says raised over a period of 8 weeks (gradual), not 'for 8 weeks'; change to "secara bertahap selama 8 minggu".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward/added meaning; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air (water-worn)".

Item 6: "air harus bersih dan kaya oksigen" fine, but "Spons filter yang terbuka juga akan dikerok" — "dikerok" for grazed is OK; "Kayu apung" for driftwood is better as "kayu rendaman/kayu bakau (driftwood)"; "kayu apung" means floating wood.

Item 4: "loach ini cenderung paling banyak di bagian yang teduh sebagian atau sepenuhnya" is clumsy; say "paling melimpah di area yang sebagian atau seluruhnya ternaungi". Also "sungai kecil" for streams OK.
Item 8: "gangguan pencernaan" for "internal problems" narrows the meaning; use "masalah internal".
Item 9: "lele rheofilik" — Glyptothorax/Akysis/Hara are catfish; "lele" is misleading, prefer "ikan patin/catfish arus deras" or keep "catfish".

Section 5 Humidity: 'It can be changed by adding moisture' was rendered as 'menyemprotkan air atau menambah sumber kelembapan' – added fact (spraying); keep to 'menambah kelembapan atau mengurangi/menambah ventilasi'.
Section 5 Molting: 'restore lost limbs' became 'menumbuhkan kembali anggota tubuh' – acceptable, but 'Jangan pernah mengganggu ... momen paling menegangkan' fine; no issue.

Section 5 Substrate: 'Use coconut fiber, soil and peat' – added '(cocopeat)' is fine; but 'kekentalan seperti "pasir untuk istana pasir"' is awkward; use 'tekstur seperti pasir basah untuk membuat istana pasir' ('kekentalan' is wrong for texture).

Section 4: 'Ideally the land area should take at least 70%... or more' fine; but 'Kepiting muda ... butuh air' omits nothing; however 'tutup yang rapat itu wajib' is colloquial for a handbook; use 'tutup yang rapat sangat penting'.
Section 9: 'adults spend little time in the water' → 'hanya sebentar berada di dalam air' is slightly off; use 'jarang berada di dalam air'.

Section 11: 'Menjelang menetas, betina lebih menyembunyikan diri' is awkward; use 'betina menjadi lebih tertutup/menyembunyikan diri'. 'Mereka tidak butuh air asin untuk berkembang biak; betina melepaskan telur di air tawar' fine.
Section 6: 'pH: at least 7.0–8.0' rendered 'pH 7,0–8,0 (minimal 7,0)' – acceptable but restructure; 'syok suhu' ok.
Section 8: 'bugs' translated 'kepik/serangga kecil' – adds a specific insect (kepik); use 'serangga kecil'. 'dead plant parts' fine.
Section 3/12: 'juveniles ... not frequently seen on drier forest ground' fine. Section 12 'kaki jalan' fine; 'squarish' ok.

Section 5 Molting: "memungkinkannya menumbuhkan kembali anggota tubuh yang hilang" is fine, but "Substrat ... Gunakan serat kelapa (cocopeat), tanah, dan gambut" is OK; the real problem: "Wadah harus punya beberapa tempat sembunyi" is fine, yet "Kelembapan bisa diatur dengan menambah kelembapan" is circular; say "menyemprotkan air/menambah sumber kelembapan".
Section 4: "Idealnya area darat mengambil minimal 70% ruang akuarium" is OK, but "Kepiting Red Devil sangat pandai kabur" is awkward; use "jago kabur" or "pandai meloloskan diri".
Section 8: EN "they are not vegetarians" translated as "bukan herbivora" — slightly changes meaning (vegetarian vs herbivore); better "bukan pemakan tumbuhan saja".
Section 8: "Pakan yang mereka sukai: ... pakan serpihan" fine; but "bugs" rendered as "serangga" duplicates the insect category; use "kepik/serangga kecil".

Section 8: "cuttlebones" as "tulang sotong" is fine, but "figs" as "buah tin" fine; "mereka bahkan bisa saling memangsa (kanibal)" OK. Minor: "Moss adalah tempat favorit untuk nongkrong" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "tempat favorit untuk bertengger dan bersembunyi".
Section 6: "pH: minimal 7,0–8,0" mirrors the English awkwardness; clearer "pH 7,0–8,0 (minimal 7,0)".

Section 11: "Betina melepaskan anakan" and "Anakan kepiting sebaiknya diberi pakan ... pakan yang sama seperti induknya" fine; "betina jadi lebih tertutup" is unnatural for "secretive"; use "lebih tertutup/pemalu" → "lebih menyembunyikan diri".
Section 12: "Umur ... tergantung penyakit" okay; "Hatchlings are almost dark" rendered "hampir gelap seluruhnya" slightly adds "seluruhnya"; use "hampir gelap".
"rimbunan tanaman" for "plantation" is loose: the source term here likely means a planted thicket or spawning plants; consider "area tanaman" or "rumpun tanaman".
"peternak" for "breeder" is non-standard in the aquarium hobby; use "breeder" or "pembudidaya".
"memukau" for "splendid" slightly overstates the colour; "indah" or "cemerlang" would be more natural.
"pemijah berkelanjutan" is awkward for "continuous spawners"; consider "pemijah sepanjang waktu" or "memijah terus-menerus".
"kusam" is acceptable, but "kurang cerah" would read more naturally for "quite dull colours".

Item 4: "Habitat asli ... terletak di bagian barat Papua Nugini" — Lake Sentani is in Indonesian Papua, not Papua New Guinea. The English says this, but the translation should not keep the error (item 2 and 5 say Indonesia/New Guinea). Fix, e.g. "bagian barat Pulau Papua (New Guinea), Indonesia".
Item 2: "Ikan hasil penangkaran massal warnanya jauh lebih pucat" — the English says "far less colour". "Pucat" is acceptable, but "kurang berwarna" is more faithful.
Item 1: "bikin heboh" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "menimbulkan kehebohan". The English also says "storms of enthusiasm", which is lost.
Item 3: "seiring setiap sentimeter pertumbuhan ikan" is awkward. Use "bertambah indah setiap pertambahan panjang satu sentimeter". "Tapi ... pun" is clumsy; use "Namun".
Item 14: "Filter kecil bertenaga aerator" is unclear. Use "filter udara kecil (air-driven)". "burayak" is a less common term than "anakan" among hobbyists.
Item 10: "Pemberian pakan beku dan pakan hidup" is correct, but "Tidak rewel" is slightly informal. Optionally use "Tidak pilih-pilih makanan".
Item 8: "paling cocok tampil" is awkward. Use "tampak paling betah/serasi".
Item 1: "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is acceptable, but "pangkal ekor ... relatif tinggi" is fine; consider "tangkai ekor" as the more common hobby term for caudal peduncle.
Item 3: "Lele Sisoridae" is slightly odd; consider "Ikan lele sisorid" or keep "Sisoridae" as a family name without "Lele".
Item 3: "melawan arus kuat" reads a little awkwardly; "di tengah arus kuat" or "agar tidak terbawa arus kuat" is more natural.
Item 4: "mutlak diperlukan" is stronger than "necessary"; use "diperlukan" or "perlu".
Item 6: "pakan buatan" for "prepared foods" is acceptable, but "pakan olahan/pelet" may be closer to the source.
Item 2: "Kalimantan" for Borneo, and Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo, not Kalimantan (Indonesian territory). Use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo)" or "Borneo" so the type locality is not wrongly placed.
Item 2: "Malaysia dan Kalimantan" implies a separate region; use "Borneo" for Malaysian Borneo.
Item 1: "Least Concern" is rendered as "Risiko Rendah"; use the standard IUCN term "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah" (minor).
Item 1: "tubuh gempal" and "kekar" are redundant for "robust, stout-bodied" (minor).
Item 9: "Unreported" is expanded to "pemijahan" (spawning), which the English doesn't state. Use "Belum pernah dilaporkan" or "Belum ada laporan di akuarium".
Item 1 and 11: 'evidently delicate and recommended only to experienced aquarists' became 'jelas tergolong sensitif dan sulit dipelihara'. 'sulit dipelihara' is an added claim; delete it.
Item 1: 'Max size: 32 mm SL (1.3 in)' is fine. 'over silt' was translated as 'lumpur halus'; plain 'lanau' or 'lumpur' is closer.
Item 5: 'it should never be introduced to a new aquarium' became 'akuarium yang baru disiapkan'. Say 'akuarium baru (belum matang/belum siklus)' to make clear it means an uncycled tank.
Item 5: 'air-powered sponge-type unit' became 'filter spons bertenaga aerator'. 'Filter spons bertenaga udara (aerator)' is more natural.
Item 9: 'fin spines' was translated as 'duri', but the item 11 original says 'rays'. The source is inconsistent, so keep it, but 'filamen seperti benang' is redundant. Use 'filamen'.
Item 11: 'Betina tidak berpigmen (bening)' for 'Females colourless' is acceptable but is an interpretation. Use 'tidak berwarna'.
Item 7: 'dianggap wajib' is slightly too strong or unnatural. Use 'sebaiknya dianggap sangat penting'.
Item 4: '(24 × 12 in)' was dropped, which is allowed. 'Volumenya sekitar 54 liter' is fine.
"kerabatnya, G. polyuranodon" is vague for "congener"; say "satu genus" (e.g. "spesies segenus, G. polyuranodon").
"piscivora" is jargon; "pemakan ikan" alone (or "karnivora pemakan ikan") reads more naturally.
"Moray" is left untranslated; the common Indonesian "belut moa" or "mura" could be added once, e.g. "belut moray".
"500 mm SL": "SL" (standard length) is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" and perhaps cm (50 cm).
"cyprinid": could use "ikan suku Cyprinidae", which is more natural.

"hidup di tempat yang sama" for sympatric is fine, but "biasanya mengalir melewati hutan tropis" is ambiguous: the subject is the river, not the fish. Rephrase as "sungai yang biasanya melewati hutan tropis".
"Terutama ikan sungai": "Predominantly" is better rendered as "Umumnya".
"bimaculata... Sarawak": the "bibiography" typo in the reference list is left as in the source, which is acceptable.
Item 1: "Butuh akuarium dengan panjang minimal 2 m" conflicts with 240 cm base, but it's faithful to the source; fine. Real issue: item 1 says "memutar air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam" – OK.
Item 5: Volume "~864 liter" is correct for 240×60×60; fine.

Item 12: "bercak depannya terletak di bawah separuh belakang sirip punggung" – OK, but "di Kalimantan" placement is awkward: "negara bagian Sarawak, Malaysia, di Kalimantan" should be "negara bagian Sarawak di Pulau Kalimantan, Malaysia".
Item 8: "ikan teri (whitebait)" – whitebait is not teri; use "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)" or similar.
Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but "ikan 'pakan'" should be "ikan umpan/feeder fish".
Item 8: "sebagian ikan kecil" for 'some smaller fish also taken' reads as a portion of fish; better "serta beberapa ikan yang lebih kecil".
Item 9: "ikan yang kalah dominan" for 'subdominant fish' is awkward; use "ikan yang berstatus subdominan".
Item 2/6: "cyprinid ... mudah kaget" for 'skittish' okay; but "Wajib pakai tutup" in item 2 is stronger than the source 'Needs'; use "Perlu".
Item 11: "schooling fish ... very peaceful" fine, but item 12 "pemalu"/"gugup" okay; main issue: item 10 "ikan teri kecil (whitebait)" – whitebait is not teri; use "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)".
Item 10: "ikan mas koki kecil" – 'small goldfish' fine, but "feeder fish" translated as "ikan pakan hidup" loses the 'feeder fish' sense; use "ikan umpan (feeder)".
Item 12: "ikan catfish (ikan berkumis)" is redundant/odd; use "ikan lele-lelean (catfish)" or just "catfish".
Item 12: "ikan yang kalah dominan" is awkward for 'subdominant fish'; use "ikan yang berada di peringkat bawah".
Item 12: "loach botiid" and "cyprinid, characid" left in English; use "loach famili Botiidae"/"ikan karper (Cyprinidae)" for naturalness.

Item 15: "tidak semestinya dianggap sebagai ikan akuarium kecuali dalam kondisi yang sangat ekstrem" – ok; "Anakan kedua spesies" fine. In item 3 'jungle perch'/'sidebar barb' fine.
Item 5: "lubuk-lubuk dalam" is ok; "perairan bendungan" is awkward for 'impounded water bodies'; use "perairan yang dibendung/waduk".
Item 6: 'Standard length: 700 mm SL' converted to 70 cm is fine; 'Hanya cocok untuk akuarium publik' fine.
Item 1: "mencengkeram ikan mangsa" is weak for 'fix a food fish'; use "menangkap/menahan ikan mangsa".

Item 18: 'Ikan ini juga dimasukkan ke dalam kelompok spesies buatan' – 'buatan' (artificial) is awkward; use 'kelompok spesies artifisial/tidak alami'.
Item 18: 'diverifikasi...memvalidasi kembali genus' – use 'mengesahkan kembali (revalidasi) genus Ectrepopterus'.

Item 11: "volume sekitar 54 liter" — the figure is given in the source, so fine, but item 8 etc. OK; main issue is elsewhere.

Item 14: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" — Daphnia/Moina are not exactly "kutu air" in the source sense; "larva chironomid (cacing darah) hidup maupun beku" fine. Keep Daphnia, Moina as written; "kutu air" is an addition.

Use 'akuarium komunitas yang dirancang dengan matang'.

Item 13: 'Daphnia, Moina' glossed as 'kutu air' — Moina and Daphnia are both 'kutu air' but 'jentik nyamuk' okay; fine. Item 18: 'garis keturunan polifiletik' is awkward; use 'kelompok polifiletik'.
Item 18: 'diffuse humeral spot' rendered 'bercak humeral yang samar' acceptable, but 'peralihan' for 'intermediate' should be 'bentuk antara/perantara'.
