Item 3: "bintik-bintik cokelat belang" is an awkward rendering of "mottled brown speckling"; use "bintik-bintik cokelat berbercak". Also "menyatu dengan baik dengan lingkungan" repeats "dengan"; use "berbaur dengan lingkungan sekitarnya".
Item 3: "transparan" for "translucent" is fine, but item 5 uses "bening dan transparan" for "clear and translucent". Use "bening dan tembus cahaya" or "agak transparan".
Item 11: "cull ... lakukan seleksi (culling)" softens the advice. Culling means removing the less colourful shrimp. Use "singkirkan udang yang warnanya kurang cerah".
Item 11: "ganti ke akuarium yang lebih besar" for "upgrade the tank" is okay, but "Tambah jumlah pakan" reads clumsily. Use "Beri lebih banyak pakan".

Item 8: "Easy Fry and Small Fish Food" is a product name, so keep it as is. Items 4 and 8 leave "grazing" in English with no gloss: "bahan grazing" and "untuk grazing jangka panjang". Use "tempat merumput/mencari makan" or "bahan makanan yang dikais".
Item 8: "sayuran ... yang sudah direbus sebentar (blansir)" is acceptable. "Kayu cholla" is fine.
Item 5: "dicari sebagai makanan" is clumsy for "forage on". Use "dijelajahi untuk mencari makan". "Kulit molting" is also inconsistent with "eksoskeleton lama"; use "Kulit hasil molting".
Item 6: "mereka lebih menyukai pH 6,5–8,5" is fine. "molting" is left in English throughout. "Ganti kulit" or "pergantian kulit" is the common Indonesian hobby term, so gloss it once.
Item 9 vs 10: source figures conflict (pH 6.0–7.2, 20–25 °C vs 3.5–6.5, 23–26 °C), but the translation is faithful. No change needed there, so only the issues below.
Item 1: "Least Concern" is left in English. Use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" or "Berisiko Rendah".
Item 11: "Sediakan arus air yang kuat" is faithful, but item 8 says torrent-like flow is unnecessary. This is a source inconsistency, so keep it as is.
Item 14: "Pseudomugil" is rendered "Spesies Pseudomugil", which is fine. The "Ikan danionin" wording is slightly awkward. Consider "danionin" alone or "ikan sejenis danio".
Item 15: "geografis tidak dipermasalahkan" loses the sense of "if geography isn't an issue". Better: "jika asal geografis tidak menjadi kendala".
Item 12: "Sayuran yang direbus sebentar" is fine. "Soilent Green" is fine.
Item 5: "merumput biofilm" is awkward. Better: "memakan biofilm" or "mengerok biofilm".
Item 17: "setup tema sungai" is added wording. The source says "mature, heavily seasoned river setups". Better: "setup bergaya sungai yang sudah matang dan lama berjalan".

Item 4: "dan negara bagian Perak" is unclear and could be read as a separate list item. Rephrase as "hutan rawa gambut Selangor Utara di negara bagian Selangor, serta negara bagian Perak di barat laut".
Item 20: "diakui ... valid" and "anggota balitorid sebelumnya" read stiffly. Consider "banyak yang dulu tergolong balitorid".
Section 7: "garam laut khusus akuarium laut" is fine, but "Never use ordinary aquarium salt" became "garam ikan biasa"; use "garam akuarium biasa".
Section 2: "can make a great pet" became "sangat menarik"; "peliharaan yang bagus" is closer.
Section 12: "pasang purnama" for "spring tides" is imprecise; use "pasang tertinggi (pasang purnama/perbani)" or "pasang perbani".
Section 12: "di cabang-cabang (divertikula) yang bercabang" is redundant, so reword it.
Section 1/6: Mixed English terms "Setup" and "Spider crab" are left untranslated; "Setup" could be "Penataan" or "Tipe set-up".
Section 9: "Kepiting ini tidak aman dengan tanaman" is awkward; use "tidak aman dipelihara bersama tanaman".
Section 9: "Pemberian pakan dilakukan setiap hari" and "leaves can stay in the tank for weeks" are acceptable, but "sayuran hijau berdaun" is redundant.

Item 3: "Sebarannya yang terbatas disebabkan oleh toleransinya..." – 'limited range' is rendered OK, but "tekanan hidraulik (arus)" adds a parenthetical gloss not in the source; remove "(arus)" or use "tekanan hidrolik".

Item 3: "sungai kecil" for 'streams' is fine, but "kecepatan arus 0–2 m/s ... di atas 6 m/s" leaves out nothing; no issue—however "Batman snail" in item 1 list is left in English while elsewhere "keong Batman" is used; use "Keong Batman (disebut juga keong Telinga)" consistently.

Item 5: "mungkin menggerogoti daun yang sedang mati" – 'dying leaves' is better as "daun yang hampir mati/mulai layu"; "menggerogoti" is also too strong for 'nibble' (use "mengerat/menyantap sedikit").
Item 5: "masukkan hanya ke akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya sudah selesai" is wordy; use "masukkan hanya ke akuarium yang sudah cycling".

Item 6: "Suhu: 22–26 °C" fine, but "memiliki tingkat kelangsungan hidup" repeated; use "tingkat kelangsungan hidupnya" for natural flow. Also "Karena itu, mereka membutuhkan masa adaptasi yang panjang agar bisa dipelihara jangka panjang di kondisi yang berbeda" is awkward; use "agar dapat dipelihara dalam jangka panjang pada kondisi air yang berbeda".
Item 9: "Seperti kebanyakan keong, mereka hidup soliter dan tidak aktif mencari keong lain" – "mengacak substrat yang gembur" is awkward; use "mengusik substrat yang lepas".

Item 9: "lobster air tawar (bahkan lobster cebol Meksiko...)" – crayfish is usually "crayfish/lobster air tawar"; fine, but "teman setangkinya" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lainnya" or "tank mate".
Item 7: "substrat soil" – use "tanah (soil)"; "24 jam nonstop" fine. Item 8: "merumput" for grazing is acceptable but "kotoran organik" for 'organic debris' should be "serpihan organik/detritus".

Item 10: "They can be too heavy for grass-like plants" is rendered "Siput ini bisa terlalu berat sehingga merusak tanaman" – adds the fact of damaging plants; use "Tanaman ini bisa terlalu berat/lebat bagi tanaman berbentuk rumput" faithfully, or keep the original meaning (the snails may be too heavy for delicate plants).
Item 10: "Leave it under the strongest lighting... ideally 24/7" is rendered "idealnya menyala 24 jam"; use "24 jam nonstop" for clarity (minor).

Item 17: "Pulligerus ... 'pullus' (young, or dark-coloured)" is rendered "muda"; OK, but "depending on feeding, poor living conditions" became "buruk tidaknya kondisi pemeliharaan", which is awkward; use "tergantung pakan, kondisi pemeliharaan yang buruk, dan stres pengiriman".
Item 12: "Social: no" translated "Hidup berkelompok: tidak"; use "Sosial: tidak" for fidelity (minor).
Item 7: "Dekorasi: kayu (driftwood)" fine, but "Sebagian besar herbivora" in item 3 lacks subject; use "Siput ini sebagian besar herbivora".
Item 15: "which poses a potential biohazard" was expanded with an added explanation "(membawa penyakit/parasit)"; remove this addition.
Item 15: "Pembiakan berhasil di laboratorium pun belum pernah dilaporkan" is fine, but "membutuhkan air payau untuk berkembang biak" fine; "larva" statement OK.

#10: "Siput ini bisa terlalu berat untuk tanaman berbentuk rumput" – 'They' (the snails) can be too heavy/rough for grass-like plants; wording is ambiguous, rephrase e.g. 'Siput ini bisa terlalu berat/merusak bagi tanaman berbentuk rumput'.

#10: "idealnya menyala 24 jam" – ok, but 'Opsional: tambahkan pupuk' fine; however "mereka sebagian besar memakan alga" and 'scavenging' translated as "mencari makan sendiri" is slightly loose; use 'mengais/merumput'.
#12: "Hidup berkelompok: tidak" for 'Social: no' is okay, but "predator yang berburu dengan penglihatan" is awkward; use 'predator visual'.
#12: "Saat senja, alga mengandung nutrisi paling banyak di akhir periode fotosintesis" is clumsy; rephrase 'karena di akhir periode fotosintesis kandungan nutrisi alga paling tinggi'.

#15: "Mereka membutuhkan air payau untuk berkembang biak" in the intro follows 'berkembang' vs original 'breed' – fine; but "berpotensi menjadi risiko biologis" for 'biohazard' is vague; use 'bahaya biologis (membawa penyakit/parasit)'.
#15: "Belum ada laporan keberhasilan pembiakan di kondisi laboratorium juga" – awkward; use 'Pembiakan berhasil di laboratorium pun belum pernah dilaporkan'.
#17: "dipakai sebagai sinonim junior" – use 'sinonim yunior/lebih muda (junior synonym)'; "kondisi hidup yang buruk" under lifespan reads oddly.
#6: "wadah yang lebih kecil" vs 'anything smaller' fine; "Di alam mereka hidup" ok. #8: "air sadah" for hard water fine.

Section 10: "Bobot dan cara merumput siput ini bisa terlalu berat/kasar" adds facts not in the English (the original only says 'They can be too heavy'). Use plain "Siput ini bisa terlalu berat bagi...".
Section 15: "(misalnya membawa penyakit atau parasit)" is an added explanation not in the source. Remove it and keep "risiko biologis".
Section 6: "20 liter adalah batas minimum mutlak" is fine, but "lower the waterline" is rendered correctly. No issue here, so ignore this point.
Section 12: "menyimpan nutrisi paling banyak" and "predator yang berburu dengan penglihatan" are stiff. Prefer "predator visual" and "kandungan nutrisi alga paling tinggi".
Section 10: "Beri pakan tambahan" is fine, but "sayuran yang direbus sebentar" for 'blanched' is acceptable. "24 jam nonstop" is also acceptable, so no change needed.

Section 13: "Pengalaman dengan siput ini menunjukkan" is awkward. Rephrase it, e.g. "Menurut pengalaman, siput ini tidak keluar dari air...". This also conflicts with section 6, which says they can crawl out, but that conflict is in the source.
Section 1: "Black Military Helmet Snail" is left in English with no Indonesian name, unlike section 2, where one is given. Consider adding "siput nerite hitam" in brackets for consistency.
#2: "Pitchblack racing snail" rendered as "Siput nerite hitam pekat" drops the 'racing' part of the common name; keep the name (e.g. 'Pitchblack racing snail') or give it in brackets.

#10: "Siput ini bisa terlalu berat untuk tanaman berbentuk rumput" is ambiguous. 'They can be too heavy' means the snails' weight/grazing is too much for delicate grass-like plants; say this clearly (e.g. 'terlalu berat/kasar bagi tanaman berbentuk rumput').
#12: "Hidup berkelompok: tidak" for 'Social: no' is acceptable, but "yang menguntungkan hewan perumput" is loose; better 'cocok bagi hewan pemakan alga'.
#17: "tergantung pemberian pakan, kondisi hidup yang buruk" is awkward; use 'tergantung pakan, kondisi hidup yang kurang baik, dan stres pengiriman'.
#14: 'pullus (young, or dark-coloured)' and 'dark-coloured sea snail' are fine, but "dipakai sebagai sinonim junior" is stiff; better 'digunakan sebagai sinonim junior'.
#7: "jangan langsung dicemplungkan" is colloquial for a handbook; use 'dimasukkan begitu saja'. 'aklimatisasikan' should be 'aklimatisasi'.

#15: "membawa risiko biologis" for 'biohazard' is vague; clarify as risiko biologis (misalnya membawa penyakit/parasit). "Belum ada laporan keberhasilan pembiakan dalam kondisi laboratorium juga" is awkward word order.
#10: 'Horned Nerite' left in English without a local term; add 'siput nerite bertanduk' or brackets.
#3: "Papua/Nugini" is awkward; use "Papua Nugini" only.
#9: "pelihara tanaman air hidup ... untuk memancing pertumbuhan alga" is slightly odd; "merangsang" is more natural.
#9: "Mereka termasuk sedikit spesies nerite" is awkward; use "salah satu dari sedikit spesies nerite".
#9: "mungkin bahkan memakan alga black beard" is clumsy; use "bahkan bisa memakan".
#12: "berpotensi membawa risiko biologis" for "biohazard" is vague; "risiko biosekuriti/penyakit" is clearer.
#12: "Belum ada laporan pembiakan yang berhasil di laboratorium juga" is awkward word order; use "Di laboratorium pun belum ada laporan...".
#13: "kondisi hidup yang buruk" listed as a factor is awkward; use "kondisi pemeliharaan yang buruk".
#13: "siput laut" is inconsistent with "keong" used elsewhere; use "keong laut".

Item 2: "secara pasti diketahui dari ... Samudra Hindia bagian barat laut" is fine, but "sesekali di delta Sungai Mekong" mistranslates "rarely" (jarang). Use "jarang ditemukan di delta Sungai Mekong". The same error appears in item 5.
Item 10: "Least Concern" is rendered as "Risiko Rendah". The usual Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah" (Least Concern). Check this against the IUCN Indonesian term.
Item 10: "Netuma ... berarti 'tari'" is acceptable. "ikan lele laut" for a marine catfish (Ariidae) is fine, but "yang dideskripsikan dari Laut Merah" is a fragment. Rephrase it as a full clause.

Item 5: "Typically euryhaline" is rendered as "Umumnya bersifat eurihalin". This is fine, but the added gloss "(tahan rentang salinitas yang lebar)" is not in the source. Remove it or keep it knowingly.
Item 4: "perairan tawar" is slightly inconsistent with "air tawar" in the first sentence. Use "air tawar" in both places.
Item 6: "induk betina yang sedang hamil" – for livebearers, "bunting" is the more usual hobby term ("hamil" is acceptable but less hobby-standard).
Item 2: "Saat ini tersedia beberapa ikan hasil penangkaran Jerman" is slightly ambiguous; clearer: "ikan hasil penangkaran di Jerman".
Item 2: "halfbeak" left as an English term without a local explanation; consider "ikan halfbeak (julung-julung/ikan paruh setengah)" on first use.
Item 5: "Saat memamerkan diri" is a bit awkward for "display behaviour"; consider "saat menampilkan perilaku pamer/berpamer".

Item 4: "Ikan ini bisa menerima sesama jenis maupun spesies lain" is weak for "tolerates"; better "dapat dipelihara bersama sesama jenis maupun spesies lain". Also "tidak semencolok warnanya seperti spesies lain" is awkward; use "warnanya tidak semencolok spesies lain".

Item 6: "gravid female" is translated as "bunting", which is a mammal term. Use "betina yang sedang hamil/bunting" in the hobby sense, or "induk betina yang hendak melahirkan". "melahirkan anakan yang mati" is fine.
Item 6: "tidak boleh dipisahkan terlalu cepat" is okay, but "ternyata" in the last sentence is added and not in the source. Remove it.
Item 2: "Saat ini ada beberapa ikan hasil penangkaran di Jerman yang tersedia" is awkward. Use "Saat ini tersedia beberapa ikan hasil penangkaran Jerman".
Item 2: "halfbeak (julung-julung)" is imprecise, because julung-julung usually refers to marine or other halfbeaks. Check that this local name is acceptable for Nomorhamphus, or use "halfbeak" alone.
"Ikan julung-julung (halfbeak) yang beranak (livebearer)": acceptable, but "hampir selalu makan" in #5 is slightly weaker than "hampir secara eksklusif"; use "hampir hanya makan dari permukaan air".

"dan kemungkinan besar juga serbuk sari": "most probably on pollen" is fine, but "pakannya terutama serangga" is slightly ambiguous; consider "memakan terutama serangga dan kemungkinan besar serbuk sari".
"pakan beku-kering (freeze-dried)": the usual hobby term is "pakan kering-beku" or "freeze-dried"; consider "pakan freeze-dried".
"Ikan ini punya hierarki yang ketat": informal "punya"; use "memiliki" for a handbook register.
"berpasangan": add "satu pasang" for clarity, e.g. "dipelihara sepasang atau dalam kelompok…".
"penasihat istana" for "Geheimrat" (privy councillor): a more accurate rendering is "penasihat rahasia" or "anggota dewan penasihat"; "istana" (palace) is not in the original.
"Nomorhamphus berarti 'dengan paruh yang kurang lebih sama panjang'": a more natural wording is "berparuh kurang lebih sama"; minor.
"Red-black halfbeak" is left in English as the suggested common name. Add an Indonesian gloss, e.g. "halfbeak merah-hitam", or keep it in brackets.
"mau menyambar pakan serpihan": "menyambar" (snatch) is stronger than "readily take". Use "mau memakan" or "mengambil".
Item 7: "misalnya guppy atau molly" is added by the translator and is not in the English; remove it or keep only "livebearer".
Item 7: "ikan mas kecil" for "small goldfish" is imprecise. Use "ikan mas koki kecil" (goldfish).
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" for "'feeder' fish" is a little awkward. "ikan pakan (feeder)" is more natural in the hobby.
Item 1: '600 mm' left unchanged; for a handbook, convert/express as 60 cm (mm to cm is the hobby norm). Same for item 1 only; minor.
Item 7: 'feeder fish' translated as 'ikan umpan hidup' — it is fine, but 'livebearer' left untranslated; use 'ikan vivipar (livebearer)' or common names like guppy/molly.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' — goldfish feeders are usually 'ikan mas' / 'ikan mas kecil'; koki is the fancy variety, so use 'ikan mas'.
Item 7: 'predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' — better 'predator obligat' or 'karnivora murni'; also 'adapting well to dead alternatives' → 'pakan mati' is okay but add 'pengganti'.
Item 1/11: 'notopterid' left as a loose English term; use 'ikan famili Notopteridae' for natural reading.

Item 11: 'dorsal fin presence (vs. absence)' – parenthetical 'yang tidak dimiliki Xenomystus nigri' is an addition in wording; acceptable but could be simplified. 'sirip dubur' for anal fin is okay; 'sirip anal' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 5: 'sedikit arus' for 'a degree of movement' is fine, but 'sebaiknya dianggap wajib' weakens 'should be considered mandatory'; use 'harus dianggap wajib'.
Item 11: 'tubuh yang tampak bungkuk' for 'humped' — use 'punggung yang melengkung/membungkuk' as a more natural description.
Item 13: "diisi air matang" — in Indonesian "air matang" means boiled water. Use "air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)" or "air dari akuarium yang sudah established".
Item 6: "kuat" for Vietnamese "khỏe" in a fish-health context is better as "sehat" or "tangguh".
Item 11: "kimia air yang sangat berbeda-beda" is awkward; use "parameter air yang sangat berbeda-beda".
Item 11: "tersedia di hobi ini" is unnatural; use "tersedia di kalangan hobiis" or "di perdagangan ikan hias".
Item 8: "hal ini perlu benar-benar diperhatikan" is a loose rendering of "to reinforce this point"; say "sehingga ancamannya nyata" or similar.
Item 3: "sungai kecil keruh" for "streams" is fine, but "Tampaknya sejalan dengan" is stiff; use "Tampaknya berkaitan langsung dengan sebarannya yang luas".

Item 1: "lele dari famili Siluridae" is fine, but leaving "two spot glass catfish" untranslated without a local name is slightly awkward; consider "lele kaca dua bintik" or a local name such as "lais".
"lele silurid": "silurid" is unnatural jargon; consider "lele dari famili Siluridae" or "lele silurid (Siluridae)".
"Borneo glass catfish" left in English with no local name; add a note like "(lele kaca Borneo)" or italic trade-name marker.
"cyprinid dan characin": consider adding the usual hobby terms ("ikan cyprinid/karper-karperan", "characin/tetra") for clarity.
"Kayu (driftwood)": fine, but "kayu apung/bogwood" is more common; "kayu" alone is vague. Consider "kayu rambatan/driftwood".
"Ganti air rutin wajib dijalankan dengan disiplin": slightly stiff; "pergantian air rutin harus dilakukan secara ketat" reads more naturally.
"Belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan": the original says "Not yet achieved"; fine in meaning but "Belum berhasil dibiakkan" is more usual.

Item 7: 'Cyprinodontiformes' is an order, but the translation says 'famili Cyprinodontiformes'; the English also says 'family', but the ID should say 'ordo' to be correct (or flag it). Same for 'Beloniformes' being called a 'kelompok saudara'.
Item 7: 'toothcarp' is left in English as 'ikan toothcarp'; use the local term 'ikan gigi/kerabat Cyprinodontiformes' or give the English in brackets after the Indonesian.
Item 5: 'Tanaman yang mengapung di permukaan' changes 'surface vegetation' (tanaman permukaan); this is acceptable only if floating plants are meant.
Item 5: 'walaupun dicampur dengan indukan' is awkward; use 'bersama indukan'.
Item 7: 'bisa dibedakan lebih lanjut' now has O. asinua as the subject, but the English 'It' is ambiguous; fine. 'ditangkap' for 'collected' is slightly off; use 'dikoleksi/diambil dari alam'.
Item 7: 'ricefish' is retained in quotes next to 'ikan padi'; fine. 'Xenopoecilius' is a typo copied from the source, so check it against 'Xenopoecilus'.
Item 1: 'Bedanya dengan O. wolasi, jantan maupun betinanya punya...' is a fragment and loses 'A member of ... group' flow; rephrase it as a full sentence.
Item 10: "Volume: sekitar 41 liter" — the English says approximately 41 litres. The number is unchanged and no conversion applies, so this is correct as written.

Item 8: "Lokasi tipenya disebutkan sebagai 'Makassar, Maros River near Maros, Sulawesi, Indonesia'" leaves the type locality in English. Either translate it or mark it as a quoted original, e.g. 'Makassar, Sungai Maros dekat Maros...'.
Item 8: "lengan barat daya pulau" is a literal rendering of "southwestern arm". Use "semenanjung barat daya".
Item 8: "negara Timor Leste" for "East Timor state" is slightly off. "Timor Timur" was the former province, and the source says "state". Use "negara Timor Leste" only if that is the intended meaning.
Item 7: 'Celebes medaka' is left in English, which is acceptable as a trade name. "catatan keberadaannya dari Timor" is awkward. Use "juga tercatat dari Timor".
Item 11: "Tanaman yang mengapung di permukaan" for "surface vegetation" is acceptable. "akar yang meliuk-liuk" and "kayu bogwood" are a little awkward. Use "akar berpilin dan kayu apung".

Item 14: "Microdevario, Trigonostigma, Pseudomugil dan beberapa Danio spp." is fine. "Ikan ini sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap sesama Oryzias" reads "congeners" as conspecifics. The source says congeners, so the sentence should be about other Oryzias. Clarify this.
Item 17: "ikan killi (toothcarp)" is acceptable. "Cyprinodontiformes" is an order, but the source wrote "family", and the translation reproduces that without comment. "klad" is acceptable.
Item 16: "spawning mop" is left in English. Use "spawning mop (kain/benang pemijahan)" or an Indonesian description.
Item 9: "lpomoea" and "crusgelii" are source typos that were carried over. Latin names are to be left unchanged, so no fix is needed.
Item 11: 'walaupun dicampur dengan induknya' misrenders 'alongside the adults'; better 'bersama induknya' (fry survive alongside adults), not an 'even if' concession.
Item 10: 'Volume: sekitar 41 liter' — the English says 'approximately 41 litres'; the figure is kept and is fine, but check the volume is consistent with 45×30 cm (it implies about 30 cm height).
Item 14: 'merayu betina' is awkward for courting; use 'memikat/mengawini betina' or 'berkompetisi memikat betina'.
Item 14: 'Danio spp.' and 'Oryzias spp.' left as in the source, which is fine, but 'sesama genusnya' for 'congeners' is stiff; use 'sesama Oryzias'.
Item 17: 'berlobus dua' for 'bilobed' is awkward; use 'bercuping dua'.
Item 17: 'kerabat segenusnya' is clumsy for 'congeners'; use 'spesies Oryzias lain'.
Item 3 and 5: 'retreat possibilities' rendered fine, but the item 5 sentence 'ikan padi kadang cenderung agak suka bertengkar' is stacked with hedges; simplify to 'kadang agak suka berkelahi'.
Item 7: 'Celebes medaka' left in English quotes, acceptable; but 'Infrequently available' joined with 'sesekali diekspor' reads choppy.
Item 2 and 7: 'berarus lambat atau tenang' reverses the English 'standing to slowly flowing' order; minor.
Item 8: the type locality quote is left in English, which is fine; no change needed except consistent capitalisation of 'Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan'.
Item 5: "Volume: ~41 litres" is rendered "~41 liter"; fine, but the 45 × 30 cm base is unchanged, so no issue. The real problem is elsewhere.
Item 9: "Pseudomugi" was changed to "Pseudomugil". The source text is silently altered; keep the original, or flag the correction.
Item 11: "Taxiphylum" was changed to "Taxiphyllum". The source text is silently altered.
Item 4: "pools and oxbows" became "genangan alami, dan danau tapal kuda/oxbow". The slash alternative is awkward; use "danau oxbow" or "danau tapal kuda" only.
Item 2: "Indian ricefish" is left untranslated. Add a local name or gloss, e.g. "ikan padi India".
Item 12: "hobiis" is non-standard; use "penghobi" or "hobiis" consistently. "Blue-eye" is left in English.
Item 13: "Xenopoecilius" is kept as the source misspelling; the correct genus is Xenopoecilus (already used earlier in the same item).
Item 13: "kerabat satu genusnya" is awkward for "congeners"; use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama" or "sesama Oryzias".
Item 1: "absolutely peaceful" became "sangat damai", which weakens the emphasis; use "sangat damai" with "sepenuhnya" or "benar-benar damai".
Item 14: the reference list is left untranslated, which is acceptable.

Item 5: "Volume: ~41 liter" is not in the tank-size table. A 45×30 cm base is not a listed tank, so check the volume figure and round it to whole litres. It is also unclear whether "liter" or "liter/L" is wanted, so use the local form consistently.
Item 11: "alamat ... Taxiphylum" - "spesies Taxiphylum" is fine, but "Berhati-hatilah saat menyatukan anakan dengan umur berbeda" is slightly awkward. Rephrase to "anakan berbeda umur".
Item 4: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" - "oxbow" is better rendered as "danau tapal kuda/oxbow"; fine, but "pools" -> "kolam" suggests man-made ponds. Use "genangan" or "kolam alami".
Item 11: "menempelkan" for "deposited" is ok, but "Ikan ini cenderung terlihat paling menarik" for "look most effective" is loose. Use "tampil paling baik".
Item 6: "akar yang berliku" for "twisted roots" is awkward. Use "akar berpilin" or "akar yang meliuk".
Item 4: '(about 68 litres)' was converted to 'sekitar 70 liter', but the source gives 68 litres in metric already; keep the figure or round sensibly. It is minor.

Item 11: 'kerabat ikan cyprinodontiform seperti ikan killi' changes the meaning of 'closely-related to toothcarps'. It should read 'berkerabat dekat dengan toothcarp (ikan killi)', and the source also wrongly called Cyprinodontiformes a family. Fix the redundant wording.

Item 11: 'sister group Beloniformes' is rendered as 'kelompok saudara dari cyprinodontiform'. Keep the structure 'ke dalam Beloniformes, kelompok saudara Cyprinodontiformes'; it is acceptable but awkward.

Item 11: 'garis vertikal kehitaman' for 'blackish lateral bars' is fine, but 'sisik lateral' and 'ruas tulang belakang' are acceptable. 'hewan bertulang belakang pertama yang kawin di luar angkasa' is fine.
Item 8: 'saling gertak atau bertarung ringan' adds 'bertarung' next to 'sparring'. Use one term only.
Item 8: 'menggabungkannya dengan Oryzias spp. lain karena berpotensi terjadi persilangan' is fine. 'akuarium komunitas' replaces 'communities'; acceptable.
Item 2: the Latin/English locality quote was left untranslated and a gloss added. This is acceptable, but 'sungai kecil' for 'stream' is fine. Nothing to fix.
Item 5: 'mungkin memberi burayak peluang hidup lebih besar bila dipelihara bersama indukan' is awkward. Use 'bila tetap bersama induknya'.
Item 1: 'daerah aliran Salo Sadang' is okay. 'pelvic brooding' is explained in brackets. Fine.
Item 4: '(about 68 litres)' kept and not rounded; the original is a US-gallon-derived figure, so a sensible rounded value (e.g. 'sekitar 70 liter') would be better.

Item 1: 'Jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin perut dan badan bagian belakangnya menjadi kehitaman' is hard to read because it has no comma. Add one, e.g. 'Jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin memiliki perut dan badan bagian belakang kehitaman'.
Item 11: 'ricefish Jepang' and 'ikan toothcarp' leave English terms in place. Use 'ikan padi Jepang' and an Indonesian term for toothcarp (e.g. 'kerabat ikan cyprinodontiform').

Item 11: 'garis vertikal kehitaman' for 'lateral bars' is acceptable, but 'sisik lateral' and 'ruas tulang belakang' are fine. The 'Xenopoecilius' typo is carried over from the source; consider correcting it to Xenopoecilus.
Item 10: 'Taxiphyllum' was silently corrected from the source's 'Taxiphylum'. This is harmless, but the Latin name in the source was changed.
Item 8: 'adu tanding' and 'merayu betina' are awkward for 'sparring' and 'courting'. Use 'saling gertak/bertarung ringan' and 'mendekati betina'.
Item 8: 'persilangan' for 'hybridisation' is acceptable. 'Akuarium komunitas' was added where the source said 'communities', which is fine.
Item 1: "Max size: 36 mm SL (1.4 in)" was translated as "36 mm SL". Dropping the inch figure is fine, but "SL" is left unexplained. Write "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 10: "about 41 litres" for a 45 × 30 cm base is not a table value, and the 40 L tank size in item 11 shows the usual size. Use "sekitar 40 liter".
Item 14: "GH dari agak lunak hingga sangat sadah" is a clumsy rendering of the hardness range. "Sangat sadah" is acceptable, but "agak lunak" is awkward.
Item 14: the temperature given as 16–24 °C differs from 16–22 °C in the other items. This is the source's own inconsistency, not the translator's.

Item 12: "burayak yang tinggal bersama ikan dewasa" adds a nuance. The English says fry have a better chance of surviving alongside the adults. Rephrase to "burayak dapat bertahan hidup bersama ikan dewasa".

Item 18: "Ikan ini juga tidak disarankan dipelihara bersama Oryzias spp. lain" misses the 'we' of "we don't recommend". Use a neutral phrasing, e.g. "Sebaiknya tidak dipelihara bersama Oryzias spp. lain".
Item 18: "cenderung tampak paling menarik" for "look most effective" is a loose rendering. Prefer "tampil paling baik".
Item 4: "telurnya menetas di sana" is awkward, and "kawin dan bertelur di luar angkasa" is fine. Tighten the clause on the eggs hatching in space.
Item 24: "sesama anggota genus O. bonneorum..." reads as if the species names are genera. Use "dari spesies lain dalam genus ini, yaitu O. bonneorum...".
Item 24: "ordo Cyprinodontiformes" replaces the English "family Cyprinodontiformes". The English is wrong, but the translator silently fixed it. This is acceptable, though it changes the source.
Item 10: "sekitar 41 liter" for 45 × 30 cm base — the source figure is kept, but a 40 L tank elsewhere is stated; fine. However item 1 omits "(1.4 in)" correctly. No issue there.
Item 14: "tahan suhu 16–24 °C" is fine, but "mempercepat metabolismenya" OK; no change needed.
Item 18: "Pseudomugi" was changed to "Pseudomugil" — the source spelling was altered; keep the Latin name unchanged or note the correction.

Item 12: "populasi paling baik di air tawar" is fine, but "burayak yang tinggal bersama induknya" adds meaning; the original says "alongside the adults" so this is acceptable. Check only the phrase "banyak tanaman airnya".
Item 24: "anggota famili Cyprinodontiformes" — Cyprinodontiformes is an order, not a family; the error comes from the source, but "famili" should be reconsidered (use "ordo").
Item 24: "cyprinodontiform sister group Beloniformes" is rendered as "Beloniformes, kelompok saudara cyprinodontiform" — fine. "kiambang kerdil" in item 23 for dwarf water lettuce is acceptable.
Item 2: "Yokihi oranye" and "Miyuki biru" mix local and trade names; fine. In item 9, "untuk keperluan di luar pemijahan" is accurate.

Item 17: "cacing sutra kering beku" — tubifex is correct as "cacing sutra", but freeze-dried is not "kering beku" order; use "cacing sutra freeze-dried" only, avoiding the redundant "kering beku (freeze-dried)".
Item 3: "Sisiknya yang berkilau sangat mencolok" is fine; no change.
#13: "rumah yang terisolasi baik" means 'isolated'. Use "berinsulasi baik" or "yang suhunya stabil" for 'well-insulated homes'.
#22: "pada pagi hari" drops 'early'. Use "pagi-pagi sekali" or "dini hari" for 'early morning'.
#4: "dipelihara sebagai ikan peliharaan" is redundant. Use "dipelihara sebagai ikan hias".
#23: "kiambang/apu-apu kerdil" is imprecise. Kiambang is Salvinia, so use only "apu-apu (kayu apu) kerdil" for dwarf water lettuce.

Item 22: 'family Cyprinodontiformes' is rendered 'famili Cyprinodontiformes' (source error kept) and 'toothcarps' as 'ikan killifish' – toothcarps is a broader group; acceptable but 'killifish' is an added narrowing; consider 'ikan toothcarp (killifish)'.
Item 22: 'emarginate' translated 'sedikit berlekuk' – fine, but 'truncate' as 'rata' is non-standard; use 'terpotong/truncate'.
Item 3: 'telurnya pun menetas di sana' – original says 'mate and lay eggs that hatched in space'; fine, but 'cukup jinak' for 'friendly' ok. 'sekumpulan telurnya' fine.
Item 8/9: Item 8 gives 'sekitar 41 liter' for 45×30 cm base; acceptable. Item 16: 'Pseudomugi' corrected to 'Pseudomugil' – source name altered; keep Latin names unchanged ('Pseudomugi').
Item 20: 'pada pagi hari' omits 'early' (early morning) – use 'pagi hari menjelang/di awal pagi'.
Item 21: 'Telur yang berwarna putih pekat sudah tidak akan menetas' fine; 'dwarf water lettuce' is rendered 'kiambang mini' – kiambang is Salvinia; use 'apu-apu kerdil/ selada air'.
Item 12: 'agak lunak hingga sangat sadah' – 'sadah' is rare; use 'sangat keras'.
Item 6: 'sungai hutan berair tawar yang asam' reorders; 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' fine.
Item 5: 'Japanese rice fish' translated as 'Medaka' – fine but loses name mention.
Item 3: "dan telurnya pun menetas di sana" is OK, but "ricefish cukup jinak" is fine; main issue elsewhere.

Item 6: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" – the English "pools and oxbows" is rendered as "kolam, dan danau tapal kuda"; acceptable. But "daerah aliran sungai besar" for "major river basins" is OK; no change.
Item 7: "sungai dan laut" is fine.
Item 8: "sekitar 41 liter" — the English gives about 41 litres, but the translator should round to the nearest sensible figure (about 40 liter); the stated figure is unrounded.
Item 5: "Japanese rice fish" translated as "Medaka" – acceptable; no change.
Item 14: "kutu air" for Daphnia is non-standard/ambiguous; use "daphnia" (kutu air) or keep "Daphnia".
Item 22: "Cyprinodontiformes" is called a "famili" (an order); the English error is carried over, so add the correct term "ordo" or leave the source's wording consistently.
Item 22: "toothcarp (killifish)" – toothcarp is an English term left in place; use "ikan killifish" as the Indonesian hobby term.
Item 10: "Jika ikan Anda hasil tangkapan alam" – fine; "paling baik di air tawar" is OK.
Item 18: "jari-jari sirip dubur bagian belakang" – "tulang rusuk pleura" in item 4 is odd; use "tulang rusuk pleural pertama".
Item 4: '100 × 30 cm ... (about 90 litres)' is kept as given; fine. No fix needed here.

Item 8: 'sangat disarankan memeliharanya sendiri tanpa spesies lain' is ambiguous next to the advice to keep six or more together. Say 'tanpa ikan spesies lain (hanya sejenis)' so it does not read as one fish alone.
Item 3: 'annual mean temperatures varying between 26.1–32.2°C' was changed to '26–32 °C'. The rounding is minor, but the original figures should be kept.

Item 11: 'Rosen dan Parenti sudah mengklasifikasikan ulang mereka ke dalam Beloniformes, kelompok saudara dari cyprinodontiformes' - 'cyprinodontiformes' is not capitalised and 'mereka' is unclear. Use 'Cyprinodontiformes' and 'ikan padi'.

Item 1: 'Sarasin's minnow' is left in English with no local gloss, and the description 'Garis lateral keperakan' loses 'broad silvery lateral stripe'. Write 'garis memanjang di sisi tubuh' instead of 'garis lateral'.
Item 11: 'toothcarp (ikan bergigi seperti killifish)' is an awkward gloss. Use 'ikan bergigi (toothcarp)'.
Item 10: 'pelvic brooding' is explained as 'mengerami telur dengan sirip perut', but the fish carry the eggs rather than incubate them. Use 'membawa telur'.
Item 5: 'pers. comm.' is left untranslated. Use 'komunikasi pribadi'.
Item 10: 'microworm' is left in English. Use 'cacing mikro' or 'microworm (cacing mikro)'.
Item 5: "~41 liter" – volume kept as in the English, which is fine, but "Alas akuarium" is acceptable; no fix needed except consider "liter" vs "L" consistency.
Item 12: "toothcarp (ikan killi)" – "toothcarp" is not a term Indonesian hobbyists use; use "ikan killi (toothcarp)".

Item 12: "famili Cyprinodontiformes" – Cyprinodontiformes is an order (bangsa/ordo), not a family; the translation copies the English error. Change to "ordo Cyprinodontiformes" or keep it as is but mark it.
Item 12: "epitel penciuman berwarna oranye ... saat hidup" – "in life" is rendered awkwardly; use "pada ikan hidup".
Item 1: "dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" is fine, but "Ikannya sangat lincah dan sehat" could be more natural as "Ikan-ikannya sangat aktif dan sehat".
Item 4: "kolam permanen" – 'permanent, remnant pools' is better as "kolam sisa yang permanen", to keep the 'remnant' meaning.
Item 9: "akuarium komunitas" is added; the English says 'communities'. Minor.
Item 4: 'rumput emersed' leaves English untranslated; use 'rumput yang menyembul ke atas permukaan air' or 'rumput emergen'.
Item 5: 'Volume: ~41 liter' – the source gives a volume of about 41 litres. This is probably fine, but check that the figure is consistent with the rest of the handbook.

Item 9: 'Jika tujuannya untuk dipijahkan, tentu idealnya dipelihara sendiri tanpa ikan lain' and the next sentence drop the source's 'we don't recommend'. The passive 'tidak disarankan' is fine, but 'obviously' is rendered as 'tentu', which is ok.
Item 9: 'Danio yang berukuran kecil' is fine. 'kurang cocok untuk banyak akuarium komunitas' is acceptable.

Item 12: 'Cyprinodontiformes' is described as a 'family' in the source. The translation keeps this as 'dianggap termasuk Cyprinodontiformes' without 'famili', a small change, though the source is itself inaccurate.
Item 12: 'ikan killi dan kerabatnya' for toothcarp adds an explanation not in the source. It is helpful but is an addition; consider just 'toothcarp (ikan killi)'.
Item 12: 'hewan vertebrata pertama yang kawin di luar angkasa' is acceptable, but 'organisme model' and 'disinonimkan' are somewhat stiff.
Item 1: 'hiobis' is not used. 'hobiis' is a less common spelling; 'penghobi' is more natural for Indonesian hobbyists.
Item 3: 'sebuah sungai pesisir yang airnya berasal dari mata air' is fine, but 'Kecamatan' for 'District' is a reasonable choice.
Item 6: "Volume: sekitar 41 liter" is kept as in the English; fine only if the source figure is meant. Check that it matches a 45×30 cm base (this is not a standard tank size).

Item 16: "Sirip ekornya berbentuk rata (truncate), bukan bulan sabit (lunate) atau sedikit bertakik (emarginate)" – fine, but "kerabat satu genusnya" for congeners is awkward; use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama".
Item 12: "adu kekuatan" and "merayu betina" for sparring and courting are slightly informal; use "saling menggertak" and "memikat betina".
Item 4: "aksen merah di tepi tubuhnya" is fine, but item 13 "bertubuh kebiruan yang tembus cahaya" is awkward; use "tubuh kebiruan semi-transparan".
Item 2: "Daisy's ricefish" is left in English with no local name or gloss; consider adding "(ikan padi Daisy)". Also "dideskripsikan" is fine.
Item 16: "mesethmoid", "midlateral", "klad" are left as untranslated or loosely rendered technical terms; consider "tepi tengah-lateral" or a gloss.

Item 7: "burayak" with "bila dipelihara bersama ikan dewasa" attaches the condition to survival, which is fine; but "kebutuhan khusus soal dekorasi" is OK. Item 15: "pagi hari sekali" is colloquial; use "dini hari".

Item 4: the English gives 183 × 61 cm and ~681 litres. The translation changes them to '180 × 60 cm' and '~700 liter'. The 72" x 24" x 24" figure becomes '180 × 60 × 60 cm', so the depth/height goes from 24" (≈61 cm) to 60 cm. Convert the figures faithfully (≈183 × 61 × 61 cm) and keep the volume as ~681 L, or round it sensibly. The tank table applies only to tanks given in gallons, not here.
Item 5: 'luar biasa jorok' for 'exceptionally messy' is too colloquial. Use 'sangat banyak menghasilkan kotoran' or 'sangat kotor'.
Item 5: 'Tanaman apung sebaiknya ada' is awkward and loses the meaning that floating plants are preferable. Rephrase as 'Tanaman apung lebih disarankan, meskipun mungkin dimakan'.
Item 11: 'sangat membuat ikan stres' is awkward. Use 'sangat membuat ikan stres' → 'sangat menyebabkan stres pada ikan'.
Item 11: 'siripnya yang merah' for 'red finnage' is fine, but 'kayu bogwood' in item 5 is a redundant mix. Use 'kayu bogwood (driftwood)' or 'kayu apung/akar kayu'.

Item 11: the English describes the 'recently described... species'. 'Gurami' used alone as the common name for O. goramy is fine, but the opening 'Gurami, Osphronemus goramy' in item 1 should say 'Gurami raksasa' (giant gourami) to match the source and distinguish it from other gurami.

Item 8: the sentence 'While smaller tankmates are unlikely to be preyed on similarly-sized cyprinids, characins, catfish...' is garbled. The translation 'pilihan yang mungkin lebih baik adalah cyprinid, characin, dan catfish yang ukurannya sebanding' changes the logic. The English says smaller tankmates are unlikely to be eaten, and that similarly-sized fish are better choices. Rewrite so the two…
Item 8: 'Ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama yang berukuran lebih kecil' is clumsy for 'smaller tankmates'. Use 'ikan lain yang lebih kecil dalam akuarium yang sama'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'cacing darah' and 'aufwuchs' are left as is. Gloss aufwuchs, e.g. 'lapisan perifiton/aufwuchs'.

Item 5: 'diam melayang' for 'hang' is slightly odd. 'Substrat pasir yang halus' is fine, but 'kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak' adds a Latin genus that is not in the source. Remove '(Fagus)' or keep it neutral.
Item 1/11: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'catfish', 'characin' are left in English. Prefer 'ikan suku Cyprinidae', 'lele/ikan kucing', 'karasin' or add a gloss.
Item 11: 'sungut moncong (rostral) dan sungut rahang atas (maksila)' and 'tenggorokan (isthmus)' are technically loose. 'Isthmus' is better rendered as 'istmus/bagian dada di antara insang'.
Item 11: 'Kelompok ini ... disebut shark minnow (ikan hiu-hiuan kecil)' is an invented gloss. Use 'shark minnow' with no made-up Indonesian name.
#10: "lancefish" is left in English. Use an Indonesian term such as "ikan lanset (sand lance)", or a generic phrase like "ikan laut kecil".
#14: "bertelur di dalam gua" is too literal for "cave spawner". Use "memijah di dalam gua/celah persembunyian (cave spawner)".
#2: "hutan yang tergenang" could be more natural as "hutan rawa banjir" or "hutan yang tergenang banjir".
Item 4: "serangga chironomid (larva nyamuk tak menggigit)" adds "larva", which the English does not say. Use "serangga chironomid (agas/nyamuk tak menggigit)" or just "serangga chironomid".
Item 1: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" - the IUCN Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah/Risiko Rendah" but the added gloss is non-standard; better "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)".
Item 3: "Butuh ... plus beberapa tanaman" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "Memerlukan ... serta beberapa tanaman".
Item 3: "mudah gugup" is awkward for fish; use "sifat ikan yang mudah takut/penakut".
Item 5: "Belum ada laporan. Belum ada catatan pemijahan" - "Unreported" is rendered clumsily; use "Belum dilaporkan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan."
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable but "Lokalitas tipe" is the more standard term.
"ikan kuli" is not the usual hobbyist name; Indonesian hobbyists say "kuhli loach" or "ikan ular/lele ular". Use the established name consistently (the same text later uses "Kuhli Loach").
"sehingga sisa pakan dapat diandalkan tidak dibiarkan tergeletak" is garbled; rephrase, e.g. "yang dapat diandalkan untuk memastikan sisa pakan tidak dibiarkan tergeletak".
"berenang panik" for "hectically" is a bit strong; "berenang gelisah/tak beraturan" is closer.
"Seberapa mudah perawatannya, sesulit itu pula identifikasi" is stiff; use "Sama mudahnya perawatannya, sama sulitnya identifikasi spesiesnya".

"spesies-spesies ini" in the trade sentence is vague; "Di perdagangan, spesies-spesies ini hampir tidak pernah dibedakan" is fine, but "satu-satunya cara membedakannya... adalah bahwa" is awkward; simplify.
"Kuhlii Loach" was changed to "Kuhli Loach" in the quoted trade name; keep the source spelling or use it consistently with the rest of the text.
"Pangio alternans" in #1: "dengan panjang 6–7 cm" is fine, but "ikan kuli" is mixed with "Kuhli Loach" within the text, so the terminology is inconsistent.

Item 5: "sekitar 54 liter" is wrong for a 60 × 30 cm base; the original gives about 54 litres, but the translation should keep or recompute it consistently. Depth is not specified, so check the figure.
Item 11: "26–27 °C" misconverts 25.6–26.7 °C. Use "25,6–26,7 °C" or round correctly to 26–27 °C. This is acceptable, but note that the gH/kH figures were left in the original.
Item 3: "kemerahmudaan" is not a natural word. Use "keperakan/merah jambu" or "berwarna kemerahmudaan" replaced with "merah muda".
Item 4: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" is fine, but "aliran air mati (backwater)" is awkward. Use "perairan tenang di tepian sungai (backwater)".
Item 1: "Kuhli hitam" drops "loach" from the common name. Use "loach kuhli hitam" for consistency with the rest of the text.
Item 8: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "cacing mikro (micro worm)" is awkward. Check the terms used by hobbyists.
Item 2/6: "lubang hisap filter" is acceptable but "intake filter" is more commonly used.
Item 7: "mikroworm" is a non-standard rendering; use "cacing mikro" (micro worm).
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but add "(Daphnia)" or use "daphnia", which is the common term among hobbyists.
Item 4: "Volume: sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but "Panjang standar ... SL" mixes terms; write "Panjang standar (SL)".
Item 5: "Filter yang lembut" is awkward; use "Filtrasi yang lembut".
Item 1: "karena ikut terbawa dalam kiriman kerabat satu genusnya" is wordy; use "sebagai tangkapan sampingan (bycatch) di antara ikan sekerabat".
Item 11: "Anggota kelompok P. shelfordii dibedakan ... karena memiliki" should read "dengan memiliki" or "berdasarkan kepemilikan", since it states a distinguishing basis, not a cause.
Item 8: "riset yang matang sangat penting" is stiff; use "perlu mencari tahu dulu dengan teliti".

Item 2: "(Kalimantan)" for Borneo — Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo; "Kalimantan" is the Indonesian part, so it is wrong. Use "Borneo". The same error appears in item 11: "populasi P. shelfordii dari Sumatra dan Kalimantan" should be "Sumatra dan Borneo".
Item 4: "Volume: ~41 liter" is odd. The source number is unchanged, but check it against the 45×30 cm base; a stated volume of ~40 L would be a sensible rounding.
Item 1/11: "ikan ikutan" for bycatch is awkward. Use something like "ikut terbawa dalam kiriman".
Item 3: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" is fine, but "mungkin juga tidak" is clumsy. Rephrase as "yang mungkin atau mungkin tidak sedikit kecokelatan oleh tanin".
Item 11: "sirip ekor berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)" is acceptable. "modus 47 berbanding 50" should state which species each value belongs to, in the order given in the source.
Item 5: "daun kering" for "dried leaf litter" is a bit loose. Use "serasah daun kering".
Item 8: "Asian aquariums" was translated as "akuarium biotop Asia". "biotop" is an added fact, because the source does not say biotope. Use "akuarium Asia".

Item 18: the translation says "Ikan dari Singapura dan Johor tersebut mungkin sebenarnya adalah Pangio muraeniformis". The English says "The former", meaning the Singapore/Johor fish, so this is probably fine. The sentence is still ambiguous, so reconsider it.
Item 18: "palang gelap" is used for "bar" and "tanda berbentuk pelana" for "saddle". Both are acceptable but unusual. Consider "garis/balok" and "pelana" consistently.
Item 18: the conjunction "dan ia memilih nama pengganti Pangio dibandingkan sinonim..." is awkward. Rephrase it, e.g. "dan ia memilih nama pengganti Pangio daripada sinonim bersamaannya, Apua".
Item 18: the citations "Kottelat and Lim, 1993" and "Tan and Kottelat, 2009" are left in English "and". Elsewhere the translation uses "dan". Make them consistent, e.g. "Kottelat dan Lim, 1993".
Item 6: "anak sungai yang tenang/genangan tepi sungai (backwater)" is clumsy. Use a single term such as "anak sungai berarus tenang (backwater)".
Item 6: "P. angullaris" is copied from the source's typo. Leave it, or flag it.

Item 3 and item 9: "tutup akuarium yang rapat" and "lubang hisap filter" are acceptable. "Kuhli loach" and "coolie loach" are not translated consistently in item 1 ("kuhli loach"), and item 18 uses 'kuhli'/'coolie' loach. This is minor.

Item 18: "Spesimen Sarawak ... dengan pelana punggung yang jauh lebih terang" – English says "much lighter" (OK), but "membentuk garis gelap yang menyambung dengan tanda-tanda tidak beraturan" (Bangka) adds meaning: original says a continuous dark stripe WITH irregular markings; wording is ambiguous, rephrase as "garis gelap yang utuh dengan tanda tidak beraturan".

Item 18: "Beberapa anggota yang telah dideskripsikan sebelumnya dimasukkan ke dalam genus Acanthophthalmus" – the English says "previously included"; the Indonesian reads as described earlier. Use "Beberapa anggota yang telah dideskripsikan dahulu tergolong dalam genus Acanthophthalmus".

Item 6: "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" – "oxbow" is a river meander lake, ok, but "perairan balik (backwater)" is unnatural; use "anak sungai yang tenang/genangan tepi sungai (backwater)".
Item 6: "berwarna teh karena tanin, mungkin juga tidak" – clumsy; rephrase "yang mungkin sedikit berwarna karena tanin, atau tidak".
Item 14: "riset yang matang wajib dilakukan" – too strong/awkward; use "perlu riset yang cermat sebelum memelihara".
Item 1: "jenis kuhli loach yang paling tidak biasa" – "paling tidak biasa" is OK but "loach tersebut" for the other Pangio alternans morphs is slightly vague; fine otherwise.

Item 29: 'Dalam kedua cara' leaves out that the adults are removed 'as soon as eggs are noticed' in the group-spawning case. In the English, the adults can stay in a heavily planted tank. Make the sentence consistent with the earlier text.

Item 30: 'paling mudah pun tetap menantang' reverses the meaning of 'challenging at best'. It should be 'paling-paling/paling banter sulit', for example 'Memijahkan kardinal tetra tergolong sulit, bahkan dalam kondisi terbaik'.

Item 5: 'garis biru kehijauan (toska)' for 'turquoise' is acceptable. 'Anda' is also fine.
Item 1: 'sebagian cukup besar' is an odd phrasing of 'a significant proportion'. Use 'sebagian besar' or 'proporsi yang cukup besar'. The same phrase appears in item 32.
Item 1: "sebagian besar ikan yang beredar di pasaran masih hasil tangkapan alam" – English says "a significant proportion", not "most"; change to "sebagian cukup besar" (also item 32).
Item 13: "20 gallons (about 75 litres)" – conversion is right, but check consistency with other items; fine. The English remark that a larger tank allows a bigger school is kept.
Item 8: "di alam ikan ini biasanya hanya hidup sekitar satu tahun" is acceptable, but "grow bigger than you'd expect" is OK; no issue.
Item 29: "pada sore atau malam hari" – English says only "in the evening"; remove "sore atau" (added fact). Same in item 30: "memijah pada sore atau malam hari" should be "pada malam hari/petang".
Item 29: "Ikan ini biasanya memijah pada malam hari" is fine, but "Kalau setelah beberapa hari belum ada telur, pindahkan pasangan tersebut" is fine; "dalam kedua cara" is okay.

Item 32: "pigmen biru di mata lebih sedikit" fine; "garis lateral biru yang lebih lebar dan memanjang lebih ke belakang" fine. "tapis insang pada lengkung bawah" ok.
Item 32: "Hypessobrycon simulans" and "P. inessi" are source typos kept; acceptable.

Item 20: 'transfer them to the spawning tank in the evening' becomes 'pada sore atau malam hari'. 'atau sore' is an addition. Also 'They should spawn during the night... exhibit their night-time colour pattern throughout' is restructured, so it reads as if the fish spawn with the lights on.
Item 20: 'If no eggs have appeared after a couple of days' becomes 'setelah beberapa hari'. 'A couple' means two, not several, so the number changes. Use 'dua hari'.
Item 21: 'Breeding... is challenging at best' becomes 'paling banter bisa dibilang menantang'. This is awkward and 'paling banter' means 'at most'. Use 'paling tidak menantang' or 'sangat menantang'.
Item 21: 'They spawn in the evening' becomes 'sore atau malam hari'. 'atau malam hari' is added; the source says only evening.
Item 21: 'Breeding... a pH of 5.0 to 6.0 and very soft water of 3 to 5 dGH or below' is fine, but 'hardboiled egg yolk' is left as 'kuning telur rebus'. Use 'kuning telur rebus matang' for fidelity.

"paling kecil dan paling mungil": redundant, but it mirrors the source. Fine to leave, or use "terkecil".
Item 1: "smallest and tiniest" and "babylonic confusion" fine, but "Karena itulah sebagian orang..." reverses the logic less clearly; OK. Main issue is elsewhere.

Item 9: "paling baik dengan pencahayaan yang lebih redup" is awkward; use "tampil terbaik dengan pencahayaan redup".

Item 1: "hijau toska mengilap dengan warna pekat" is awkward. Use "hijau toska mengilap yang pekat" or "berwarna intens".

"batu kerikil bulat" for 'pebbles': 'batu kerikil' is fine, but 'bulat' (round) is added; remove it.

Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is a free paraphrase of "biologically-immature aquaria". It is acceptable but could be "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".

Item 9: '(sirip punggung, dubur, dan ekor)' is an added fact. The English only says 'unpaired fins'. Use 'sirip-sirip tunggal' without the list, or keep it generic.

Item 5: 'moss' and 'tanaman apung' are fine, but 'kimia air' reads awkwardly. 'Perubahan kimia air' would be better as 'perubahan parameter air'.
Item 9: "spawn" diterjemahkan "telur" tetapi "membentuk telur" agak kaku; lebih natural "betinanya bertelur/matang telur". "perilaku kawin" sebaiknya "perilaku pemijahan/berpacaran (courtship)".
Item 9: "akuarium foto" kurang jelas; lebih baik "akuarium pemotretan".
Item 1/9: "lele hias" dan "bumblebee catfish" tidak konsisten; pilih satu istilah dan gunakan secara konsisten.

Item 16: "8 drops of methylene blue for every 19 litres" is kept literally. This is fine, but "19 liter" came from a gallon conversion. Check whether it is right. Likely OK.
Item 1: "Deep Angels" is translated as "Manfish altum". This is acceptable, so no change is needed.

Item 17: "Namun, waspadai manfish altum yang memakan hasil pemijahan discus" slightly changes "Be wary of Altum Angels eating Discus spawns". Use "waspadai kemungkinan manfish altum memakan telur discus".

#1: "Deep Angels can reach 20 cm in length and up to 35 cm in height" is translated as "Manfish altum". That is acceptable, but check that the numbers match; they do. No change needed here.

#16: "8 drops of methylene blue for every 19 litres" was kept as 19 litres. This is correct only if the source gave 19 litres. Keep it.
#16: "spawns are being eaten" is translated as "telurnya ... dimakan". The English "spawns" may include eggs and fry. Use "telur/burayak" or "hasil pemijahan".
#17: "better tropical fish suppliers" is translated as "pemasok ikan tropis yang lebih bagus". This reads awkwardly. Use "pemasok ikan hias tropis yang berkualitas".
#17: "susah makan" for "feeding difficulties" shifts the meaning. Use "sulit diberi pakan".
#17: "Justru hal itu sendiri terasa sangat memuaskan" is stiff and unnatural. Use "Tantangan itu sendiri sangat memuaskan".
#2, #11: "most fish are wild-caught and can be difficult to feed" is rendered "Kebanyakan ikan yang beredar merupakan tangkapan alam". "yang beredar" is added but harmless.

Item 14: 'Glyptoperichthys joselimaianus' in the Remarks sentence is odd, but it mirrors the English source, so it is not a translator error.
Item 14: 'Dibudidayakan dalam jumlah banyak untuk hobi' is acceptable, but 'spesies berukuran besar' could be phrased as 'spesies yang tumbuh besar'.

Item 14: 'penulis pertama' is ambiguous for 'the first author'; make it 'penulis deskripsi pertama' or rephrase.
Item 14: the quoted word "peculiar" is translated as "unik", which is a different meaning; use "aneh" or "tidak lazim".
Item 6: 'catfish yang gagah' leaves English 'catfish' where hobbyists say 'ikan lele-lelean' or keep 'catfish'; acceptable, but consider consistency.
Item 12: 'berenang anggun' for 'sailing elegantly' loses the sail imagery; consider 'meluncur anggun'.
Item 11: 'pakan' is repeated in 'pakan serpihan, pakan tablet, pakan hidup, dan pakan beku', which is heavy; use 'serpihan, tablet, pakan hidup, dan beku'.
Item 10: 'patut dicatat' is stiff for 'noteworthy'; use 'patut diperhatikan'.
Item 4: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern, LC)' is acceptable, but the IUCN Indonesian term 'Berisiko Rendah' is more standard.

Item 14: 'A minimum of seven ... more than 12' is kept, but item 13 says 8–10; fine. However 'Botia loaches' translated 'loach dari genus Botia' OK. Real issue: 'Orang yang hanya ingin lima ekor' fine.
Item 17: 'half a dozen specimens of each sex' → 'masing-masing enam ekor per jenis kelamin' is redundant but meaning ok; minor.
Item 13: 'boisterous' → 'lincah dan bandel' adds 'bandel' (stubborn), slightly off; use 'ribut/aktif dan kasar'.
Item 12: 'roughage ... daphnia, brine shrimp' rendered 'pakan berserat' fine, but 'Terlalu banyak cacing darah ... betina menggembung' OK. 'freeze-dried' left in English; use 'pakan kering-beku'.
Item 14: 'angelfish (manfish)' — 'manfish' is the common Indonesian name; ok, but 'cherry barb', 'silver tip tetra' left English; add Indonesian forms where common.

Item 4: 'Provinsi Riau, Jambi' fine; but type locality quote left in English 'Palembang Province' while text says 'Kabupaten Lahat' — acceptable; 'Sumatera Selatan (South Sumatra)' dropped bracket fine.
Item 1: 'cyprinid' left untranslated; use 'ikan suku Cyprinidae' / 'cyprinid' with explanation for hobbyists.
Item 18: 'tingkat kelangsungan hidup burayak' OK; 'perilaku kawin' for 'breeding behavior' ok; 'benang wol' fine.

Real issue: 'blue-eye rainbowfish' left in English without Indonesian rendering; consider 'ikan pelangi blue-eye'.

Item 7: 'Hanya tersisa 4,6% hutan tua, sedangkan sisanya hanya berupa petak-petak kecil' – the English says the remainder exists only in small fragmented patches; acceptable. But 'more than 35% of the original cover lost between 1990 and 2005' is fine. 'civil war' translated 'perang saudara yang lebih baru' ok.
Item 8: 'Karena adanya musim monsun... sangat beragam' – 'wide range' → 'sangat beragam' slightly strengthened; use 'cukup luas/beragam'.
Item 10: 'the more you get, the more outgoing' → 'makin berani menampakkan diri' acceptable; but item 20 'Cherry Barbs thrive in small schools ... 5-6' vs. item 2 '6-10' is source inconsistency.
Item 11: 'Karena ikan ini suka berkelompok... agar cukup untuk beberapa ekor' fine; 'dimasukkan ke akuarium lebih dulu sebelum ikan lain' adds 'sebelum ikan lain' – acceptable.
Item 21: 'ikan livebearer, ikan rainbow, anabantoid, ikan catfish, loach' – use 'ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)' and 'lele/catfish' consistently; 'ikan catfish' is redundant.
Item 28: 'adults hunt their own offspring' fine; 'water sprite' left untranslated – add local name e.g. 'kiambang air/Ceratopteris'.
Item 29: 'tapis insang... berbentuk lempeng' for 'laminate' and 'jari-jari duri predorsal yang mengarah ke depan' are awkward; 'Dravidia ... lalat daging' fine. Minor.
Item 27: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' ok; 'dalam kedua cara' fine.
Item 1: 'Life expectancy' → 'Harapan hidup' ok; 'Sifat: damai' for 'Social' OK.

Item 7: 'much of it when the country was under British colonial rule, though a significant portion was also removed during the more-recent civil war' is rendered 'banyak di antaranya ... meski sebagian besar juga hilang selama perang saudara'. 'sebagian besar' (most) changes 'a significant portion'; use 'sebagian yang cukup besar'. 'meski' also misses the 'also' sense.

Item 22: 'Dwarf shrimp seem to do okay with larger amano shrimp but cherry barbs may go after adult cherry shrimp' is rendered 'Udang kerdil tampaknya aman bersama udang amano yang lebih besar'. This changes the meaning: dwarf shrimp may be fine with amano shrimp, and the dwarf shrimp are not the fish's tank mates. Reword it as dwarf shrimp being fine kept together with amano shrimp.

Item 22: 'They swim anywhere to feed but tend to stay in the middle to bottom levels' conflicts with item 1 ('top and mid-dweller'), but the Indonesian follows the English, so this is not a translation error. Item 22: 'plecos' is rendered 'pleco', which is fine.
Item 3: 'sifatnya yang aktif' for 'energetic personality' is fine. 'ribut' for 'boisterous' is slightly informal; 'agresif/heboh' would be more natural.
Item 25: 'merah ceri' is an odd calque; use 'merah cherry' or 'merah terang'. Also 'tannish-red' as 'merah kecokelatan' is fine.
Item 29: 'ruas tulang belakang abdominal dan 14–16 kaudal' is acceptable, but 'seratobrankial' should be 'ceratobranchial' or 'tulang ceratobranchial ke-5' for technical accuracy.
Item 11: 'Sebaiknya ikan ini dimasukkan ke akuarium paling awal' is slightly ambiguous; say 'dimasukkan lebih dulu sebelum ikan lain'.
Item 27: "diisi air matang" is ambiguous, since "air matang" usually means boiled water. Use "air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature/cycled)".
Item 26: "perbedaan kelamin" for "gender differentiation" is stiff. Something like "pematangan gonad/kematangan kelamin" reads more naturally.

Item 4: "sekitar 243 liter" for 120 × 45 × 45 cm is a wrong conversion. 120×45×45 = 243 L is the volume, but the tank should be named by the size keepers use, which is about 240 liter. The tank-size table does not list this size, so it should be rounded to a whole number of litres. Check that the figure reads as a deliberate rounded size.
Item 10: "120 × 30 × 30 cm (120 liter)" is wrong. The English gives 113 litres, and 120×30×30 = 108 L. The number was changed, so correct it to about 108 liter or keep the source figure.
Item 10: "filter internal bertenaga" and "filter bertenaga" are vague for "internal power filter". Use "filter internal (power filter)" or "filter internal bermotor".
Item 10: "memijah terus-menerus" for "continuous spawner" is fine, but "burayak" is an uncommon word for fry. Hobbyists mostly say "anakan" or "benih". This is minor.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "pelet butiran kering" is redundant for "dried flakes and granules". Use "pakan serpih dan granul kering".
Item 1 and item 11: "Rasbora elegan" is not an established common name. Use "rasbora elegans" or keep the English "elegant rasbora" in brackets.

Item 5: "Ikan ini akan tampak sangat indah" is acceptable. However, "tumbuh baik" is used for fish in items 4 and 5 where the English says "do well" or "thrive". Prefer "berkembang baik" or "sehat" for fish.

Item 11: "Rasboroides dan Trigonostigma" list: the English says four new genera were erected "to preserve monophyly of the existing groups i.e. Boraras, Horadandia, Rasbora, Rasboroides and Trigonostigma"; fine, but "tidak berduri" for "non-spiny" plus "jari-jari pertama ... tidak bercabang" is OK. Real issue: "tuberkel" is used where the English is "tubercules" – fine; no major error here.

Item 2: "Ulu (sungai) Belayan" dropped "Indonesian Borneo" – the English says "Kalimantan Timur (east Kalimantan), Indonesian Borneo"; the ID omits "Borneo Indonesia". Minor omission; add "Borneo, Indonesia".

Item 10: "75 × 30 × 30 cm/71 liter" – the English volume is 67.5 L for those dimensions, but 71 is the source figure; keep. However "half-filled" is correct. "Induk ... dipindahkan setelah beberapa hari" matches "a couple of days".
Item 10: "Pemijahan bisa dipicu dengan menambahkan sedikit air yang lebih dingin" is OK; "Paramecium ... diperkenalkan naupli artemia" OK.
Item 4: "~41 liter" – 45×30 cm base volume was converted from the source; verify the rounding (the source figure ~41 L is acceptable).
Item 3: "habis terbakar pada 1997 dan 1998" – "burned to the ground" ok. "gutter" rendered as "parit" is fine.
Item 11: "jambul" for 'crest' acceptable; "Sementara itu, klad keenam" fine. "Tuberkel ... mungkin menandakan kematangan seksual" ok.

Item 1: The first sentence and the second sentence of the English are fused. The translation adds 'dan sesekali bisa melompat keluar'. This is a small addition and not a real problem. Item 1 is otherwise fine.
Item 11: 'Brittan (1954)' is used for the 'species complexes' review, but the reference list cites Brittan 1972. This is a source inconsistency and not a translation error, so no fix is needed.
Item 11: 'dorsohypural distance' is translated as 'jarak dorsohipural'. 'Dorsohypural' is a technical term and should be checked. It is acceptable but could be marked.

Item 11: 'deeper caudal peduncle fitting 7.9-8.8 times in SL' is rendered as 'batang ekor yang lebih tinggi, yaitu 7,9–8,8 kali panjang standar'. This reverses the meaning. The depth fits into SL 7.9–8.8 times. Use 'tinggi batang ekor masuk 7,9–8,8 kali dalam panjang standar'.

Item 11: 'The identity of the type species ... is no longer in question' is fine. However, 'R. cephalotaenia ... yang semestinya dianggap sebagai spesies tipe' is slightly awkward. Rephrase it as 'di antaranya R. cephalotaenia ... yang seharusnya dianggap sebagai spesies tipe'.

Item 3: 'sungai kecil berarus' translates 'flowing streams'. This is fine. 'perairan tepi/rawa banjiran yang tenang' for 'backwaters' adds 'banjiran'. Use 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai (backwater)'.
Item 4: 'luas permukaan minimal 120 × 30 cm' is fine. 'Volume: ~108 liter' is fine.

Item 1: "Di kondisi mana pun, penutup yang rapat..." has no preceding context in the ID and repeats the lid sentence. It follows the EN, but "In either situation" refers to nothing. This is an awkward duplicate; fix or drop the redundancy.

Item 3: "anak sungai yang tenang (backwater)" mistranslates backwaters. Backwaters are genangan/perairan tepi yang tenang, not tributaries (anak sungai). Use "perairan tepi/rawa banjiran yang tenang".

Item 11: "batang ekor yang lebih tinggi" is ambiguous. Deeper caudal peduncle means "batang ekor yang lebih tinggi/tebal", so this is acceptable, but "fitting 7.9-8.8 times in SL" is stiff: "7,9–8,8 kali dalam SL" should read "7,9–8,8 kali panjang standar".

Item 11: "Menurut pengertian saat ini, spesies ini terdapat di Jawa" - "As currently recognised it occurs" refers to R. argyrotaenia. Make the subject explicit as "R. argyrotaenia" to avoid confusion with R. tornieri.
Item 11: "Klad" is the clade term; it is fine but "clade" in brackets would help hobbyists. "monofili" and "genus baru" are fine.
Item 3: "kolam" for "pools" is OK, but "khas berwarna cokelat" reads awkwardly. Rephrase as "biasanya berwarna cokelat".
Item 4: "luas permukaan minimal 120 × 30 cm" - OK. Item 10: "burayak" is regional (Malay); "anakan" or "larva/benih" is more common among Indonesian hobbyists. "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable.

Item 3 and 7: "biologically immature tank" is translated as "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang". This adds a specific claim, though it is roughly right. Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" or "belum stabil".
Item 12: "best removed after a couple of days" is translated as "setelah beberapa hari". "A couple of days" means about 2 days. Use "setelah sekitar dua hari".
Item 12: "half-filled with water" and the 39 litres figure. A 60×20×20 cm container holds 24 L when full, so 39 L is wrong. Check the source figure and the conversion.
Item 6: 60×38×30 cm is about 68 L, which is consistent. The "~68 liter" is fine, so no change is needed here.
Item 8: "tampaknya paling baik dalam kondisi sedikit asam hingga netral" is awkward. Use "tampaknya paling cocok pada kondisi sedikit asam hingga netral".
Item 10: "paling-paling hanya sesekali" is a poor rendering of "sporadic at best". Use "paling banter hanya sporadis".
Item 10: "lele/catfish" is misleading, since lele is a specific food fish. Use "ikan lele-lelean (catfish)" or just "catfish".
Item 14: "menyinonimkan" is awkward. Use "menyatukan ... ke dalam Rasbora (sinonim)".
Item 14: "Liao et al. among the unclassified species, possibly not Rasboras" is translated as "yang mungkin bukan Rasbora". Say "spesies yang belum jelas klasifikasinya (incertae sedis)".
Item 15: the reference list is left untranslated, which is fine.
#11: 'have been received' became 'Tersedia spesimen...'. Say that the specimens were received or obtained, not that they are generally available.
#4: 'sekitar 243 liter' is a very precise figure for the volume. Round it, for example to 'sekitar 240 liter'.
Item 4: Volume 'sekitar 243 liter' – the English gives 243 litres, so this is fine, but check that nothing else is missing.
Item 10: 'lateral stripe' translated as 'garis lateral' is confusable with the lateral line (gurat sisi); use 'garis/pita memanjang di sisi tubuh' instead.

Item 10: 'Heros, Archocentrus, Cichlasoma, Nandopsis' list is fine, but 'cheek-scale rows modally 6' rendered as 'umumnya 6' is acceptable; 'dentary pores' and 'maxilla' left in English – use 'pori dentari' and 'tulang maksila' for consistency.

Item 11: 'Tersedia spesimen ... telah diterima' – the English 'have been received' is shop talk and was changed; 'Ini pertama kalinya ikan seperti ini tersedia' is a loose rendering of 'They are available for the first time' (should say these wild-origin fish are available for the first time).
Item 12: reference list untranslated – fine.
Item 3: 'daerah aliran sungai dekat pesisir' is awkward for 'coastal drainages'; 'generalis secara ekologi' is stiff – use 'generalis ekologis'.
Item 8: 'sesama jenis lainnya' is ambiguous (could mean same sex); use 'sesama spesiesnya' for 'conspecifics'.
Item 9: 'Biparental substrate spawner' expanded into a sentence; acceptable but could be shorter: 'Pemijah substrat dengan pengasuhan biparental'.
Item 1: 'Rocio octofasciata' is not italic/preserved issue? Latin names unchanged – fine; 'bentuk aslinya' vs 'natural form' fine.

Item 1: "ikan ini hanya boleh ditangkap" - the English passive is more general (only small quantities may be caught); consider "hanya sejumlah kecil yang boleh ditangkap dan diekspor sebagai ikan hias" (minor).
Item 4: "Pemberian pakan beku dan pakan serpihan tidak bermasalah" is slightly stiff; consider "Pakan beku dan pakan serpih (flake) mudah diberikan/diterima dengan baik" (minor).

Item 5: "sekitar 243 liter" is the exact conversion; 120 × 45 cm base should be given as a tank size by the usual local figure (e.g. "sekitar 240 liter" is not in the table, but a 120×45 cm tank is typically ~ 200 liter) — avoid the over-precise 243.
Item 7: Temperature "15–25 °C" kept as source; fine, but check that source is not a typo (likely 20–25). No translation change needed beyond consistency.

Item 9: "well-researched community aquarium" rendered awkwardly as "akuarium komunitas yang penghuninya sudah dipelajari dengan cermat"; simplify to "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan matang".
Item 1: "burayak" and "diternakkan" fine, but "ikan cyprinid" should be "ikan famili Cyprinidae (suku Cyprinidae)" for natural usage.
Item 12: "keranjang sampah" for 'catch-all' is a literal calque; use "kelompok serba-ada/penampung" for taxonomic wastebasket.

Item 5: '120 × 45 cm ... (sekitar 243 liter)' — the litre figure is odd, but it is in the source; however the tank volume is not a US-gallon conversion, so keep it. Not an error.
Item 11: 'Rupanya beberapa ikan dewasa menunjukkan perubahan warna' — fine. 'mengungkapkan bahwa rasio kelamin ... lebih banyak jantan' is fine.
Item 3: 'ditangkap' for 'collected' is fine, but 'di sebelah selatan Kerala' is correct per source ('lies south of Kerala'). The source is geographically wrong, yet the translation is faithful.
Item 13: 'Indonesia' is a fidelity match to the source. It is fine.

Item 12: 'garis merah tua' for 'scarlet body stripe' — scarlet is bright red, 'merah tua' means dark red and conflicts with 'lebih cerah'. Use 'merah terang/merah menyala'.
Item 9: 'well-researched community aquarium' is rendered 'direncanakan dengan baik' (well-planned), which changes meaning slightly; minor.
Item 5: '(about 243 litres)' became 'sekitar 240 liter'. This rounding is fine, so no change is needed.

Item 12: 'Puntius dulunya merupakan kelompok polifiletik yang menampung segala macam spesies, berisi lebih dari 100 spesies' is redundant and slightly changed. Use: 'kelompok polifiletik serba-campur yang berisi lebih dari 100 spesies'.
