#1: 'Large numbers are produced' lost 'Southeast Asia' context nuance only slightly. 'cyprinid' could be 'anggota suku Cyprinidae'. The text is otherwise faithful.
#3: In 'ditangkap' (collected), 'dikoleksi/ditangkap dari alam' is better. Minor.

Item 8: 'Volume: ~68 litres (~18 US gal)' is rendered 'sekitar 68 liter'. This is acceptable, but the tank is 'Akuarium 76 liter' elsewhere, so the 68 vs 76 L difference is not harmful. No fix needed here.
Item 16: 'if the latter resources are limited' became 'jika wilayah terbatas'. It drops 'pakan' (food). Change to 'jika pakan dan wilayah terbatas'.

Item 10: 'Anubias spp. likely to fare best' and 'The latter are particularly useful' became 'Anubias sangat berguna'. 'The latter' refers to Anubias, so this is fine. However 'filter berkapasitas lebih besar dari ukuran akuarium' for 'over-sized filter' is slightly loose; use 'filter berkapasitas jauh lebih besar'.

Item 22: 'one simple and 19-26 branched pectoral-fin rays' became 'satu jari-jari sirip dada tunggal dan 19–26 bercabang'. Better is 'satu jari-jari tunggal dan 19–26 jari-jari bercabang pada sirip dada'.
Item 22: 'posterior portion of paired fins' became 'bagian belakang sirip berpasangan'. This is fine. 'sirip dubur' for anal fin is acceptable, but hobbyists write 'sirip anal'.
Item 15: 'frozen spirulina brine shrimp' became 'artemia beku yang diperkaya spirulina'. This is acceptable. 'Alga rambut' and 'black beard' are fine.
Item 13: 'river manifold tank' was kept as 'model river manifold', which is unclear. Explain it, e.g. 'akuarium aliran sungai (river manifold)'. 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is acceptable.
Item 6: 'cascades' became 'air terjun kecil', which is fine. 'Run' as 'aliran deras' is fine. The phrase 'kadang sampai menjadi arus deras sekali' is awkward. Use 'terkadang sangat deras'.

Item 20: 'mouthing of the dorsal surface' became 'mencucup-cucup permukaan punggungnya'. It is understandable, but 'mengulum' or 'menyentuh dengan mulut' is more natural. In the same item, 'discovery of small numbers surviving' is fine.

Item 12: 'the putative subfamily Sicydiinae' was translated as 'subfamili Sicydiinae yang masih diperdebatkan'. This is a loose rendering and it adds a claim. Use 'subfamili Sicydiinae yang diduga/diusulkan'.

Item 12: 'attached to the belly only between the fifth pair of fin rays whereas in other sicydiines it's attached between all five rays'. The ID 'di antara kelima jari-jarinya' is fine, but the first clause 'pada bagian di antara sepasang jari-jari sirip yang kelima' is awkward and unclear. Rephrase it.

Item 9: 'Avoid those that feed aggressively' was rendered 'ikan yang makannya agresif'. It is acceptable, but 'hillstream loach' was added to the text and is not in the source. Remove the added 'hillstream loach'.

Item 9: 'The majority of cichlids ... inhabiting the lower reaches' was rendered 'bagian hilir sungai'. The original means the lower part of the water column or tank, so this is a wrong meaning. Use 'bagian bawah akuarium'.
Item 6: 'Aged driftwood' was rendered 'kayu ... yang sudah lama terendam'. Better: 'kayu apung/driftwood yang sudah matang/lapuk'.
Item 4: 'syntopically' was rendered 'hidup di tempat yang sama'. This is fine. 'terik matahari tropis' adds the sense of harsh, scorching sun. Use 'sinar matahari tropis'.

Item 11: 'initially pelagic ... larvae' was rendered 'hidup melayang di kolom air'. The sentence is garbled in the source, and the translation fixes it silently. This is acceptable. 'burayak' for fry is OK.
Item 8: 'Daphnia' was rendered 'kutu air'. Hobbyists say 'daphnia' or 'kutu air', which is acceptable. 'Artemia' is fine.

Item 6: "turnover of 10-15 times" is rendered correctly, but item 1 says 8–12 times; fine. Real issue in item 12: "putative subfamily Sicydiinae" became "subfamili Sicydiinae yang masih diperdebatkan" – OK; but "between the fifth pair of fin rays" / "between all five rays" is rendered as "di antara pasangan jari-jari sirip kelima" and "kelima jari-jarinya", which is ambiguous/possibly altered; ch…

Item 11: "the initially pelagic post-hatch larvae are washed downstream" – "burayak pasca-larva" for post-larval fry is fine, but "hidup melayang di kolom air" adds detail; acceptable. The "Hal ini tidak diragukan lagi" is OK.
Item 3: "Moluccas" left in English; use "Maluku" or "Kepulauan Maluku" and "Kepulauan Rempah-rempah" – the sentence is circular as written.
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang membulat".
Item 9: "pelagic" translated as "berenang di kolom air" – acceptable; "Hindari ikan yang makannya agresif" fine. "Ikan yang lebih besar sebaiknya tidak dimasukkan sama sekali" fine.
Item 1: "Hardiness: needs a well-established tank" translated as "Ketahanan" is slightly odd; a clearer rendering would be "Daya tahan".
Item 10: "posteroventral portion of the body" rendered "bagian belakang bawah tubuh" – fine; "genital papilla" fine.
Item 4: "bedrock" as "batuan induk" is a geological term meaning parent rock; use "batuan dasar".

Item 11: 'strategi ini hanya di famili Gobiidae saja pun dipakai oleh berbagai genus kerabat' is garbled and unnatural; rewrite as 'strategi ini dipakai oleh berbagai genus kerabat, hanya dalam famili Gobiidae saja'.

Item 12: 'cakram ... menempel ke perut hanya di antara jari-jari sirip pasangan kelima' is wrong. The English says the disc is attached only between the fifth pair of rays, and then 'between all five rays' in other sicydiines. Fix the wording so it reads 'hanya di antara pasangan jari-jari kelima' and 'di antara kelima jari-jari'.
Item 12: 'subfamili Sicydiinae yang masih bersifat dugaan' puts 'putative' on the wrong noun. Better 'subfamili Sicydiinae (yang diajukan/dugaan)'.
Item 12: 'goby bibir bergigi' and 'spesies Sicyopus ... bersifat omnivora' are fine, but 'Banyak yang diimpor' is ambiguous. Specify 'Banyak spesies/ikan ini'.

Item 12: 'Lidahnya juga menyatu ... beberapa goby lain' is acceptable, but 'Juxtastiphodon ... tidak ada yang melengkung ke belakang' is fine. Check 'jari-jari yang menebal' against the original, which says 'strong spine and thickened, highly-branched rays'.
Item 9: 'Caridinia' in the English was corrected to 'Caridina'. This is fine, but check that 'teman setangkinya' is natural; 'penghuni akuarium yang sama' is better.

Item 6 and item 1: the turnover figures conflict, but both are faithful to the English, so they are not errors. 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn'; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus karena terkikis air'.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'kutu air' can be read as a parasite. Use 'daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)'.
Item 11: 'Hal ini tidak diragukan lagi disebabkan oleh' is fine, but 'burayak' for post-larval fry is a poor fit. Use 'anakan' or 'larva'.
Item 12: added fact 'yang keabsahannya masih diperdebatkan' (subfamily validity disputed) — not in English; the original says 'putative' only. Remove or render as 'yang diduga/dianggap'.

Item 12: 'cakram ... menempel di antara kelima jari-jarinya' vs 'between all five rays'; fine, but 'hanya menempel ke perut di antara pasangan jari-jari sirip kelima' is ambiguous; clarify as 'hanya di antara jari-jari sirip kelima'.

Item 11: 'baru di famili Gobiidae saja' is a mistranslation of 'by various related genera in the family Gobiidae alone'; should be 'hanya di famili Gobiidae saja pun dipakai oleh berbagai genus kerabat'.
Item 12: 'Ketiga spesies Smilosicyopus' fine, but 'pemakaian beberapa nama secara berlebihan' misstates 'over-use of some names'; should be 'pemakaian berlebihan nama-nama tertentu'.
Item 1: 'memutar air akuarium' is acceptable but 'turnover' is better rendered 'perputaran air'.
Item 12: 'sirip perut' for pelvic fins and 'cakram perut' are acceptable; 'gigi bibir' for labial teeth is stiff.
Item 9: 'Caridinia' kept as in the source (should be Caridina) — consider correcting.
Item 12: 'Sicyopus ... termodifikasi' fine; 'di garis tengah depan sirip punggung' for 'predorsal midline' should be 'garis tengah di depan sirip punggung' (ambiguous).

Item 1: 'Golden Choco-Gourami ... terbesar ... maksimal sekitar 6 cm' is fine, but item 6 volume: 80×30 cm base 'sekitar 72 liter' is kept from source; fine. Main issue is item 14: 'Genus ini memiliki struktur telur yang sama dengan ketiga genus terakhir' — 'Genus ini' should be 'Sphaerichthys' (okay) but 'ketiga genus terakhir' is ambiguous; clarify as Luciocephalus, Parasphaerichthys dan Ctenop…
Item 14: 'tiga anggota genus lainnya' fine, but 'garis-garis vertikal terang' for 'light vertical bars' should be 'pita/garis vertikal terang'; minor.
Item 14: 'jantan memiliki garis samping terang ... dari pangkal batang ekor' — source says caudal peduncle base; OK. 'biasanya di atas gurat sisi' fine.
Item 12: 'Puncak pemijahan berupa pelukan' — 'climactic spawning embrace' better as 'Pelukan pemijahan puncak'; minor.
Item 12: 'sebagian breeder' — use 'sebagian peternak/pembiak' instead of English 'breeder'.
Item 12: 'burayak' used for 'fry' in mouth/juveniles; 'anakan' vs 'burayak' inconsistent; also 'Telur/burayak disimpan di dalam mulut' fine.

Item 2/12: 'Telurnya dierami di mulut oleh si jantan' omits the term 'paternal mouthbrooder' as label; acceptable, but 'Telur dierami di mulut oleh si jantan' as a heading-like sentence reads awkward.
Item 5: 'Lymnophila' is source spelling; 'perwakilan dari genus' is literal — use 'beberapa jenis dari genus'.
Item 4: 'cukup jauh lebih ke selatan' is awkward; use 'agak lebih jauh ke selatan'.
Item 13: 'sebanding dengan S. vaillanti' — better 'mirip dengan cara pada S. vaillanti'.

Item 14: 'Sphaerichthys memiliki struktur telur yang unik ... bersama tiga genus terakhir' – English says 'They share with the latter trio'; the sentence is garbled/ambiguous. Rephrase: 'Genus ini memiliki struktur telur yang sama dengan ketiga genus terakhir, yang unik di antara teleostei'.

Item 14: 'garis-garis vertikal terang' for 'light vertical bars' fine, but 'garis lateral' for 'lateral stripe' and 'gurat sisi' for 'lateral line' are inconsistent; use 'garis samping/gurat sisi' consistently.
Item 2: the bracketed explanation '(yang mengerami telur di mulut adalah si jantan)' is an added gloss, redundant; delete. Also 'jauh dari kata umum' is awkward; use 'tidak umum/jarang ditemukan'.
Item 11: 'bercumbu' for courtship sounds odd; use 'saat berkencan/dalam masa penjodohan (courtship)'. Same in item 12 'Perilaku bercumbu'.
Item 9: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' acceptable, but 'kutu air' for Daphnia and 'mikro worm' are inconsistent; use 'Daphnia' and 'cacing mikro (microworm)'.

Item 7: 'tanaman air' with 'Taxiphyllum' etc fine, but 'beech, oak' left untranslated; add 'daun beech/oak' with explanation or local equivalent. 'burayak' used for 'fry' while 'anakan' for 'juveniles' – okay.
Item 12: 'betina yang terbalik' omits 'diputar/dibalik' sense of the pair; fine. 'Telur/burayak disimpan di dalam mulut' OK. 'peternak' for breeders better 'pembudidaya/breeder'.
#1 "sulit dipelihara dan peka": "delicate" means rapuh/mudah stres, not hard to keep; wording shifts the meaning. Use "ikan yang rapuh dan sensitif".

#3 "Spesies ini juga ditemukan di Semenanjung Melayu": "juga" is added. The source does not say "also". It gives Indonesia as the origin and says the species is found on the Malay Peninsula. Remove "juga" or follow the source.
#6 "mutlak diperlukan" is acceptable, but "jentik nyamuk" is imprecise for mosquito larvae. Consider "larva nyamuk"; "baik hidup maupun beku" is placed too far from the foods it describes.
#1 "Chocolate Gourami" is capitalised throughout. Hobbyists commonly write "chocolate gurami", so use the Indonesian spelling "gurami".
"Semenanjung Malaysia" (sentences 3 and 4): English says "Malay Peninsula"; use "Semenanjung Melayu" (Malaysia is a narrower, different term).

"Asal: Indonesia. Spesies ini ditemukan di Semenanjung Malaysia.": the source is contradictory, and the translation keeps that. Check it against the source and fix the origin (the Malay Peninsula is not Indonesia), or flag it.
"Pakan serpihan kebanyakan tidak mau dimakan": reads awkwardly; better "Pakan serpihan umumnya tidak diterima/ditolak".
"mosquito larvae" translated as "jentik nyamuk": fine, but "baik hidup maupun beku" now applies to all items including fruit flies; this is a minor shift that is acceptable.
"Cara mengerami di mulut": unnatural; use "mouthbrooding (mengerami telur di mulut)" or "pengeraman di mulut". Also, the young are carried in the mouth, not "dierami"; wording is imprecise.
"Chocolate Gourami" is capitalised in sentence 2 but lowercase elsewhere: make it consistent.
"rapuh" for "delicate" (sentence 1): better "sulit dipelihara/peka", because "rapuh" means physically fragile.
Item 1 'Size': the English gives '(approximately 2–2.4″)'. Dropping the imperial figure is fine, so no fix is needed there.

Item 24: 'Betina yang mengerami' and the other 'betina' passages are consistent with the source. However, item 23 says the male broods, and item 24 says the female does. These conflict in the source itself, so check the English original. The translation is faithful to each.
Item 7: 'Asal: Indonesia' contradicts 'Semenanjung Malaya' and is likely an error in the source. The translation is faithful, so flag it for editorial review.
Item 25: 'induk membawa dan merawat anaknya' keeps the source claim that both parents brood. This conflicts with the other items, so check it against the source.
Item 6: 'sejauh ini memiliki sebaran paling luas di genusnya' is fine. 'Lokasi tipe' is acceptable, but 'lokalitas tipe' is more common.
Item 9: 'Lymnophila' is the source spelling and is kept unchanged, which is fine. 'sungai air hitam yang terhubung dengannya' is fine.
Item 14: 'Kesadahan' is fine. 'hasil budidaya' for tank-raised is fine.
Item 21: 'Cyprinid damai yang berenang di kolom air' is fine. 'lincah dan heboh' adds 'lincah' for 'boisterous'. This is a minor nuance.
Item 13: the wording 'Masukkan hanya ke akuarium yang sudah matang secara biologis' is fine. The °F figure was left out, which is allowed.
Item 17: 'pakan buatan' for 'prepared foods' is fine. 'Beri makan ... sekali atau dua kali sehari' is fine.
Item 13: the English gives 'Temperature: 25–29 °C (77–84 °F)'. The Indonesian drops the °F, which is allowed. No fix needed here.

Item 23: 'dierami di dalam mulut jantan' and 'informasi FishBase saat ini menyebut jantan sebagai induk'. This matches the English, which claims the male broods. Items 2, 24 and 27 say the female is the maternal mouthbrooder, so the source contradicts itself. The translation is faithful, but flag it to the editor for a factual check.
Item 27: 'subfamili Osphronemidae Luciocephalinae' is wrong. Osphronemidae is a family, so write 'subfamili Luciocephalinae dalam famili Osphronemidae'.
Item 6: 'sirip tunggal (sirip punggung, dubur, dan ekor)' adds a parenthetical that is not in the source. Delete it or give the more usual term 'sirip tidak berpasangan'.
Item 7: 'Asal: Indonesia' while the text says the species is found on the Malay Peninsula. The English is also inconsistent, so the translation matches the source. Flag it.
Item 11: '~54 liter' is kept from the source. Fine. Item 21: 'lebih agresif' for 'boisterous' changes the meaning slightly. Use 'lebih lincah/heboh'.
Item 24: 'Pelukan puncak saat memijah' is stiff. Use 'pelukan pemijahan'. 'peternak' for 'breeders' is better as 'pembudidaya'.
Item 1: 'warna dasar cokelat tua seperti cokelat' is redundant. Say 'cokelat tua pekat'. The 'Data Deficient' status is kept, which is fine.
Item 20: "Rüber dkk. (2006)" is fine, but "Kuhli loach" and "Cyclops" could be glossed. This is optional and minor.
Item 18: "jantan alfa" is slightly awkward. "jantan dominan" would be more natural.
Item 8: "gua" for caves is fine, but "gua" is less common in hobby usage than "tempat sembunyi". This is minor.

Item 17: the English says the male broods the eggs. The translation says 'dierami di dalam mulut jantan'. That matches item 17 but contradicts the other items. Items 2, 16 and 18 say the female broods. Item 17's brooding sex is a source contradiction, not a translation error. Check that 'pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) betina' in item 2 and 'pengeram mulut jantan' in item 20 match the English.
Item 18: 'ada kesimpulan yang simpang siur' adds the word 'kesimpulan'. The English says 'confusion'. Use 'ada kebingungan/kesimpangsiuran'.
Item 18: 'pembuat sarang busa' for 'bubblenester' is fine. 'plastik wrap' is acceptable, but 'peternak' for 'breeders' is better written 'pembudidaya'.

Item 20: 'Sphaerichthys memiliki struktur telur yang unik ... sama seperti tiga genus terakhir'. The English says the shared trio is Luciocephalus, Parasphaerichthys and Ctenops, so this is fine. 'guratan berbentuk spiral' for 'spiralling ridges' is acceptable. 'kerabat segenusnya' is a little stiff. 'garis tegak' is used for 'bar' in item 20, where 'pita/garis vertikal' would be more natural.

Item 15: 'Meskipun tidak bergerombol seperti ikan schooling/shoaling' leaves the English terms in place. Use 'ikan bergerombol (schooling/shoaling)'. 'lebih agresif' for 'more boisterous' changes the meaning slightly, because 'boisterous' means rowdy or active, not aggressive. The same applies in items 2 and 19.

Item 8: 'Ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari jika parameter airnya tidak mirip' is acceptable. 'dekorasi' and 'substrat pasir halus' are fine, but 'soft, sandy' should be 'pasir lembut'.
Item 12: 'Cyclops' and 'Baby artemia' are acceptable. 'Pakan hidup dan beku sangat penting selama masa adaptasi' is fine.
Item 1: the 'approximately 2–2.4″' figure is dropped, which is permitted. 'Data Deficient (kurang data)' is fine.
Item 8: "coklat cokelat tua" is a duplicated/garbled phrase; use "cokelat tua" (or "coklat tua") only.
Item 24: "coklat cokelat tua" is likewise duplicated; fix to "cokelat tua".
Item 11: "Volume: ~54 liter" is not the size keepers here would name. A 60×30 cm base may be fine, but check the volume figure against the source and use a standard value.
Item 24: "Pendekatan biasanya dimulai oleh jantan" mistranslates courtship. Use "Pacaran/penjajakan" instead of "pendekatan".

Item 24: "pembuat sarang busa" is acceptable, but "anabantoid ... satu-satunya" and "burayak" for the eggs/fry in the brooding sentence are loose. "Telur dan burayak" is fine, yet "anakan ... bisa berenang bebas" is okay. The main problem is "plastik wrap" for clingfilm/shrinkwrap; use "plastik pembungkus (cling wrap)".
Item 19: "Hindari ikan yang cepat dan rakus saat makan" adds "rakus", which is not in the source ("fast, competitive feeders"). Use "ikan yang gesit dan kompetitif saat makan".
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is fine, but the pattern is inconsistent with the other items. Minor.
Item 4: "rapuh" for "delicate" is off; "sensitif/peka" is more natural for a fish.
Item 20: "hibridisasi" is fine, but "kerabat satu genusnya" is awkward. Use "spesies sekerabat dalam satu genus".
Item 11: 'Volume: ~54 litres' for a 60×30 cm base is kept as is. It is not a gallon conversion, so it is fine; no change needed unless the source figure differs.
Item 26: 'subfamili Osphronemidae Luciocephalinae' is wrong. Use 'subfamili Luciocephalinae dalam famili Osphronemidae'.
Item 24: 'pembuat sarang busa' is fine, but 'burayak' is used for eggs/fry. 'Telur dan burayak disimpan di dalam mulut' is acceptable. For 'free-swimming juveniles', 'anakan' is fine.

Item 6: 'Kalimantan Tengah' is kept, but 'several hundred kilometres east' is placed in the wrong clause. In Indonesian it reads as if Sampit is east of Central Kalimantan; reword to 'di sebelah timur Banjarmasin'.
Item 7: 'tenggara' (southeast) is kept, but the English says 'Kalimantan' is the region name. Fine.
Item 21: 'Untuk ikan komunitas' is stiff. Phrase it as 'Sebagai teman satu akuarium'.
Item 1: 'Not Evaluated' is correctly kept in brackets. No change needed.
Item 20: 'Danionella, Microdevario' etc. are fine, but 'cyprinid damai yang berenang di kolom air' translates 'pelagic' loosely. Use 'cyprinid pelagis'.
Item 18: 'Pada dasarnya merupakan mikropredator' mistranslates 'Primarily'. Use 'Terutama'.
Item 12: 'Ketapang almond leaves' is rendered as 'daun ketapang', which is fine.
Item 3: "sulit dipelihara" is added; English says "rare and delicate" (langka dan rapuh/sensitif). Change it to match the source.
Item 5: "Central Kalimantan (Kalimantan Tengah) province" and Borneo were reduced, which is fine. But "several hundred kilometres east" is kept, so check that it is faithful; it is acceptable.
Item 10: GH ≤ 3 °d and KH ≤ 1 °d are unchanged, which is fine. "Akuarium blackwater yang sudah matang" is fine.

Item 14: "Di alam terutama memangsa hewan-hewan renik" mistranslates "micropredator". It should say pemangsa mikro (micropredator) feeding on small crustaceans. "hewan-hewan renik, seperti krustasea..." also changes the structure.

Item 20: "Sphaerichthys dan tiga genus yang disebut terakhir..." is a rewrite. The English says they share the egg structure with "the latter trio", so this is acceptable, but "ikan teleostei" should be "teleostei".
Item 19: "Burayak ... akuarium pembesaran ... burayak membutuhkan akses": the English says "they". This is fine.
Item 11: Temperature range 26–31 °C is unchanged, which is fine. Item 1: the ID drops "(≈ 1.5–2″)" as instructed.
Item 6: "Spesies ini dikenali dari warna dasar..." is fine. Item 19: "pengeram mulut jantan" is fine.
Item 15: "Hindari ikan yang gesit dan agresif berebut pakan" adds "agresif"; the English says "fast, competitive feeders" (pemakan yang gesit dan kompetitif).

Item 20: "merupakan pengeram mulut jantan" is fine, but "Sphaerichthys memiliki struktur telur yang unik ... bersama ketiga genus terakhir" is garbled and changes the meaning: the original says Sphaerichthys shares the egg structure with the latter trio (Luciocephalus, Parasphaerichthys, Ctenops), and Trichogaster/Trichopodus are not included. Reword so it is clear.
Item 19: "pembuat sarang busa" for bubblenester is acceptable, but "Pelukan puncak" for 'climactic spawning embrace' is awkward. Use "puncak pelukan pemijahan".
Item 19: "7–20 hari" is correct, but it conflicts with item 18's "10–14 hari". Both match the source, so no change is needed. Item 19: "1 sampai 6 ekor" is not an issue.
Item 16: "tidak bergerombol seperti ikan schooling" is awkward and redundant. Use "tidak membentuk kawanan (schooling)".

Item 9: "pot tanah liat" for 'ceramic flowerpots' is acceptable, but "sungai" and "Di alam ikan ini hidup di perairan ... mengalir sangat lambat" adds the idea of slow flow, which is slightly different from 'sluggish or still'. Minor.
Item 3: "rapuh" for 'delicate' can read as physically fragile. "Sensitif/sulit dipelihara" would be better.

Item 7: 'Lymnophila' is a misspelling kept from the source and is fine. "Ikan ... banyak berubah ... telah banyak berubah" in the last paragraph is repetitive: "dalam banyak kasus telah banyak berubah".
Item 14: "agar warna dan kondisinya berkembang optimal" is acceptable. "Pemangsa mikro" for 'micropredator' is a bit literal.
Item 1: The English term is left in brackets after "Belum Dievaluasi", which is allowed. In item 5, "Kalimantan Tengah" and "Kalimantan Selatan" are fine.
Item 8: English says 'Minimum of 75 litres (20 gallons)'. 20 gallons is about 75 L, so the number is fine. No fix needed here.
Item 17: 'Red mosquito larvae' was translated as 'cacing darah/bloodworm'. This is an added gloss, and 'jentik nyamuk merah' is already clear. Drop the parenthetical or keep it neutral.

Item 22: 'the females hold the eggs' contradicts items 2, 23 and 24, which say S. vaillanti is a paternal mouthbrooder. The translation is faithful to the English source, so flag it as a source inconsistency rather than a translation error. The translator could add a note if allowed.
Item 21: 'intensifies further during courtship/spawning' became 'semakin pekat lagi saat masa pendekatan/pemijahan'. 'lagi' is redundant. Use 'semakin pekat'.
Item 11: 'daun oak/ek' is awkward. Use 'daun oak' only.
Item 24: 'Sphaerichthys species are often grouped within the Osphronemid subfamily Luciocephalinae' was restructured correctly. 'Nangah' and other names are unchanged. No fix needed.
Item 1: 'Temperature: 24-28°C (75-82°F)' dropped the °F figure, which is allowed. 'introverted' became 'tertutup', which is acceptable.
Item 19: 'schooling/shoaling' was left in English without an Indonesian equivalent. Add 'berkelompok' or 'bergerombol' so the term is explained.
Item 14 (and 2): 'Samurai gourami' and 'Vaillant's chocolate gourami' are left in English. This is acceptable as a trade name.
Item 8: English says '75 litres (20 gallons)'; the translation keeps 75 liter. 20 gallons is about 75 L, so this is fine. No fix needed here, but item 17 has a real error.

Item 14: 'Corydoras' is rendered 'Corydoras' only. The English says 'Corydoras catfish', so add 'lele kecil' or 'ikan kucing' for the reader.
Item 16: 'dengkingan/cicitan' is an odd rendering of croaking/chirruping. Use 'suara berkuruk/mencicit'. 'Gelang sirip dada' for pectoral girdle is also stiff.
Item 19: 'monotipe' and 'danionin' are used loosely. 'Ikan bertulang sejati' for 'bony fishes' is OK, but 'subfamili ... kelompok saudara' needs consistent terminology.
Item 13: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'cacing grindal' and 'cacing mikro' should keep 'grindal' and 'micro worm' as hobbyists know them.
Item 6: "burayak artemia (nauplii)" is non-standard. "Burayak" means fry. Hobbyists say "nauplius artemia" or "naupli artemia".
Item 6: "pakan plankton berukuran kecil" is slightly loose for "small planktivorous food". Something like "pakan hidup berukuran kecil" would be clearer.
Item 8: "The kings of the discus fishes" became "yang paling istimewa", which loses the "kings" image. Use something like "rajanya discus".
Item 8: "legendarily most beautiful" became "dikenal sebagai yang paling cantik", which loses the "legendary" nuance. Use "konon/legendaris paling cantik".
Items 1 and 2: "mengikuti Rio Solimões" is vague for "ranges down the Rio Solimões". Use "menyebar di sepanjang Rio Solimões".
Item 2: 'Danau Sentarum lake system' became 'sistem danau Sentarum'; use 'sistem Danau Sentarum' (proper name, capital D) to match item 1.
Item 9: 'saat sedang mengandung telur' for 'gravid' is slightly awkward for an egg-bearing fish; use 'saat sedang bertelur/penuh telur'.
Item 7: 'mendorong ikan masuk ke kondisi siap memijah' is stiff; use 'merangsang ikan siap memijah'.
Item 5: 'berasal dari perairan yang arusnya lambat' is fine, but 'Ikan ini seharusnya tumbuh baik' is awkward; use 'Ikan ini akan tumbuh baik'.
Item 11: 'pita pertama' for 'anterior bar' is an inference, and the English didn't number it; 'pangkal depan' for 'origin' adds 'depan' not in the source (use 'pangkal sirip punggung').

Item 11: 'serasah' in item 5 and 'jari-jari sirip punggung tidak bercabang' for 'simple ray' are acceptable, but the English 'rostral and maxillary barbels' is rendered 'sungut maksila'; 'sungut maksilar' is the usual term.
Item 8: 'ribut atau sangat lincah' for 'boisterous or very vigorous' is OK, but 'tidak terlalu mudah kaget' for 'less skittish' is awkward; use 'tidak mudah takut/stres'.
Item 1: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is awkward for 'congeners'; use 'spesies segenus'.
Item 2: the Indonesian omits "Borneo" ("Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan), Borneo"). Add "Borneo" back.

Item 8: "mereka bisa kalah bersaing dalam mendapatkan pakan" is garbled. It is also ambiguous about who loses. Write "karena ikan ini bisa kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan". "sangat agresif" also changes "very vigorous" (it should be energetic or lively), and "saat makan" is an addition.
Item 9: "saat sedang mengandung telur" for "gravid" is fine, but "tubuhnya jelas lebih bulat" is clumsy. Use "tubuhnya tampak jelas lebih bulat".
Item 11: "dibandingkan 5–6 jari-jari bercabang pada sirip anal pada anggota genus lainnya" repeats "pada sirip anal". Shorten it.
Item 11: "sungut maksila" and "tapis insang" are acceptable. "pita tegak" for "bars" is non-standard; use "pita vertikal" or "garis tegak".
Item 5: "setup bergaya sungai hutan" is awkward and repeated. Use "akuarium bertema sungai hutan". "berasal dari perairan yang arusnya lambat" is OK.
Item 1: "kawasan danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant. Use "kawasan Danau Sentarum".
Item 2: "sistem danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant. Use "sistem danau Sentarum".
"Bearded worm goby" left in English as the name; consider adding a local/descriptive name (e.g., goby cacing berjenggot) with the English in brackets.
"Matanya sangat mengecil" is slightly awkward; better "matanya sangat tereduksi/mengecil sekali".
"ia bisa menghirup udara" - "bernapas dengan udara" is more natural; "ruang bronkial" could be "ruang insang".
"Kemungkinan besar ikan ini cukup pasif" is slightly stronger than "Likely to be quite inactive"; "Kemungkinan ikan ini cukup pasif" is closer.
"Jelas jangan dicampur" is awkward; use "Sama sekali tidak boleh dipelihara bersama...".
"mangsa" for "food" is acceptable but "pakan" is closer.
"berat jenis" for sg is fine, but add "(sg)" for hobby familiarity.
Item 4: "~432 liter" is the English figure left unchanged and not a sensible rounding. 120×60×60 cm is 432 L, so the number is correct. Not an error.

Item 11: "Largescale archerfish termasuk dalam kelompok ikan menarik yang berevolusi memiliki cara makan..." is awkward. Rephrase, e.g. "salah satu kelompok ikan menarik yang mengembangkan cara makan yang sangat khas ini".
Item 11: "Toxotes chatareus dijual di Inggris" leaves in a UK-specific mention. It matches the source, so it is acceptable, but it could be generalised for Indonesian readers.
Item 7: "ditembak jatuh" and "mau menerima pakan apung" are slightly stiff. Prefer "mau memakan pakan apung".

Item 8: "monodactylus (mono)" and "chromide hijau" are not the usual local names. Use "monyet/mono (Monodactylus argenteus)" and "chromide hijau (Etroplus suratensis)", or keep the English trade names consistently.

Item 11: the "six species" and "the most commonly available" facts are kept. In item 1, "setup air payau" is fine, but "Largescale archerfish" is left without the Indonesian name "ikan sumpit" in the intro, so add "ikan sumpit sisik besar".
Item 3: "Menghuni berbagai biotop" has no subject. Add "Ikan ini" for clarity.

Item 4: "~432 liter" — 120×60×60 cm = 432 L, so the figure is correct; no change needed. Real problem: the source says "Standard length: 40 cm SL"; keep it, but "Alas akuarium" is odd — use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Panjang × lebar dasar".

Item 7: "The archer fish ... paludarium setup described above" — the earlier text (item 5) calls it a "biotope setup", not a paludarium, so "seperti dijelaskan di atas" is fine. Fix "pakan apung seperti pakan serpihan dan pelet" to avoid repetition: "pakan apung seperti serpihan dan pelet".

Item 11: "Largescale archerfish termasuk dalam kelompok ikan menarik yang mengembangkan cara makan ini" — "mengembangkan" reads as if the fish deliberately developed it; use "yang berevolusi memiliki cara makan yang sangat khas ini".
Item 11: "Toxotes chatareus juga dijual di Inggris" — "juga" is added; the source says "is offered for sale in the UK". Remove "juga".

Item 8: "scat (ikan kiper)" — "ikan kiper" is a different fish (Scatophagus is called ikan scat/kiper in some usage but "kiper" is also used for Datnioides/Monodactylus confusion); prefer "scat" alone or "ikan kiper (scat)", and give "mono" as "monodactylus (mono)". "green chromide" should be rendered as the local trade name "chromide hijau" or "Etroplus suratensis".

Item 3: 'Minimum tank size: 15 gallons (~60 litres)' is fine, but item 11 is the problem. English 'A single Dwarf Gourami: 10-gallon (40-litre)' is OK, though '20–30 gallons (80–120 litres)' is an inconsistent conversion in the source; keep as is.
Item 14: 'angelfish' is translated as 'manfish'. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish/skalar' (Pterophyllum is commonly 'angelfish' or 'skalar' in Indonesia); 'manfish' is non-standard.
Item 14: 'Endler's livebearers' became just 'endler'. Write 'guppy endler' or 'Endler's livebearer'.
Item 14: 'goldfish' became 'ikan mas koki'. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish'; this is acceptable, but check consistency.
Item 9: 'truncate' tail fin became 'tegak lurus di ujungnya'. Better: 'rata/terpotong di ujungnya'.
Item 17: 'dasar kaca' was added; the English only says light reflecting off the bottom. Drop 'kaca'.
Item 17: 'Elodea and Anacharis' are the same plant; this is faithful to the source, so leave it.

Item 29: 'In Singapore they breed all year round and fry can mature in as little as four months' is OK. Item 29: 'beware of surface agitation, as some filters can disturb the nest' became 'merusak sarang'; 'mengganggu' is closer.
Item 27: 'Ketapang/Indian Almond' is shortened to 'daun ketapang kering' and 'adult and fry tanks' is OK. Item 21: 'gaudy species' became 'berwarna mencolok'; fine.
Item 4: 'siklus nitrogen' is correct for aquarium cycling; 'a couple of weeks' became 'beberapa minggu' (a few weeks); use 'sekitar dua minggu'.
Item 7: "Volume: sekitar 81 liter" is fine, but the English gives 120 mm SL; check nothing else. No fix needed there.
Item 8: "20 gallons (about 76 litres)" should be 80 litres (OK), but "10-gallon" is rendered "sekitar 40 liter" (OK). No change needed.
Item 1: "Sepat mutiara" is fine, but "gurami" is used for gouramis; keep consistent.
Item 18: "dadanya yang merah mencolok" is acceptable; no change.
Item 19: "6-8\" in depth" converted to "15–20 cm" is right, but "10\" diameter" became "25 cm" — correct.
Item 14: "jentik kaca" for glass worms is a non-standard term; use "cacing kaca" or "larva nyamuk kaca".
Item 15: "it will become withdrawn" translated as "menjadi pemalu"; better "menyendiri/menarik diri".
Item 2: "Life expectancy: 4 to 5 years" is kept as in the source, though it conflicts with item 1 and 21 (8 years); no translation fix needed.
Item 6: "Volume: ~68 liter" is fine, but the 75 × 30 cm base with ~68 L stays as given; no issue. Real problems are elsewhere.

Item 1: "padahal R. agilis adalah sinonim junior ... ikan yang konon mirip dengannya" adds a contrastive "padahal" and changes the logic; the English only states the facts. Use "tetapi" or a plain statement.

Item 15: "R. gracilis oleh Kottelat" is kept, but the source's "Ahl ... R. taeniata" chain is fine. The sentence "karena spesimen tipenya ternyata mewakili genus yang berbeda" is ambiguous, so state clearly that the R. agilis type specimens belong to a different genus.

Item 15: "Hasilnya sangat berbeda: ... disinonimkan dengan Rasbora" turns "The results differed significantly and ..." into a colon construction. Acceptable, but "sistem Liao et al. diikuti di sini ... setidaknya karena" misses "if only because" nuance ("walaupun hanya karena").

Item 11: "ikan cyprinid ... mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik" is a semicolon splice that changes the structure of "with ... perhaps constituting the best choices". Rephrase so the companions are clearly the suggestions.
Item 7: "Spesies ini tampaknya paling baik di bawah pencahayaan" is awkward; use "paling baik dipelihara di bawah pencahayaan yang cukup redup".
Item 7: "Koloni ini bisa menjadi sumber pakan" for "These" is ok. "Kutu air" for Daphnia (item 10) is fine.

Item 14: "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" and "Alas akuarium" are fine. "Ikan dipijahkan secara berkelompok, dengan masing-masing enam ekor" should say "sekitar enam ekor" ("half a dozen" is approximate).
Item 6: "Volume: ~68 liter" with base 75 × 30 cm: fine; no issue. (ignore)

Item 2: "Asal: Singapura" — OK; but item 1 says "Kalimantan" while the English says "Borneo"; the translation changes the island to the Indonesian part only (also in item 3 "Di Kalimantan", "Kepulauan Sunda Besar, yaitu Kalimantan dan Sumatra"). Use "Borneo" (the island) to avoid excluding Sarawak/Malaysian Borneo.
Item 3: "Di Kalimantan, sebagian besar penangkapan..." then "Sarawak" is said to be in Kalimantan; use "Di Borneo".

Item 11: "Hindari teman satu akuarium yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan" adds "saat makan"/"agresif"; English says boisterous or very vigorous tankmates that may outcompete it for food. Also "mereka bisa kalah bersaing" drops the subject "it"; rephrase.

Item 15: "empat genus baru dari Liao et al., ... disinonimkan" fine; but "Klad keempat/kelima" statement "begitu pula anggota klad kelima" is OK. "Sinonim junior" ok. Item 14: "pemijahan biasanya terjadi" turns "should take place" into a stronger claim; use "seharusnya terjadi".
Item 4: "harlequin rasbora" and "glowlight rasbora" left in English; use local names (e.g. rasbora harlequin/ rasbora glowlight) consistently; "gurami coklat" should be "cokelat".
Item 12: "Rasbora ini adalah ikan komunitas yang sempurna" is fine.

Item 3: type locality left in English ('8 kilometers southeast of Anjungan on road to Pontianak') – quoted type locality may stay, but 'kilometers' etc. is untranslated English; also remove/convert or translate consistently.

Item 15: 'karena spesimen tipe yang menjadi dasar nama R. agilis ternyata termasuk genus lain' adds a claim not in the source (original: type specimens found to represent a different genus, not specifying R. agilis basis); also 'Liao dan rekan-rekannya' fine, but 'ikan yang dideskripsikan ... dideskripsikan ulang' ok.
Item 1: 'konon mirip dengannya' is fine, but 'akur dengan ikan lain' is a weak rendering of 'fine with others'; prefer 'cocok dengan ikan lain'.
Item 11: 'cyprinid ... mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik' – 'perhaps constituting the best choices' OK; 'ribut' for 'boisterous' fine; 'anabantoid' could be 'anabantoid (labirin)'.
Item 14: 'betina tampak bertelur' should be 'betina tampak penuh telur/bunting telur' (gravid); 'pelet butiran' in item 10 is redundant for 'granules'.
Item 4: 'glowlight rasbora' left in English without local name; add local name or bracket.
Item 5: 'Lymnophila' retained; 'streams and rivers' reversed to 'sungai dan anak sungai' (ok) but 'hutan purba' for 'ancient forest' fine; 'perwakilan genus' stiff.
Item 7: 'ikan ... daun ek/oak' fine; 'Beberapa rumpun tanaman apung untuk lebih meredam cahaya' awkward.

Item 11: "Avoid boisterous or very vigorous tankmates as they may outcompete it for food" became "Hindari teman yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan karena mereka bisa kalah bersaing". This reverses the meaning: the tankmates outcompete this fish, not the other way round. Fix: "karena mereka dapat mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan". Also "saat makan" was added, and "agresif" is not the same…

Item 11: the Borneo species list lost "for example" and the sentence order changed. Also "mungkin merupakan pilihan teman terbaik" is a weak rendering of "perhaps constituting the best choices"; it is acceptable, but "Cyprinid ... mungkin" would read better as a single sentence.
Item 1: "konon mirip dengannya" is acceptable, but "menampilkan fotonya" for "pictured it" is fine. "Padahal" adds a contrastive nuance that the English does not have. Use a neutral "tetapi".

Item 15: "redescribed as R. gracilis by Kottelat in 1991 because the type specimens were found to represent a different genus" is rendered literally and is ambiguous. The Indonesian "dideskripsikan ulang ... karena spesimen tipenya mewakili genus yang berbeda" gives the wrong reason. Make it clear that the fish originally called R. agilis proved to be a different genus.
Item 15: "membentuk empat genus baru" for "erected four new genera" should be "mendirikan/menetapkan empat genus baru". Also "Para penulis tersebut" reads stiffly.

Item 7: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan" is awkward. Use "Pemilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting". "daun beech, oak" is acceptable, but add an Indonesian gloss or note that these are not available locally. "blackwater" is fine.

Item 4: "yaitu glowlight rasbora" leaves the English trade name in without an Indonesian equivalent; this is acceptable but could be smoother. "syntopically" was rendered as "di tempat yang sama", which is fine.
Item 5: "Lymnophila" is kept as in the source (the correct spelling is Limnophila); a note is optional. "nyaris nol" for "negligible" slightly overstates; "sangat rendah" is safer.

Item 11: 'Meskipun tidak satu pun ... bisa dianggap 100% benar, sistem Liao dkk. yang dipakai di sini sambil menunggu...' is ungrammatical, missing 'adalah/tetap'. Rewrite as 'sistem Liao dkk. tetap dipakai di sini...'. It is hard to read.
Item 11: 'dan mereka membentuk empat genus baru' is wrong. 'erected four new genera' means the researchers established the genera, so use 'mendirikan/menetapkan empat genus baru'.
Item 11: 'garis lateral tambahan berwarna kemerahan' reads as an extra lateral line. It should be 'garis memanjang di sisi tubuh (strip lateral) tambahan berwarna kemerahan'.
Item 11: 'spesies tipe Rasbora' is fine, but 'dan satu ikan yang belum dideskripsikan yang mirip' is clumsy. Also 'Klad ketiga ... Trigonostigma' is fine.

Item 1: 'menampilkan fotonya' and 'ikan yang katanya mirip dengannya' are awkward. Also 'sejak sebuah buku ... menampilkan' is OK, but 'katanya' is too colloquial for a handbook. Use 'yang konon mirip'.

Item 8: 'ikan sekeluarga karper (Cyprinidae) ... mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik' has a muddled structure. 'Avoid boisterous tankmates as they may outcompete it' is rendered ambiguously as 'mereka bisa kalah bersaing dengannya', which reverses the meaning (should be 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan' / ikan ini bisa kalah bersaing).
Item 3: 'Lymnophila' is left as in the source, so keep it. 'Tempat airnya ... akibat asam humat' is OK, but 'perwakilan genus' is a literal calque. Use 'beberapa genus seperti'.
Item 10: 'induk harus segera dipindahkan' is repetitive. The 'half a dozen specimens of each sex' phrasing is OK. 'pelet butiran' in item 7 is an inaccurate rendering of 'granules'.
Section 1: 'akur dengan ikan lain' is a mild rendering of 'fine with others'; fine overall. But 'ikan yang konon mirip dengannya' is ok.
Section 11: 'membentuk satu kelompok monofiletik yang terdiri atas enam klad' ok; but 'Genus ini sudah lama diakui sebagai garis keturunan polifiletik' fine.
Section 8: 'Hindari teman setangki yang ribut atau sangat agresif karena bisa kalah bersaing' — 'vigorous' is not 'agresif'; use 'sangat lincah/aktif'.
Section 8: 'ikan cyprinid seukuran' and 'loach kecil' leave English terms; prefer 'ikan sekeluarga karper/sepat' style local terms (e.g. 'loach' acceptable), minor.
Section 2: Type locality quote left in English; acceptable as a quote, but 'Borneo' vs 'Kalimantan' inconsistent.
Section 3: 'Lymnophila' retained as in source (should be Limnophila) — Latin name unchanged, fine; 'Habitat air jernihnya' lacks antecedent 'clear water habitats' context, say 'Habitat air jernih'.
Section 10: 'Telur akan menetas dalam 18–48 jam' fine; 'pakan seukuran infusoria' ok; 'pemijahan biasanya terjadi' adds 'biasanya' not in the source ('should take place'), minor.
Section 5: 'tempat teduh dan celah persembunyian' — 'caves' rendered as 'celah persembunyian', acceptable; 'kutu air' for Daphnia in section 7 is fine.
Item 10: 'preferably in the evening' became 'sebaiknya pada sore atau malam hari' – adds 'sore atau' (afternoon); original only says evening. Use 'sebaiknya pada malam hari'.

Item 10: 'a large (40-50% of tank volume), cool water change' – 'cool' rendered as 'lebih dingin' (cooler) – acceptable, but 'ganti air besar' is fine; however 'Spesies ini tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan anak' is awkward; use 'tidak menjaga telur/anakan'.
Item 10: 'dry runs' translated as 'latihan' is unclear; use 'gerakan pemijahan palsu/uji coba tanpa telur'.
Item 10: 'kesadahan 1–5°H' – the unit °H kept; ok, but 'peternak' for breeders should be 'pembudidaya/breeder'.
Item 10: 'burayak' used for fry, but earlier in the same paragraph 'anakan' used for young; keep consistent. 'sinkhole' (item 3) left in English; use 'lubang runtuhan/doline'.
Item 8: 'ikan hias paling populer' – 'fish in the hobby' fine, but 'ikan jantan juga akan menampilkan warna...' fine; 'catfish, loach' left as English trade names – acceptable.
Item 2: 'reports from Laos probably represent cases of mistaken identity' ok. Item 11: 'kilau pigmen oranye' for 'flash' ok; 'tidak dikuantifikasi' is stiff; use 'belum diukur'.
Item 11: 'colourless' translated as 'pucat' – slightly changed; use 'tanpa warna/keabu-abuan pucat'.
Item 12: reference list left untranslated – fine, no issue.
Item 5: 'daun beech, oak' left untranslated – add 'beech (bangkuang/ek)' or note local equivalents, e.g. 'daun ek'.
Item 25: 'boisterous' is translated as 'berisik' (noisy). It means rowdy or boisterous, so use 'beringas/hiperaktif/kasar' instead, in both places.
Item 22: 'blanched vegetables' is rendered 'sayuran rebus'. 'Sayuran yang diblansir/direbus sebentar' is more precise.
Items 29 and 30: 'in the evening' is expanded to 'sore atau malam hari'. This slightly adds to the source; 'pada sore hari' or 'menjelang malam' is closer.
Item 31: 'Mating: one female per male' contradicts the '2 males and 3–4 females' in the list. This is faithful to the English, but the translator could flag it.
Section 8: the English list has a stray Vietnamese item 'thức ăn đông lạnh'. The translator rendered it as 'pakan beku', which is fine. The source glitch is not a translation error.
Section 9: 'Active: at night' is fine, but 'Seperti kebanyakan udang, spesies ini sangat sosial' is a mild stretch. This is a minor point.
Section 8: 'Tidak perlu diberi makan secara langsung' is unclear for 'No direct feeding is necessary'. Reword, e.g. 'tidak perlu disuapi/ditarget langsung'.
Section 8: 'ia membersihkan ... yang kemudian dimakannya sebagai bagian dari pakannya' is awkward. Use 'udang ini' instead of 'ia', and avoid repeating 'pakan'.

Section 12: the English says 'The hump of the third abdominal somite bears two red bars and a white line'. This is translated correctly. However, 'Rostrum putih-merah' adds 'putih-merah' to the English 'A very long white-red rostrum', which is faithful. Ignore.
Section 4: '"tenggelam" (jarang terlihat)' for 'may get lost' is acceptable but a bit loose. Consider 'sulit terlihat/hilang di antara batuan'.
Section 9: 'kemampuan bertahannya yang terbatas' for 'limited defensive capability' loses the meaning. Use 'kemampuan pertahanan diri yang terbatas'.
Section 6: 'Hardness: 8–12 dKH' should say KH or 'kesadahan karbonat (KH)'. Plain 'Kesadahan' is ambiguous with GH.
Section 5: 'Beri waktu untuk beradaptasi' dropped the English distinction between temperature-acclimate and full acclimatisation. It still gives the same advice. Minor point.

Item 15: "terhadap pemancing yang menanganinya dengan kasar saat ikan ini dipegang" – 'nasty anglers' is rendered as handling roughly and is redundant; use e.g. "terhadap pemancing yang menangkapnya/memegangnya" without inventing 'dengan kasar'.
Item 10: "lancefish (sejenis ikan sand eel)" adds an explanation not in the source and is questionable; use "ikan lancefish/sand eel" or a plain local term, and drop the added gloss.
Item 3: "profilnya menggolongkannya" is a literal rendering of 'the profile treats it as'; use neutral wording, e.g. "ikan ini dianggap sebagai ikan yang benar-benar berbahaya".

Item 2/3/15: "lele" for Wallago catfish is acceptable, but "Helicopter catfish" is better given as a trade name with a local gloss, e.g. "lele helikopter (helicopter catfish)"; in Indonesia the fish is also known as tapah/ikan tapa.
Item 7: "~5184 liter" / "sekitar 5184 liter" - fine, but check item 3 vs item 2: English says 2 m max and 240 cm in different places; keep as source (no fix).
Item 3: "Tapah" is added as a local name not in the source; Tapah is a legitimate local name for Wallago, but "helicopter catfish" is fine. Low severity.
Item 14: "Memelihara ikan ini benar-benar berbahaya" - the subject is awkward; better "Ikan ini benar-benar berbahaya untuk dipelihara".
Item 14: "memutus tangan" - OK, but "akuaris" is non-standard; use "aquascaper/penghobi akuarium" ("penghobi akuarium yang paling berpengalaman").

Item 15: "terhadap pemancing yang usil saat dipegang" - ambiguity: the English says nasty anglers when handled (the fish is handled); rephrase as "terhadap pemancing yang menanganinya dengan kasar/saat ikan dipegang".
Item 15: "Ikan yang sudah tertangkap gigi-gigi ini tidak akan lolos" - "doomed" is fine, but add nuance that it refers to prey fish: "ikan yang tergigit pasti celaka".

Item 10: "lancefish" left untranslated without a local equivalent; add the Indonesian term (e.g. "ikan lancet/ikan pedang") or gloss it. Also "Ikan yang lebih besar ... tidak perlu diberi pakan sesering itu" - "sesering itu" refers to nothing; use "sesering ikan kecil".
Item 13: "dibudidayakan secara komersial" - the source says "bred"; the earlier clause says "Belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan", fine. "alasan yang sudah jelas" ok.
Item 1: "minimal 2 m" - the source says tank "at least 2 m long"; OK.
Item 5: volume "~5184 liter" is a false-precision figure, but it is unchanged from the source, so no fix is needed there. However, 360 × 120 × 120 cm = 5184 L is correct, so leave it.
Item 2/12: "profilnya memperlakukannya" keeps the source's "the profile" reference, which is awkward. Rephrase neutrally, e.g. "ikan ini dianggap benar-benar berbahaya".

Item 7: 'Ikan liar ... pemakan omnivor' is redundant. 'Pemakan' plus 'omnivor' repeats itself, so use 'omnivor yang mencari makan'. 'Mencari makan di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (on the bottom), which is not in the source.
Item 11: 'sesungut berisi' for 'fleshy tentacles' is awkward. Use 'sesungut berdaging'.
Item 10: 'Bertelur di dalam gua' for 'cave-spawner' is slightly literal. 'Pembiak dalam gua/lubang' or 'bertelur dalam gua' is fine, but 'telur dan anak' adds 'anak', which is acceptable.

Item 1/6: "Kekerasan air (GH)" adds a "(GH)" label that the English doesn't have. Minor. The English says only "Hardness", and the value is in dGH.
Item 5: "tumbuhan akuatik yang berakar" is slightly wordy. "tumbuhan berakar" would be enough. Minor.
Item 13: "Oscar sangat menuntut kimia air yang baik" reads stiffly. Use something like "Oscar sangat sensitif terhadap kualiti air".
Item 20: "kekacang" means legumes. For "nuts" use "kacang" or "buah bernut".
Item 18: "ikan bilis/whitebait" is imprecise, because whitebait is not the same as ikan bilis. Use "whitebait" or a more exact local term.

Item 3: "boleh hidup selama seekor anjing" is wrong/nonsensical; should be "selama hayat seekor anjing" (as long as a dog lives).
Item 2: Minimum tank size "65 gallons (about 250 litres)" is fine, but the translation omits that figure's context. No change needed, but "Tahap mahir" for Care: Advanced is OK.

Item 18: "ikan kecil (whitebait)" for whitebait is vague; use "ikan bilis/whitebait" or equivalent.

Item 27: "akuarium awam serta kedai selalunya ditawarkan lebih banyak ikan" is awkward and wrongly passive; should read that public aquaria and shops are often offered more fish than they can house ("sering ditawarkan" with clear subject).
Item 27: "Semasa mengurat" (courtship) is colloquial; use "semasa percumbuan".

Item 19: "mengelakkan tangki berkemungkinan menjadi terlalu ramai ikan" is awkward for "potentially overpopulating your tank". Use something like "dan mengelakkan tangki menjadi terlalu sesak dengan ikan".

Also 'mengelakkan tangki menjadi terlalu padat' loses 'overpopulating' meaning (use 'terlalu ramai ikan').
Item 12: 'agak tidak cerewet' is awkward; use 'agak mudah dijaga'. 'Susunan gaya semula jadi' should be 'Susun atur bergaya semula jadi'.
Item 4: 'diberi kepada pemilik baharu' fine, but 'ladang ikan' for fish farms OK; 'hitam putih' should be 'hitam dan putih' (black and white) to avoid reading as a single colour.
Item 5: 'Populasi liar yang terlepas' ok; 'dikutip' for 'collected' should be 'ditangkap/dikumpulkan'.

Item 27: 'akuarium awam serta kedai biasanya ditawarkan lebih banyak' is a wrong passive; the public aquaria and shops are offered more fish than they can house: use 'sering ditawarkan ikan lebih banyak daripada yang mampu ditampung'. 'Semasa mengawan' for courtship should be 'Semasa pacaran'.
Item 24: 'betina yang sedang mengawan' for 'nuptial females' should be 'betina yang bersedia membiak'; 'mengawan' is inaccurate for spawning in cichlids.

Item 28: 'jantan akan berenang di atasnya untuk mensenyawakan telur' acceptable; 'oscar boleh jadi cerewet' fine. Item 29: 'Kebanyakan orang tidak sengaja membiakkan' wrongly reads as 'accidentally'; the meaning is 'do not intentionally breed' - use 'Kebanyakan orang tidak membiakkan oscar dengan sengaja'.

Item 26: source says female has 'one smaller hole and one larger' - translated correctly, but item 25 'one larger hole' versus male 'holes' is fine. Item 20: 'Cichlid besar boleh mudah dijangkiti' is ungrammatical; use 'mudah dijangkiti'.
Item 10/2: 'Isi padu: ~540 liter' correct; item 2 'Penjagaan: Lanjutan' for 'Advanced' should be 'Mahir/Pakar'.
Item 13: "kawin betina" for "female catkins" is not a proper term; use "katkin betina".
Item 28: "'berkurangan'" for the suborbital bone 'reduced' reads awkwardly; "mengecil" or "terkurang" would be clearer.
Item 6: "tangki yang langsung kosong" is awkward; use "tangki tanpa sebarang hiasan" or "tangki yang kosong sepenuhnya".
Item 9: "secara longgar" is added to "shoaling", which the English does not say. Use plain "berkawan/berkelompok (shoaling)".

Item 4: '80 × 30 cm ... (kira-kira 72 liter)' – the tank volume figure was kept from the source and not checked or adjusted to the local tank size; the number is unclear without a tank height, so give a sensible rounded size or verify it.
Item 12: the reference list is left untranslated, which is allowed, so nothing to fix there.
Item 10: 'Pengeram mulut oleh ikan jantan' is awkward; use 'Ikan jantan mengeram telur dalam mulut'.
Item 7: 'Betta spp. nampaknya sangat mudah menjadi obes' is stiff; use 'cenderung menjadi terlalu gemuk'.
Item 8: 'Sesetengah ikan cyprinid dan loach kecil ... sesuai' is ambiguous; clarify with 'sesuai dijadikan kawan tangki'.
Item 5: 'diset untuk mengedarkan air secara perlahan' is a loose rendering of 'set to turn over gently'; use 'dilaraskan supaya aliran perlahan'.
Item 2: 'Lokaliti taipnya' is jargon; use 'Lokaliti tipe'.
Item 4: '(kira-kira 72 liter)' – 80 × 30 cm tank volume is not given in the English as a conversion issue, but 'about 72 litres' is unchanged; fine. Real issue: none here.

Item 1/8: 'bukan antara ahli genus yang lebih agresif' is stiff; use 'bukan antara spesies yang lebih agresif dalam genus ini'.
Item 3: 'Dasarnya' for substrate is ambiguous; use 'Substratnya'. 'tumbuhan tebing yang menjulur' ok.

Item 10: 'mengurat' for courtship is wrong register; use 'pemikatan/pacaran'. 'dikutip ke dalam mulut' is fine.

Item 13: the English heater rule '5 watts of power per gallon' is converted to '1.3 watt per litre'. The conversion is fine, but 'pemanas akuarium patut dilaburkan' is awkward. Use 'sebaiknya dapatkan pemanas akuarium'.
Item 3: 'patut tidak digalakkan' is ungrammatical. Use 'patut dihalang' or 'tidak wajar digalakkan'.
Item 14: 'makan flake' and 'Glassworm' are left in English. Use 'serpihan (flake)' and 'cacing kaca (glassworm)'.

Item 20: 'Ikan jantan akan membelit badannya pada ikan betina, yang sudah terbalik' is awkward. Use 'membelit badan betina yang telah terbalik'.

Item 21: 'Tumbuhan terapung mungkin digabungkan ke dalam sarang jika ada' is unnatural. Use 'Tumbuhan terapung boleh dimasukkan ke dalam sarang jika ada'. 'Proses ini diulang sehingga telur betina habis' is acceptable.
Item 1: 'perlu boleh sampai ke permukaan air' is awkward. Use 'perlu dapat naik ke permukaan air'.
Item 1: the Fahrenheit figure is dropped, which is fine. 'ikan laga' for Betta is fine.
Item 6: 'lapisan daun reput' is acceptable but adds 'reput'; the source says only 'leaf litter'. Use 'daun kering yang gugur'.
Item 23: 'persekitaran yang lebih teruk' for 'harsher environments' is vague. Use 'persekitaran yang lebih mencabar'. 'Nama biasanya' is ambiguous; use 'Nama lazimnya'.

Item 30: "pemotongan perkembangan" is too literal for "developmental truncation". Use "pemendekan perkembangan" or give the English term in brackets. This also keeps it consistent with 'developmentally truncated' earlier in the same item.

Item 12: "mungkin sukar berenang jika arusnya deras" adds "berenang" (swim). The English only says the fish "may struggle". Use "mungkin bergelut/tidak selesa".
Item 22: "ikan pembersih/loricariid kecil" is awkward. Use "loricariid kecil seperti Otocinclus".
Item 12: "Tambahan sampah daun kering lagi menonjolkan" is clumsy. Use "Penambahan daun kering lebih menonjolkan suasana semula jadi".
Item 10: 'about 41 litres' for 45 × 30 cm is unchanged from the source, but the tank height is not given. Check the figure, since it cannot be verified.

Item 13: in 'GH 1–10 °d, KH 0–3 °d' the '°d' is fine. However, 'Air lembut dan berasid lebih digemari untuk kesihatan dan warna jangka panjang' is ambiguous. Rephrase it as 'lebih sesuai untuk kesihatan dan warna dalam jangka panjang'.

Item 1: 'jantan dewasa mempunyai badan merah tua' renders 'crimson-red' as dark red. Use 'merah delima/merah terang'. Also, 'Ikan ini aman... jadi Chili Rasbora sesuai' adds a causal 'jadi' that the source does not have.
Item 7: 'air yang mengalir perlahan dan sangat teduh' puts the shade on the water. Say 'kawasan air yang mengalir perlahan dan sangat teduh'.

Item 12: 'mungkin bergelut jika arusnya deras' is awkward. Also 'kerana kebanyakannya berasal dari air...' lacks a clear subject, so say 'kerana ikan ini kebanyakannya berasal dari perairan yang tenang'.
Item 20: 'Ia tidak memilih' is incomplete. Use 'Ia tidak cerewet makan'.

Item 25: 'Jantan biasanya lebih menarik' is correct but flat. Consider 'lebih menawan'.
Item 15: the source's 'pH 6.0–8.0' sits outside the 4.0–7.0 range given elsewhere. That inconsistency is in the source, so keep the numbers, but check the stated pH range.

Item 39: 'Tetraodon' is described as 'Greek' and 'Carino' as 'Latin'. This is fine. 'jalur gelap yang lebar dari sirip atas hingga sirip bawah' is slightly awkward. Use 'sirip dorsal hingga sirip ventral'.

Item 6: "kedai haiwan peliharaan berangkai" is awkward. Use "rangkaian kedai haiwan peliharaan". "Spesies unik" for "oddball species" loses the sense; use "spesies yang agak pelik/luar biasa".

Item 1: 'ikan yang hidup berkumpulan' is fine, but 'hierarki sosial' is acceptable. Item 7: 'tangki yang dihias lengkap' is fine. However, 'Penambahan daun kering akan lagi menonjolkan' is awkward. Use 'akan menambah lagi'.
Item 13: 'Ikan ini membiak secara bebas' for 'free spawner' is imprecise, and 'dikondisikan' is a non-standard borrowing. Use 'didedahkan kepada keadaan pembiakan' or 'dimatangkan'.

"yang ada di mana-mana" for "ubiquitous" is a little stiff. Consider "yang begitu lazim" or "yang sangat meluas dalam hobi".

Item 7: '5 to 10-gallon' converted to '19–38 liter' is fine, but item 8: 'unheated' etc fine. Real issue in item 9: none.
Item 10: English gives 70–83°F (21–28°C); fine. No issue.
Item 17: 'Persenyawaan biasanya berlaku' - 'Spawning' means pemijahan/bertelur; 'persenyawaan' (fertilisation) changes meaning.
Item 17: 'milt' left untranslated; use 'sperma/air mani ikan (milt)'.
Item 17: 'sehingga telur ikan betina habis' ok, but 'dibiarkan di dalam tangki' for 'in situ' is fine; 'Tukar air patut dibuat' awkward - use 'Pertukaran air hendaklah sedikit dan kerap'.
Item 17: 'nauplii artemia' and 'microworm' left in English; add 'cacing mikro' and use 'nauplius artemia'.

Item 4: 'Sangat meluas dan tersebar secara meluas' is redundant; rephrase.

#1 "Kebanyakannya aktif pada waktu malam" is acceptable, but "Saiz: 5 cm SL" leaves SL unexplained; consider "5 cm (panjang piawai, SL)".
#4 "dH" is fine, but consider "dGH" for consistency with hobby usage.

#9: "memberi kelainan" for "add contrast" is slightly vague; "memberi kontras visual" would be clearer
Item 13: 'memakan telur atau anaknya' adds 'or its young'. The English says only 'eat their brood', so keep it to 'memakan anak/telur' without implying a separate fact.
Item 14: 'diatribusikan kepada Jens Meulengracht-Madsen' is awkward calque. Use 'dikreditkan kepada' or 'dikaitkan dengan'.
Item 14: 'Isbrücker (2011) ... bahawa Microgeophagus sensu Frey (1957) sebenarnya nama tersedia' is missing the copula 'ialah'.
Item 8: 'tangki' in 'hiasan tangki' is mixed with 'akuarium' used elsewhere. Use 'hiasan akuarium' consistently.
Item 4: "ikan ini haiwan yang tahan lasak" is awkward; use "ikan ini sangat tahan lasak" or "ialah haiwan yang tahan lasak".
Item 4: "g garam/liter" mixes the unit styles; use "g garam/L" or "g garam seliter".
Item 7: "sebarang keagresifan teragih dalam kumpulan" is clumsy; use "supaya keagresifan terbahagi/tersebar dalam kumpulan".
Item 7: "incompatible with conspecifics" is rendered as "agresif". This slightly changes the meaning; "tidak serasi dengan sesama spesies" is closer.
Item 6: "ia disarankan diberi makan" is stiff and passive; use "disarankan memberi makan beberapa kali sehari dalam bahagian kecil".
Item 1: "Ikan mono" is fine, but "magnificent" is rendered as plain "cantik"; "menawan" would be closer.

Item 4: "mulai 10–15 g garam/liter" renders "from 10-15 g" oddly; "mulai" implies a start point but a range is given. Use "pada kira-kira 10–15 g garam seliter" or "dari 10–15 g garam/liter" to match the original.
Item 4: "sangat tahan lasak" adds emphasis. The English says only "robust", so use "tahan lasak".
Item 4: "sebaiknya ikan ini dipelihara untuk sementara waktu sahaja" is acceptable, but "if possible" is lost. Use "jika boleh, ... hanya buat sementara".
Item 7: "keagresifan dapat tersebar" is awkward. Use "supaya sebarang keagresifan terbahagi/teragih dalam kumpulan".
Item 7: "ikan sejenisnya" for conspecifics is acceptable, but "sangat tidak serasi" is stiff. Use "agresif terhadap sesama spesies".
Item 1: "Ikan mono" is a local name for Monodactylus, but "magnificent" is rendered as "sangat cantik", which is acceptable. Consider adding "(moonies)" in brackets on first use.
Item 3: "sangat suka berenang" is acceptable, but "eager to swim" is better as "sangat aktif berenang".
Item 8: "dari luaran" is awkward. Use "secara luaran" or "daripada rupa luaran".
Item 5: "Kulit lusuh atau kulit yang ditanggalkan udang" is wordy/awkward for "shrimp molt"; use simply "kulit yang ditanggalkan (molt)".
Item 6: "Batu karang hancur" for crushed coral is a bit unnatural; hobbyists usually write "karang hancur" or "crushed coral" only.
Item 8: "Easy Fry and Small Fish Food" is left in English inside Malay sentence with "and"; fine as a product name but the list reads awkwardly; consider quoting it as a product name.
Item 11: "berried" and "culling" used unexplained in Malay; add a short gloss e.g. "bertelur (berried)", and use "singkirkan" consistently.
Item 11: "berenang ke sana ke mari dengan bersemangat" is slightly soft for "in a frenzy"; "dengan kalut/ghairah" is closer.
Item 1: "tahan dengan julat parameter air" is slightly awkward; "boleh menerima/menyesuaikan diri dengan pelbagai parameter air" is more natural. "liter" vs Malaysian "liter" is fine.
Item 9: "ikan otocinclus" and "udang kerdil" are acceptable but "udang cherry" vs "cherry shrimp" is used inconsistently across items; pick one.

Item 8: "Easy Fry and Small Fish Food" is left in English with "and". It is a product name, so keep it as is, but make sure the list reads naturally. Write "Hikari First Bites, Easy Fry and Small Fish Food, serta Bacter AE".

Item 5: "Kulit salinan udang" is odd for "shrimp molt". Use "Kulit lusuh/kulit yang ditanggalkan udang". Also "bersalin kulit" is used, but the common hobby term is "menyalin kulit" or "pelepasan kulit". "Bersalin" suggests giving birth, which can confuse readers.
Item 6 and Item 11: "bersalin kulit" and "kegagalan bersalin kulit" should be "menyalin kulit" (molting). Also "sudah bersalin kulit" in item 11 reads like giving birth.
Item 11: "rakus" for "in a frenzy" is too strong. Use "bersemangat" or "liar".
Item 11: "cull" is rendered as "buat culling dengan mengasingkan". The English means removing the less colourful shrimp, so use "singkirkan" or "buang" with "culling" in brackets.

Item 2: "rili (berjalur)" and "green jade" are left as English colour names. Acceptable as trade names, but "warna perang bertompok" in item 3 should be "coklat berbintik" ("perang" is not the usual term for brown; Malaysian Malay uses "coklat" or "perang" for hair). Use "coklat" for the fish colour.
Item 3: "yang menyamar dengan baik dengan persekitarannya" has a doubled "dengan". Use "yang sebati dengan persekitarannya".
"Pengawanan" (spawning): hobbyists in Malaysia usually say "pemijahan" for fish spawning. "Mengawan" for mating is fine.
"tumbuhan terapung di permukaan" for "surface vegetation": this is slightly narrower than the original. Consider "tumbuhan permukaan" or "tumbuhan yang tumbuh hingga ke permukaan".

#6: '(about 41 litres)' was rendered as 'kira-kira 40 liter'. 45×30 cm is a base footprint, not a tank size from the table, so the converted figure should stay at 41 litres. Also use the 'liter' spelling consistently: 'litre' is the form used elsewhere in Malaysia.
#7: 'aquascape' is left as untranslated English with no Malay term. Use 'akuarium bertema habitat semula jadi' or 'susun atur'.
#7: 'daun kering' for 'leaf litter' is acceptable but 'serasah daun' is more precise. 'terhakis air' for 'water-worn' is odd; use 'licin dihakis air' or 'kayu hanyut'.
#8: 'tidak membesar dengan baik' for 'fail to thrive' understates it. Use 'tidak subur/tidak sihat'.
#9: 'flake dan granul' are English words left in place; use 'serpihan' and 'butiran', or put the English in brackets after the Malay.
#14: 'tangki' is used alongside 'akuarium'. Use one term consistently, preferably 'akuarium'.
#16: 'order', 'famili' and 'klad' are used for taxonomic ranks, and 'monotipik' and 'parafiletik' are loanwords. Use 'order/bangsa' consistently or gloss them.
#3: 'Oryzias liar' reads awkwardly; use 'Oryzias liar' with 'ikan' or 'spesies Oryzias liar'.

Item 6: '45 × 30 cm ... (about 41 litres)' – the tank volume is left as an exact figure; per the tank table use a local rounded size or revise, and 'liter' is non-standard (use 'liter'/'L' consistently; 'liter' is acceptable but 'L' preferred).
Item 7: 'tangki' used for 'set-up' while elsewhere 'akuarium'; 'tambahan garam laut' should be 'penambahan garam laut' (or 'tambahkan garam laut').
Item 7: 'Cuba ketahui asal usul ikan anda ... sesetengah populasi paling sesuai di air tawar' – 'do best in freshwater' reads awkwardly; use 'paling sesuai dipelihara dalam air tawar'.
Item 8: 'tidak akan sihat' is a weak rendering of 'fail to thrive'; use 'tidak membesar dengan baik'.
Item 10: 'mengurat' is colloquial/inappropriate for fish courting; use 'semasa memikat betina'.
Item 14: 'spawning mop' left in English with no Malay gloss; and 'prolifik' is awkward – use 'subur membiak'.

Item 16: 'Selain itu' and leaving 'toothcarp', 'ricefish' untranslated; consider 'ikan padi' consistently (item 1 uses ikan padi).
Item 3: "a few dollars" became "beberapa ringgit". This changes the currency, and a few US dollars is not a few ringgit. Use "beberapa dolar" or leave out the price.
Item 1: "line bred" was rendered as "pembiakan selektif". "Pembiakan baka/stren" (line breeding) is closer.

Item 13: "tangki 40 liter atau kolam khas untuk spesies ini sahaja" is slightly ambiguous, since "khas" could be read as applying only to the pond. Say "tangki 40 liter atau kolam untuk spesies ini sahaja".

Item 3: "telur tersebut menetas di sana" is fine, but item 1 omits "(1.4 in)" correctly; no issue there. Real issue in item 22: "Setakat ini, ia haram dibeli..." – 'ia' is ambiguous after discussing the glowing form; use "bentuk bercahaya ini haram...".

Item 22: "mutate a fish that would literally glow" -> "memutasikan ikan yang benar-benar bercahaya sehingga gen tertentu..." loses the purpose; better "menghasilkan mutasi pada ikan supaya ia bercahaya sehingga...".

Item 22: "Rosen dan Parenti telah mengklasifikasikan semula kumpulan ini dalam Beloniformes, kumpulan saudara cyprinodontiform" – original calls Cyprinodontiformes an order, but translation says 'famili Cyprinodontiformes'; should be 'order/bangsa' (Cyprinodontiformes is an order) – copied source error, but 'ahli famili Cyprinodontiformes' is misleading.
Item 6: "tasik ladam" for oxbows is fine, but "Biasanya ditemui di perairan pesisir pantai" ok. Item 7: "sering bergerak antara anak sungai dan laut untuk tujuan selain pembiakan" is acceptable.

Item 8: "41 liter" is a different rounding from source 'about 41 litres' – fine. Use Malaysian spelling "liter"/"liter" consistently; "tangki" vs "akuarium" mixed – prefer "akuarium" or "tangki" consistently.
Item 2: "dalam kurungan" for 'in captivity' is stiff; use "dalam pemeliharaan/akuarium".
Item 14: "sejuk beku" for frozen – use "beku"; "kutu air (Daphnia)" is acceptable but Malaysian hobbyists say "kutu air" for Moina/Daphnia, fine.
Item 17: "keladi bunting" for water hyacinth is wrong; water hyacinth is "keladi bunting" (Eichhornia) – OK, but "kiambang kecil" for dwarf water lettuce is fine; no change needed.
Item 1: "Kekerasan air (GH): 5–25 dGH" – label 'Hardness' changed to add GH; minor, use "Kekerasan: 5–25 dGH".

Item 8: '45 × 30 cm ... (kira-kira 41 liter)' – 41 litres kept as is, acceptable; but 'liter' is Indonesian spelling, use 'liter/liter' consistently as 'liter' is accepted in Malaysia; prefer 'L' or 'liter' fine.

Item 21: 'kiambang kecil (dwarf water lettuce)' and 'keladi bunting' for water hyacinth: 'keladi bunting' is the local name for Eichhornia, OK, but 'kiambang' is Salvinia; check dwarf water lettuce (Pistia) is 'kiambang' - acceptable. 'tukar air yang kerap' is awkward: use 'penukaran air yang kerap'.

Item 12/11: 'tahan suhu' should be 'tahan pada suhu' or 'bertoleransi terhadap suhu'.
Item 16: 'kelihatan paling menarik' for 'look most effective' acceptable.

Item 11: "a few feet in length" was rendered as "60–90 cm". A few feet is about 90 cm or more, and item 1 says the fish easily tops 90 cm. This understates the adult size. Use something like "beberapa kaki (sekitar 90 cm atau lebih)" or "lebih 90 cm".
Item 10: "akhir musim bunga dan bulan-bulan musim panas" is literal and sounds odd for Malaysian readers. Consider "akhir musim bunga dan musim panas" (or "hujung musim bunga hingga musim panas").
