Item 5: "melompat keluar dari permukaan air" changes "breaches the surface". It implies jumping out of the tank, but the source says the fish breaks the surface. Suggested: "menerjah/melompat ke permukaan air", which also explains why a heavy cover is needed.
Item 6: "(GH)" is added after "kekerasan air", which is not in the source. The unit "°H" is also inconsistent with the GH/dGH wording; use "dGH" or "°dH" consistently.

Item 4: "liter" could be "liter" or "litre"; keep it consistent with the other items. "mana-mana tangki kecuali yang sangat besar" is slightly awkward; "hanya sesuai untuk tangki yang sangat besar" is more natural.
Item 7: "sejauh barat Colombia di sebelah barat" is redundant and awkward. Write "sejauh Colombia barat" or "hingga ke barat Colombia".
Item 13: '20 gallons (about 75 litres)' – 20 US gallons is about 75 L, so this is fine; no fix needed. Real issues are below.
Item 5: 'neon tetra ... half red stripe that starts in the middle of the body' is fine, but 'citarasa' should be 'cita rasa'.
Item 8: 'an annual fish ... hidup hanya kira-kira setahun' – 'kira-kira' is added; the source says it is usually an annual fish. Minor.
Item 10: 'They live in shoals ... feed on worms and small crustaceans' is rendered correctly, but 'hidup berkawan' is awkward; use 'hidup dalam kawanan'.
Item 16: pH range '3.5–7.5' is kept, but the Fahrenheit conversion was dropped as instructed, so it is fine. 'ikan tangkapan liar' is okay.
Item 24: 'Dwarf gourami' and 'Danio' are fine, but 'setengah dozen' should be 'setengah dozen' or 'sekurang-kurangnya enam ekor' for clarity.
Item 25: 'betta fish' translated as 'ikan laga' is fine; 'Gunakan cardinal tetra yang sudah dewasa ... supaya ia tidak dijadikan makanan' is acceptable.
Item 29: 'gH 1-5' is kept as written; 'Dari segi hasil, lebih baik dibiakkan secara berpasangan' is acceptable.
Item 32: 'gill raker pada lengan bawah insang' and 'ventral-limb gill rakers' are literal; use 'tulang tapis insang (gill raker) pada lengan insang bawah'. 'P. inessi' typo is from the source.
Item 32: 'di kawasan tengah Negro' is awkward; use 'di kawasan tengah rio Negro'. 'ikan hiasan' is fine.
Item 20: 'temperature of around 26.5–29 °C (80–84 °F)' was translated as '27–29 °C'. The lower bound 26.5 was changed to 27, which is a changed number. Use 26.5–29 °C.
Item 5: 'sejauh barat Colombia di sebelah barat' is redundant and garbled. The source says 'as far west as western Colombia'. Rephrase, e.g. 'hingga ke barat Colombia'.
Item 5: 'Rio Negro di Sungai Amazon' is wrong. The Rio Negro is a tributary of the Amazon. Write 'anak sungai Rio Negro bagi Sungai Amazon'.
Item 4: 'tidak pernah direkodkan dari lembangan tersebut' is acceptable, but the source locality quote is untranslated English. Leave it as a quoted locality if intended; otherwise add a gloss.

Item 20: 'Ikan sepatutnya bertelur pada waktu malam ... memperlihatkan corak warna waktu malamnya' is fine. However, 'Jika tiada telur selepas beberapa hari' changes 'a couple of days', so use 'dua hari'.
Item 6: 'Panqolus maccus' is kept as in the source. 'hampir sebagai ikan tahunan' is awkward. Use 'hampir sebagai ikan setahun (annual)'.
Item 15: 'flake' is left in English. Use 'makanan serpihan (flake)'.
Item 19: 'cangkuk' for the anal-fin hook is acceptable. 'Jantan juga mempunyai cangkuk yang menonjol pada sirip dubur' is fine.
Item 14: 'larva chironomid hidup dan sejuk beku' is ambiguous. 'jentik-jentik' for mosquito larvae is fine, but 'kutu air' for Daphnia is the correct hobby term, so keep it.
Item 11: pH 3.5–7.5 is unchanged. The header 'Kekerasan air (GH)' adds 'GH', which is harmless.
Item 8: "very vigorous" is translated as "terlalu aktif". This is slightly off, because "vigorous" here means boisterous or robust. "Lasak" or "agresif" would be more accurate.
Item 10: "intensifying in the colour" is translated as "menjadi lebih terang". "Lebih pekat" or "lebih garang" would be closer, since the colour deepens rather than brightens.

Item 10: "Beri ikan dewasa makanan yang baik ... untuk menyediakan mereka membiak, dan biasanya ikan akan bertelur" – 'Condition' is rendered awkwardly. Rephrase, e.g. "Kondisikan ikan dewasa dengan diet berkualiti ... dan pembiakan biasanya berlaku".

Item 10: "ikan keli" for catfish bottom dwellers is misleading, because it suggests the food fish keli (Clarias). Use "ikan hampulang/ikan kucing" or "catfish" in the aquarium sense, e.g. "ikan catfish dasar".

Item 10: "Jika air terlalu beralkali ... kebanyakan anak cenderung menjadi jantan" – the source says 'too acidic and the opposite is true', so females dominate. The Malay is fine, but "sebaliknya" should be made clear as 'kebanyakan betina'.

Item 10: "Pada masa ini pasangan itu perlu diperhatikan ... ada betina yang boleh menyerang" is fine. However, "Anak ikan patut dibiarkan bersama induknya sehingga ... jika tidak" adds the nuance "jika tidak" and loosens the original structure. Make it explicit: 'leave until signs of next spawn, otherwise the male may turn aggressive'.
Item 11: "Kebanyakan besar Kribensis" is ungrammatical. Use "Sebahagian besar Kribensis" or "Majoriti Kribensis".
Item 11: "bentuk albino yang muncul dalam akuarium" is a loose rendering of 'aquarium sport albino form'. Use "mutasi albino (sport)".

Item 4: The source gives 24" x 15" x 12", which converts to about 61 x 38 x 30 cm. 60 x 37.5 x 30 cm is the source's own metric figure, so it is fine. However, "Tangki ... sesuai" drops the 'single pair' nuance, which should be "sepasang ikan sahaja".
Item 16: "well-researched community aquarium" is rendered as "dirancang dengan teliti" (carefully planned). Use "yang dikaji dengan baik" or "yang dirancang berdasarkan kajian". This is minor.
Item 4/5: "feral" is left as "populasi feral". Item 3 gives a gloss, but "populasi liar yang terlepas" would read more naturally.
Item 21: "pasangan Afrika kepada tetra Amerika Selatan" – "pasangan" reads as a mated couple; use "setara" or "padanan Afrika" for "counterpart".
Item 21: "pertunjukan mengurat" is too colloquial for courtship displays; use "pertunjukan percumbuan" or "gelagat mengawan".
Item 17: "sirip yang lebih menarik" and "sirip yang menarik" are vague for "elaborate fins"; use "sirip yang lebih rumit/berhias".
Item 1: "Warnanya akan timbul" is a bit awkward; "warnanya semakin terserlah" is more natural.
"Sebenarnya, hiasan tidak diperlukan": "Strictly speaking" is better as "Secara tegasnya" or "Secara teknikalnya". "Sebenarnya" on its own is slightly off.
"lancefish" is left in English. Use a Malay name or add a short gloss.
"hutan yang dinaiki air" is a bit stiff. "hutan banjir" or "hutan yang dibanjiri air" is more natural.
Item 9 and item 12: "membiak subur" for "thrive" suggests breeding. Use "tumbuh subur" or "hidup subur".
Item 6: "saluran air panas" for "warm waterways" reads as hot water. Use "saluran air yang hangat" or "suam".
Item 20: "mudah dibawa berbincang" for "easygoing" is an awkward idiom. Use "mudah bergaul" or "tenang".
Item 1: "dibiakkan dalam kurungan" is stiff for "captive-bred". Use "hasil pembiakan tangkaran" or "dibiakkan di akuarium".
Item 26: "jantan boleh menjadi agak agresif" for "quite vigorous" slightly changes the meaning. Use "agak aktif/bertenaga".
Item 5: "saliran air panas" means hot water. Use "saliran air yang hangat" for "warm waterways".
Item 11: "tangki bertumbuhan dengan tumbuhan terapung" is clumsy. Use "tangki bertanaman dengan tumbuhan terapung".
Item 23: "mengeluarkan ikan dewasa" can be read as removing the adults, while the English "remove them" is ambiguous. Make clear whether the fry or the adults are removed.

Item 3: "Isi padu: ~81 liter" ialah nilai asal yang tidak ditukar atau dibundarkan dengan betul; 90×30×30 cm ≈ 81 L, jadi ini hampir sama, tetapi "liter" lebih baik ditulis "liter/L" secara konsisten. Item 3: "80 mm SL" tidak menyatakan "panjang piawai" dengan jelas (SL tidak diterangkan).
Item 1: "Taburan asalnya bermula dari Venezuela dan Colombia dan menganjur ke utara hingga Mexico" agak kekok; lebih baik "Taburan asalnya dari Venezuela dan Colombia hingga ke utara Mexico".
Item 9: "supaya gangguan ini tidak tertumpu pada seekor betina sahaja" ialah tambahan/tafsiran; "dissipate" cuma bermaksud mengurangkan gangguan. Tulis "untuk mengurangkan gangguan ini".

Item 9: "breeding nets or traps" diterjemah "jaring atau kotak pembiakan (breeding box)"; "traps" menjadi "kotak" dan istilah Inggeris berubah. Gunakan "jaring atau perangkap pembiakan (breeding trap)".
Item 1/10: "hard and alkaline" diterjemah "tidak keras dan tidak beralkali" boleh diterima, tetapi "lebih sihat" bagi "do better" boleh jadi "lebih baik keadaannya".
Item 4: "shimmying" diterjemah "badan bergoyang-goyang di tempat" - boleh diterima, tetapi "dijangkiti kulat" bagi "fungus" lebih baik "kulat (fungus)".

Items 2 and 3: "during display" is translated as "semasa mempamerkan diri untuk memikat betina" – "to attract females" is an added fact not in the English; remove it (e.g. "semasa mempamerkan diri" / "semasa pertunjukan").
Item 3: "step up their colours" rendered as "meningkatkan kecerahan warnanya" – brightness narrows the meaning; use "menceriakan/mempertingkat warnanya".
Item 3: "Warnanya sememangnya sudah cemerlang walaupun tanpa itu" is awkward; use "Warnanya memang sudah cemerlang".
Item 3: "first sent from a breeder in Thailand" – keep; but "strain tulen" in item 1 should be "baka/galur tulen" for natural Malay.

Item 3: "first sent from a breeder in Thailand" is rendered as "yang pertama kali dihantar oleh seorang penternak di Thailand", which is fine. The real problem is that "Endler" is used alone throughout (items 2 and 3) where the English has "Endler's Guppy". Use "Guppy Endler" or "Endler's Guppy" so readers know it is a guppy.
Item 3: "Walau bagaimanapun, warnanya memang sudah terang" mistranslates "The colours are brilliant anyway". Use something like "Warnanya sememangnya sudah cemerlang walaupun tanpa itu".
Items 2 and 3: "menayangkan diri" is an unnatural rendering of "during display". Use "semasa mempamerkan diri/ketika berlagak (courtship display)", or "semasa ghairah/memikat betina".

Item 3: "Warna ikan ini berbeza-beza" followed by "warnanya yang boleh menjadi lebih terang" in the list of features. "The ability to step up their colours" should read "keupayaan meningkatkan kecerahan warnanya", for parallel structure.
Item 1: "strain tulen" is acceptable. "Populasi yang pada asalnya dikumpulkan" is fine, so no change is needed.

Item 7: the English gives about 41 litres and the Malay keeps it, but it says 'kira-kira 41 liter'. Per the unit rules 41 L should be rounded, e.g. 'kira-kira 40 liter'. Also use the Malaysian spelling 'liter' consistently, and 'liter' is fine.
Item 14: 'Jangan pelihara bersama guppy kerana kedua-duanya akan berkacuk' is fine. However 'buli tidak tertumpu pada seekor betina' is wordy, so rephrase it as 'supaya gangguan terbahagi'.

Item 20: the English says 'Parents eat their own young'. The Malay 'Induk akan memakan anaknya sendiri' is correct. But item 19 says adults 'rarely' eat young. This conflict is in the source, so no fix is needed.
Item 11: 'boleh mudah dijangkiti' is awkward. Use 'mudah dijangkiti' instead.
Item 2: 'Endler berkait rapat' is OK. 'memiliki warna serta corak yang terang' for 'vibrant' is fine.

Item 16 and 22: the English 'step up their colours' is rendered correctly. The sentence 'Bagaimanapun, warnanya memang cemerlang' wrongly adds a contrast. The English is 'The colours are brilliant anyway', so use 'Walau bagaimanapun/pada dasarnya warnanya memang cemerlang'.
Item 9: 'Ini ikan air sederhana keras' is awkward. Use 'Ikan ini sesuai untuk air sederhana keras'.
Item 13: 'daphnia' is translated as 'kutu air'. Hobbyists in Malaysia usually say 'daphnia' or 'kutu air'. Add '(daphnia)' for clarity.

Item 20: "Parents eat their own young" is rendered as "Induk akan memakan anaknya sendiri". This is correct, but it contradicts item 19, so check the consistency of the source rather than the Malay. No fix is needed here.
Item 14: "supaya kemungkinan buli tersebar" is awkward and unclear. Use "supaya gangguan/buli dapat disebarkan merata" or "supaya buli tidak tertumpu pada seekor betina".
Item 6: "sangat panas, keras" is a clumsy rendering of "very warm, hard water". Use "sangat suam dan keras", because "panas" suggests scalding.

Item 3: the English "Pure-bred Endlers are called class N Endlers; care for hybrids is somewhat similar" has been split into two sentences and slightly reworded. The meaning is intact, so this is fine.
Item 16: "Endler's Guppy ialah ikan yang lincah" is plural in the English ("Endler's Guppys are lively fish"). Use "Endler's Guppy ialah ikan-ikan yang lincah" or rephrase it as a generic statement.
Item 21: "tahap kekerasan" and "dihuraikan dari Trinidad" are acceptable. However, "guppy biasanya ditemui di air mengalir yang lebih sejuk" is fine, so no change is needed.

Item 15: "ikan komuniti yang aman dan terlalu besar untuk memakannya" is ambiguous. Use "terlalu besar untuk dimakan oleh Endler"; the current wording could be read as the community fish being too big for the Endler to eat, which reverses the meaning. The English means the fish are too big to eat the Endlers.
Item 7: the translator dropped the imperial figure. This is allowed. The 41 L figure is kept as in the source, which is fine.
Item 10: "boleh mudah dijangkiti" is awkward; use "mudah dijangkiti" or "cenderung dijangkiti".
Item 17: "menayangkan diri kepada betina" is unnatural for courtship display; use "mempamerkan diri" or "menunjuk-nunjuk".
Items 8 and 17: "tangki bertumbuhan" and "kawasan bertumbuhan padat" are non-standard; use "tangki bertanaman" or "ditanam dengan tumbuhan akuatik" and "kawasan tumbuhan padat".
Item 17: "sangat cepat membiak" for "incredibly prolific" is acceptable but flat; "sangat subur membiak" is more natural.
Item 2: "mensenyawakan diri sendiri" for "self-fertilize" is stiff. "membuat persenyawaan sendiri" or "mengawan sendiri/hermafrodit" would read more naturally.
Item 9: "memakan kulit telur untuk keluar" renders "chew through the egg casing" a bit loosely. "mengunyah/menggigit menembusi kulit telur" is closer.

Item 16: "8 titis methylene blue bagi setiap 20 liter air" – the English gives 19 litres; the number was changed. Keep 19 L, or use a sensible conversion only if the source was in gallons (it was not).
Item 15: "(iaitu ikan generasi F1)" is an added fact not in the English. Remove it.
Item 7: "padat dengan tumbuhan akuatik dan bertutup rapi" – "well covered" means dense plant cover. "bertutup rapi" could be read as a closed lid. Use "dengan banyak tumbuhan penutup" or similar.
Item 16: "Jika telur dimakan oleh induk" – the English says spawns are eaten. Fine, but "mula gantikan" reads awkwardly. Use "mula menggantikan".
Item 17: "mudah dijangkiti penyakit lubang di kepala" – fine. "sangat lemah terhadap pengumpulan nitrat" is unnatural. Use "sangat tidak tahan terhadap pengumpulan nitrat".
Items 2, 17: "saudaranya" for relative – use "spesies sekerabat" or "kerabatnya" for natural Malay.
Item 16: "liter" and "akuarium" are fine. Use "litre" for consistency with the Malaysian standard spelling.

Item 7: "padat dengan tumbuhan akuatik dan banyak tempat berlindung" adds "banyak tempat berlindung" (many hiding places), which is not in the English ("densely planted, well covered"); remove or render "well covered" faithfully.

Item 6: the English says "height of at least 70 cm" for the tank, which the Malay keeps, but it also drops the link to the previous sentence; check that "tangki" is the term used elsewhere ("akuarium" is used in other items) and make the terms consistent.

Item 16: "19 litres" is a converted figure (5 US gallons) and should be 20 litres. Also "8 titis ... bagi setiap 19 liter" should read "20 liter" or "litre", and use "liter" consistently as "L" or "litre" elsewhere.
Item 12: "terlalu aktif" for "overly lively" is acceptable, but "Ia sama sekali tidak patut" is slightly stronger than needed; consider "Jangan sekali-kali dipelihara bersama...".
Item 14 and 17: "hole-in-the-head" is rendered as "penyakit lubang di kepala", which is fine; but item 1 "Deep Angel" is left as the English trade name, so it is OK.

Item 15: "induk generasi F2 pun masih jelas menunjukkan" misreads "the parents of an F2 generation" and is ambiguous; clarify that the parents of the F2 generation (i.e. the F1 fish) show a spawning season.
Item 9: "langsung tidak sihat" is awkward for "will not do well at all"; use "langsung tidak membiak dengan baik" or "tidak akan subur" (the same applies in items 17 and 18).
Item 5: the translation is missing, shown as "(left out)". Translate the whole paragraph on the natural range (Colombia, Guyana … Far East and Eastern Europe).
Item 10: "pelet atau flake" leaves "flake" in English. Use "pelet atau kepingan (flake)" or similar.
Item 4: the source says 'Liposarcus pardalis' but item 11 says the genus is now Pterygoplichthys. The translation keeps the source's Liposarcus, which is fine. Consider no change.
Item 3: 'Kerana itulah lebih seronok lagi' is slightly informal and loosely renders 'All the more beautiful'. Consider 'Oleh itu, lebih menarik lagi untuk memperoleh...'.
Item 11: 'tersalah dijual' is awkward for 'miss sold'. Use 'sering dijual secara salah sebagai' or 'sering tersilap dilabel sebagai'.
Item 11: 'tahun sembilan puluhan' is slightly clumsy. Use 'awal tahun 1990-an'.
Item 7: 'membesar terlalu besar' is repetitive. Use 'tumbuh terlalu besar'. 'tangki' is fine, but 'akuarium' is more common in Malaysia.
Item 10: the English term 'flake' is left in the Malay text. Use 'makanan kepingan (flake)' or similar.
Item 17: "diisi dengan air matang" – in Malay "air matang" usually means boiled water. Use "air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)" or similar.
Item 17: "Kumpulan dewasa boleh dirangsang (conditioning)" is awkward. Use "dikondisikan" or "diberi makanan penyubur" instead.
Item 13: "ikan rainbow" is acceptable, but "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)" would be clearer for readers. "Bersaiz sama" is better than "sama saiz".
Item 12: "roughage" is rendered as "makanan berserat", but daphnia and brine shrimp are not fibre sources. Keep the sense of "roughage" and check the wording.

Item 1: "Saiz dewasa: kira-kira 5 cm" is fine, but "Saiz tangki minimum: kira-kira 95 liter" is a wrong conversion. 25 gallons is about 95 L, so the rounding rule gives 95 L. However, the item 9 and 10 volumes are not consistent with it, so check them.
Item 7: "hutan hijau malar yang basah" is awkward. Use "hutan malar hijau yang lembap".
Item 7: "Hutan Kottawa ... hanya merangkumi 15–20 hektar" and "4.6% hutan lama yang tinggal" are acceptable. But "suhu air mungkin agak sejuk" is fine, so no change is needed there.

Item 7: "hanya sedikit sahaja litupan hutan negara itu yang tinggal ... menyebabkan habitat ... merosot" changes the logic of the original. The source says the habitat and water quality degraded as a result. Also, "Walau bagaimanapun" is used twice in a row, which reads clumsily.
Item 7: "2,000–3,000 mm" and "1,000 m" add comma separators. This is minor and acceptable, so no fix is needed.
Item 22: "ikan laga" for betta is fine. "ikan cory dan pleco" is acceptable.

Item 22: "mixes with ... blue-eye rainbowfish" is retained correctly. But "Dwarf shrimp seem to do okay with larger amano shrimp" is mistranslated as "Bagi udang kerdil, udang amano yang lebih besar nampaknya tidak bermasalah". The meaning is that dwarf shrimp can live with larger amano shrimp, which is an unclear rendering.
Item 29: "Dravidia" is kept in the list of new genera, which is correct. Also, "Kemudian didapati ... telah pun digunakan" is fine.
Item 30: the reference list is left untranslated as instructed, so no fix is needed.
Item 3: "Ia banyak dijual kerana ... mudah dibiakkan" is fine. But "Ikan barb selalunya mendapat nama buruk" is acceptable, so no fix is needed.
Item 1: 'kira-kira 95 liter' is wrong. 25 gallons is about 95 L, which rounds to 95 L at the nearest 5 L, so this is fine. The real issue is elsewhere.

Item 29: 'Dravidia ... diwujudkan' is fine, but the diagnosis list drops 'free uroneural present'. The 'gill rakers' clause is kept, but 'infraorbital' and the other items are fine. The omission is 'maxillary barbels absent or present', which is translated 'tiada atau ada'.
Item 29: the character list omits 'post-epiphysial fontanelle' in the P. titteya/P. bimaculatus clause. Check that all items are kept.

Item 7: 'ketinggian bawah 1000 m dari aras laut' is acceptable. 'Hutan lama' is acceptable. But 'sebahagian besar juga dimusnahkan semasa perang saudara' changes 'a significant portion' (bahagian yang ketara). Rephrase it.

Item 7: 'sebahagian besar flora dan fauna endemik' reverses the meaning. The English says the forests host a significant proportion of the country's endemic flora and fauna, not most of it. Use 'sebahagian ketara'.

Item 7: 'Namun begitu, sebahagian besar hutan ini telah ditebang' adds 'Namun begitu' where the English says 'The vast majority has been cleared'. This is fine, but 'untuk pertanian ladang' is fine too.
Item 2: 'pilihan yang memang sesuai untuk pemula' is fine, but 'cyprinid' as 'siprinid' is non-standard for hobbyists. Consider 'cyprinid' or 'ikan keluarga Cyprinidae'.
Item 22: 'ikan laga' for betta is good, but 'ikan cory dan pleco' is fine. 'Blue-eye rainbowfish' is left in English with no gloss. This is minor.
Item 14: 'Ikan liar mungkin paling sesuai di hujung bawah julat ini' is OK.
Item 29: 'tetapi lihat di bawah' and 'sub-Himalaya' are fine. Check 'pharyngeal teeth' and 'caudal vertebrae' against the original.

Item 4: '243 litres (64 US gal)' converted to 'lebih kurang 243 liter' – the conversion is not rounded as required (64 US gal ≈ 242 L; sensible rounding would be about 240 L). Rounding only, but the text should use a rounded figure.

Item 1/6/10: 'Hardness: 5–20 dGH' was changed to 'Kekerasan air (GH): 5–20 dGH'. The added '(GH)' label is not in the source and is slightly inaccurate, because dGH is the unit; use 'Kekerasan: 5–20 dGH'.

Item 7: 'mosquito larvae' translated as 'jentik-jentik' – acceptable, but 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm)' is rendered 'cacing darah' – the hobby term is fine; no fix needed except 'prawn/shrimp' reduced to 'udang' (minor).
Item 10: 'tompok di sisi badan berbentuk segi empat' – 'squarish' means roughly square ('hampir segi empat sama'); 'segi empat' is imprecise.

Item 10: 'sisik dari dubur hingga sisik antara sirip pelvis' – 'vent' should be 'liang dubur/vent'; 'dubur' alone is acceptable but the 'dentary pores' rendered as 'liang pada tulang rahang bawah' is fine.
Item 10: 'bintik bermata (ocellus)' – 'ocellated spot' is better as 'bintik berbentuk mata (ocellus)'.
Item 10: 'baris sisik pipi lazimnya 6 (4-7)' – use 'modus 6 (4–7)' if the statistical sense is to be kept.
Item 5: 'batu yang agak leper dan licin terhakis air' is awkward; use 'batu leper yang licin kerana hakisan air'.
Item 11: 'telah diterima' reads like shop talk and is awkward without a subject; rephrase neutrally, e.g. 'Spesimen ... kini telah diperoleh'.
Item 8: 'tangki komuniti yang dirancang dengan teliti' – 'well-chosen' refers to the choice of tankmates, not planning; use 'dengan rakan setangki yang dipilih dengan baik'.

Item 7: 'jentik-jentik' for 'mosquito larvae' is fine, but 'prawn/shrimp' is reduced to 'udang' (acceptable); however 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is the wrong term: Daphnia is 'kutu air' but commonly 'water flea'. Check consistency.

Item 5: 'biologically immature aquarium' is rendered as 'kitaran nitrogennya belum matang'. This is a narrowed interpretation; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologi' or 'belum dikitar sepenuhnya'.
Item 5: 'ia tidak boleh sekali-kali dimasukkan' uses 'ia' for plural fish. Reword to 'ikan ini'.
Item 10: 'bermod 6 (4-7)' is a literal rendering of 'modally' and is hard to read. Use 'lazimnya 6 (4-7)'.
Item 10: 'plat farinks', 'gigi simfisis' and 'liang dentari' are overly literal anatomical terms. Add the English term in brackets or use clearer Malay, e.g. 'plat esofagus/farinks'.
Item 10: 'lembangan' for 'drainage' is acceptable, but 'sungai Motagua' for 'ríos' is fine. 'jabatan' for 'departments' in Item 2 is odd in Malay. Use 'jabatan (wilayah)' or 'wilayah'.

Item 9: 'Bertelur di atas substrat, dan kedua-dua induk menjaga telur dan anak' adds 'anak' (fry care), which is not in the source. The source only says 'biparental'. Use 'Pembiak substrat dwi-induk (biparental)'.
Item 12: the reference list is correctly left untranslated, so no change is needed here.
Item 1: 'strain' and 'tangki' are acceptable, but 'Ikan teman setangki' is clumsy. Use 'Ikan sekolam/teman setangki'.
Item 10: "sisik dari vent hingga sisik interpelvis" leaves English "vent" in place. Use "dubur" or "lubang dubur".
Item 10: "gill-raker" (twice) is left in English. Use "sikat insang" or "gill raker (sikat insang)".
Item 10: "baris sisik pipi bermod 6 (4-7)" is stiff and hard to read. Use "biasanya 6 (4-7)" for "modally 6".
Item 2: "menganjur ke selatan" is a bit unnatural. "merentang ke selatan" is more natural.
Item 2: "jabatan Cortés dan Yoro" for Honduran departments. "jabatan" is acceptable, but "wilayah/jabatan (department)" would be clearer.

Item 9: 'yellowtail silver' became 'yellow tail silver' in Banjar Red sentence, consistent with the earlier form name, so fine; but the 'crossback' sentence says the 'cross back golden' form is named 'crossback', while English attributes this to the 'red tail golden' form (the latter form). The translation changes which colour form is meant.
Item 9: 'Kalimantan Barat dan Kalimantan Tengah... masing-masing' is fine, but 'wilayah' for 'provinces' should be 'wilayah/provinsi' consistently.

Item 7: 'dikondisikan dengan makanan berkualiti' adds detail not in the source ('properly conditioned beforehand') and 'dikondisikan' is Indonesian-style; use 'diberi makanan khas terlebih dahulu' or 'dikondisikan' with a Malay alternative such as 'disediakan'.
Item 1/2/3/5: 'pupus setempat' is stiff; 'pupus di banyak kawasan' is more natural.
Item 5: 'persediaan yang kosong sepenuhnya' is awkward; use 'tangki tanpa hiasan/substrat' for 'completely bare set-ups'.
Item 7: 'kemerosotan organ' is vague; use 'kerosakan/degenerasi organ'.
Item 9: 'warna asas merah-oren yang sangat terang' adds 'terang' (bright); the English says 'strongly red-orange'. Use 'sangat pekat' or 'kuat'.
Item 5: 'sepasang ikan dewasa untuk dibiakkan' is awkward. Use 'sepasang ikan dewasa pembiak'.
Item 9: 'untuk ciri-ciri ini' is vague. Use 'bagi ciri-ciri tersebut'.
Item 9: 'Berdiri di depan akuarium yang berisi ikan yang megah ini' is stiff. Use 'Berdiri di hadapan akuarium yang menempatkan ikan-ikan yang indah ini'.
#4: "tangki sekurang-kurangnya 300 liter" switches from "akuarium" to "tangki"; use "akuarium" consistently and smooth the phrasing.
#5: "kekerasan air (GH)" is a small clarifying addition not in the English; it is harmless but could be dropped.
Item 7: "Ikan dalam kurungan" for "captive specimens" is awkward. Use "ikan yang dipelihara dalam akuarium" or "ikan tangkapan/ternakan".
Item 11: "sirip ekor berbentuk rata hingga bulan sabit" is a loose rendering of "truncate to lunate". "Terpangkas hingga sabit" is clearer.

Item 10: 'Tangki 60 cm x 30 cm x 30 cm (56 liter)' – 60x30x30 is 54 L and the original '56 litre' is kept; fine. However, item 11 '10-gallon (40-litre)' and '20–30 gallons (80–120 litres)' were kept as the source gave them; OK.
Item 14: 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is fine, but 'Jauhkan ikan ini daripada crayfish' leaves 'crayfish' untranslated; use 'udang karang (crayfish)'.
Item 21: 'Harlequin Trigonostigma heteromorpha' leaves the English common name without a Malay hobby form; use 'rasbora harlequin'.

Item 27: 'segenggam dua serat gambut' and 'plastik pembalut makanan' are acceptable; but 'Jantan langsung tidak dapat menerima kehadiran pasangannya lagi' is awkward; use 'Jantan tidak lagi bertoleransi terhadap pasangannya'.
Item 27: 'ia akan bertelur bila-bila masa ia mahu' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'ia akan bertelur dengan sendirinya'.
Item 20: 'Kutu air' for daphnia is non-standard hobby usage; Malaysian hobbyists say 'kutu air' for daphnia commonly, but also use 'daphnia'; consider adding the term.

Item 14: 'kitaran nitrogen akuarium' in item 4 is OK, but item 14 'dalam kebanyakan besar kes' is wrong; use 'dalam sebahagian besar kes'.

Item 27: 'ditandai dengan sarang yang mula berpecah' fine, but 'jantan akan menjadi sangat lemah dan kaku' adds 'kaku' (stiff), which is not in the source ('very limp').

Item 30: 'dwarf gourami yang dieksport dari Singapura' – source says 'coming out of Singapore'; 'dieksport' adds a fact (export). Use 'yang datang dari Singapura'.

Item 14: 'ikan laga' for bettas fine; 'Endler' alone for 'Endler's livebearers' drops 'livebearer'; use 'Endler livebearer'.

Item 12: 'Cuba kurangkan arus seboleh-bolehnya' fine; but 'ikan ternakan tangki' should be 'ikan hasil ternakan tangki' (minor).

Item 9: "Susunan tangki bertumbuhan" reads unnaturally. Use "Tangki bertanaman" or "Susunan tangki yang ditanam tumbuhan".
Item 20: "tingkah laku mengurat" is too colloquial. Use "tingkah laku memikat" or "tingkah laku pemikatan".

Items 1, 8: "sangat garang" for "spiteful" is acceptable but loses the sense of malice. "berdendam/jahat" or "nakal dan agresif" is closer.
Item 10: "flake yang dihancurkan menjadi serbuk" is wordy. "serpihan (flake) yang dihancurkan" would read better.

Item 7: 'Minimum tank size: 10 gallons (about 38 litres)' is a plausible conversion, but 10 gallons should round to 40 litres and 20 gallons to 75 litres. 38 L and 75 L are close, so this is only minor.
Item 19: 'harlequin rasbora melekatkan telurnya' reads awkwardly; 'bertelur lekat' or 'pelekat telur' would be more natural. 'Rasbora lain menabur telur secara rawak' is acceptable.
Item 19: the English says 'about 80 degrees Fahrenheit' for hatching. The Malay gives 27 °C, which is correct.
Item 20: 'Airnya sebaiknya ber-pH 5.0–6.0, kekerasan 1–5 °H' keeps '°H' as in the source. Use dGH, as in the other items.
Item 20: 'tukar air yang banyak (40–50% isipadu tangki) dengan air yang lebih sejuk' is fine. 'mengurat' for courtship is colloquial; 'berkawan' or 'pemikatan' would be better.
Item 20: 'Paramecium atau yang seumpamanya' is fine. 'Makanan awal patut Paramecium' lacks a verb and reads awkwardly; add 'ialah'.
Item 22: 'mendapati bahawa spesies dalam genus rasborin mewakili satu kumpulan monofiletik' is awkward. 'rasborin' should be 'rasborin (genera rasborin)'. 'Dikod bar DNA' is fine.
Item 22: 'ikan ... daripada perdagangan akuarium' is fine. 'kemerah-jambuan' is an odd coinage for 'pinkish'; use 'kemerah-merahan jambu' or 'merah jambu'.
Item 11: the Fahrenheit figure was dropped as instructed, so it is not an error.
Item 1: 'omnivor' is fine, but 'Pembiakan: bertelur' omits that the eggs are laid and attached; this is minor.
Section 4 emersed: 'อาจสีซีดและกลายเป็นสีเขียว' – 'lose its colours and turn green' is rendered awkwardly; use 'สีสันจางลงและกลับเป็นสีเขียว'.

Section 3: 'mesh areas' was translated as 'พื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำ' (wetlands), which is a guess and may change the meaning. 'Mesh' is probably a source error, so check the original wording or use a neutral term.
Section 4: 'In winter it can only survive indoors' is correct, but 'ความกระด้าง 1–12 GH' is fine. The real problem is 'ไม่ใช่พืชทนเค็ม' for 'not a halophyte'. Use 'ไม่ใช่พืชทนเกลือ (ฮาโลไฟต์)'.
Section 5: 'ใบมีสีเขียว เหลือง และแดง' then 'สีแดง ส้ม ม่วง หรือเขียว'. This follows the source, but the 'ส้ม/ม่วง' colours are not in the first list. Check consistency.
Section 5: 'ปลาบางชนิด (เช่น Ancistrus)' leaves the name in Latin. Add the Thai hobby name 'ปลาซักเกอร์/แคทฟิชอันซิสตรัส' (a Thai term for the fish).
Section 4: 'Hardness 1–12 GH' / 'ไฟที่ให้แสงอย่างน้อยระดับกลางค่อนสูง' is fine. However 'Let it float freely in the water' was rendered as 'ปล่อยให้ลอยในน้ำ', which drops the 'freely' nuance.

Section 4: 'Grown emersed, it needs a larger tank of at least 80 litres' – the source's 80 L is kept, which is OK. 'In winter... south-facing window' – the source says 'even on a south-facing window', so the tone should be 'แม้จะวางไว้ริมหน้าต่างที่หันไปทางทิศใต้'.
Item 10: 'ปลาหมูอินโด (clown loach)' is wrong. Clown loach (Chromobotia macracanthus) is usually called 'ปลาลูกผึ้ง' in Thailand. 'ปลาหมูอินโด' is a different fish.
Item 10: 'กุ้งก้ามแดงหรือกุ้งเครย์ฟิช' for 'crayfish' is wrong. 'กุ้งก้ามแดง' is a specific species (red claw). Use 'เครย์ฟิช/กุ้งน้ำจืดก้ามใหญ่' or just 'เครย์ฟิช (crayfish)'.
Item 10: 'ปลาคาร์พ (โค่ย)' changes 'koi'. Use 'ปลาคาร์ฟ/ปลาโคอิ'. 'ปลาแจ็คเดมซีย์' is acceptable, but 'ปลาเตตร้าบัวโนสไอเรส' should be more standard.
Item 10: 'เป็นแหล่งไบโอฟิล์มให้กินได้เต็มที่' is awkward for 'buffet of biofilm'. 'อาจเป็นอันตรายต่อปลาหรือกุ้งได้จริง' is a stiff rendering of 'really dangerous'.

Item 12: 'ปลูกแบบบก (emersed)' and 'สายพันธุ์' for 'Variations' are loose. The text itself says these are not real subspecies or varieties, so 'รูปแบบ/ฟอร์ม' is better. Also 'สัตว์ไม่มีกระดูกสันหลัง' for 'invertebrates' is stiff. Hobbyists say 'สัตว์น้ำไม่มีกระดูกสันหลัง' or 'กุ้งหอย'.
Item 12: 'Rotting (necrosis)' is translated 'เน่า (เนื้อเยื่อตาย)', which is fine. But 'เอาใบที่เหี่ยวออกและตัดแต่งเพื่อสุขอนามัย' is awkward.
Item 12: 'ยาฆ่าแมลง' is too narrow for 'chemicals (pesticides)', which here also target snails and parasites. Use 'สารกำจัดศัตรูพืช'.
Item 12: 'Aerial roots usually grow in 3 scenarios' is fine. 'ต้นไม้อาจพาปรสิตและสิ่งติดมาอย่างหอยศัตรูพืช' is awkward for 'hitchhikers'.
Item 7: 'วิธีเริ่มแบบแห้ง' and 'ใช้ปากคีบปลูก ... และโรยไว้บนผิววัสดุปลูก' are awkward. 'sprinkle them on top' is unclear in the source too. Also 'ให้ปุ๋ยเกินขนาด' is fine.

Item 9: 'micronutrients' is rendered 'ธาตุอาหารรอง', which means secondary nutrients (Ca, Mg, S). Use 'ธาตุอาหารเสริม/จุลธาตุ' for micronutrients and 'มหธาตุ' for macro, in items 9 and 12. 'ธาตุอาหารหลัก' for macro is acceptable.

Items 2 and 3: the Latin genus name "Alternanthera" is transliterated as "อัลเทอร์แนนเทอร่า". Keep it in Latin letters (Alternanthera), or give it in brackets after the Thai. Spellings of the transliteration vary among hobbyists.
Item 3: "แสงที่มีความเข้มสูง" is slightly stiff. "แสงแรง" or "ความเข้มแสงสูง" is more natural.
Item 3: the opening sentence "อัลเทอร์แนนเทอร่าที่เป็นที่รู้จักกันดีในรูปแบบขนาดจิ๋วนี้" is long and awkward. Split it or rephrase it, for example "อัลเทอร์แนนเทอร่าสายพันธุ์จิ๋วที่รู้จักกันดี".
Item 8: 'ต้องการแสงเพียงปานกลางเป็นอย่างมาก' is a muddled rendering of 'moderate lighting at best'. Use 'ต้องการแสงปานกลางอย่างมากที่สุด' or 'แค่แสงปานกลางก็พอ'.
Item 10: 'mollies' became 'ปลาบลูมอลลี่', which adds 'blue' that is not in the source. Use 'ปลาโมลลี่'.
Item 3: 'naturalized' became 'พืชที่ตั้งถิ่นฐานในธรรมชาติ', which is stiff. Use 'กลายเป็นพืชต่างถิ่นที่ขยายพันธุ์เองในธรรมชาติ'.
Item 10: 'pygmy Corydoras' became 'แพะแคระ', which is ambiguous. Write 'ปลาแพะแคระ (pygmy Corydoras)'.
Item 10: 'Otocinclus catfish' became 'ปลาแคระโอโต้', which loses the catfish meaning. Use 'ปลาซัคเกอร์/ปลาโอโตซิงคลัส'.
Item 10: 'ช่วงพัก (ระยะพักตัว)' is redundant. 'Rest (dormancy) periods' can be simplified.
Item 2: "ปุ๋ยเม็ด" is narrower than the source "phân" (fertiliser). Use "ปุ๋ย" or "ปุ๋ยเสียบ/ปุ๋ยรองพื้น" so no detail is added.
Item 2: the source field is Vietnamese, not English. The Thai matches it closely, but check that the right source text was supplied.
Item 2 (TH): the source heading is 'Mấy tuần đầu' (first few weeks), but the Thai 'ช่วงสัปดาห์แรก' means 'the first week'. Use 'ช่วงไม่กี่สัปดาห์แรก'.
Item 2 (TH): 'ฝังปุ๋ยฝังเพิ่ม' repeats 'ฝัง' and reads clumsily. Use 'ปุ๋ยเม็ด/ปุ๋ยก้อนเสียบเพิ่ม' or 'เติมปุ๋ยรองพื้นเพิ่ม'.
Item 2 (TH): 'ดินปลูก' for 'phân nền' (nutrient substrate) is inconsistent with 'วัสดุปลูก' used elsewhere in the same text. Use 'ดินปลูก/ซอยล์' consistently, or say 'ดินที่มีธาตุอาหาร'.
Item 2 (TH): 'หัวสีดำ' for 'củ đen' is fine, but 'set' was rendered as 'จัดตู้ใหม่'. The source says only 'lúc mới set', so keep it as 'ช่วงเพิ่งจัดตู้'.

Item 3 (TH): the source says 'single root', which refers to the bulb. 'หัวเดียว' is fine. In 'เติบโตได้ดีทั้งในน้ำอ่อนและน้ำกระด้าง', 'น้ำกระด้าง' is acceptable, but 'ทนทาน' for 'tolerant' loses the sense that it tolerates varied water. Consider 'ปรับตัวได้ดี'.
Item 4 (TH): 'สายพันธุ์' for 'varieties' is acceptable, but 'วงศ์ Aponogeton' is wrong. The family is Aponogetonaceae, and Aponogeton is a genus (สกุล). Use 'สกุล Aponogeton'.
Item 5: the English source is Vietnamese, not English. The Thai is a faithful translation of it, so this is a source-data problem. Check why a Vietnamese source was supplied.

Item 7: "low salinity (>8.4 g/l)" is rendered as "ความเค็มต่ำ (>8.4 กรัม/ลิตร)", which keeps the source's contradictory sign. Check the original figure, since it is probably meant to be a maximum (<).

Item 7: "อากาศหนาว (−4 °C และต่ำกว่า)" and "น้ำแข็งตัวเป็นเวลานาน" add nothing wrong, but "มักสร้างตาที่จมลงสู่พื้นจนกว่าอากาศจะอุ่นขึ้น" should say "จนถึงฤดูใบไม้ผลิ" (until spring) to match the English.
Item 8: "ปลากระดี่แคระ" for dwarf gourami is fine, but "ปลาแพะแคระ" for pygmy corydoras is nonstandard. Use "ปลาคอรี่แคระ" or "คอรีดอรัสแคระ".
Item 8: "หอยเจดีย์" for Malaysian trumpet snail and "หอยชอปสติ๊ก" for chopstick snail are acceptable. "ราสโบร่า" should be written "ราสบอร่า", the standard hobby spelling.
Item 8: "ปลาม้าลาย" for zebra danio is fine. "ปลาไวท์คลาวด์" is fine. "ปลาฟาโลเวลล่า" for royal farlowella drops the "royal", so write "ฟาโลเวลล่าราชา" or add the Latin name.
Item 8: "กุ้งเครย์ฟิช" is fine. "ดินมอนต์มอริลโลไนต์" is fine but could be "ดินเหนียวมอนต์มอริลโลไนต์".
Item 3: "พูใบด้านบน" for dorsal lobe is acceptable. Spelling out "ใบจะเปลี่ยนเป็นสีแดงเข้ม" is fine.

Item 5: the 'TH' text is a translation of the Vietnamese passage; the Thai is fine, but it was checked against Vietnamese, not the English source. It also adds details not in the English item list (e.g. 'bèo chỉ nằm ở một phần bể'), so this item should be treated as non-English source.
Item 8: 'ปลาคาร์ดินัลจีน' for white cloud mountain minnow is awkward; the common Thai name is 'ปลาเรนโบว์/ปลาไวท์คลาวด์' (white cloud). Please fix.
Item 8: 'ปลาม้าลาย' for zebra danio is fine, but 'ปลาซิว' for rasboras is too generic; use 'ราสโบร่า'.

Item 8: 'หอยขมญี่ปุ่น' for Japanese trapdoor snail and 'หอยเจดีย์' for Malaysian trumpet snail are questionable; use 'หอยเจดีย์' only for MTS and check the others. 'หอยแบล็คเดวิล' and 'หอยแรบบิท' are transliterated only.
Item 8: 'ปลาคาร์ป' for koi should be 'ปลาคาร์ฟ/ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป'; 'ปลาเท็กซัส' should be 'ปลาเท็กซัสซิกลิด' and 'แจ็คเดมป์ซีย์' should be 'ปลาแจ็คเดมป์ซีย์'.
Item 8: 'ฉีดยาฆ่าแมลง' for 'treated with pesticides' adds 'sprayed'; use 'ใช้ยาฆ่าแมลง/ผ่านการใช้สารกำจัดศัตรูพืช'.
Item 7: '(>8.4 g/l)' is kept from the source and is a possible source error; the Thai 'ความเค็มต่ำ' paired with '>' is contradictory. Translate faithfully but flag it.
Item 7: 'น้ำแข็งเป็นเวลานาน' for 'prolonged freezing' should be 'น้ำค้างแข็ง/การแข็งตัวของน้ำเป็นเวลานาน'. 'ฤดูใบไม้ผลิ' (spring) is not a natural fit for Thailand; consider 'ช่วงอากาศอุ่นขึ้น'.

Item 3: 'พื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำ บ่อ คู คลอง' translates 'ditches' as 'คูคลอง', which is acceptable. 'Anabaena azollae' and the item's wording 'แหนแดง' are fine. In item 1, 'ไม้ลอยผิวน้ำ' for 'floater' is acceptable.

Item 6 brackish water: English '(>8.4 g/l)' means greater than 8.4 g/l, but Thai says 'ต่ำกว่า 8.4 g/L' (lower than). The inequality is reversed, so the figure is changed. Fix the direction, or keep the source meaning faithfully.
Item 5 planting: 'น้ำยาฟอกขาว (สารละลายโซเดียมไฮโปคลอไรต์ หรือน้ำยาซักผ้าขาว)' adds explanatory content not in the source. Use just 'สารละลายคลอรีนฟอกขาว' or 'น้ำยาฟอกขาว'.
Item 5 propagation: 'การแตกแยกหรือหักของส่วนลำต้นและใบ' adds 'and leaves'. The source says 'vegetative parts'. Use 'ส่วนที่ไม่ใช่การสืบพันธุ์ (ส่วนลำต้น)'.
Item 3: 'สีเขียวเข้มหรือสีแดง' for 'intense green or reddish' is slightly off. 'ไทรโคม' for trichomes is non-standard. Consider 'ขนขนาดเล็ก (trichomes)'.

Item 7: 'ปลาคาร์พ/ปลาโคอิ' for koi is unnecessary. 'ปลาออโตซินคลัส (ออตโต)' and 'ปลาแอนด์เลอร์' are awkward. 'หอยศัตรู' for pest snails is OK but 'หอยรบกวน' is more natural. 'Mosquito fern' stays in English, which is acceptable.
Item 1: 'ใบ' for 'Fronds' is fine, but 'ไม้ลอยผิวน้ำ' for floater is a bit off. 'ไม้ลอยน้ำ' is the common term.
Section 5: "สารละลายคลอรีน" for "bleach" is wrong/misleading; use "น้ำยาฟอกขาว/สารละลายโซเดียมไฮโปคลอไรต์ (น้ำยาซักผ้าขาว)" - care advice accuracy.
Section 6: "(>8.4 g/l)" is kept as in the source, but the Thai reads as a low-salinity claim; check that the sign is consistent (likely "<"). Also "g/l" is fine but should be consistent with L.
Section 6: "ฤดูใบไม้ผลิ" for spring is unnatural for Thailand; use "จนถึงต้นฤดูร้อน/เมื่ออากาศอุ่นขึ้น".
Section 5: "ฉีดยาฆ่าแมลง" (section 7) adds "sprayed"; the source says "treated with pesticides" - use "ผ่านการใช้สารกำจัดศัตรูพืช".
Section 7: "ปลาม้าลาย" for zebra danio is OK, but "ปลาแพะแคระ" for pygmy corydoras is non-standard; use "ปลาคอรีดอรัสแคระ". "ปลาซิว" for rasboras is vague; "ปลาแรสบอร่า" is the term hobbyists use.
Section 7: "ปลาคาร์ฟ" for koi should be "ปลาคาร์พ/ปลาโคอิ"; "ปลาออตโต้" should be "ปลาออโตซินคลัส/ออตโต".
Section 7: "ไนโตรเจนกับคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์" is OK, but "ยุคน้ำแข็งหลายยุคต่อเนื่องกัน" overstates 'a succession of ice ages'; minor.

Section 3: "แหนแดง" is the Thai name for Azolla, but the heading calls it "Fairy moss" in the table (item 1); mixing is fine, but "ไทรโคม" should be "ไทรโคม (trichomes)" with the English term in brackets for clarity.
Section 8: 'ปลาม้าลาย' for zebra danios is fine, but 'ปลาแคระ (ออตโต้)' for otocinclus is wrong/vague. Use 'ปลาออโต้/ออโตซิงกลัส (Otocinclus)'.
Section 8: 'ปลาหมูอินเดียน่า (ปลาโลชโคลวน์)' for clown loaches is a mistranslation. Use 'ปลาโคลนโลช/ปลาเสือโคลวน์โลช (clown loach)'.
Section 8: 'ปลาเตตร้าบัวโนสไอเรส' is awkward. Use 'ปลาเทตร้าบัวโนสไอเรส'.
Section 8: 'ปลาคิลลี่โคลวน์' is acceptable, but 'ปลาซิวภูเขาขาว' for white cloud mountain minnow should be 'ปลาซิวขาว/ไวท์คลาวด์' (the standard hobby name).

Section 5: 'ถอนก้านดอกทิ้ง' and then 'การเด็ดก้านดอกออก' are inconsistent. Also, 'ปล่อยให้ลอยไว้' under 'Inspect it for decaying particles' reads like a step that follows the split. Reword it to 'ตรวจดูอนุภาคเน่าและใบเสียที่ต้นใหม่'.
Section 5: 'ชอบน้ำอ่อนถึงกระด้างปานกลาง' is fine, but 'ใบเสียหาย' is vague. Make it 'ใบเสีย'.
Section 7: 'ธาตุอาหารรองและธาตุอาหารหลัก' reverses the English order (micro and macro). 'Micro' means ธาตุอาหารรอง/จุลธาตุ and 'macro' means ธาตุอาหารหลัก, so reorder it to match.
Section 7: 'ต้นไม้ดูดซึมธาตุอาหาร' should be 'ไม้น้ำ' or 'ต้นนี้'. Also, 'low-tech (ตู้ไม้น้ำที่ไม่ใช้ CO2 และแสงน้อย)' adds an explanation that is not in the source.
Section 1: the translation drops '(20 gallons)', which is allowed. Section 9: 'วาไรตี้' should be 'พันธุ์' or 'วาไรตี้ (variety)'.
Item 8: 'otocinclus' translated as 'ปลาอ็อตโต (ปลาซักเกอร์อ็อตโต)'. Use the standard 'ปลาอ็อตโต' or 'อ็อตโตซินคลัส' consistently, and drop the misleading 'ซักเกอร์'.
Item 8: 'pygmy corydoras' translated as 'ปลาแพะแคระ'. This is the wrong fish: 'ปลาแพะ' is a Corydoras cat, but the usual hobby term is 'คอรี่แคระ' or 'ปลาหมูแคระ'. Please check it.
Item 8: 'clown loaches' translated as 'ปลาโคลนโลช'. This is a mistransliteration. Use 'ปลาโคลนโลช/โคลวน์โลช' or 'ปลาไหลลาย', as hobbyists write it.
Item 8: 'koi' translated as 'ปลาคาร์ฟ (ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ฟ)'. Use 'ปลาคราฟ' or 'ปลาโคอิ', which is the usual term.
Item 8: 'zebra danio' translated as 'ปลาม้าลาย'. 'ปลาเซบร้าดานิโอ' or 'ปลาม้าลาย' is okay, but 'white cloud mountain minnows' as 'ปลาไวท์คลาวด์' is fine.
Item 8: 'crayfish' translated as 'กุ้งเครย์ฟิช'. The wording 'ระวังกุ้งเครย์ฟิชส่วนใหญ่' should say what to avoid, such as 'ไม่ควรเลี้ยงร่วมกับ'.
Item 8: 'Fertile leaflets are rarely formed' translated as 'ใบย่อยที่สร้างสปอร์'. This is acceptable but could be clearer. 'Varieties' translated as 'สายพันธุ์ต่าง ๆ' should be 'พันธุ์/วาไรตี้'.

Item 3: 'mesophyte habitats' translated as 'ถิ่นอาศัยแบบมีโซไฟต์'. The Thai splits the word wrongly and reads as 'มีโซไฟต์'. Use 'พืชที่ชอบความชื้นปานกลาง (mesophyte)'. 'แหล่งนิเวศน์' should be spelled 'นิเวศ'.

Item 5: 'Keep the fern from drying out' and 'Dry start method: the plant is grown without water at first' are weakened. The Thai says to add no water, but the English says to add a little water up to the lowest part of the substrate. Clarify this.
Item 5: 'cling wrap' translated as 'พลาสติกห่อหุ้มอาหาร'. Use 'ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร'. 'Java fern' translated as 'เฟิร์นใบมะพร้าว' is wrong. Use 'เฟิร์นชวา' or 'ชวาเฟิร์น'.

Item 2: The added parenthetical "(นักเลี้ยงในไทยมักเรียกสั้น ๆ ว่า บูเซ ซึ่งเป็นต้นเดียวกัน)" isn't in the source. It adds a claim about Thai hobbyists. Drop it, or just write "บูเซ" where the source says "Bucep", for example "Bucephalandra (บูเซ)".
Item 2: "ให้ภาพรวมของการจัดสมดุล" is awkward for "cho bố cục cân". Use something like "เพื่อให้องค์ประกอบของการจัดสมดุลกัน" or "เพื่อให้ภาพรวมการจัดดูสมดุล".
Item 2: "ใยหิน" can read as asbestos. Consider "ร็อกวูล" or "ใยหิน (rockwool)" for the rockwool on potted plants.
Item 1: The source writes "Bucephelandra" and the translation writes "Bucephalandra". The correct spelling is fine, but it is a change to the Latin name as written.

Item 2: "บูเซปโตช้า ตู้ปลาที่เพิ่งตั้งใหม่..." is hard to read. "บูเซป" and "โตช้า" run together, so it looks like one word. The causal "nên" (so/therefore) is also lost. Write "บูเซปโตช้า ดังนั้นตู้ที่เพิ่งตั้งใหม่...".
Item 2: "ใช้คีมคีบ" for "nhíp" (tweezers) is slightly off. Use "ปากคีบ" or "แหนบ", the usual aquascaping tweezers.
Item 2: "บูเซป" is a transliteration of the Vietnamese slang "Bucep". Use the full "Bucephalandra" or a known Thai hobby nickname such as "บูเซ", and say once that they are the same plant.
Item 2: "ให้องค์ประกอบดูสมดุล" is slightly stiff for "bố cục cân". Try "ให้ภาพรวมของการจัดสมดุล".
Item 1: the source spells the genus 'Bucephelandra'. The Thai silently uses 'Bucephalandra', which is the correct spelling, so no change is needed.
Item 2: 'ผูกติดขอนไม้' says to tie the plant on, while the source says 'gắn' (attach). Consider 'ยึด/เกาะติดขอนไม้' so it also covers gluing.
#1: Thai writes "Bucephalandra" while the source has "Bucephelandra". Latin names should stay unchanged, so either keep the source spelling or confirm the correction on purpose.
#1: "เติบโตแบบจมน้ำ" sounds like the plant is drowning. Use "เติบโตใต้น้ำ (submersed)" and "เติบโตเหนือน้ำ/โผล่พ้นน้ำ (emersed)".
#2: "ปลูกในกระถาง" for "cây chậu" (potted plants) is a bit off. Hobbyists usually say "ต้นที่ปลูกในถ้วย/ถ้วยปลูก" for tissue-culture or nursery plants.
#2: "กระจายไปวางตามจุดอื่นอย่างทั่วถึง" is stiff. Use something like "วางกระจายตามจุดอื่นๆ ให้สมดุล".

Item 1: The source spells it "Bucephelandra", but the Thai has "Bucephalandra". Quietly correcting the Latin name goes against the rule that Latin names stay unchanged. It is a minor point, since the correction is botanically right.
Item 2: "มองเห็นได้ชัดมาก" only says the rockwool is easy to see. The Vietnamese "nhìn rất lộ" means it looks unsightly or exposed. Use something like "ดูไม่เนียน" or "เห็นชัดและไม่สวย".
Item 2: "ใยหิน" for rockwool is understandable, but Thai hobbyists often write "ร็อกวูล". You could add it in brackets after the Thai term.
Item 1: The source spells the genus "Bucephelandra", but the Thai has "Bucephalandra". This is the correct spelling and a harmless fix, though it is not literally unchanged. It is minor.

Item 1: the second paragraph is missing. Add a translation of "Sold as a portion of 3 rhizomes (single, double or triple portions available)", e.g. จำหน่ายเป็นชุดละ 3 เหง้า (มีให้เลือกแบบ 1 ชุด 2 ชุด หรือ 3 ชุด).
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Thai follows the Vietnamese meaning faithfully, but the source should be checked.
Item 2: "บูเซป" for Bucep is a nickname written in Thai. Consider Bucephalandra or บูเซฟาแลนดร้า on first use so readers recognise it.

Item 2: "bông đá" is rendered as "ใยหิน" (rock wool). Rock wool is the right material, but the item 2 heading and body say "แกะใยหินออก" and the English-side term is unclear. Check that the term is used consistently. Thai hobbyists usually say "ใยหิน" or "ร็อกวูล", so a bracket gloss would help.
Item 2: "ซื้อต้นไม้แบบกระถาง" – "cây mua dạng chậu" means potted plants. Say "ไม้น้ำแบบถ้วย/กระถางที่ปลูกในใยหิน" so the pot form is clear. "ตำแหน่งปลูก" is fine.
Item 2: "hút bớt phân dư" means absorbing excess waste or nutrients from fish waste. "ธาตุอาหารส่วนเกิน" is acceptable but loses the "waste" cue. Consider "สารอาหารส่วนเกินจากของเสีย".
Item 2: "ตะไคร่" for "rêu" (algae) is correct. "โตช้า" is fine.

Item 3: the English reads "grown submersed and emersed at times". The Thai "เติบโตทั้งแบบจมน้ำและแบบพ้นน้ำสลับกันไปตามช่วงเวลา" is acceptable. The source misspells "Bucephelandra", and the Thai corrects it to the Latin name "Bucephalandra". That is fine.
Item 2 is a Vietnamese source, not English. Confirm that "บูเซป" as a nickname matches the Thai hobby term "บูเซ" or "บูเซฟาแลนดร้า".

Item 6: "ไม่ต้องอัดคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์ (CO2) เพราะโตเร็วมาก จึงเหมาะใช้เป็นไม้หลังตู้" reads as if fast growth is the reason CO2 isn't needed. The English gives fast growth as the reason for using it as a background plant. Split the sentences, for example: "...ไม่ต้องอัด CO2 และเพราะโตเร็วมาก จึงเหมาะใช้เป็นไม้หลังตู้..."
Item 6: "ให้ไม้น้ำต้นอื่นได้รับอาหารเพียงพอ" should say nutrients ("ธาตุอาหาร") instead of "อาหาร", which could be read as food.
Item 9: "ปลาคาร์ป" for koi is too general. Use "ปลาคาร์ป (โคอิ)" or "ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป".

Item 2: "ผักกูดน้ำ (water sprite)" is wrong. Water sprite (Ceratopteris) is usually called "เฟิร์นน้ำ" or "water sprite"; ผักกูดน้ำ is a different plant. Also "สาหร่ายพุงชะโด" is a doubtful name for hornwort. The usual Thai hobby name is "สาหร่ายหางกระรอก" (or "หางแมว"). Check this term in every item.
Item 4: "ปล่อยลอย" is fine. But the sentence "ตัดแต่งเมื่อเริ่มโตจนควบคุมไม่อยู่" has no subject. Say clearly that the plant is pruned.
Item 5: "หอยในตู้ปลากินซากอินทรีย์" leaves out the word "detritivores". Also "ปลาคาร์ป" for koi is acceptable but should be "ปลาคาร์ป (โคอิ)". "สัมผัสแล้วรู้สึกสากคล้ายหนาม" is OK.
Item 6: "during the cold season" is translated as "ฤดูหนาว", which is fine. But the sentence order is confusing: "ไม่ว่าท่อนไหน… ไม่ว่าจะปล่อยลอย" repeats "ไม่ว่า". Rephrase it.
Item 1: "ไม้ต้น (stem plant)" is not the usual term. Hobbyists say "ไม้ลำต้น" or "ไม้ก้านยาว" or "ไม้ปลูกแบบแตกยอด" (stem plant).
Item 8: "คาร์บอนน้ำ" is non-standard. Use "ลิควิดคาร์บอน (liquid carbon)". "ที่ดูดตะกอน" for a gravel vacuum should be "สายดูดทราย/ที่ดูดขี้ปลา".
Item 2: "เฟิร์นใบหอก (Java fern)" is a poor match for Java fern. Hobbyists in Thailand usually write "เฟินชวา" (or "เฟิร์นชวา"). "ใบหอก" is the Lance variety, not the general name.
Item 12: 'cherry barb' is translated as 'ปลาเสือพ่นน้ำแดง'. That is wrong, because เสือพ่นน้ำ is the archerfish. Use ปลาตะเพียนเชอร์รี่ (cherry barb).
Item 12: 'harlequin rasbora' is translated as 'ปลาซิวข้างขวาน'. That is the hatchetfish, so the fish is wrong. Use ปลาแรสบอร่าสามจุด or ซิวฮาร์เลควิน.
Item 12: 'bamboo shrimp' is translated as 'กุ้งบัมเบิ้ลบี/กุ้งพัด'. Bumblebee shrimp is a different animal. Use กุ้งไผ่/กุ้งพัด only.
Item 12: 'clown killifish' is translated as 'ปลาคิลลี่หางแดง'. 'หางแดง' is an added fact. Use ปลาคิลลี่คลาวน์.
Item 10: the last paragraph has a corrupted character in 'การเต���ม CO2'. Fix it to 'การเติม'.
Item 12: 'ปลาแพะแคระ (pygmy cory)' and 'ปลาบอลลูน/ปลามอลลี่' give hobbyists two terms where the original has one. Keep a single common name for each.
Item 10: 'more pronounced colour' is rendered as 'สีเข้มชัดขึ้น'. This adds 'darker'. Use 'สีสดชัดขึ้น'.
Section 8: 'จึงเลี้ยงร่วมกับสัตว์อื่นที่ฉีกกินต้นไม้ได้ได้' is garbled (duplicate 'ได้', and 'ฉีกกินต้นไม่ได้ได้' reads as can tear it). Rewrite: 'จึงเลี้ยงร่วมกับสัตว์อื่นที่ไม่สามารถฉีกกินต้นได้'.
Section 5: 'เพื่อป้องกันรอยตัดจากเชื้อโรค' is awkward. Use 'เพื่อป้องกันเชื้อโรคเข้าทางรอยตัด'.
Section 5: 'ลำต้นจะปลูกรวมเป็นกอหรือ...ก็ได้' is awkward. Use 'ปลูกลำต้นรวมเป็นกอ หรือเว้นระยะห่างกัน...ก็ได้'.
Section 5: 'ใบจะซีดและละลาย' for 'discolor and melt'. Prefer 'ใบเปลี่ยนสีและเน่ายุ่ย'.
Section 5: 'ปลูกแบบจมน้ำทั้งต้น' appears twice, as in the source, but the repeat reads oddly. Consider merging.
Section 5: 'ขี้ผึ้งเทียน' should be 'ขี้ผึ้งจากเทียน' or 'ไขเทียน'.
Section 5: 'ซึ่งต้นจะรอด' is blunt. Use 'ต้นก็จะรอดได้'.

Section 1/3: 'ไผ่กวนอิม' is a common name for Dracaena sanderiana, so it is fine. In section 3, 'เงินไหลมา' is a different plant from Syngonium (the common name is 'เงินไหลมา' for Syngonium, but check it). Consider using 'ซิงโกเนียม' instead.
Section 8: 'ตัวอ่อนแมลงปอและแมลงปอเข็ม' should be 'ตัวอ่อนแมลงปอและแมลงปอเข็ม' as nymphs of both. Specify 'ตัวอ่อนของแมลงปอและแมลงปอเข็ม'.

Item 5 'ขยายพันธุ์แบบไม่อาศัยเพศ' is fine, but 'สารเคมีเหล่านี้' etc. are OK; the real error: 'The plant ... pest such as snails' translated 'ศัตรูพืชอย่างหอย' is acceptable. Main problem: 'Lucky bamboo ... Full submersion' paragraph and list are fine.
Item 8: 'กุ้งเครย์ฟิช' is wrong for crayfish; use 'เครย์ฟิช' or 'กุ้งแม่น้ำ/crayfish' (crayfish are not กุ้งทั่วไป).
Item 8: 'ไม่ผลัดใบ ... ใบมักบิดและมีสีเขียว' fine, but 'พืชในสกุล Dracaena spp.' is redundant/incorrect; use 'พืชสกุล Dracaena'.
Item 8: 'ไม่ปล่อยสารพิษลงในน้ำ ... จึงเลี้ยงร่วมกับสัตว์อื่นที่ไม่สามารถฉีกกินต้นได้' loses the 'can be kept with' logic slightly; rephrase as 'จึงเลี้ยงร่วมกับสัตว์อื่นที่ฉีกกินต้นไม่ได้ได้'.
Item 5: 'ไผ่กวนอิมขยายพันธุ์แบบไม่อาศัยเพศ' is correct, but 'ตัดกิ่งแขนง (ตรงข้อ) ให้เรียบร้อยเพื่อไม่ให้รอยตัดแตกเป็นขุย' is OK; 'ปลูกแบบจมน้ำทั้งต้น' repeated heading is fine.
Item 5: 'ต้นจะเหลืองเมื่อสัมผัสคลอรีน' fine; 'ซึ่งต้นจะรอด' ('It will survive') is fine; 'โรยกรวดผิวเรียบ' for 'soft pebbles' changes meaning (soft vs smooth); use 'กรวดเม็ดเล็กนุ่ม' or similar.
Item 3: 'เงินไหลมา (Syngonium)' is a mismatch: Syngonium is usually called 'ออมเงิน/เงินไหลมา' ambiguous; verify the common name.
Item 7: 'แบบไม่โดนโดยตรง' lacks the word 'แสง'; write 'แสงทางอ้อม'. 'ของเสียจากปลา หอย กบ กุ้ง' fine.
"ไม้น้ำแบบกอ (ใบแตกออกจากโคนเป็นรูปดอกกุหลาบ)": Rosulate is usually called "ไม้น้ำแบบโรเซตต์/ไม้กอ"; the explanation is acceptable but slightly long, so consider "ไม้น้ำแบบกอ (Rosulate)".
"ตัวถ่วง" for the anchor: hobbyists usually say "แถบตะกั่ว" or "ตะกั่วรัด"; "ตัวถ่วง" is vague.
"ต้นไม้ที่ได้มาเป็นกำ...": slightly awkward. Prefer "ไม้น้ำที่ขายมักเป็นมัดของลำต้นหรือต้นอ่อน รัดไว้ด้วยแถบตะกั่ว".
"เว้นระยะห่างกันพอสมควร": the English "with some distance into the bottom substrate" is ambiguous; consider "ปักลึกพอสมควร" in case it means planting depth rather than spacing.
Item 2: "ซับสเตรต" is acceptable, but "วัสดุปลูก" or "พื้นตู้" is more familiar to Thai hobbyists. Use one term consistently across items 2 and 3.
Item 2: the source says "Kiếm Ozelot Green", and "อเมซอน โอซีล็อต กรีน" is acceptable. You could add the Latin name Echinodorus 'Ozelot' in brackets, or use "ใบพาย", so it matches item 3.
Item 2: the source is Vietnamese, not English, but the Thai is a faithful translation. No fix needed for the language itself.

Item 2: the Vietnamese says the plant is 'dễ trồng, sống khỏe trong gần như mọi điều kiện'. The Thai is fine, but 'วัสดุปลูกที่มีธาตุอาหารสูง' is slightly wordy. Use 'ซับสเตรตที่อุดมด้วยธาตุอาหาร' or similar.

Item 3: 'The dark spots form a bigger contrast on the light leaves' is rendered as 'จะตัดกันชัดเจนมากขึ้น'. It is not clear what the contrast is bigger than. Rephrase, e.g. 'จุดสีเข้มตัดกับใบสีอ่อนได้ชัดเจน'.
Item 3: 'fluted' is rendered as 'เป็นคลื่นจีบ'. This is acceptable, but 'ขอบใบเป็นลอน' is more natural.
Item 1: 'ไม้น้ำที่ขึ้นเป็นกอแบบใบเรียงเป็นวง (โรเซตต์)' is long for a Type field. Shorten to 'ไม้น้ำทรงโรเซตต์ (Rosulate)'.
Item 1: 'สายพันธุ์ปรับปรุง (cultivar)' is fine. Consider 'พันธุ์ปลูกเลี้ยง (cultivar)', which is the term hobbyists commonly use.
Item 3: "micronutrients" is rendered as "ธาตุอาหารรอง", which means secondary nutrients (Ca, Mg, S). Use "จุลธาตุ" or "ธาตุอาหารเสริม" instead.
Item 3: "วัสดุปลูกที่มีธาตุอาหาร" is slightly awkward. "วัสดุปลูกที่อุดมด้วยธาตุอาหาร" reads more naturally.
Item 2: the source is Vietnamese, not English, but the Thai is faithful, so this is not a translation fault. Check that the source text for item 2 is correct.

Item 1: the English says 'Height: 20-30+ cm' and the Thai says '20–30 ซม. ขึ้นไป'. This is acceptable, but it conflicts with item 4, which gives 25–50 cm. This is a source inconsistency, not a translation error.
Item 3: 'takes a lot of light from plants underneath' is rendered as 'บังแสงของต้นไม้ที่อยู่ด้านล่างไปมาก'. This is a little awkward. Use 'บังแสงของไม้น้ำที่อยู่ด้านล่างค่อนข้างมาก'.

Item 3: 'A nutritious bottom' is rendered as 'วัสดุปลูกที่มีธาตุอาหาร'. This is fine, but the sentence is incomplete as written. Use 'การใช้วัสดุปลูกที่มีธาตุอาหารและการเติม CO2 ช่วยส่งเสริมการเติบโต'.
Item 2: 'ในตู้ปลาขนาดใหญ่' could say 'ตู้ไม้น้ำ' to match hobby usage. This is minor.
Item 4: 'Double Red' is kept in Latin letters and quotes. This is acceptable.

"อีโลเดียช่วยป้องกันตะไคร่": the English says Egeria, but Thai uses "อีโลเดีย" (Elodea), a different genus name. Use "อีเจเรีย" or "Egeria" (or the established Thai name "เอเจอเรีย/สาหร่ายหางกระรอกใหญ่") so the name matches the Latin Egeria densa.
"ต้นไม้จะมาเป็นกำ...ด้วยตัวถ่วง": "anchor" here is the lead strip/weight that holds the bundle. "ตัวถ่วง" is acceptable, but "แถบตะกั่ว" is clearer to hobbyists.
"ยอดจะเรียวเล็กลง": "tendrils grow thin" is rendered as shoots/tips. Consider "เถา/ลำต้นเรียวเล็ก" for fidelity.
"เด็ดใบที่โคนลำต้นออกประมาณ 5 ซม.": "lowest 5 cm of the stems" is fine, but "any damaged leaves" is ambiguous: say "ใบที่เสียหายทั้งหมดตลอดลำต้น".
"Cosmopolitan" as "พบได้ทั่วโลก" is acceptable, but in item 3 the sentence order is awkward; use "Egeria densa ซึ่งพบได้ทั่วโลก" with a clearer structure.

"transparent wads" is mistranslated as "กอโปร่ง ๆ" (loose clumps); the Thai drops the sense of "wads" and the "in front and in the centre" planting advice is changed. Use something like "ปลูกเป็นกลุ่มโปร่งแสง/โปร่งตา" and make the meaning explicit.
"Each straw" is rendered as "แต่ละเส้น"; use "ใบ/ก้านแต่ละต้น" or "แต่ละก้าน" for natural meaning.
"the plant maintains an open form of growth" is rendered awkwardly as "ต้นไม้จะคงทรงการเติบโตแบบโปร่ง"; use "ทรงพุ่มโปร่ง".
"This American Eleocharis" gives "มาจากทวีปอเมริกา"; use "Eleocharis จากอเมริกาเหนือ" in keeping with item 1 (which says North America). It is vague and may mislead.
"basic" is rendered as "ไม้น้ำพื้นฐาน"; "ไม้น้ำปลูกง่าย" is the more natural term.
"เพอร์สเปกทีฟ" is transliterated; use "มิติและความลึก/ทัศนมิติ" instead.
"ความสูง: 20–30+ ซม. (ค่าเฉลี่ยหลังปลูกในตู้ครบสองเดือน)" is clumsy; use "หลังปลูกในตู้ประมาณสองเดือน".
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Thai follows it faithfully, but the source should be checked.
Item 2: "หญ้าหัวไม้ขีด" is not the name Thai hobbyists usually use for Eleocharis. Use "หญ้าเข็ม" or "หญ้าผมนางเงือก" (hairgrass), and keep it the same in all items.
Item 2: "แผ่ขยายค่อนข้างเร็ว" is weaker than the source "lan khá hung" (spreads aggressively). Use something like "แผ่ขยายรุนแรง/เร็วมาก".
Item 3: "ปูพรมได้ผลแน่นอนที่สุด" is slightly stiff. Consider "เป็นหนึ่งในไม้ปูพรมที่เชื่อถือได้ที่สุด".
Section 8: "keep the lights on for up to 10 hours daily" was translated as "ควรเปิดไฟไม่เกิน 10 ชั่วโมงต่อวัน". The wording is acceptable, but "ปลาสอด" in section 9 is a bigger problem, see below.
Section 9: "mollies" is translated as "ปลาสอด". Mollies are ปลาโมลลี่ (ปลาสอดหางดาบ is a swordtail), so the fish is wrong. Use "ปลาโมลลี่".
Section 9: "Amano" shrimp is translated as "กุ้งยามาโตะ". This is acceptable. "ghost shrimp" is translated as "กุ้งฝอยใส", which is a different local species. Use "กุ้งโกสต์" or "กุ้งแก้ว".

Section 9: "rainbowfish" is translated as "ปลาเรนโบว์". Use "ปลาเรนโบว์ฟิช". "clown loaches" is translated as "ปลาหมูอินโด". This is acceptable. "otocinclus" is translated as "ปลาออตโต้". Use "ปลาอ็อตโต".

Section 6: "Easy Green" should be written "Easy Green" as a trade name. "Mulm" is translated as "ตะกอน", which is fine. "dwarf baby tears" is left in English. Add a Thai term, such as "ไม้ตระกูลเบบี้ทียร์แคระ (Hemianthus callitrichoides)".

Section 11: "Melting" is translated as "อาการละลาย" without a bracket. Add the English term, "(melt)". "Nitrates and phosphates ... Dose them regularly" is translated as "ควรเติมเป็นประจำ". This is acceptable.

Section 1: "Fertilizer: recommended" conflicts with section 8, where fertilizer is "essential". This conflict is in the source, so no fix is needed. "Minimum tank size: 20 litres" is kept as in the source, which is acceptable.
Section 4: "leaves ... (1 cm long)" is correct. The sentence about the "low-growing stem plant" is fine. "Placement" in section 1 is translated as "ตำแหน่งในตู้", which is fine.

Section 2: "traders sometimes mix them up" is translated as "ผู้ขายก็สับสน". This is acceptable. "Pest snails" is translated as "หอยศัตรูพืช". Use "หอยตัวแสบ" or "หอยที่เป็นศัตรูในตู้", because "ศัตรูพืช" suggests agricultural pests. Also, "ตะไคร่" for algae should be "สาหร่าย/ตะไคร่น้ำ".

Item 8: "keep the lights on for up to 10 hours daily" -> "ควรเปิดไฟไม่เกิน 10 ชั่วโมง" is acceptable, but 'Fertilizer: essential' conflicts with item 1 'ควรใส่' (recommended); make consistent with each source.

Item 9: "pearl and honey gouramis" -> "ปลากระดี่มุก" is fine, but "Japanese trapdoor" snail -> "หอยขมญี่ปุ่น" is wrong (Japanese trapdoor snail is Viviparus; it is not 'หอยขม'); also "Malaysian trumpet" -> "หอยมาเลเซีย" drops 'trumpet' (use หอยเทพมาเลเซีย/หอยจุ๊บแจง style term or 'Malaysian trumpet snail').

Item 9: "zebra danios" -> "ปลาม้าลาย" ok, but "clown loaches" -> "ปลาหมูอินเดีย" is wrong; clown loach is ปลาหมูปลาตัวตลก/'ปลาหมูข้างลาย' (ปลาหมูบอลลูน? no). Use the proper name "ปลาหมูอารีย์/โคลวน์โลช".
Item 9: "pygmy corydoras" -> "ปลาแพะแคระ" is unusual; use "ปลาคอรี่แคระ".
Item 9: "Amano" shrimp -> "กุ้งยามาโตะ" ok; "ghost shrimp" -> "กุ้งฝอยใส" ok; "koi" -> "ปลาคาร์ป" loses specificity, use "ปลาคาร์ปโคอิ".

Item 2: "Choose only healthy specimens" and "bleach solution" -> "น้ำยาฟอกขาวเจือจาง" adds 'diluted' not in the source; also no dilution ratio given, which is risky care advice—state concentration or omit 'เจือจาง' consistently.
Item 6: "Let them grow to about 5–6 cm" fine; but "until it takes hold it is not a rapid grower" fine. "Heavy trimming promotes ... giving a carpet-like look" ok.
Item 11: "Hard to plant" heading -> "ปลูกยาก" ok; "Yellowing leaves: ... high pH" ok. "Pot variant" -> "แบบกระถาง" is fine.
Item 8: 'Alkaline and/or hard water' rendered as 'น้ำที่เป็นด่างและ/หรือกระด้าง' – fine, but 'Hardness: soft water is required, 1 – 6 GH' ok; no issue. Real issue below.

Item 10: 'zebra danio' translated as 'ปลาม้าลาย' – acceptable, but 'white cloud mountain minnows' as 'ปลาซิวหางแดง' is wrong/misleading; use 'ปลาไวท์คลาวด์ (White Cloud Mountain Minnow)' and don't call it ปลาซิวหางแดง.
Item 10: 'Buenos Aires tetras' as 'ปลาบัวโนสแอริสเตตร้า' is a garbled transliteration; use 'ปลาเทtrา บัวโนสไอเรส' or 'บัวโนสไอเรส เตตร้า'.
Item 10: 'clown loaches' as 'ปลาหมูข้างลาย' is wrong; use 'ปลาหมูอารีย์' / 'โคลนโลช'.
Item 10: 'otocinclus' as 'ปลาอ็อตโต' is fine, but 'ปลาซิลเวอร์ดอลลาร์' and 'ปลาออสก้าร์' ok; 'Jack Dempsey' as 'แจ็คเดมป์ซีย์' fine. 'killifish' = 'ปลาคิลลี่' ok.
Item 7: 'dry start' left in English; add Thai e.g. 'วิธีเซ็ตตู้แบบแห้ง (dry start)'.
Item 7: 'สีซีดผิดปกติ' for 'Discoloration' narrows meaning; use 'สีใบผิดปกติ'.
Item 7: 'ใบล่างโหรงเหรง' for 'Leggy bottom leaves' is ok but 'ใบล่างจะตาย' loses 'die back' nuance; minor.
Item 3: 'El Chaco boliviano' rendered 'แถบชาโกของโบลิเวีย' and 'Sierra de Amambay' as 'เทือกเขาอามัมไบ' – fine; 'ปลาซิวหางแดง' is main factual error.
Item 3: "ไม่จุกจิก" is slightly colloquial/redundant next to "เลี้ยงง่าย"; could simplify to "เลี้ยงง่าย เหมาะกับมือใหม่".
Item 3: "ใบแผ่เป็นรูปพัด" for "fanned" is fine, but "ตัดกับสีอื่น" is vague; "สีเขียวสดช่วยสร้างความตัดกัน" would be more natural.
Item 3: "Hottonia" is left in Latin; add Thai name (e.g., ผักกาดน้ำ/ฮอททอเนีย) if hobbyists use one, for readability.
"whitish flowers" translated as "ดอกสีขาวอมเทา" (greyish-white) – adds a colour not in the source; use "ดอกสีขาวอมครีม/ขาวนวล" or just "ดอกสีขาว".
"significant partial water change" → "เปลี่ยนน้ำบางส่วนในปริมาณมากทุกครั้ง" reads as 'every large change'; should be "หลังเปลี่ยนน้ำบางส่วนครั้งใหญ่".

"Crooked roots" translated "รากบิดงอ" fine, but "Balling"/"Melting" "อาการละลาย" is OK; "Replacement" heading rendered "ย้ายง่าย" fine. Real issue: "Check nitrate: the plant needs nitrate (>10)" lacks unit/meaning – add "(>10 mg/L)" only if source implies; keep clear.
"Hydrocotyle leucocephala" common name "บัวบกบราซิล" is used, but the table at top keeps the English "Brazilian pennywort" in 'ชื่อสามัญ' – give the Thai name (บัวบกบราซิล) there.
"ปลาซิวข้างขวาน" is wrong for harlequin rasbora; hobbyists use "ปลาซิวฮาร์เลควิน/ปลาซิวสามเหลี่ยม".
"ปลาเตตร้า" for generic tetras OK, but "ปลาเชอรี่บาร์บ" fine; "หอยเจดีย์มาเลเซีย" for Malaysian trumpet snail is fine; "หอยเขาแกะ" for ramshorn is questionable – use "หอยแรมฮอร์น"/"หอยฝาเดียวขดแบน".
"koi" translated "ปลาคาร์พ (ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป)" – should be "ปลาคาร์พ/ปลาkoi (ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป)"; acceptable but "Jack Dempsey" fine.
"The plant needs warmer temperatures" → "ต้องการอุณหภูมิค่อนข้างอุ่น" adds 'ค่อนข้าง' (relatively) – minor addition.
"Mushroom pennywort, moneywort" left in English in 'other names'; give Thai equivalents or leave as trade names.
"Slow growth ... supply enough CO2" ok; "bamboo shrimp" → "กุ้งบามบู" better "กุ้งไผ่/กุ้งพัดลม"; "Amano" → "กุ้งยามาโตะ" is the Thai trade name, ok.
Section 8 "ปลาแพะแคระ (pygmy cory)": pygmy cory catfish is Corydoras pygmaeus (ปลาคอรี่แคระ), not 'goat fish'. Fix the term.
Section 8 "ปลาคาร์ป" for koi: use ปลาคาร์พ/ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป (koi). Plain 'carp' changes the meaning.
Section 8 "หอยเจดีย์" for Malaysian trumpet snails: use หอยเจดีย์มาเลเซีย or its usual name. The plain form is vague.
Section 8 "ตัวอ่อนแมลงปอและแมลงปอเข็ม": damselfly nymphs are ตัวอ่อนแมลงปอเข็ม. As written it reads as dragonfly nymphs plus adult damselflies.
Section 8 "กุ้งฝอยใส (ghost shrimp)": ghost shrimp is usually กุ้งแก้ว. Check this against the common name.
Section 6: "คาร์บอนน้ำ" is an unnatural rendering of liquid carbon. Use คาร์บอนน้ำ/ปุ๋ยคาร์บอนชนิดน้ำ with a clear explanation.

Section 5 "เติมฟอสเฟตเล็กน้อย" adds 'a little' (เล็กน้อย), which the English 'add some phosphate' does not say. Section 5 "เปลี่ยนน้ำในปริมาณมาก" for 'significant partial water change' drops the 'partial' sense.

Section 5 "ตัดใบส่วนเกิน" and "ละลาย" are acceptable; but 'Balling' "จับตัวเป็นก้อน" and 'Melting' headings are fine. Section 8: "ปลาหางนกยูง" is guppies and "ปลาหางดาบ" is swordtails, which are right.

Section 8 "ธาตุอาหารส่วนเกิน" and "แหล่งหาอาหาร" are fine. Section 8 "ปลาแจ็คเดมป์ซีย์" and "ปลาซิลเวอร์ดอลลาร์" are fine. Section 8: Asolene spixi is left in Latin, and 'rabbit snails' as "หอยแรบบิท" is a loose transliteration.

Item 6: "ต่อเมื่อ...เท่านั้น" says optimum growth only under strong light and soft acidic water, but the original's "does not need to be rooted" is fine. The real issue is item 7: "free excess CO2" was rendered as "ส่วนเกินจากอากาศโดยไม่ต้องเติม", which adds the claim that the CO2 comes from the air. Reword to something like "CO2 ส่วนเกินฟรี".

Item 9: "Medium lighting is enough for it to thrive" contradicts the 'high light' wording elsewhere. This is a source inconsistency, but "เติบโตได้ดี" should not be inflated. Keep it as "เพียงพอให้เติบโตได้".

Item 10: "koi" was translated as "ปลาคาร์ฟ (ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป)". Use "ปลาคาร์ป/ปลาโคอิ" instead. "Silver dollars" is better as "ปลาเหรียญเงิน/ซิลเวอร์ดอลลาร์". "Otocinclus" is "ปลาอ็อตโต", not "ออตโต้", and "หอยแรบบิท" should be "หอยแรบบิทสเนล". "Malaysian trumpet snails" as "หอยเจดีย์" is acceptable.
Item 10: "Jack Dempsey" was rendered as "แจ็คเดมซีย์", which is acceptable. "Amano shrimp" was rendered as "กุ้งยามาโตะ (อามาโน่)"; this is fine.
Item 12: "ใบเน่า/ใบเปื่อยยุ่ย" for "Melting" is inaccurate, because the text describes die-back of the emersed form. Use "อาการใบละลาย (melting)" or "ใบร่วงยุบ".
Item 12: "ปล่อยให้แผ่ไปทั่วผิวน้ำ" is fine. In the final paragraph, "การตกแต่งขอนไม้" changes the meaning of "driftwood" (ideal for driftwood setups). Reword to "ตู้ที่ตกแต่งด้วยขอนไม้".

Item 11: "Verticillata originates from America" is fine. "indoor plant" as "ไม้ประดับในบ้าน" is fine. Item 7: "Emersed in high humidity" is fine. "the dry start method ... providing unlimited CO2" is acceptable.

Item 10: "Buenos Aires tetra" is rendered as "ปลาเตตร้าบัวโนสไอเรส" and is acceptable, but "koi" is translated as "ปลาคาร์ป". Use "ปลาคาร์ฟ/ปลาkoi (ปลาแฟนซีคาร์ป)"; plain carp is a different, broader term.

Item 10: "pearl gourami" is "ปลากระดี่มุก" and is fine, but "harlequin rasbora" is "ปลาซิวข้างขวาน". That is a different species (hatchetfish-like). Use "ปลาซิวฮาร์เลควิน/ปลาซิวหนู" for Trigonostigma heteromorpha.

Item 10: "swordtails" is "ปลาหางดาบ" and "mollies" is "ปลาสอด". "ปลาสอด" is a general term for livebearers and is used for swordtail, so it is ambiguous. Use "ปลาโมลลี่" for mollies. "otocinclus" is "ปลาออตโต้", which is fine. "pygmy corydoras" is "ปลาแพนด้าแคระ", which wrongly names the panda cory; use "ปลาคอรี่แคระ".

Item 10: "Japanese trapdoor snails" is "หอยขมญี่ปุ่น". Use "หอยเจดีย์ญี่ปุ่น/หอยฝาปิดญี่ปุ่น". "ramshorn snails" is "หอยเขาแกะ", which is acceptable. "ghost shrimp" is "กุ้งฝอย", which is a different local shrimp; use "กุ้งแก้ว". The "Malaysian trumpet snail" is the "หอยเจดีย์" and is fine.
Item 10: "Basically any shrimp species" is "กุ้งได้แทบทุกชนิด", which reads as "can shrimp". Rewrite as "เลี้ยงร่วมกับกุ้งได้แทบทุกชนิด". Also "Jack Dempsey" is "แจ็คเดมซีย์", which is acceptable.

Item 2: "Whorled pennywort" is rendered as "บัวบกน้ำ" in the body text but left in English in the list. Use one consistent term. The statement that it is "a primary medicine" is a claim about the plant that was kept as is.

Item 9: "Medium lighting is enough for it to thrive" contradicts the preceding "quite demanding", but this is in the source. "Root tabs are not good" is rendered as "ปุ๋ยฝัง", which is fine. However, "Provide a photoperiod" as "ควรเปิดไฟวันละ" is fine.

Item 12: "Melting" is "ใบละลาย", but the English describes die-back of the emersed form, so "ใบเน่า/ใบเปื่อยยุ่ย" is more accurate. "Sparse or leggy" is "ต้นโปร่งหรือยืดยาว", which is fine. The leaf width "2–5 cm wide" is fine.
Item 1: "Type: Stem plant" is "ไม้ต้น (ไม้ข้อ)". Hobbyists say "ไม้ลำต้น" or "ไม้ข้อ" for stem plants; "ไม้ต้น" alone is misleading.
Item 7: "free excess CO2" is rendered as "ได้รับ CO2 ส่วนเกินจากอากาศโดยไม่ต้องเติม". This is acceptable. "Dry start" is left in English, which is fine.

Item 2: "soft, slightly acidic water" was translated as "น้ำอ่อนที่มีค่า pH เป็นกรดอ่อนเท่านั้น". The "เท่านั้น" now attaches to the water condition, and it also adds a pH value that the source doesn't give. The source says optimum growth needs both strong light and soft, slightly acidic water. Fix: "ต้นจะเติบโตได้ดีที่สุดเมื่อได้รับแสงจัดและอยู่ในน้ำอ่อนที่เป็นกรดเล็กน้อยเท่านั้น".
Item 2: "but can be used as a floating plant" was translated as "ปล่อยให้เป็นไม้ลอยน้ำได้". This is acceptable, but "แต่นำมาใช้เป็นไม้ลอยน้ำได้" is more natural.

Item 3: "Verticillata originates from America" was translated as "ทวีปอเมริกา". The source says only "America", so this is probably fine. However, the standalone "Verticillata" is awkward. Use "Hydrocotyle verticillata" or "ชนิดนี้" instead.

Item 3: "foreground plant" was translated as "ไม้หน้าตู้". This is acceptable. However, "definitely" became "อย่างแน่นอน", which is stiff. "เป็นไม้พื้นหน้าโดยแท้" or "เป็นไม้พื้นหน้าอย่างชัดเจน" would read better.
Item 3: "indoor plant" was translated as "ไม้ประดับในบ้าน". Fine, but "garden ponds" as "บ่อในสวน" could be "บ่อน้ำในสวน".
Item 3: "trailing growth form" was translated as "เลื้อยทอดไปตามพื้น". This adds "along the ground". Use "เลื้อย" or "แผ่ทอดเลื้อย" instead.

Item 4: 'Keep bundled plants in tanks where water is changed twice a week for 2 weeks' is fine, but 'anchor' is mistranslated as 'ตัวถ่วง' and 'remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2")' is rendered 'เด็ดใบออกจากโคนต้นขึ้นมาประมาณ 5 ซม.', which is fine. The real problem is 'Tropica's own nursery' becoming 'ผู้ผลิตเอง'. This drops the source name, which is allowed, so do not change it.

Item 4: 'a bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor' is rendered 'กิ่งหรือต้นอ่อนที่รวบไว้ด้วยตัวถ่วง'. 'ตัวถ่วง' is vague, so use 'แผ่นตะกั่ว/แถบตะกั่วรัดโคนต้น' to match the lead strip or anchor. Also 'กิ่ง' for 'stems' is awkward. Use 'ต้น' or 'ลำต้น'.

Item 5: 'emersed' is rendered 'ใบบก' and 'submersed' as 'ใบน้ำ', which is OK. But 'ต้นที่ปลูกแบบบก' is fine, and 'เปลี่ยนแปลงขึ้นลง' is fine. 'stagnant, oxygen-deprived water' is rendered 'น้ำนิ่งและขาดออกซิเจน', which is OK.

Item 5: 'Halfway through the first week' is rendered 'กลางสัปดาห์แรก', which is fine. 'tweezers' is rendered 'ปากคีบ'. Use 'ปากคีบ/ที่คีบไม้น้ำ' for the planting tweezers. 'กิ่ง' for 'stems' appears throughout. A stem plant's 'stem' is better as 'ลำต้น' or 'ต้น', since 'กิ่ง' means branch.

Item 5: 'it can grow like a weed at 1-8 cm per day' is rendered 'โตเร็วเหมือนวัชพืชถึงวันละ 1-8 ซม.', which is fine. 'many people remove it and plant the top half in its place' is rendered 'หลายคนจะถอนทิ้งแล้วปลูกครึ่งบนแทนที่', which is fine.

Item 6: 'Its rapid growth helps prevent algae' is OK, but 'micronutrients' is rendered 'ธาตุอาหารรอง'. 'ธาตุอาหารรอง' means secondary nutrients, a different category from micronutrients. Use 'ธาตุอาหารเสริม/จุลธาตุ'.
Item 2: 'melting' is rendered 'ละลาย', which is the common hobby term. 'Water wisteria ... 25 cm across' is fine. 'ไม้หลังตู้' and 'หน้าตู้' are fine.

Item 7: 'free of algae and pests' is rendered 'ปลอดจากตะไคร่และศัตรูพืช'. The source says 'free of algae and pests', so this is fine. 'outcompete algae' is rendered 'แย่งธาตุอาหารจากตะไคร่', which adds a nutrient claim the English does not make. Use 'เอาชนะตะไคร่' or 'แข่งกับตะไคร่'.
Item 7: 'adds visual texture' is rendered 'เพิ่มมิติ'. Use 'เพิ่มเท็กซ์เจอร์/ความโดดเด่นของพื้นผิว'. 'more needle-like leaves' is OK.

Item 2: the source is Vietnamese and gives the plant only as "Đại hồng hà". The Thai "ไฮโกรฟิลา โรซาเนอร์วิก" is acceptable but should be written as the Latin name Hygrophila polysperma 'Rosanervig', as in item 3, so the name is consistent.
Item 2: "ตัดแรง" is a little colloquial and vague for "mạnh tay". Use something like "ค่อนข้างรุนแรง".
Item 4: "ใบลายหินอ่อน" is a slightly literal rendering of "marbled leaves". "ใบลายเส้นสีชมพู" would be more natural.
Item 1: "สายพันธุ์ปรับปรุง (cultivar)" is fine, but "พันธุ์ปลูกเลี้ยง" is the more common hobby term.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Thai matches its meaning, but check that the right source was supplied.
Item 2: "Amazon Frogbit" is left in Latin letters with no Thai name. Consider adding a Thai transliteration such as "แอมะซอน ฟร็อกบิต" the first time it appears.
Item 4: "ปลากระดี่" is fine for gouramies. "ที่ชอบรากของไม้ลอย" ends abruptly; it would read better as "ที่ชอบอาศัยใกล้รากไม้ลอย".
